description: The Original Angelina is a tiny, charming patisserie that feels like a fairytale hideaway, complete with a cozy little outdoor nook. It's beloved for its delicious desserts and consistent quality over the years, with friendly staff and a magical, intimate setting.
address: 592 horeya ave, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21599

name: Salé Sucré Pâtisserie
description: Sale Sucre is a patisserie offering premium-quality desserts, with the chocolate profiterole a standout favorite. It sits among strong competitors in the area and runs on the pricier side, and a few longtime fans feel quality has slipped somewhat.
address: 74 Albert El Awal St, Baron Towers, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432008

name: Manna Patisserie
description: Manna is a patisserie with a broad selection spanning Oriental sweets and Western cakes, with the gateaux and red velvet often singled out. Staff are noted as friendly and well-organized, though some visitors find quality can be inconsistent between visits.
address: 10 Syria, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434045

name: MOKAMBO Patisserie
description: Mokambo is a long-established patisserie praised for high-quality sweets and an enticing, beautifully arranged display. The selection is extensive and home-made in style, though popular items can sell out, so booking ahead is sometimes worthwhile.
address: 17 Mostafa Fahmy, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451009

name: Mr Baker
description: Mr. Baker is a well-known Alexandria patisserie celebrated for desserts like vanilla mille-feuille and chocolate eclair, plus chocolates and party mini-sandwiches. It's a popular choice for occasions, though some find custom cakes pricey and occasionally below expectations.
address: 45 Albert El Awal St, beside Metro Market, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432061

name: Génoise Patisserie
description: Genoise is an Egyptian patisserie offering an assortment of pastries, tarts, and custom cakes built from customers' own photos. Quality and friendly service earn praise, though experiences at individual branches can vary.
address: 24 El Moaaskar El Romani St, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434045

name: Le Goût Parisien
description: Le Gout Parisien is a charming French bakery that brings a genuine taste of Paris to Alexandria, with croissants and their many variations the clear stars. The atmosphere is lovely and quality high, so arriving early is wise before the best items sell out.
address: 9 Albert El Awal St, Delta Life Compound, Smouha, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Mocambo Patisserie - Raml Station
description: This Mokambo branch at Raml Station is among Alexandria's oldest sweet shops, renowned for its choux with chantilly cream and fresh mille-feuille. It offers a wide, consistently fresh selection served by professional, helpful staff.
address: Raml Station Square, Alexandria Governorate

name: Vanilla Patisserie
description: Vanilla Patisserie is a spotless confectionery shop specializing in mini cakes and cheesecakes with strong attention to detail. Customers love the consistently fresh products, reasonable prices, and notably respectful service.
address: 185 El Horreya Rd, Al Ibrahimeya Qibli & El Hadra Bahari, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5422004

name: Alexandra Hamos
description: Alexandra Hamos is a nostalgic, long-running patisserie known for Greek-style pastries like spanakopita and tiropita alongside its mille-feuille and croissants. It carries plenty of old-world charm, though some recent visitors have raised concerns about freshness.
address: 140 Omar Lotfy, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424060

name: Sourdough
description: Sourdough is a small but cozy Alexandria bakery praised for its fresh, high-quality pastries and fair prices. Most guests highlight the superb service and welcoming feel, with only occasional reports of service slip-ups.
address: 18 mahmoud Abou El-Ola Mosque, Kafr Abdou, Alexandria Governorate

name: Marzouk Patisserie
description: Marzouk is a hidden-gem patisserie known for its stuffed petit fours and a signature treat called Cinash, essentially mini cinnamon rolls. It offers a wide range of pastries and beverages at moderate prices, with a small streetside seating area.
address: Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434005

name: NOLA Kafr Abdo
description: NOLA in Kafr Abdo is a dessert and cupcake shop offering a colorful variety of high-quality treats in a pleasant neighborhood setting. The desserts and decor win fans, though prices run a bit high and the space itself is fairly small.
address: 36 Kafr Abdou, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: Bakery House
description: Bakery House is a clean, well-organized bakery offering a wide variety of baked goods, from croissants and donuts to savory snacks. Reasonable prices and friendly service make it a dependable spot to grab a coffee and a treat.
address: 672 El Horreya Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: Elena Cakes & Sweets
description: Elena Cakes & Sweets is a specialty shop focused on Russian honey cake (Medovik), a rarity in Alexandria, founded by a Russian baker. The cake is praised as light, rich, and reasonably priced, though delivery experiences have occasionally disappointed.
address: 6 El Shaheed St, off Jules Gamal St, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: Genoise Patisserie
description: This Genoise patisserie branch offers croissants, pastries, and Oriental sweets like kunafa. Reviews are mixed, with praise for the pastries offset by complaints about service at the counter.
address: 5 Al Moaaskar Al Romani, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21613

name: Moullie’s
description: Moullie's is a dessert spot with a stylish, playful setting that even includes a ping-pong table and a relaxed, no-pressure vibe. The cheesecakes and cookies are decent, though several guests find the portions small and the prices steep.
address: 35-37 Kafr Abdou, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433115

name: Süss Kafr Abdu
description: Suss in Kafr Abdo is a stylish, minimalist pastry shop with a relaxing atmosphere and standout, attentive service. It offers a range of treats including sugar-free options, though the space leans pricey with notable VAT and service charges.
address: Ahmed Abd El-Aziz, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433113

name: La Poire
description: La Poire is a well-established Alexandria bakery and patisserie offering a broad range of sweets and reliable custom cakes for celebrations. Experiences vary by branch, with praise for professional managers tempered by occasional complaints about pricing and consistency.
address: 6W7V+RX, 35 Victor Emanuel Sq, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432063

name: Coucou Egypt
description: Coucou is a cookie shop and cafe in Kafr Abdo known for its OG cookies, mini pancakes, churros, and cookie ice cream in a bright, attractive space. The treats and friendly staff earn praise, with prices that feel high solo but reasonable when shared.
address: 38 Khaleel Basha, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433111

name: Génoise
description: This Genoise location is a patisserie and coffee shop offering tarts, cakes, mini sandwiches, and even fasting-friendly (seyami) options. Set in a quiet neighborhood, it's appreciated for fresh croissants, good coffee and juice, and reasonable prices.
address: 21 El Shafei St, Bab Sharqi & Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5423003

name: Marvel Patisserie
description: Marvel is a popular patisserie chain across Alexandria offering consistently fresh cakes and a wide range of sweets at affordable prices. Fans appreciate the friendly staff and desserts that strike a nicely balanced, not-too-sugary sweetness.
address: 16 Mostafa Kamel, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432066

name: El Saidy Patisserie
description: El Saeedy is a reliable, welcoming pastry shop known especially for its basbousa and balanced, not-overly-sweet desserts at reasonable prices. The shop is small and can get crowded, and while service is usually warm, a few have noted exceptions.
address: Saad Zaghloul Square, Raml Station Branch, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372063

name: Genoise
description: This Genoise branch is a spacious, calm patisserie and cafe suited to a morning coffee, quiet study, or a quick business meeting. The fresh bakery and good coffee earn praise, though service quality has drawn criticism at some locations.
address: 264 Abdel Salam Aref St, El Soyof Bahari, Second Montaza District, Alexandria

name: Prepy
description: Prepy is a long-established Alexandria boulangerie and patisserie in the Manshia area, open around the clock with an elegant, vintage feel. It's known for famously fresh bakery items, with the eclair a particular favorite among regulars.
address: El Mansheya El Kubra, Mansheya District, Alexandria Governorate 5361022

name: Saber Patisserie
description: Saber is an old-school patisserie with an authentic, nostalgic vibe, especially praised for its dairy-based desserts like rice pudding and Um Ali. The shop is small and better for takeaway, and while regulars find it consistent, a few delivery orders have arrived past their best.
address: El Mosheer Ahmed Ismail Rd, El Mantika El Shamalia, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber

name: Bookuccino Cafe
description: Bookuccino is a quiet, clean cafe and study library with soothing music, hot drinks, and a small curated book selection. Its calm atmosphere makes it ideal for reading, studying, or working, supported by an attentive owner who looks after guests.
address: Abou El-Arab, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Miami, Alexandria Governorate 21919

name: Moustafa Gad Restaurant - Central Bank Branch
description: Moustafa Gad's Central Bank branch is a popular Alexandria spot for breakfast and dinner, with professional staff and reliably good food at reasonable prices. Service is quick even when busy, though this branch is geared mainly toward takeaway rather than dine-in.
address: Tosson St (formerly Salah Salem), in front of the Central Bank, Raml Station, Al Attarin District, Alexandria Governorate 21121

name: Moslem Sandwich (Be Dameer) - Smouha Branch
description: Muslim Sandwich in Smouha is known for generously sized sandwiches in a wide variety of flavors at wallet-friendly prices. Packaging for delivery is solid, though some customers have experienced inconsistency in freshness and quality.
address: Hatem Mosque, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432072

name: Abs Restaurant
description: Abbas is a beloved Alexandria sandwich shop steeped in childhood nostalgia and regarded by many regulars as among the city's best. It earns consistent praise for clean preparation, good prices, and dependable quality.
address: 14 Amir El-Bahr, Emberouz WA Moharram Beik, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5413441

name: KAK Squad - Kafr Abdo
description: KAK Squad in Kafr Abdo is a cozy spot specializing in fried chicken, with the crispy breaded chicken and welcoming atmosphere winning fans. Experiences can be inconsistent, as some visitors have found the chicken or sides below par.
address: 22 Ahmed Abd El-Aziz, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433113

name: 5 Roosters Fried Chicken
description: 5 Roosters is a fried-chicken restaurant with a nice sea view and tasty, well-cooked chicken when fresh. It has potential but draws complaints about greasiness, weak air conditioning, and cleanliness, so quality can be uneven.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424074

name: Papa döner egy
description: Papa Doner is an affordable doner spot praised for flavorful food, massive portions, and standout crinkle fries. Most reviews are enthusiastic, though a few note the food can be oilier than advertised.
address: 52 El Mithaq St, Al Akbal, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Kalet El Bahr
description: Kalet El Bahr is a seaside restaurant and cafe area prized for its stunning views of the Mediterranean and a family-friendly setting. The beautiful location is the main draw, though it can become very crowded and occasionally rowdy.
address: 6V3H+C8P, Zawyet Khattab, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321317

name: The Roof Cafe
description: The Roof Cafe is a modest, affordable spot with a pleasant setting and fair prices. Service and organization can be hit or miss, and some guests have flagged cleanliness as an area for improvement.
address: Corniche, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452042

name: La Gourmandise
description: La Gourmandise is the restaurant inside the Hilton Alexandria Corniche, serving breakfast and dinner buffets with a wide spread and friendly staff. The food and service are generally enjoyable, though some find the buffet selection only adequate for the setting.
address: 544, El- Guiesh Avenue, Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Softie Egypt
description: Softie is a dessert spot popular for its boba drinks, milkshakes, ice cream, and mochi in a calm, comforting space. The drinks are generously filled and tasty, though some find the menu pricey for the portions and delivery packaging lacking.
address: 42 Abd Al Aziz Agamea, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433112

name: Azza Ice Cream
description: Azza is one of Alexandria's oldest and most authentic ice cream shops, located in Bahary with a pleasant streetside setting. The gelato, particularly mango and lemon, earns high praise at affordable prices, though opinions on some flavors like chocolate are mixed.
address: 11 26th of July Rd, El Anfoushi, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321381

name: Fresco Gelateria
description: Fresco Gelateria is known for fresh, creamy gelato in innovative flavors, with tiramisu among the favorites. The quality and variety stand out, though some find the flavors a touch too sweet and the interior fairly plain.
address: 29 El Ismailia St, Kafr Abdou, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Nezamy Ice Cream
description: El Nezamy is a classic 1950s-style ice cream parlor celebrated for natural flavors and its signature vanilla milk scoop. Generous portions, friendly staff, a sea view, and a notable Um Ali round out a nostalgic experience.
address: 15-16 El Geish Rd, Eastern Harbour seafront, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321382

name: Sultana Ice Cream
description: Sultana, in the heart of Kafr Abdo, is known for top-quality ice cream served in hand-made cones along with ice cream tarts and bowls in flavors like Lotus and chocolate. Quality is a consistent highlight, with limited parking the main drawback.
address: Saint Geni Square, Abu El Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433111

name: Omaya Ice Cream
description: Omaya is one of the most popular ice cream shops in Alexandria, known for its creamy, Syrian-style ice cream and wide range of inventive and classic flavors. Friendly service, quick orders, and moderate prices add to its broad appeal.
address: 72F4+G7M, Gamal Abd El-Nasir Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526024

name: Makram ice cream
description: Makram is a traditional ice cream shop serving since 1948 from a single, old-fashioned location, with a deep, creamy vanilla as its staple. Loyal fans love its consistency and value, though its antique look and casual handling aren't for everyone.
address: Kasr Al Tin, Zawya Khattab, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321321

name: Angelina Kyria Pâtisserie
description: Angelina Kyria is a patisserie renowned for its kahk and kunafa made with high-quality ingredients and fresh nut fillings. It also handles custom celebration cakes well and earns strong praise for its customer service, with only occasional order disputes.
address: Behind 63 and 65 Fouad St, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21517

name: Ice Cream Aza
description: Ice Cream Aza serves natural-tasting ice cream at very affordable prices, with strawberry and chocolate among the favorites. Conveniently near the Citadel, it's a worthwhile stop, though one or two visitors have questioned upselling at the counter.
address: 6V2Q+J85, El-Gaish Rd, Souq at Tork, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361030

name: Just smash
description: Just Smash is a burger spot whose Iconic burger and loaded fries draw praise for flavor. Experiences are uneven, with some customers reporting portions smaller than advertised or issues with delivery orders.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: fifter burger
description: Fifter is a smash-burger joint earning enthusiastic reviews for tasty, high-quality burgers and friendly staff. There's no dine-in space, but regulars consider it among the better burger options around and wish for more branches.
address: 313 Mostafa Kamel, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433010

name: Smokery Burger, Alexandria
description: Smokery Burger combines Nashville-style fried chicken with smash burgers, giving guests a taste of both in one stop. The burgers are well-cooked, though some find the advertised spice levels mild and portions on certain items small, and dine-in is limited.
address: 150 Ahmed Kamha, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423030

name: Holmes Burgers ,Roshdy
description: Holmes Burgers in Roshdy is a long-running favorite known for great burgers, a clean space, and helpful staff, with the Hangover and cheesy mushroom sandwiches standing out. Dine-in is the way to go, as some delivery orders have arrived soggy from excess sauce.
address: 6WJW+VHQ, Al Moaaskar Al Romani, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434046

name: Texas Fill & Refill
description: Texas Fill & Refill is a vintage-styled diner with a cool look, tasty burgers, and standout mozzarella sticks served in generous, filling portions. The space can feel cramped and service is sometimes inexperienced, but the friendly atmosphere wins guests over.
address: Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: Bruxie's Kafr Abdo
description: Bruxie's in Kafr Abdo is a small but well-regarded spot serving an excellent breakfast menu and one of the better American burgers in Alexandria. Good coffee, a notable carrot cake, two-floor seating, and 24-hour delivery add to its appeal.
address: 26 Sant Giyn, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433113

name: Dopamine Burger
description: Dopamine Burger is praised for fresh ingredients and burgers that taste genuine rather than artificial, served by friendly, professional staff. The classic burgers are a highlight, though some wish the sandwiches were a little larger.
address: 456 El Horreya Rd, above Kabnoury Co., Fleming, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5450101

name: Tac
description: TAC is an American-style restaurant known for its buffalo wings with ranch, chili fries, burgers, and pizza. Quality is reliably consistent, with the Mac & cheese and crispy chicken among the dishes guests rave about.
address: 12 Tout Ankh Amoun, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432020

name: Buffalo Burger - Semoha
description: Buffalo Burger in Smouha is a fast-food burger chain branch with sharply mixed reviews. Some praise consistent food and friendly service, while others report bland seasoning, mediocre meat, and unhelpful staff.
address: El-Shaheed Tayar Mahmoud Shakir Abd El-Moneim, St, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21646

name: Kcal's
description: Kcal's is a burger spot earning strong reviews for its Big K burger, light-yet-sturdy bread, and well-seasoned, not-greasy patties. Fast, polite service and tasty sides like mozzarella sticks and fries round out the experience.
address: 10 Hausop, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433114

name: Wales Burger
description: Wales Burger is a smash-burger spot with mixed opinions: the cheese-and-bacon fries are a favorite and the burgers can be rich and savory. Some find them well worth it, while others feel the patties are ordinary and pricey for the size.
address: 41 Abdel Hamid Badawi St, second building from Soter St, Alexandria Governorate 21529

name: Burger Masr
description: Burger Masr is a small but popular spot serving big, filling burgers with generous fries at very friendly prices. Delicious food and excellent service make it a strong value, with the limited seating its only real constraint.
address: 22 off Gamal Abdel Nasser Rd, Alexandria Governorate

name: Burger El Mazag
description: Burger El Mazag is a clean, family-friendly restaurant praised for tasty food and good value, including well-regarded breakfast and suhoor options. Friendly, helpful staff and fresh ingredients make for a consistently pleasant visit.
address: 6W7X+48F, Hatem Mosque, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432072

name: Pretzel burgers
description: Pretzel Burgers is a stylish, seaside burger spot praised for juicy, flavorful beef burgers, soft buns, and crispy fries. Service is fast and the cozy waterfront setting adds to a consistently enjoyable experience.
address: behind The Tunnel (the Hyper), next to Toscanini Cafe, seafront, Alexandria Governorate 21617

name: Burger Spot
description: Burger Spot is a clean, attractively designed open-air burger place with a pleasant look and quick preparation. Opinions on the food are split, with some praising it and others finding the burgers heavy on sauce and pricey for what's offered.
address: Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Crow's
description: Crow's is a cafe and smash-burger spot known for its distinctive Sweet BBQ and Crows smash burgers, fair prices, and professional, friendly service. The burgers are the highlight, though the coffee can be inconsistent.
address: 6W6P+6C2, Tout Ankh Amoun, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432020

name: 3B Burger
description: 3B Burger is a well-regarded Alexandria burger shop offering tasty burgers with melted cheese and a free salad-bar refill. Service is quick and friendly, though some regulars feel the quality and beverage selection could improve.
address: El Fardous St, beside Kheir Zaman, Pharmacists' Buildings, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: Buffalo Burger - Sidi Gaber
description: Buffalo Burger in Sidi Gaber is a fast-food burger branch praised for flavorful, good-quality food, friendly staff, and a complimentary ice cream after the meal. Service is usually a strength, though a few visitors have experienced longer waits.
address: Al Mashir Street City Square Mall, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21519

name: Maltut
description: Maltut is a pizza and pies spot known for elaborate, well-made pies and respectful, superb service. The food earns strong praise, with the main drawback being the lack of a proper dining area.
address: Port Said St, Camp Chezar, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate

name: Ciao pizza
description: Ciao Pizza is regarded by many as among the best in Alexandria, with its dough the standout and the chicken ranch a recommended pick. Quality can be uneven, as some delivery orders and dishes have disappointed.
address: El-Fardous, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432073

name: Diego's Pizza
description: Diego's Pizza offers tasty pizzas with popular toppings like chicken ranch in a large, air-conditioned space with quick service. Reviews are mixed, with praise for taste and value offset by serious complaints about hygiene.
address: 200 Abdel Salam Aref St, Louran, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Forno pizza
description: Forno Pizza is a popular pizza spot famous for its enormous, hot cheese pull and flavorful pizzas like the ranch chicken. Consistently good taste makes it a favorite for takeaway and a place fans return to.
address: 47 Al Naby Danyal, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372021

name: Pub’s Pizza
description: Pub's Pizza is a welcoming pizza spot with classy service, fresh ingredients, and a perfect crust, with the shrimp and crispy chicken pizzas singled out. Excellent value and a pleasant atmosphere make it a go-to for many.
address: 6W6X+XR8, Hatem Mosque, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432072

name: Pizza Roma.Q
description: Pizza Roma.Q serves pizzas and pasta with the chicken ranch among its more reliable options. Reviews lean critical, with several customers citing declining quality, rising prices, and underwhelming dishes.
address: Hatem Mosque St, Restaurants Complex, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432072

name: Pizza Hut | Roshdy
description: This Pizza Hut branch in Roshdy is valued for its easy location, nice view, comfortable seating, and helpful staff. Experiences with the pizza itself vary, with some finding the crust bland or oily and others enjoying fresh, authentic-tasting pies.
address: 238 Roushdy, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434046

name: Pizza Hut | Glim Alex
description: The Pizza Hut branch in Gleem is known for a clean, calm setting with a nice view and quick service. Most guests praise the friendly staff and fresh, hot pizza, though a few have found the food oily or service lacking.
address: 360 El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452032

name: Pizza Class
description: Pizza Class is a tidy pizza spot praised for its appealing cheese assortment and decent quality at slightly high but reasonable prices. Some recent visitors have reported cold deliveries, smaller fillings, and slower service.
address: El Mahmoudeya Axis St, El Hadra El Gedida, Bab Sharqi District, Alexandria Governorate 5420123

name: What the crust
description: What the Crust is considered one of Alexandria's best pizza spots, with expertly made dough and a crispy edge that fans rave about. The pizzas are delicious, though prices run on the higher side.
address: Green Plaza, Ezbet El Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Pizza Station - Alexandria - Sidi Bishr
description: Pizza Station in Sidi Bishr is a pizza spot with mixed reviews, ranging from satisfied customers praising good food, fair prices, and polite staff to others citing soft crust and delivery delays. Experiences appear to vary considerably by visit.
address: 17 Al Shahid Abbas Suleiman Al Aaser, As Soyouf Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517072

name: Brimo Pizza
description: Brimo Pizza is a Pizza spot in Alexandria.
address: 7 Kamal El Din Salah St, Tabarak 1 Building, Smouha, Alexandria Governorate 21431

name: El Hattab Pizza
description: Pizza El Hattab is frequently called one of the best pizzerias in Alexandria, prized for its bold wood-fired flavors, fluffy-yet-crispy crust, and standout sauce. Fast delivery and generous, melty toppings round out a beloved experience.
address: 91 Gamal Abdel Nasser Rd, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate 21515

name: Go sushi
description: Go Sushi is a small, affordable sushi shop offering good-quality combo rolls and notably flexible, polite service, including delivery to far-off areas. Most experiences are positive, with the modest setting its main limitation.
address: 12 Badr El-Deen, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451003

name: Dojo Egypt
description: Dojo Egypt is a martial arts school and training facility with professional coaches, a large open-air space, and varied equipment, well-suited for beginners and competitors alike. Reviews are mixed, with strong praise for the training offset by complaints about management and reception.
address: 6X47+JCP, Green Plaza, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Mori Sushi - Designia Mall
description: Mori Sushi at Designia Mall is a branch of the well-known chain offering good-quality sushi in a cozy, welcoming setting with easy parking. Friendly service and reliable food make it a comfortable choice, including for first-time sushi diners.
address: Designia Mall, Desert Road Sector, Alexandria Governorate

name: SUSHIRITO
description: Sushirito is a sushi bar with sharply divided reviews: fans praise fresh, generous combos while critics report poor packaging and freshness issues, especially with delivery. Experiences appear inconsistent, so results can vary.
address: 27 Abd Al Aziz Agamea St, Alexandria Governorate

name: Deba sushi
description: Deba Sushi is a sushi restaurant with mixed feedback, earning praise from some for warm service and attentive presentation while others find the rice and fish lacking and the service slow. Quality seems to vary noticeably between visits.
address: Bridge, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Sashimi Sushi Bar
description: Sashimi Sushi Bar offers sushi with decent ingredients and pleasant flavors, though reviews are mixed and lean critical. Some return happily while others cite small portions, poor packaging, and inconsistent cleanliness.
address: 28 Kafr Abdou, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433115

name: Ginger Restaurant
description: Ginger is an Asian and sushi restaurant whose reviews skew negative, with complaints about small portions, freshness, and service outweighing the positives. Some dishes are acceptable, but many find it overpriced for the experience.
address: 6X48+C57, Green Plaza, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Sofia’s sushi
description: Sofia's Sushi is a sushi spot that draws frequent complaints about long waits and management, though its ingredients can be tasty. Several reviewers suggest it works better for takeaway than dine-in.
address: 441 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452058

name: NORI SUCHI &Coffee
description: Nori Sushi & Coffee is a cafe and sushi spot whose sushi divides opinion, with several reviewers feeling it lacks authentic flavor and quality. A few have had good delivery experiences, but expectations should be set accordingly.
address: 127 Ahmed Shawqi St on the tram line, El Moaaskar El Romani, Abu El Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: Qaryah Malaysia Restaurant
description: Qaryah Malaysia is a rare spot for authentic Malaysian cuisine in Alexandria, offering flavorful, affordable dishes in a comfortable setting. The food and quick service earn praise, though the decor is plain and the menu could be broader.
address: 18 Sero Setries, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372012

name: Sake sushi
description: Sake Sushi is considered one of the best sushi restaurants in Alexandria, with a clever chef and very tasty food. The place is small but has a nice atmosphere and is well worth a visit.
address: St.front Deeb mall, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433132

name: OSCA Lounge
description: OSCA Lounge is a restaurant serving Italian dishes in a comfortable, well-designed space with a nice view, popular for breakfast. The food and polite staff earn praise, with only occasional service slip-ups noted.
address: Point 6 mall 6, Street 6, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434044

name: Signature - The Black Villa...!
description: Signature - The Black Villa is an elegant, cozy restaurant with unique aesthetics and a comfortable outdoor area, well-suited for dates and gatherings. Warm service and dishes like its pizza have made it a fast favorite for many.
address: Diab, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451007

name: Gabati & Ma'oun
description: Jabati w Maoon is a casual spot specializing in chapati, with the Kraft cheese chapati a favorite and karak tea on offer. Quality and management earn praise, though some find the chapati portions small or the food occasionally over-salted.
address: 127 Galal El Desouki St, Bab Sharqi & Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21563

name: Taamia (Falafel)
description: This is one of the oldest falafel (taamia) shops in Alexandria, located on Al-Moshir Street with a nostalgic local reputation. Longtime customers note the falafel is still fairly good, though quality is felt to have declined over the years.
address: El Mosheer Ahmed Ismail St, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433051

name: Khawater Demeshkeya
description: Khawater Demeshkeya is a Syrian restaurant with comfortable seating and a varied menu, but reviews lean negative. Several guests have reported cleanliness issues, small portions, and disappointing taste, with experiences varying widely.
address: Hatem Mosque St, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 22743

name: El Raya El Demeshkaya Restaurant
description: El Raya El Demeshkaya is a Syrian restaurant popular with students and locals for its beef shawarma, friendly staff, and good prices. Most experiences are positive, though some longtime customers feel quality has slipped recently.
address: 379 Port Said St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5424041

name: Al-Awafi Damascene Restaurant - Cleopatra
description: El Awafy El Demeshky in Cleopatra is a Syrian spot praised for shawarma made with real meat, moderate prices, and tasty sides like cheese-topped potatoes. The main drawback is slow service, with some waits longer than expected.
address: 10 El-Lewaa Ahmed Ali, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433023

name: Layali El Sham
description: Layali El Sham is a Syrian restaurant serving flavorful, well-liked food in a frequently busy setting. Most guests are satisfied, though a few have noted rigid pickup policies and crowding.
address: 7X9V+MM8, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517275

name: Bawabet El Sham
description: Bawabet El Sham is a Syrian spot known for beef shawarma, roasted chicken, Syrian saj bread, and fries with garlic sauce, plus notably fast delivery. In-store service can be slow during busy times, but the food keeps fans coming back.
address: 12 Mostafa Fahmy, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451008

name: El Reef El Shami
description: El Reef El Shamy is a Syrian restaurant offering traditional dishes, with generally good food. Service and wait times draw criticism, however, and some find items like the fries and garlic sauce inconsistent.
address: Emberouz WA Moharram Beik, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 21515

name: Karam El Sham
description: Karam El Sham is a popular Syrian restaurant offering good portions at affordable prices, with the fattah, grilled chicken, and sandwiches earning praise. Long waits and crowding during peak times are the main downsides.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526016

name: Sanabel Layali El Sham Syrian Cuisine
description: Sanabel Layali El Sham is a neighborhood Syrian eatery with normal prices and a mixed reputation. Some enjoy the food, while others have flagged customer service and delivery packaging as areas needing improvement.
address: Sidi Beshr Qebli, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5516348

name: Set El Sham Syrian Restaurant
description: Set El Sham is a Syrian restaurant where the Syrian dishes, especially the shawarma, win the most praise for taste and value. Non-Syrian items and the dining area are considered less impressive, so the Syrian menu is the safer bet.
address: 14 Ras El Tin Palace, Alexandria Governorate 21513

name: Rawan El Sham Restaurant
description: Rawan El Sham is a Syrian restaurant offering takeaway and delivery with uneven reviews. Some praise the taste while others find the food and service in need of improvement.
address: Al Galaa, Al Qasaei Qebli, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5447451

name: El Shamy Restaurant - El Bait El Kabier
description: El Shamy (El Bait El Kabier) is a Syrian restaurant praised for genuinely delicious food, a beautiful setting, and respectful, appreciative staff. It's well-liked for both dine-in and delivery, with some wishing for slightly larger portions.
address: 14th of May Rd, Smouha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Abo Fares El Sory
description: Abo Fares El Sory is a Syrian restaurant with nicely decorated indoor seating and well-regarded dishes like shawarma fatta. Quality stands out for many, though some find the value and portion sizes disappointing.
address: Iskandar Ibrahim St, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza District, Alexandria Governorate 5517280

name: Sham Levantine & Syrian Cuisine
description: Sham is a Levantine and Syrian spot whose shawarma earns high praise from many as among the best around, while others have found it inconsistent. The crepes and fresh chicken are also noted, with experiences varying by visit.
address: Riad, Al Aqesa WA Baqos, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5450212

name: El Dayyash Syrian
description: El Dayash El Soory is a small Syrian eatery with a mostly warm local reputation for friendly people and a pleasant setting. Reviews are generally short and positive, with the occasional complaint about reliability.
address: Ezbet El Maraghi, El Mohageren, Third Montaza, Alexandria Governorate

name: Wardet Dimashq Restaurant
description: Wardet Demashk is a tidy Syrian spot praised for clean food preparation, orderly service, and very reasonable prices. It's a dependable choice for takeaway with a solid local reputation.
address: El Wehda St, off El Malek St

name: Layaly El Sham Restaurant
description: Layaly El Sham is a Syrian restaurant with a vast menu and affordable prices. The food can be excellent, but reviews frequently criticize the order-taking and report inconsistency in portions and freshness.
address: Estoret Louran Tower, Btal Al Islam, As Soyouf Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451112

name: Abu Omar Syrian Restaurant
description: Abu Omar El Soury is a Syrian restaurant whose reviews skew strongly negative, with complaints about declining quality, small portions, and service. Some also question how authentically Syrian the food really is, so expectations should be modest.
address: 30-5, El-Shaikh El-Sayed Ramadan, Sidi Beshr Qebli, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517160

name: Ibn El Sham
description: Ibn El Sham is a Syrian spot offering meat pies, made-to-order pizzas, hawawshi, and pasta with simple but flavorful results and friendly people. Most takeaway experiences are positive, though there has been at least one hygiene complaint.
address: El Ibrahimeya, off El Geish Rd

name: Zaman El Khair Syrian
description: Zaman El Kheir El Soury is a Syrian restaurant praised by regulars for clean, high-quality shawarma cut in thick slices. However, several customers have reported serious problems with delivery times and service.
address: El Saraya Towers, El Nasr St (Adel Abu Zahra), in front of Green Plaza, Alexandria Governorate

name: Al-Baik Syrian Restaurant
description: El Beik El Soury is a Syrian eatery praised for delicious, clean food at unexpectedly reasonable prices and efficient staff. Most reviews are enthusiastic, with only the occasional dissenting experience.
address: in front of Beit El Ezz, El Bitash

name: Al-Baik El Shami - Mahrousa Tunnel St.
description: El Beik El Shamy on Mahrousa Tunnel Street is a popular Syrian fast-food spot known for its Syrian falafel, loaded fries sandwiches, and spiced rotisserie chicken at great value. Some regulars note recent price increases and occasional service issues.
address: El Mahrousa Tunnel St from the sea, Montaza, Alexandria

name: Syrian Chicken House
description: Syrian Chicken House is a Syrian spot with divided reviews, ranging from loyal multi-year fans to others disappointed by the burgers and shawarma. The crispy items earn some praise, but overall consistency is a question mark.
address: 13 Cairo St, Sidi Bishr Qibli, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate 5516401

name: Tekram aynak Khoutat Demeshk
description: Tekram Aynak (Khoutat Demeshk) is a Syrian spot geared toward delivery with low fees, offering large shawarma portions and a varied menu at affordable prices in a clean setting. Service can be slow when busy, which regulars take as a sign of its popularity.
address: 345 Mostafa Fahmy St, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452031

name: Rabea Al Shaam
description: Rabea Al Shaam is a fast-food spot in Asafra praised for delicious, clean food, quick service, and good value. It's a reliable everyday choice for breakfast or lunch with a loyal local following.
address: Salman El-Farsi, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526020

name: Aleppo Shawarma - Syrian Cuisine
description: Shawarma Halab is a Syrian shawarma spot with polarized reviews: some praise it as among the cleanest shawarma around with polite staff, while others report billing, portion, and service problems. Experiences vary, so results may differ.
address: Khaleel Hamada, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517250

name: Elbait Elsoori
description: Elbait Elsoori is a Syrian shawarma spot praised for clean, tasty food, fat-free shawarma, standout potato seasoning, and a low fixed delivery fee. Most reviews are positive, with occasional complaints about portion size on delivery orders.
address: 82 Abdel Aziz Ahmed St, No. 17, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate

name: Baba Doqni
description: Baba Doani is a budget-friendly sandwich spot known for huge, well-priced sandwiches, with the potato and shish tawook sandwiches especially recommended. It's a great-value choice for a filling, casual meal.
address: El Mandara Bahari, beside El Tawheed Mosque, Alexandria

name: Minouche Pizza
description: Minouche is a long-running pizza spot, in business for decades, that tastes good when eaten fresh on the spot. Delivery and recent experiences have drawn many complaints about presentation, temperature, and pricing, however.
address: 399 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Stefano's Restaurant
description: Stefano's is an upscale Italian restaurant with gorgeous decor, attentive service, and standout dishes like truffle risotto, veal fagottini, and seafood risotto. It's among the finest dining in Alexandria, with prices to match and notable care for dietary needs.
address: 399 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21599

name: Teatro Eskendria
description: Teatro Eskendria is a cafe in a pleasant spot on Fouad Street with a nostalgic feel, serving dishes like fried chicken with potatoes. Reviews are mixed, with some enjoying the food and others citing service and quality concerns.
address: 5WW3+F57, Al Shawa, Kom Ad Dakah Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371041

name: The Alexandria Deli
description: The Alexandria Deli is an art-filled, cozy deli and cafe that feels like dining inside a gallery, run by hands-on, friendly owners. It's celebrated for excellent coffee and a warm, laid-back atmosphere, a genuine hidden gem.
address: 27 Mohamed Darwish, Street, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433113

name: El Haresh Liver Sandwich
description: El Haresh is a takeaway spot for Alexandria's famous street food, the Alexandrian liver (kebda eskandarani), served as a simple, tasty sandwich. It focuses on liver alone, which fans find very good, though the spice level may not suit everyone.
address: 42 El Mosheer Ahmed Ismail St, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria

name: Heresh liver shop
description: Heresh liver shop is a sandwich shop in Alexandria.
address: 7 Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517074

name: MORE IN
description: More In is a sandwich shop whose reviews skew negative, with complaints that the food doesn't match its ads and that service is poor. A few items like the chicken sandwich have pleased, but experiences are uneven.
address: Safia Zaghloul St, Raml Station Square, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: Wahba
description: Wahba is a specialist in Alexandrian liver (kebda) and heart sandwiches, prepared fresh to order and served hot, with some dine-in seating. Many consider it among the best for kebda in the city, though a few have found ingredients inconsistent.
address: 5 Mahmoud Azmy, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372013

name: Mouslim
description: Mouslim is a sandwich spot offering large, tasty sandwiches in two sizes, with the meat sandwiches and coleslaw earning praise. Affordable prices, generous portions, and good service from order to delivery make it a solid choice.
address: Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517180

name: Meso Kebda
description: Meso Kebda is a popular Alexandrian fast-food spot specializing in Egyptian-style liver (kebda), usually served in sandwiches with fresh bread and tahina. It is a quick, budget-friendly choice for a hearty street-food meal.
address: 101 Ibn Al Anbare, Emberouz WA Moharram Beik, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5413376

name: Wahba Sultan El Kebda
description: Wahba Sultan El Kebda is a beloved spot for Alexandrian liver, praised for a well-balanced spice mix, a standout Shami sandwich, cleanliness, and good prices. Tucked in an alley between Orabi and Salah Salem streets, many call it the best liver in the city.
address: 31 Passage, Al Attarin Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372004

name: Aseel
description: Aseel serves authentic Egyptian cuisine in a clean, quiet setting with a warm welcome and a wide variety of dishes, including vegetarian options. Generous portions, freshly made bread, friendly service, and fair prices earn it consistent praise.
address: 35 Bahaa El Din El Ghatoury St, El Gawza 1 Tower, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432065

name: El Araby Kebda
description: Kebda El Araby is a sandwich shop serving tasty Egyptian liver (kebda) with fast service, reasonable prices, and fresh ingredients. The food is well-liked, though service experiences can be uneven.
address: 53 Khaled Ibn Al Walid, As Soyouf Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517047

name: El Habashi Kebda - Nasr St.
description: El Habashy on El Nasr Street is a liver (kebda) spot praised for some of the best Alexandrian liver around, served with potatoes, grilled sausage, pickles, and tahini at excellent prices. The food and hospitality win fans, though the seating and service are fairly basic.
address: El Nasr St, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5360020

name: Dallah
description: Dallah is a relaxed spot popular for breakfast, with fresh, beautifully presented food, good coffee, and a calm, welcoming atmosphere best enjoyed from a sea-view table. Friendly service and fair value are highlights, though the desserts can disappoint.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Harsh Kebda
description: Kebda El Harsh is a modest spot focused on Alexandrian liver and sausage sandwiches, with liver that most find tasty. The street-side seating attracts stray cats and cleanliness can be inconsistent, so takeaway is often the better option.
address: Selma St, Layla Al Akhylayah, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Araby Kebda - Bahary
description: Kebda El Araby in Bahary is a well-regarded oriental street-food spot serving distinctive Alexandrian liver, meat, sandwiches, and good salads in the old town. Staff are friendly and helpful, with prices that lean slightly high and street-only parking.
address: 4 El-Sayed Mohammed Karim, Al Mazar, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321383

name: Fahmy Kebda
description: Kebda Fahmy is a favorite for affordable, delicious Alexandrian-style liver, served in a clean setting. Seating is on the street, but the traditional food and value keep liver lovers coming back.
address: 13 Sidi Metwally, Al Attarin Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371010

name: Abu Ahmed Macaroni
description: Macarona Abu Ahmed is a casual, kid-friendly spot serving tasty traditional dishes at budget prices. The food earns praise for its flavor and the service is friendly and quick.
address: El Wardian, in front of El Wardian Military Secondary School, Alexandria Governorate 5332242

name: Kebdet Samy
description: Kebdet Samy is a hidden-gem oriental eatery known for using fresh local meat and serving authentic dishes, with the liver especially recommended. Reasonable prices and hospitable staff make it popular with locals, though quality can occasionally slip.
address: 28 El-Sayed Mohammed Karim, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321381

name: Dokkan Balady
description: Dokkan Balady is an Egyptian spot with a lovely view and warm hospitality, with dishes like butterfly shrimp drawing praise. Some recent visitors feel quality and attention to orders have declined, so experiences can vary.
address: 315 El Geish Rd, Stanley, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21221

name: Shehab Butchery
description: Shehab Butchery is a meat products store in Alexandria.
address: 97 Abd El-Salam Aref, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451009

name: Abu Ammar Al-Souri Restaurant
description: Abu Ammar Al-Souri is a Syrian restaurant offering chicken shawarma, sandwiches, pizza, and Syrian pies with fast takeaway and delivery. Reviews are sharply divided, with longtime fans praising the variety while others report declining quality and cleanliness.
address: 27 Ismail Zaki Ahmed, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433126

name: Smash It Fouad Street
description: Smash It on Fouad Street is a smash-burger spot that, at its best, serves hot, flavorful, high-quality burgers with polite, friendly service. Experiences are inconsistent, however, with complaints about packaging, value, and mismatched online menus.
address: 21517, 73 El-Horeya Rd, Kom Ad Dakah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21517

name: Nawar Food court
description: Nawar is a centrally located food court bringing together several restaurants and cafes with something for most tastes at reasonable prices. It's convenient and varied, though service and atmosphere can be hit or miss depending on the outlet.
address: 41 Dinkrat St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424002

name: KAK Squad - Fouad Street
description: KAK Squad on Fouad Street is a fried-chicken spot praised for tasty sandwiches and fries and notably friendly, welcoming staff. Some find the portions a little small or the sauces not to their taste, but most experiences are positive.
address: 6 El-Horeya Rd, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372013

name: Bruxie’s Fouad Street
description: Bruxie's on Fouad Street is a welcoming cafe known for good coffee, including a standout Irish coffee, and friendly hospitality. The food and coffee win regulars, though some find quality and prices inconsistent across the menu.
address: 67 el Horeya road, Fouad, Alexandria Governorate

name: Flare Hot Chicken
description: Flare Hot Chicken specializes in Nashville-style fried chicken with generous portions, tasty sauces, and good fries. The heat can be intense even at lower levels, and some report inconsistency in presentation and service across visits.
address: 66 Fouad, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372013

name: Abu Janna Restaurant
description: Abu Genna is a casual spot popular for late-night sandwiches and small bites that fans say are well worth a try despite the modest look. Reviews are mostly positive, with a few noting concerns about cleanliness and consistency.
address: Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432073

name: Nexus
description: Nexus is a large, spacious cafe and restaurant in a calm location, handy near the train station, with waffles among the recommended items. Experiences vary, with praise for the coffee and space offset by complaints about service, cleanliness, and air conditioning.
address: Fouad, St, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: The truck
description: The Truck is a garden-seating street cafe that's cosy in winter and pleasant in the evenings, with fresh air and a peaceful setting. Many find it pricey for the quality, and some have noted cleanliness issues with stray cats and flies.
address: 11 Vectoria Basseli, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423001

name: La Petite Boulange
description: La Petite Boulange is a cozy cafe and bakery beloved for flaky, buttery croissants, fresh pastries, and excellent coffee, served by warm, friendly staff. The space is small with closely spaced tables, but the quality and atmosphere more than make up for it.
address: 48 Fouad Street, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372013

name: Fernando's
description: Fernando's is an Italian restaurant with attractive decor, a rich menu, and delicious food served by friendly, professional staff. The beverage options are limited and a few service quirks have been noted, but the overall experience is well-regarded.
address: 55 El Horreya Rd (Fouad St), El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: Omar Rest House
description: Omar Rest House is a convenient stop midway between Cairo and Alexandria for prayer, a rest, and a snack or meal. The food is decent, though some find the prices high for what's offered.
address: 5WQF+QCH, Cairo - Alexandria Desert Rd, Emberouz WA Moharram Beik, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5413381

name: Mcdonald's - Foaad Street Branch
description: This McDonald's on Fouad Street is a cozy, larger-than-usual branch with a classic wooden interior, pleasant background music, and reliably fresh fries. Most visits are comfortable, though a few guests have reported inconsistent service.
address: 331 El Horreya Rd, Sidi Gaber, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371082

name: Fever
description: Fever is a long-standing Alexandria night spot and bar offering attentive service and appetizers from the well-known Santa Lucia kitchen. It maintains a selective, quality-focused atmosphere, though the space is small and drinks are pricey.
address: 5WX3+69Q, Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372024

name: Cheese House
description: Cheese House is a casual spot offering a range of restaurant-style meals, including pizza, at reasonable prices. Service and value earn praise from many, though a few have found the menu and execution a bit confusing.
address: 12 Al Manzalawi, Emberouz WA Moharram Beik, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5413354

name: Itehad Iskandary Sandwiches
description: Itehad Iskandary is a budget-friendly sandwich shop serving Alexandrian favorites like grilled kebda, sakalans, and grilled meat, with fast, professional service even when crowded. The food is best eaten hot, and many regulars consider it a real local treasure.
address: 21 El-Shaheed Gawad Housny, Al Ibrahimeyah Qebli WA Al Hadrah Bahri, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5422060

name: Abou Helmi Kebda
description: Abou Helmi is a landmark liver spot in El Mansheya, beloved for its Alexandrian liver sandwiches on fresh bread and quick service. It's best for takeaway given the limited seating, and the street-side setting attracts stray cats.
address: Hamid Ali Abou Goumah, Souq at Tork, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361013

name: Jordanian Tabkha Restaurant - Alexandria
description: This Jordanian kitchen in Alexandria is a go-to for authentic, home-style Jordanian food in a clean, welcoming setting near Al-Moftah Mosque. Fresh dishes and warm, friendly hospitality make it highly recommended for fans of Jordanian cuisine.
address: Al Helmeya, Emberouz WA Moharram Beik, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5415135

name: Am Amin Kebda
description: Kebda Am Amin is a clean, well-liked spot for Alexandrian-style liver near Raml Station, with good taste and reasonable prices. Seating is on the street and attracts stray cats, so some prefer takeaway, but the liver itself is widely recommended.
address: 5VXX+R4Q, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372043

name: Nutopia (Fouad St.)
description: Nutopia on Fouad Street is a dessert spot for chocolate and Nutella lovers, with molten cakes, waffles, jars, kunafa cups, and even chocolate-laced drinks. The red velvet and cookies are favorites and the staff are helpful, though the space is tiny.
address: 73 El-Horeya Rd, Kom Ad Dakah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21515

name: Olive Island
description: Olive Island is an open-air Greek-style restaurant and bar with a breathtaking view over the bay, fishing boats, and sunset. The view and seafood are the main draw, but reviews are mixed on food quality and service, so manage expectations.
address: 6V6M+VGR, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321430

name: Souvlaki
description: Souvlaki is a cozy Greek spot praised for its flavorful chicken souvlaki, melted halloumi with fries, and proper Greek salad with feta and olive oil. The communal, intimate setting is charming, though a few feel the place looks smaller than its online photos suggest.
address: Al Moaaskar Al Romani, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434045

name: Greek Community Club (Soter)
description: The Greek Community Club (Soter) is a serene members' venue with stunning sea and beach views and three restaurants serving high-quality Greek and Egyptian cuisine. The food, service, and atmosphere are consistently praised, though access is generally limited to members and their guests.
address: Ali Moustafa Moshrfah St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423017

name: Gabi
description: Gabi is a Turkish restaurant in downtown Alexandria offering authentic, well-cooked food in a cozy, elegantly decorated setting with warm hospitality. Friendly, polite service and good shisha round out an experience many guests rate highly.
address: 5W8M+G9Q City Center, Qetaa at Tarik as Sahrawi, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5258730

name: Farag Abo Khaled
description: Farag Abo Khaled is one of Alexandria's renowned spots for kebda and street food, with specialties like brain with butter, grilled liver, kofta, sojok, and steak sandwiches. The food and fast service are widely praised, though a few longtime customers feel quality has dipped.
address: 32 Mohamed El Sayed Korayem St, El Gomrok, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321381

name: Koshary Salsa
description: Koshary Salsa serves fresh, flavorful koshari with well-balanced tomato, garlic, and spicy sauces in generous portions. It's praised for clean, hygienic preparation, quick friendly service, and English-speaking staff, with an optional liver add-on worth trying.
address: Mostafa Mohammed Ismail St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424001

name: Koshary El Tahrir
description: Koshary El Tahrir is a renowned name in Egyptian koshari, celebrated for consistent quality and flavorful dishes. The koshari delivers, though some find the service and staff could be more friendly and helpful.
address: 633 El Geish Rd, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza District, Alexandria Governorate 5517274

name: Koushary Ala Aslo
description: Koushary Ala Aslo is considered by many one of the best koshari spots in Alexandria, serving clean, filling plates at very affordable prices. Good service and tasty extras like roz b laban add to its strong value.
address: 182 Omar Lotfy St on the tram, Bahary, Al Ibrahimeya Bahari & Sidi Gaber, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5424061

name: Koshary Abu Nasser
description: Koshary Abu Nasser is a popular oriental restaurant offering great value, with vegetarian-friendly koshari alongside grilled items like liver and kidneys. The food is fresh and delicious, though service can lag during busy times.
address: 13 Broeksh, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372043

name: Ana Misho, Alexandria
description: Ana Misho is a well-liked koshari spot near Ibrahimiya tram station, offering tasty plates at a fair price with professional, kind service and an added dine-in area. It's a traditional favorite, though some feel quality has dropped over time.
address: 92 Omar Lotfy, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424054

name: Koshary El Sheikh Samy
description: Sheikh Samy is a small koshari shop with limited options but tasty food, especially its delicious tomato sauce, at very low prices. It's a solid pick for local fast food, though there has been at least one complaint about freshness.
address: Galal El Desouki St, Abis, Moharram Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5421050

name: Koshary Al Sokhn
description: Koshary Ala El Sokhn is a small, eat-and-go shop that many regard as serving the best koshari in the area, now in a renovated, clean space. Good prices, efficient service, and a rice-and-vermicelli twist make it a reliable choice.
address: 4 sultan Hussien St, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372060

name: Koshary Al Zaeem
description: Koshary Al Zaeem is an Egyptian fast-food spot serving koshari, kebda, and other dishes with drinks and on-the-spot seating. The food is generally well-liked, though service and organization draw mixed reviews.
address: Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517262

name: Koshary Hadeer
description: Koshary Hadeer is a Sidi Bishr icon beloved by locals for its distinctive, delicious koshari, available chili or plain. Many longtime regulars consider it among the best koshari in Alexandria.
address: 169 Cairo St, Sidi Bishr Qibli, Second Montaza District, Cairo-Alexandria Desert Rd, Alexandria Governorate

name: Koshary Makkah
description: Koshary Makkah is a long-running spot serving tasty, well-spiced Egyptian koshari in a clean setting with a welcoming host. It remains a decent choice, though some longtime customers feel the quality has changed over the years.
address: St 7 off 45 St, towards the sea, Alexandria Governorate

name: Spicy Restaurant
description: Spicy is a koshari spot praised for good-quality koshari and very fast service. Experiences vary, with some finding it a reliable favorite and others critical of value or service.
address: 6XRV+642, Seyouf Sq., As Soyouf Qebli (Include Izbat Derbanah), Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5514077

name: Koshary Wesaya
description: Koshary Wesaya is a koshari and crepe spot considered one of the better, cleaner options in its area at fair prices. Some longtime customers feel the food and service quality have declined recently, so experiences can vary.
address: 1 El Qasem, As Soyouf Qebli (Include Izbat Derbanah), Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5515361

name: Koshary Masrawy
description: Koshary Masrawy is a clean koshari spot serving popular, well-liked food. Service is the main sticking point, with some praising it and others reporting frustrating customer-service experiences.
address: El Thlathi, El Omrawy, Montaza District, Alexandria Governorate 5525015

name: Koshary Al Modhesh
description: Koshary Al Modhesh is a long-known name for this classic Egyptian street food, offering affordable, quick meals. Quality draws mixed reviews, with some enjoying it and others citing freshness and value concerns.
address: El Shohada Square, in front of Misr Station tram stop

name: Koshary Spicy
description: Koshary Spicy is praised for genuinely tasty koshari with a well-balanced pasta and sauce. The food can earn top marks, though several reviewers point to service and delivery attitude as areas needing improvement.

name: Ala Ad El Eid - Koshary & Kebda

description: Koshary El Harafish is a casual eatery in Alexandria serving koshary, Egypt's beloved comfort dish of rice, lentils, pasta, and chickpeas topped with spiced tomato sauce and crispy fried onions. It is a filling, affordable choice for a fast everyday meal.

name: Koshary Zaeem Alexandria - Amr & Emad, Bir Masoud
description: This koshari spot offers a distinctive flavor and a beautiful sea-facing location at fair prices. The food earns praise, though some visitors have noted lapses in service and cleanliness.

name: El Tayyeb
description: El Tayyeb is a modest, air-conditioned koshari spot popular with students and local workers, offering average food at average prices. It's a convenient everyday option, though a couple of guests have noted small service quibbles.

name: El Modhesh

name: Abou Eltarek
description: Abou Eltarek is a dining spot in Alexandria.

name: El Soultan koshary

name: Koshary Zamzam
description: Koshary Zamzam is a long-running, generational koshari spot serving popular Egyptian dishes at reasonable prices with good service. It's a dependable everyday option, with most finding the koshari solid if not exceptional.

name: Koshary El Harafesh

name: Koshary Negaf
description: Koshary Negaf is a no-frills koshary restaurant in Alexandria serving the classic Egyptian mix of rice, lentils, macaroni, and chickpeas with tangy tomato sauce and crunchy onions. It is a quick, value-for-money stop for a satisfying local meal.

name: Sawarikh
description: Sawarikh is an authentic Egyptian diner and Bahary landmark serving an extensive menu of sandwiches and plates, including seafood, fava-bean dishes, fried brain, and Alexandrian liver. Reasonable prices and bold, traditional flavors make it a great pick for trying real local cuisine.

name: El Haramein Restaurants

name: El Hag Ragab
description: El Hag Ragab is a koshari spot with a distinctive reputation for taste and service at good prices. Fans rate the koshari highly, making it a reliable local favorite.

name: Stanli Beach
description: Stanley Beach is a nostalgic, popular Alexandria beach with chairs, umbrellas, beanbags, and waiter service, easily reached from nearby hotels. It charges an entrance and seating fee, and while the setting is lovely, some note the water can be murky and cafes partly block the view.

name: Masoud Well
description: Masoud Well is a low-key seaside spot popular for watching the sunset, having a coffee by the water, and rod fishing, with bikes and horses sometimes available to rent. There isn't a lot to do, and the area is still being developed and can get crowded, but the scenery is pleasant.

name: Stanley Bridge

name: Montazah Bay Beach

name: Montazah bay

name: Keluobatra Beath

name: Miramar El Sharq Beach
description: Miramar is a small, family-oriented beach pavilion with an affordable entrance fee, a cafeteria, and a prayer room, well-suited for children and family outings. It can get very crowded, and water cleanliness draws occasional complaints, so experiences vary.

name: Al-Ibrahimiya Pedestrian Tunnel

name: Pedestrian tunnel

name: Mohamed Shico

name: El Sayad Mahmoud Othman Fishing Gear & Bait - Agami, Alexandria

name: Asmak Shabaan seafood restaurant

name: Abdo Farag Seafood Restaurant

name: LOTSY
description: LOTSY is a Seafood spot in Alexandria.

name: Moussa

name: Abo Elseed

name: Iskandarani Resturant

name: Male massage

name: Recovery Zone

name: Bawabet El Sham Syrian Massage Center

name: Kasr El Shabab

name: medical massage Alexandria

name: Alaa Barber Shop & spa

name: Sayed Latino Beauty Salon and SPA

name: Herbal Spa - Massage Center Egypt

name: Lomyen Beauty & Spa

name: Massage Center Egypt - Palestine Hotel

name: Julia beauty lounge

name: Hayah Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Center

name: Beauty House Nada yousry

name: La Beauté Salon

name: Eve Beauty Center

name: KanDaka

name: World Fit Gym Alexandria

name: Hype Gym & Fitness
