description: Little Fingers is a spacious, clean, and well-maintained kids' area with games and birthday-party hosting. Families praise the nice team and the fun, well-kept environment for children.
address: 29 Mostafa Kamel, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432066

name: Dino land
description: Dino Land is a kids' play area with a sea view and a cafe for parents, where children often have a great time. Experiences are mixed, however, with complaints about weak air conditioning, slow food service, and crowding with limited supervision.
address: 141 elgiesh road, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434013

name: Bubble kids area , Smouha Branch
description: Bubble in Smouha is a clean, safe kids' area with well-monitored play zones, a good cafe, and helpful, caring staff. The main complaint is that the music is often played far too loud, which can bother some families.
address: Zaki Ragab, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432015

name: Kids zone
description: Kids Zone is a secure, clean play area with plenty of supervised activities and a controlled gate so children can't leave without a parent. It's especially convenient alongside the nearby restaurants and cafes, though some find it a bit pricey for longer stays.
address: Alexandria Corniche, El Raml District, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria 5434050

name: Popeye Park
description: Popeye Park at Raml Station is a well-loved indoor playground offering a safe, clean, and colorful space with a variety of activities and staff who entertain the kids. It's considered one of the better children's areas in Alexandria, with only minor toy maintenance noted.
address: 164 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373001

name: Ozzie World Kids Area
description: Ozzie World is a budget-friendly kids' area that many find clean, safe, and fun with caring staff. Reviews are mixed, however, with several recent visitors reporting worn or broken games and a need for upkeep.
address: 111 Memphis St, El Ibrahimeya, Alexandria Governorate 21111

name: Kikoland_ kids area
description: Kikoland is a calm, colorful kids' area with diverse games for various ages and respectful, friendly staff who play with the children. The space is on the small side and some have flagged the bathroom condition, but many families return regularly.
address: Gihan Roundabout, above Dragon Mobile

name: Under 5 International Preschool - Alexandria
description: Under 5 is a clean, well-organized international preschool and nursery with kind, attentive teachers and creative, engaging activities. Parents consistently praise the warm, loving environment and the seasonal camps that keep families coming back.
address: 26 Khaleel El-Masry, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433107

name: Little Fingers Kids Area
description: Little Fingers is a clean, attractive kids' area with friendly, respectful staff, good supervision, and quality kids' meals and desserts at affordable prices. Children enjoy the interactive games, and families happily return.
address: 183 Port Said St, in front of Fathalla Market, Al Ibrahimeya Bahari & Sidi Gaber, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5424063

name: Dreamland (Madinat El Ahlam)
description: Dreamland (Madinat El Ahlam) is a toy store in Alexandria stocking a wide range of toys, games, and gifts for children of all ages. It is a go-to spot for birthday presents and holiday shopping.
address: 30 Mostafa Kamel St, Smouha Square, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: The Little Kingdom Academy
description: The Little Kingdom Academy is a preschool praised for a safe, fun environment and professional, warm staff who run daily skill-building activities. Parents highlight the genuine, holistic care and the children's evident happiness.
address: Villa 7 street 61, Branched from Kamal Salah Al Din, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Madinet Elahlam
description: Madinet Elahlam is a beloved toy store with a huge selection and a reputation for high-quality, long-lasting toys, plus slides that delight younger visitors. It's a go-to spot for children's gifts and a treat for the inner child.
address: 724 El Horreya Rd, Louran, El Raml District, Alexandria Governorate 5422003

name: Honey Fun Amusement Park
description: This is a small, clean amusement park well-suited to younger children, with affordable prices. It's pleasant if modest, with a limited selection of rides that some feel could be expanded.
address: Mahmoud El Falaki St, El Soyof Qibli, Third Montaza, Alexandria Governorate 5515251

name: Kids Square - kids area
description: Kids Square is a kids' area with a generally safe, supervised play space that many families appreciate, attached to a restaurant. Service quality has reportedly slipped over time, with complaints about slow food and inconsistent supervision, so experiences vary.
address: 5 Mahmoud Reda, As Soyouf Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517073

name: Funky Monkey Kids Area
description: Funky Monkey is a clean, well-ventilated kids' area with fun games and notably helpful, polite supervisors who keep a close eye on children. Reviews are mostly positive, though some cite uneven air conditioning, aging toys, and pricey cafe items.
address: Gamal Abdel Nasser St corner, above Rayaheen Roastery, Sidi Bishr, Mahmoud El Eisawy, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: The Camp
description: The Camp is a top-rated indoor padel club with high-quality courts that let you play in any weather, plus fitness equipment and a 3x3 basketball court. The warm, welcoming vibe, strong community, and excellent operational team make it a standout in Alexandria.
address: Abis, Ring Rd, Alexandria Governorate

name: The Hit padel
description: The Hit Padel offers a fantastic atmosphere and affordable prices for padel, with professional service and genuine, welcoming vibes. The main wishes from players are upgraded rackets and more reliable booking during tournaments.
address: 6232+HXC, Alexandria Agriculture Rd, Khorshid Al Qebleyah, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5444061

name: Padel square
description: Padel Square is a nice facility with three padel courts and two clay tennis courts, friendly staff, parking, and quality rackets provided for padel bookings. Drawbacks noted include a tricky-to-reach location, worn balls, sandy courts, and basic lockers and restrooms.
address: in front of El Horreya School, first St right after Abis Bridge, Alexandria Governorate 21519

name: Basketball Court Alex Water Club
description: This basketball court at the Alexandria Water Company club sits in a quiet, pleasant sports complex that also hosts football. It's a decent local facility, though it lacks wheelchair access.
address: 13 Dr Ahmed Zaki Abou Shady, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5422023

name: SR Padel Alexandria
description: SR Padel offers five indoor, air-conditioned courts with clean, sand-free, non-slip ground, letting you play comfortably year-round and avoid wind, rain, and harsh sun. It runs a little pricier than some, but players feel the quality and consistent conditions are worth it.
address: Near FOC Factory Of Champions, Agriculture Rd Khurshid, Alexandria Governorate 21515

name: Tennis court EZDK Club
description: Tennis court EZDK Club is a sports club in Alexandria.
address: 4Q7W+RQX, Al Bostan Rd, Ad Dakhilah, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5312432

name: Taba Divers
description: Taba Divers is one of the oldest and most trusted shops for diving and swimming equipment in Alexandria and an authorized ScubaPro dealer carrying original gear. Longtime customers value the reliability, though some find prices on the higher side.
address: 243 El-Fath, Al Qasaei Bahri, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5450380

name: submarine diving center
description: This diving center runs trips to Alexandria's underwater archaeology sites, including submerged ruins and a WWII airplane, a draw for fans of historical diving. Experiences vary sharply with conditions, however, as some report poor visibility and equipment, so set expectations carefully.
address: Bahary, Hunting Club, Alexandria Governorate 21511

name: EL AWADY DIVE SHOP
description: El Awady is a dive shop offering diving gear and supplies, with reviewers describing good stock and staff. It's a straightforward option for divers in the area.
address: AL ESAWY, Alexander, Alexandria Governorate 5517174

name: Bowling hub GP
description: Bowling Hub (also known as The Club House) is a relaxed spot for friends with bowling lanes and billiard tables under attractive lighting. Reviews are mixed, with complaints about management, equipment maintenance, and long waits offsetting the pleasant atmosphere.
address: 6X48+FGR, 14th of May Bridge Rd, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Saltana Stanley
description: Saltana in Stanley is a chic cafe with unique decor, a pleasant musical backdrop, and a menu of light snacks, sandwiches, and beverages, plus a games floor. Reviews are mixed, however, with several diners citing crowding, high prices, slow service, and inconsistent quality.
address: 259 El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452003

name: Green Plaza Sports Complex
description: Green Plaza is a large sports complex with football pitches, padel courts, and a swimming pool, suited to group outings and birthdays. Reviews are mixed, with the football well-rated but complaints about crowding, broken padel rackets, and staff service.
address: Green Plaza Mall, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21684

name: Gomla Market
description: Gomla Market (Fathalla) is a large, popular hypermarket in the Carrefour mold, known for quality products, wide selection, and a seafood counter where staff will cook your fish. Most shoppers praise the variety and value, though stock and service can vary by branch.
address: 9 El-Shaheed Galal El-Desouky, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5422022

name: El Nasr Mall
description: Mall El Nasr is a spacious hypermarket-style store carrying a wide range of clothing, sportswear, school supplies, and more at generally good prices with frequent seasonal sales. Drawbacks include difficult parking and inconsistent quality on some clothing items.
address: 596 Abou Quer, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451011

name: Gomla Market - Gianaclis
description: Gomla Market in Janaklees is a clean, well-organized one-stop grocery with a wide variety of fresh products, good prices, and helpful staff. It's a comfortable, spacious place to shop, with occasional complaints about checkout queues.
address: 2 El-Fath, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451101

name: Gomla Market - Green Towers
description: Gomla Market at Green Towers offers good products, competitive prices, and regular offers, plus a spacious, clean prayer area. It's a well-regarded branch for everyday shopping.
address: Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21646

name: Gomla Market - Sporting
description: Gomla Market in Sporting is an all-purpose Fathalla market with an on-site bakery, cook-to-order takeaway at some outlets, and a good selection of fresh and frozen goods at competitive prices. It tends to be less crowded than other branches, with cleanliness and service rated as average.
address: 178 Port Said St, Al Ibrahimeya Bahari & Sidi Gaber, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5424080

name: Balbaa Village for Grills & Seafood | Bashair El KhirBranch
description: Balbaa Village (Bashair El Khir branch) is a popular spot for authentic Egyptian grills and seafood, famous for tasty appetizers and hot, fluffy fresh-baked bread. Most diners feel they get great value, though some have reported slow delivery and inconsistent kitchen execution.
address: Bashayer El Kheir, New Downtown, beside Safir Wedding Halls, start of the International Rd, Al Qabari, Alexandria Governorate 5434033

name: Zed & Co
description: Zed & Co is a cozy brunch spot with attentive, friendly staff, good coffee, and a well-regarded breakfast menu featuring bagels, eggs Benedict, and French toast. Note that the full breakfast menu starts a bit later in the morning, with coffee and desserts available earlier.
address: Sant Giyn, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433113

name: Fathalla Market Bolkly
description: Fathalla Market in Bolkly is a well-stocked supermarket with a great bakery, a strong fruit selection, and a relatively clean, easy layout. Parking can be tricky at peak times, but most shoppers find everything they need, often around the clock.
address: Abd El-Rahman Shokry, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452004

name: Gomla Market - Raml Station
description: Gomla Market at Raml Station is an organized, lively hypermarket with an impressive range from fresh produce to electronics and clothing across two well-laid-out floors. Clean aisles, good year-round discounts, and a central location make it a convenient city-center stop.
address: Salah Mostafa St, El Mesalla Sharq, Bab Sharqi District, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: Fathalla Market
description: Fathalla Market is a general supermarket with a great variety of products and competitive prices on most items. Drawbacks noted by shoppers include uneven organization, missing stock at times, and the air conditioning being turned off.
address: El Nasr St off 14th of May St, Lotus Gardens Towers, Hod Malaqa No. 8, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Gomla Market - El Gomrok
description: Gomla Market at El Gomrok is a tidy, well-organized two-level supermarket with reasonable prices, good stock, and easy parking. Friendly, helpful staff and a generally quiet atmosphere make it a convenient neighborhood option.
address: Dr Abdel Moneim El Dabba St, Haret Sidi Abu Shousha, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 21534

name: Gomla Market - El Farana
description: Gomla Market at El Faraana is a tidy, clean supermarket with polite, cooperative staff and a decent range of everyday goods. Some shoppers feel prices and quality are no longer clearly better than elsewhere, and certain fresh items like meat and coffee are limited.
address: El-Horeya Rd, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423002

name: BRGR Green Plaza
description: BRGR at Green Plaza serves quality burgers and chicken with well-liked fries, plus good coffee and matcha and friendly staff. The trade-offs are smallish portions and relatively high prices, but many consider the quality worth it.
address: Green Plaza, Ezbet El Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Awlad Abdo
description: Awlad Abdo is a popular local sandwich shop with a wide variety of options, best known for its mixed-cheese sandwich as a finishing favorite. It's a typical grab-and-go takeaway spot, fine on hygiene, with opinions on the food ranging from great to merely okay.
address: 112 El-Imam Malik, Al Attarin Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371020

name: Mochi anime
description: Mochi is a cozy, beautifully decorated spot for Japanese-style ramen, sushi, and tteokbokki, with a surprisingly authentic, clean taste on a busy road. Friendly service and an attention to detail make it a comfortable, welcoming find.
address: 508 El Geish Rd, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517185

name: Spinneys - Alexandria
description: Spinneys in Alexandria is a clean, pleasant hypermarket with a standout bakery and the full range of standard Spinneys sections, focused on the shopping experience. It's smaller than the Cairo branches with assisted street parking, and service can be inconsistent at times.
address: 6X84+V94, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080

name: Gomla Market - Miami
description: Gomla Market in Miami is a large shopping center with a wide range of goods, good offers, and friendly, helpful staff, plus ready-made food on the second floor. Note that mobile network coverage inside is poor, and some items can be inconsistently stocked.
address: Mohamed Anwar El Sadat St, 45 St, Miami, in front of Beau Rivage Beach, Montaza District, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Alexandria Governorate 21929

name: Balance point wellness center & physical therapy
description: Balance Point is a clean, professional wellness and physical therapy center praised for skilled doctors, top-notch sterilization, and a calm, relaxing atmosphere. It's notable as one of the few places in Alexandria offering cupping therapy for women, with many loyal long-term clients.
address: 6 Ibn el Nadim, from Amir el behar, Roushdy, Kafr abdo, Alexandria Governorate

name: YO STUDIO
description: YO Studio is a spacious, clean wellness studio widely regarded as one of the best for yoga, with classes for all levels, harmonious decor, and a calm, professional atmosphere. It also hosts workshops and retreats, though one visitor reported a poor experience with reception.
address: 6 Alfred Layan St, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21529

name: Wellness Oasis Clinic
description: Wellness Oasis is a clean, comfortable medical clinic praised for attentive doctors and good follow-up care. Most experiences are very positive, with the occasional disappointing visit when inquiring about treatments.
address: Faculty of Medicine St, Building 14, Raml Station, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21577

name: Medical massage therapy
description: This is a well-regarded recovery practice where Dr. Amr offers an all-in-one approach of deep-tissue massage, chiropractic adjustment, and cupping therapy. Many clients report real relief from migraines, back, and neck pain, though a few felt the combined techniques weren't right for them.
address: Adnan medny, As Soyouf Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: Iwellness gym
description: iWellness is a clean, modern gym and a real hidden gem, with brand-new machines, a great atmosphere, and friendly, helpful staff, plus a sauna, steam room, and jacuzzi. It's well-maintained, rarely overcrowded, and offers parking, making for a complete experience.
address: Saba Pasha, 69 Mostafa Abu Heif Street, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452031

name: The Two-Twenty
description: The Two-Twenty is a neat wellness center offering unique classes, including well-regarded aerial yoga. Visitors enjoy the tidy space and skilled instructors and plan to return.
address: Qetaa at Tarik as Sahrawi, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5258710

name: the secret spa
description: The Secret Spa is one of the most beloved massage spots in Alexandria, praised for impeccable cleanliness, courteous service, and genuinely impressive results. Skilled therapists and a sophisticated, professional atmosphere keep clients coming back.
address: 23 El Qasem, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432067

name: Kandaka Spa & Beauty
description: Kandaka Spa & Beauty is a well-regarded spa and beauty destination offering Moroccan baths, jacuzzi, facials, and massage with professional staff in a clean, welcoming setting. Most experiences are excellent, though a few note inconsistency between visits.
address: 801 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21913

name: Hammam El Saraya
description: Hamam El Saraya is a spa offering hammam and Moroccan bath treatments and massage, with welcoming staff and a relaxing setting at its best. Reviews are sharply mixed, however, with several complaints about hygiene and service not matching the price, so it's worth confirming details.
address: 80 Fouad St, in front of Radio Shack, El Bastami, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Elite Spa
description: Elite Spa is a massage spa praised for experienced, friendly staff, quality equipment, and good value, with wedding packages also on offer. Most experiences are very positive, with a couple of notes that hygiene could be enhanced.
address: Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Dolmabahce Spa
description: Dolmabahce is a health spa with sharply divided reviews, with some praising caring service and a clean space, often citing a favorite therapist. Others report booking mix-ups and a decline in service and professionalism, so it pays to confirm your reservation.
address: 8 Ibn Marzouk St, Saba Basha, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452013

name: La Detox
description: La Detox is a highly praised medical spa offering facials, massages, bath soaks, and Moroccan baths, with positive energy, friendly, flexible staff, and noticeable results. Many regulars consider it their go-to for skin and spa treatments in Alexandria.
address: 29 Abdel Moneim Riyadh, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21520

name: Premedion Recovery
description: Premedion Recovery is a calm, spotlessly clean wellness center with professional, attentive staff and well-regarded treatments like Balinese and hot-stone massage. The welcoming reception and relaxing rooms earn consistent praise, with only minor service notes.
address: Green Plaza, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Aphrodite Spa & Wellness Center
description: Aphrodite is a spa offering Moroccan baths and other treatments with a good level of privacy. Reviews skew negative, however, citing worn towels, dated facilities, pricing confusion, and inconsistent service, so it's wise to confirm details beforehand.
address: 172 Maarouf El Rasafi St, Kafr Abdou, Sidi Gaber

name: Hammam Al Sham
description: Hammam Al Sham offers Moroccan bath packages with provided towels and amenities and a relaxing setting, and some guests leave satisfied. Reviews are mixed-to-negative, however, with repeated complaints about hygiene and long waits, so set expectations carefully.
address: Mustafa Kamel, Abu Qir St

name: Therapista
description: Therapista is a hair-focused salon led by Salma, a charismatic, detail-oriented expert, with high-quality products and treatments. It runs pricey and operates very limited hours, and some clients cite long waits, so booking ahead and patience help.
address: 6W7R+F3X, Al Lewaa Abd Al Tawab Hadeb, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432061

name: Premedion Health & Wellbeing
description: Premedion Health & Wellbeing is a clean, well-organized wellness and physical therapy center with a sauna, steam room, jacuzzi, and relaxation room. Therapists like Esraa and Rasha are singled out for professional, relaxing massages in a spotless, comfortable setting.
address: 10.5 Km, Cairo - Borg El-Arab Desert Rd, Alexandria Governorate 21934

name: Soher Rashwan Spa (Ladies)
description: Soher Rashwan is a women's spa widely praised as one of the best places in Alexandria for a Moroccan bath, with the warm, knowledgeable Madam Soher herself often providing treatments. The cozy, safe, home-like atmosphere and skilled deep massage draw visitors from near and far.
address: 1 Abd Satar Mansour, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452058

name: Pamper Yard
description: Pamper Yard is a health spa praised for genuine skill, with treatments like the Moroccan bath performed by experienced specialists in private, very hygienic spaces. Professional therapists, attentive care, and well-regarded bridal packages make for an exceptional experience.
address: 4 kafr abdo, street, Alexandria Governorate

name: G Spa Alexanderia
description: G Spa offers treatments like milk-and-honey baths and aromatic massages, with friendly, professional, English-speaking staff at its best. Experiences are inconsistent, however, with complaints about product quality and poor coordination between the spa and call center over bookings.
address: Four seasons, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: El Maamoura Distinguished Beach
description: Maamoura is a scenic beach with pleasant water and views, open through the daytime and often calm and swimmable in late spring. Access is on the pricey side and tipping the chair-and-umbrella attendants feels expected, but it's lovely, especially when uncrowded.
address: 72RM+GHG, El-Shaheed Youssef El-Sebaey, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Casablanca Resort Village , North Coast
description: Casablanca is a quiet, elegant North Coast resort with a large, clean beach and a cafe serving fresh drinks and sandwiches, well-suited to families seeking calm. Services are limited with few restaurants and markets, and the sea can be choppy, but the landscaping and pool are lovely.
address: XG4H+5WM, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, North Coast, Alexandria Governorate 5232113

name: Long Beach Resort
description: Long Beach Resort is a calm, private resort known for its exceptionally long, clean beach with low traffic even in peak season, and a neat pool with snack and drink service. Stand-alone villas and chalets offer a high standard of privacy, making it an elegant, peaceful escape.
address: Km 86, North Coast, Alexandria-Marsa Matrouh Rd, Marsa Matrouh Governorate

name: Golden Beach Resort - North Coast Km 47
description: Golden Beach Resort is a cozy private village on the North Coast, ideal for a quiet getaway with several swimming pools and a short walk to the beach. It's a calm, relaxing escape from the city, though the sea isn't always suitable for swimming.
address: Alexandria-Matrouh Rd, Alexandria Desert Rd, Alexandria Governorate

name: Golden Beach North Coast
description: Golden Beach is a calm, old-school North Coast resort with well-kept gardens, two nice swimming pools, and a long beach walk, well-suited to families and morning relaxation. It's showing its age with limited amenities and little nightlife, and the sea can be hard to swim in.
address: North West Coast, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, North Coast, Alexandria Governorate 5232001

name: Marakia
description: Marakia is a large, older North Coast village with a nice beach, multiple swimming pools, green areas, and a market zone with restaurants and services. It's a clean, family-friendly summer spot with reasonable prices, though it's worn in places and light on activities beyond swimming and shopping.
address: Unnamed Rd, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, North Coast, Alexandria Governorate 5231305

name: Amoun Resort
description: Amoun is a calm, organized North Coast village with distinctive architecture, where you can rent a chalet or villa for a family summer holiday at affordable rates. It's family-friendly with improving beaches, though it's aging and some report inconsistent management.
address: k. 36, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, North Coast, Alexandria Governorate 21513

name: Sidi Krer Village - North Coast
description: Sidi Krer is a large, secure beachfront residential resort managed by the Armed Forces, well-maintained and family-friendly with a wide range of sports. The strong security and clean facilities are big draws, though entry can involve checks and most amenities carry a fee.
address: ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5251101

name: Eagles Resort
description: Eagles Resort is a clean, secure, and relaxing seaside vacation spot, recently expanded with multiple hotels, pools, and an aqua park, and all units facing the sea. It's calm and family-friendly, though some note management issues and that access can be restricted.
address: 2JPX+FMV, Unnamed Road, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5251301

name: Sky Yacht Club
description: Sky Yacht Club is one of Alexandria's most scenic private beaches, a calm seaside spot beside a hotel and pool that serves drinks and snacks and hosts events and celebrations. The atmosphere and setting are lovely, though some find the food and service inconsistent.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: White Beach
description: White Beach is one of Alexandria's nicer beach clubs, where the entry ticket includes an umbrella, chair, beach towel, and welcome drink, with helpful, friendly hosts. It's best early before the crowds, though water and beach cleanliness can be inconsistent and pricing should be confirmed at reception.
address: San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452050

name: Armed Forces Officers Club
description: The Armed Forces Officers Club is a newer seaside venue with a nice sandy beach and reasonable prices. It's still finding its footing, with some visitors reporting limited service and cleanliness issues, so it may be worth a return visit as it matures.
address: 6WHR+MQP, El-Gaish Rd, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Engineers Club - Alexandria
description: The Engineers Club in Saba Basha is a members' social club with a seaside beach, pool, small football pitch, food court, and even some government-service counters, all at decent prices. It can get crowded, and the beach and some amenities carry extra fees, but you can usually find a relaxing spot.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452042

name: Teachers' Club Beach
description: The Teachers' Club beach offers a sea view and shaded parking, serving as a hangout primarily for teachers. Reviews lean critical, citing a small, sometimes littered beach, aging facilities, noise from weddings, and extra charges, so expectations should be modest.
address: Alexandria Corniche, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Andrea
description: Andrea is a well-known nightlife spot in the El Bitash area of Agami, popular for dancing, drinks, and a lively late-night atmosphere. It's geared toward adults seeking nightlife rather than families, with reviews mixed on food and service.
address: Alexandria-Marsa Matrouh Rd, El Bitash Gharb, Dekheila, Alexandria Governorate 5314722

name: Rixos Montaza Alexandria (Cleopatra Forest)
description: Rixos Montaza (Cleopatra Forest) is a beautiful, hidden-gem hotel set within the Montazah grounds, with private bungalows, lovely gardens, and amazing sea views. Guests praise the clean, calm, relaxing atmosphere and easy access to the wider Montazah facilities.
address: 72P7+W5, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Sea view Paradise 2 Appartment
description: Sea View Paradise 2 is a clean, fully equipped apartment rental that lives up to its photos, with beautiful views and a friendly, respectful host. The location can be a little tricky for taxis to reach, but guests are consistently impressed.
address: 26 Zoukak Ibn Al Sahan, Al Mazar, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321372

name: Pharonia Resort
description: Pharonia Resort is a 5-star hotel in Alexandria.
address: Cleopatra Raod, El Hamam, Marsa Matrouh Governorate 51512

name: Rasheed Hotel
description: Rasheed Hotel is a budget hotel whose main strength is its central location and low prices. Reviews are sharply divided, with several serious complaints about cleanliness and bedding, so it's best for travelers prioritizing price and location over comfort.
address: 8 Orabi Square St, Mansheya District, Alexandria Governorate 5361003

name: Monk Cafe
description: Monk Cafe is a cafe with a varied menu including sushi, and gentle, attentive staff at its best. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about inconsistent sushi quality and service, so experiences can vary.
address: 5WX4+8W4, Kom Ad Dakah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371082

name: Romeo cafe and restaurant
description: Romeo is a lovely little cafe that's cozy, chill, and great for a break, studying, or relaxing, with friendly owners. It's a bit small, but the tasty kunafa, good coffee and espresso, and warm atmosphere win regulars over.
address: El Sultan Hussein St, Bab Sharqi & Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5423004

name: Abo alaa cafe alex
description: Abo Alaa is a long-standing simple drinks kiosk serving excellent hot and cold beverages at very affordable prices, with many loyal daily regulars. Quality, cleanliness, and value stand out, though a few find the service disorganized at busy times.
address: 6W35+2WV, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423005

name: Blogger Cafe
description: Blogger Cafe is a beautiful two-story spot with a European-pub feel, nice decor, friendly staff, good prices, and strong internet, making it great for chatting, working, or studying at quieter times. The main drawback for some is the amount of indoor smoking.
address: 6 Taghour, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423010

name: Seed al balad
description: Seed El Balad is a calm, pleasant, and relaxing cafe with respectful staff, affordable prices, and a good atmosphere for watching a match without the crowds. Locals describe it as a beautiful, welcoming spot.
address: 5WX6+833, Omar Toson, Kom Ad Dakah Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371081

name: Mawlaweya Cafe
description: Mawlaweya is a casual cafe near the beach popular with a young, mixed crowd, with friendly staff, tasty drinks, well-liked shisha, and reasonable prices. The street setting isn't to everyone's taste, but many find it a nice, lively spot.
address: Champollion St, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5423010

name: kaffine_65
description: Kaffine 65 is a cozy, relaxing cafe in a nice area with good coffee, pleasant music, and friendly staff, well-suited to grabbing a coffee or settling in to work. It's a favorite for its comfortable, laid-back vibe.
address: Ahmed ezz el din hella, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423003

name: 27 Barista
description: 27 Barista is a small cafe serving good coffee at reasonable prices, with friendly, respectful staff. It's a straightforward, pleasant spot for a quick cup.
address: Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423011

name: Borset Bab Shark
description: Borset Bab Shark is a classic Alexandrian sidewalk ahwa, a great place to warm up with tea or milk coffee, smoke shisha, and soak in the old-city atmosphere. It's authentic local character rather than upscale comfort, which is exactly its charm for many.
address: 28 Mostafa Basha Sobhy, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5422003

name: Toscanini Cafe
description: Toscanini is a cafe popular for its atmosphere, friendly staff, and well-regarded shisha, good for spending relaxed hours with friends. Opinions on the food and some drinks are mixed, and a few find the shisha prices high.
address: 1 Bastour, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5422014

name: Kids Area
description: This kids' area is a large, well-equipped play space attached to Flamingo Cafe and Caribou Coffee, with respectful, professional staff and shows even for toddlers. Children under two often enter free, and while the hourly rate feels a bit high, most find it worthwhile.
address: 28 Street 5, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434044

name: Play Planet Kids Area
description: Play Planet is a clean, mostly soft-padded indoor playground with a great variety of toys for ages one and up, and exceptionally friendly staff focused on safety. The on-site cafe is also well-liked, with tasty treats and good prices, making it a relaxing spot for parents.
address: 6XM3+GG3, Abd El-Aziz Fahmy, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452012

name: Bubble kids Area , Miami Branch
description: Bubble in Miami is a clean, organized, and very cute kids' area with themed stalls, a car track, and an in-house cafeteria, well-suited to ages two to eight. Staff are well-trained and attentive to hygiene and safety, though some find it a touch pricey.
address: 1, Talha ben Abdalla st, Khaleel Hamada, Alexandria Governorate 21614

name: Gravity code - City Center Alexandria
description: Gravity Code at City Center is a fun trampoline and adventure park that's a hit for kids, teens, and birthday parties, with friendly, helpful staff. It's clean and enjoyable, though some wish it had its own restrooms so children don't have to leave the area.
address: 5WCJ+4FH City Center, Cairo Alex Desert Rd, Qetaa at Tarik as Sahrawi, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Bubble kids Area Ganaklis Branch
description: Bubble in Ganaklis is a clean, safe kids' area with friendly staff where children happily spend hours, rated among the better play spaces in Alexandria. The main concerns are the garage-exit entrance, which feels unsafe, and prices that some find steep.
address: 650 Abu Qir St, El Loaloaa Tower, in front of Dar El Sadr Heart Hospital and CIB, Alexandria Governorate 5451101

name: Smouha club bowling center
description: Smouha Club's bowling center is a fun, clean, and affordable spot with friendly, responsive staff and an enjoyable night mode. The lanes can lag occasionally, requiring staff help, and there's no on-site snack option, but it's a great outing with friends and family.
address: Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080

name: Kilo Kabab Restaurant
description: Kilo Kebab is a grill restaurant whose reviews skew negative, with multiple complaints about high prices and disappointing meat quality. A few items, like the lemon juice, draw praise, but many do not recommend it.
address: San Stefano Grand Plaza, El Geish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: McDonald's San Stefano - Alexandria
description: This is the McDonald's branch at San Stefano, offering the familiar fast-food menu in a central mall location. Reviews are mixed-to-negative, with several complaints about cold food and service, though some praise a hands-on, helpful branch manager.
address: San Stefano Mall, San Stefano, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Pizza Queen
description: Pizza Queen is a clean, cozy pizza spot with a sea-view location, quick service, and an easy ordering and delivery process at good prices. Opinions on the pizza vary, with some finding it tasty and fresh and others underwhelmed, so results can be inconsistent.
address: Grand Plaza, El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Holmes Burgers - San Stefano
description: Holmes Burgers at San Stefano is an Egyptian smash-burger chain serving tasty, made-to-order burgers like the Smash Double Cheeseburger, plus sides such as mozzarella sticks. Friendly, attentive staff and a clean setting make it a reliable fast-food pick, with only minor notes on fries.
address: 6XW8+99H, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Abu Fares Syrian - San Stefano
description: Abo Fares is a Syrian-style restaurant at San Stefano with tasty shawarma, kofta, and dessert at relatively good prices when at its best. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about cold food, slow service, and a noisy food-court setting, so experiences vary.
address: San Stefano Food Court, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: Sushi
description: This sushi spot prepares fresh sushi in front of you and is well-liked by sushi lovers for taste and value. The main frustration cited is frequent unavailability of certain rolls and ingredients, so the menu can be hit or miss.
address: 7 El-Demerdash, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Kenoz
description: Kenoz is a classy, oriental-themed restaurant best known for its marvelous sea view, especially at sunset, with decent coffee and reasonably priced food for the setting. Reviews on service and the breakfast buffet are mixed, so the standout is really the view.
address: 6XW8+6C7, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: BIBO
description: BIBO is a barbecue restaurant whose reviews are overwhelmingly negative, with repeated complaints about food quality, cleanliness, and service. Most reviewers strongly advise against it.
address: 422 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452056

name: KFC | San Stephano
description: This is the KFC branch at San Stefano, serving the familiar fried-chicken menu with free parking and a kid- and wheelchair-friendly setup. Most reviews are positive on food and service, with some noting it could use more seating.
address: 6XW8+9CJ, 6XW8+89Q, El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 2, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate

name: Hops
description: Hops is a casual fast-food spot with a nice window view and some well-liked items like the mac and cheese and fries. Reviews are mixed, with complaints about small chicken portions and thick milkshakes, so ordering choices matter.
address: San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Holmes Burgers
description: Holmes Burgers is a cozy little burger spot, the chain's original branch, with quick, friendly staff and tasty, generously sized burgers at its best. Consistency is an issue, though, with some recent visits reporting dry burgers, cold fries, and long waits.
address: 7 Ibrahim Naseer St, Louran, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451104

name: Darwish Restaurant
description: Darwish is a historic seafront restaurant with a prime location, an old-Alexandria atmosphere, and generally good, plentiful food at reasonable prices. Service is inconsistent, however, and some diners are bothered by beggars approaching tables, so the setting outshines the service.
address: Raml Station, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Cheezo
description: Cheezo at Kuta Festival is a burger spot with a pleasant outdoor seating area, decent service, and good value when there are offers. Reviews are mixed on the food itself, with some finding the burgers small and inconsistent, so it's a casual rather than standout choice.
address: in front of El Qaed Ibrahim, Raml Station Square, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: PAPA DOLA
description: Papa Dola is a Lebanese restaurant that some praise for flavorful food and top-notch, friendly service. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about long waits, an added service charge, and inconsistent food temperature and presentation.
address: 48 Al Askandar Al Akbar, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372044

name: Atheneos
description: Atheneos is a seafront cafe with an amazing setting and Mediterranean view, courteous staff, and quick service. Opinions on the drinks are mixed and some are bothered by extra charges and street vendors, so the view and atmosphere are the main draw.
address: 16 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372051

name: Wahed Mashwy - Raml Station
description: Wahed Mashwy at Raml Station serves fresh, generously portioned grilled food that leaves many diners full and satisfied, at acceptable value. Service can be slow and inconsistent, with some complaints about the morning cashier and order accuracy, so patience helps.
address: 17 Saad Zaghloul Square, Raml Station, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Danes
description: Danes is a Seafood spot in Alexandria.
address: 1 Digla, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Nos Dasta (Half Dozen)
description: Nos Dasta is a casual restaurant with sharply divided reviews. While some report delicious, hot food and excellent service, many others cite slow delivery, cold or poor-quality food, and weak customer service, so experiences are inconsistent.
address: Raml Station Square, beside Mall El Khalideen, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21517

name: elherish fo lever sandwirchs
description: El Herish is a popular spot famous for its delicious, fast, and affordable liver sandwiches, praised for soft bread and well-sliced, flavorful liver. It gets crowded, and a few have noted inconsistent portions or spice levels, but the value and taste keep fans coming back.
address: Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372064

name: Bazooka Fried Chicken..
description: Bazooka is a Cairo-born fried-chicken chain with a pretty location and a wide seating area in Alexandria. The food is decent, but reviews note long waits, occasional order mix-ups, and that it doesn't fully live up to its Cairo reputation here.
address: 2 Safia Zaghloul St, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Mostafa Gad
description: Mostafa Gad is a reliable local spot for tasty, affordable grab-and-go sandwiches made with good ingredients, like the soori potato and mozzarella wrap. It's a satisfying, budget-friendly takeaway you can enjoy nearby or by the sea.
address: 2 Ibn Al Saegh, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372063

name: El Wahsh Burger
description: El Wahsh is a popular grilled-burger spot that many rate among the best in Alexandria, with the creamy mushroom burger a standout. Reviews are mostly positive, though some find the patties thin or the sauces overpowering, and orders are occasionally incomplete.
address: 67 safia Saad Zaghloul, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21512

name: Harisa El Halaby
description: Harisa El Halaby is a century-old Alexandrian dessert parlor serving traditional harissa to locals and tourists since 1909, with the plain version a favorite. The old-school charm and taste win many fans, though a few have found the quality inconsistent.
address: 1 Saad Zaghloul Square, Raml Station Square, Alexandria Governorate

name: Tots
description: Tots is a cheerful, relaxing cafe with cool music, friendly and professional staff, and good-quality, well-portioned desserts. Service is generally great, though one visit reported a long wait, so it's best at quieter times.
address: 6W33+56G, Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373010

name: Buffet Misr
description: Buffet Misr is a well-established spot overlooking Raml Station Square, prized for its prime location, sea view, classic drinks with a touch of nostalgia, and moderate prices. The food and buffet are comfortable rather than remarkable, but the value and setting stand out.
address: 4 Saad Zaghloul, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372063

name: Panacea Suites Hotel
description: Panacea Suites is an elegant, well-run hotel on Borg El Arab Road with a peaceful, homey atmosphere, spacious rooms, and a pool. Guests praise the comfort and service, though the isolated location means limited nearby dining and services.
address: Old Marqia Rd, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 5215875

name: Borg El Arab Beach Hotel
description: Borg El Arab Beach Hotel is a peaceful beachfront hotel with a beautiful private beach, clear water, and clean, elegant rooms with daily housekeeping. It's especially relaxing outside peak season, with the main request from guests being a reopened, properly shaded kids' club.
address: Km 52, Alexandria-Matrouh Desert Rd, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 23121

name: Royal N.J Hotel & Resort
description: Royal N.J is a budget hotel notable mainly for being the closest option to Borg El Arab Airport, near a hypermarket and train station. Reviews are very mixed, with some finding it clean and convenient for a quick overnight and others citing cleanliness and value complaints, so confirm pricing in advance.
address: New Borg El Arab City, Marsa Matrouh, Hod Sakra & Abu Hamad, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 5221570

name: Spring House Compound
description: Spring House is a clean, quiet compound very close to Borg El Arab Airport, offering excellent value and a gracious, helpful host. Guests consistently praise the hospitality, comfort, and peaceful setting for an overnight or short stay.
address: St 108, Al Dheraa Al Bahari, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 5217384

name: Jasmine cottage
description: Jasmine cottage is a 5-star hotel in Alexandria.
address: Unnamed Road, Bahig, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 5244788

name: Motel King Mariout
description: Motel King Mariout is a quiet retreat near supermarkets, cafes, and restaurants, well-suited to travelers seeking space away from city noise. Experiences vary widely, however, with some praising clean rooms and excellent service and others reporting service and comfort problems.
address: Qetaa Maryout, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5247030

name: Sidi Krair Armed Forces Resort
description: Sidi Krair Armed Forces Resort is a 4-star hotel in Alexandria.
address: 40M, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate

name: King Mariout Villas Alexandria
description: King Mariout Villas is a quiet, upscale villa compound with clean air and amenities like snooker and table tennis, set in a calm, green environment. It's a peaceful spot for a relaxed stay away from the city bustle.
address: Mohamed Rachid Rd, Ekeingy Maryout (Sharq WA Gharb), Second Al Amreya, Alexandria Governorate 23713

name: Doctors Resort
description: Doctors Resort is a clean, spacious, family-friendly compound close to Alexandria with a good beach and indoor and outdoor pools, rarely feeling crowded. On-site dining is limited to a few outlets, and some amenities are villa-access only, so it suits self-catering family stays.
address: North Coast, Alexandria-Matrouh Desert Rd, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 23713

name: Villa El Eila
description: Villa L-3eela is a clean, spacious, fully equipped villa with a pool and games for both children and adults, ideal for a relaxing family getaway. It comfortably accommodates large groups, though a few note the building's surrounding location isn't the best.
address: Km 36, North Coast Rd, Negmet El Khalig St, Alexandria Governorate

name: Verdina
description: Verdina is a luxurious, secure North Coast villa community with an amazing beach, great for large families seeking a clean, safe getaway. Surrounded by trees and only minutes from the airport, it offers serenity away from the busier parts of Sahel.
address: XHQP+5GJ, Alexandria - Marsa Matrouh Rd, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, North Coast, Alexandria Governorate 5235003

name: Sedra Resort
description: Sedra is a clean, family-friendly resort with a great beach, beautiful views, swimming pools, and a water park, plus friendly, attentive hosts and good maintenance. Personalized service and hospitality stand out, with the main downside being limited nighttime activities, though a mall is close by.
address: 2J47+6CV, Alexandria - Marsa Matrouh Rd, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, North Coast, Alexandria Governorate 5236132

name: Sidi Krir Resort - North Coast
description: Sidi Krer village is a quiet, secure, family-friendly North Coast resort with clean villas, swimming pools, a swimmable lake, restaurants, and supermarkets nearby. It's well-maintained and safe for kids, making it a great choice for a relaxing summer holiday.
address: 2J8P+93W, Alexandria - Marsa Matrouh Rd, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5251101

name: Villa Norina
description: Villa Norina is a 5-star hotel in Alexandria.

name: Villa oasis
description: Villa Oasis is a clean, well-equipped villa with friendly, helpful owners, a spacious organized kitchen, and a nice pool, great for large families and gatherings. Guests return again and again for the relaxing atmosphere, free WiFi, and warm hospitality.
address: 2Q39+332, Ekeingy Maryout (Sharq WA Gharb), Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5247122

name: Ostaz Farid
description: Ostaz Farid is a hotel in Alexandria offering simple, practical lodging for travelers. It provides a convenient base for visitors exploring the city.
address: Borg El Arab Rd entrance, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 5215811

name: Alexmotel
description: Alexmotel is a 5-star hotel in Alexandria.
address: 3M5R+492, Alexandria - Marsa Matrouh Rd, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5251644

name: North coast
description: This North Coast spot is celebrated for its breathtaking beach, crystal-clear sea, and refreshing breeze, sometimes likened to the Egyptian Maldives. It's a divine seaside escape, especially enjoyable with family.
address: V974+PCX, North Coast Area, North Coast, Alexandria Governorate 5075403

name: Indulge El Montazah Hotel
description: Indulge El Montazah Hotel is a 4-star hotel in Alexandria.
address: 79 Matrouh-Alexandria Road, North Coast, Marsa Matrouh Governorate 5093301

name: Montazah Water Sports Club
description: Montazah Water Sports Club is a well-kept, organized spot for water activities like kayaking, though the club itself is members-only. Its Ritsa cafe is open to visitors, with a great view, friendly service, and surprisingly reasonable prices.
address: 72P9+X9P, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Villa Baytona residence
description: Villa Baytona is a villa-style residence with a wonderful garden and swimming pool that appeals to many guests, and some praise the caring service. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about cleanliness, water pressure, limited area services, and inconsistent management, so it's worth confirming details before booking.
address: King’s wood, street, kafoury road, Bahig, Second Al Amreya, Alexandria Governorate 5244772

name: Laguna King
description: Laguna King is a clean, comfortable village hotel with kind, helpful owners, cozy rooms, and a tasteful breakfast, offering good value for the price. Some in-room amenities are limited and parts were still under construction, but guests describe a pleasant, welcoming stay.
address: Ekeingy Maryout (Sharq WA Gharb), Second Al Amreya, Alexandria Governorate 5244878

name: Radisson Blu Hotel & Convention Center, Alexandria
description: The Radisson Blu is an upscale hotel and convention center with spacious, clean rooms, a well-equipped fitness room, indoor and outdoor pools, and a spa, backed by professional, attentive staff. It's somewhat isolated, so a car is helpful, but most guests describe an excellent, comfortable stay.
address: Alex West, Mehwar El Taameer, Road 23rd, North Coast, Alexandria Governorate 21599

name: TOLIP Family Club Borg El Arab
description: TOLIP Family Club in Borg El Arab is a quiet resort hotel with a pool, trampoline, spa, and English-speaking staff, set about 45 minutes from downtown Alexandria. Reviews are mixed, however, with some praising the facilities and others citing dated, poorly maintained rooms, so it's worth checking recent feedback.
address: Ekeingy Maryout (Sharq WA Gharb), Second Al Amreya, Alexandria Governorate 5247007

name: Africana Hotel and Spa
description: Africana Hotel and Spa is an oasis-like retreat with beautiful gardens, immaculate rooms, elegant decor, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere, popular for both relaxing stays and weddings. Guests consistently praise the comfort, service, and convenient access to local attractions.
address: Madinet Borg Al Arab, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 23719

amenities: Atm Of The National Bank Of Egypt

name: Hilton Alexandria King's Ranch
description: The Hilton King's Ranch is a well-appointed hotel with excellent facilities, a poolside cafe, beach access, and friendly, professional staff who earn frequent praise by name. Most stays are excellent, though a few guests have reported check-in delays and room-readiness issues.
address: 10.5 km, Cairo - Borg El-Arab Desert Rd, Ekeingy Maryout (Sharq WA Gharb), Alexandria Governorate

name: Dana Plaza Hotel
description: Dana Plaza Hotel is a 4-star hotel in Alexandria.
address: Intersection Of Rd.2, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate

amenities: Family Condo With Panoramic Sea View

name: Flores casas de playa
description: Flores Casas de Playa offers clean, beautifully furnished beach apartments with breathtaking direct sea views and a kind, helpful host, all at great value. The immediate surroundings can be a bit rough, but the units themselves and the views win guests over.
address: Elzouhor St. ( natural gas First building on the beach, Km 19 5 Alex. Mateouh road, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5252833

name: family condo with panoramic sea view
description: This is a residential apartment rental with panoramic sea views in a beach community. Reviews are mixed, with some finding it a good holiday rest and others citing inconsistent quality, broken streets, and prices that don't match the value, so it's worth confirming the specific unit.
address: 1 El Dheraa El Bahari, First Amreya District, Alexandria Governorate 5252833

name: Siesta Hotel Alexandria
description: Siesta is a simple, budget-friendly hotel with notably large rooms and a central location, at reasonable prices. Note that towels aren't provided and reviewers report a decline in housekeeping and amenities, so it's best for travelers prioritizing space and cost.
address: 5WJG+VFC, As Sabheyah WA Izbat Sharkas WA Izbat Raafat, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5412011

name: Mira Resort
description: Mira Resort is a quiet hideout with a nice swimming pool and pleasant seating, where the water is kept clean and clear. Opinions vary, with some finding it relaxing and others a bit pricey for what's offered.
address: 3PMG+W49, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5252542

name: Sea Garden Police Hotel
description: Sea Garden Police Hotel is a clean, tidy, family-friendly hotel with very clean, safe swimming pools, friendly staff, and good value for a three-star property. Its main drawback is that there's no beach on-site, so you'll need to travel for the sea.
address: 4RRJ+G7M, Al Meks, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5312780

name: King marioute
description: King marioute is a 4-star hotel in Alexandria.
address: 3PJM+93W, El-Salam, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5252510

name: Adham Hotel
description: Adham Hotel is a cozy, secluded hotel with clean rooms, a good restaurant, beach access, and a clean pool, plus on-site gym and spa, with many guests returning year after year. It's showing its age and could use renovation, but the facilities and helpful staff make for a pleasant stay.
address: 2QCC+XXX adham compound hotel, 1km borg el arab hwy. king mariut, Cairo - Borg El-Arab Desert Rd, King Maryout (Sharq WA Gharb, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate

name: Freelancer
description: Freelancer is a resort with a pool and a fun summer cinema that many enjoy. Reviews note recent neglect, however, with complaints about cleanliness and upkeep, so the experience can depend heavily on when you visit.
address: ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5252542

name: Car Mends
description: Car Mends is an amusement center with a variety of children's games. It's a decent option for kids, though some find the prices a bit high compared to other mall play areas.
address: 6X38+J8Q, Izbat an Nuzhah, Qesm Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: VR Arena
description: VR Arena was a clean, immersive virtual-reality venue with friendly staff and an enjoyable experience. Note that recent reviews indicate the location has closed, so it's best to confirm before visiting.
address: 6WHQ+9CC, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434023

name: Seven Seas Restaurant - Abu Qir
description: Seventh Seas in Abu Qir is a seafood restaurant praised by many for top-notch food, good service, and friendly staff. It runs pricey for the area and a nearby construction has affected the once-direct sea view, but the food experience wins fans.
address: 83F6+5MM, El-Moez, Abu Qir Ash Sharqeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527436

name: El Embrator Fish Rest
description: El Embrator is an Abu Qir seafood restaurant where the food can be fantastic, but reviewers consistently note that it's expensive for the area. Service draws some complaints, and several diners feel nearby spots offer better value.
address: 9 Mohammed Abdou, Abu Qir Al Gharbeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527426

name: Abu Qir Fish Store & Restaurant
description: Abu Qir Fish Store & Restaurant pairs a large fresh-fish market with a restaurant, run by experienced chefs and known to many for excellent grilled fish at reasonable prices. Reviews are mixed on service, but it's a classic Abu Qir spot for picking and grilling your own catch.
address: 72G4+R33, Al Mandarah Bahri, Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5526067

name: Captain Lobster
description: Captain Lobster in El Seyouf is a well-regarded seafood restaurant praised for fresh, clean food, excellent service, and respectful, responsive management. Many call it the best seafood spot in the area, offering good value for money.
address: El Soyof Shamaa, beside the National Bank of Egypt, Third Montaza, Alexandria Governorate 5515132

name: El Shalaby Seafood
description: Asmak El Shalaby in Asafra is a bit of a hidden gem for traditional seafood, with fresh products, fast cooking, well-liked seafood soup, and reasonable prices. The space is modest but offers dine-in, and the polite service and quality make it worth a visit.
address: 8 Salman El-Farsi, El-Mansheya El-Bahareya, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526062

name: Abo Saber
description: Abo Saber is a popular seafood spot praised for fresh, perfectly cooked fish and shrimp, nice side dishes, and friendly, smiling staff, with takeout also impressive. It's a sizable place and runs a little pricey, but most diners leave very satisfied.
address: Km 20, Alexandria-Marsa Matrouh Rd, before 6 October, Abu Yousef, Al Dheraa Al Bahari, Amreya, Alexandria Governorate 21928

name: El Emperator Restaurant - Abu Qir
description: El Embrator in Abu Qir is a seafront seafood restaurant where you choose fresh seafood and how it's cooked, with quality and generous portions at their best. Reviews are mixed, with some finding it pricey relative to the taste, so the prime location is a key draw.
address: 17 Mohammed Abdou, Abu Qir Al Gharbeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527430

name: 7seas & zephyrion
description: 7Seas & Zephyrion is consistently rated among the best restaurants in Alexandria, maintaining high standards in both food and presentation with excellent, professional service. Prices are on the higher side, but most diners feel the quality and experience justify it.
address: 38 Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Abu Qir Ash Sharqeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527436

name: Qasr El Sabreen
description: Qasr El Saberin is one of the better local pizza spots in the Abu Qir area, with tasty, good-quality pizza, generous fillings, and reasonable prices. Service can be a little slow at times, but the value and flavor make it a local favorite.
address: Abu Qir El Gharbeya, Montaza District, Alexandria Governorate 5528350

name: Al.Non Sea Food Resturant
description: Al.Non is a traditional, family-run Abu Qir seafood restaurant where the food is worth the wait. Reviews note that the new port has pushed the sea farther from the restaurant and that prices run higher than the simple setting suggests, so it's about the food rather than the view.
address: Abu Qir Ash Sharqeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527438

name: Bela Vesseta Restaurant
description: Bela Vesseta is one of the oldest and most prestigious seafood restaurants in Abu Qir, recently renovated, with a beautiful sea view and plenty of history, including a reputation as a spot once frequented by President Sadat. It's a quiet, scenic place to enjoy fresh fish by the sea.
address: Abu Qir El Sharqeya, Montaza District, Alexandria Governorate 5527438

name: Paradise Seafood - Abu Fathy Fish
description: Paradise (Abo Fathy) is essentially a small fish shop serving food rather than a full restaurant, with good, reasonably priced seafood. The setting and surroundings draw criticism for cleanliness and limited seating, so it's better suited to takeaway.
address: 8393+CRH, Bardesi, Abu Qir Al Gharbeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527403

name: Om Reda Fish - Abu Qir
description: Om Reda Fish is a seafood restaurant in the Abu Qir area of Alexandria, known for fresh fish and shellfish prepared in traditional Egyptian style. Abu Qir is famous for its seafood, and this spot offers a casual, local dining experience.
address: Al Giesh, Abu Qir Al Gharbeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527415

name: El Noon Cafeteria
description: Cafeteria El Non offers a heavenly beachfront setting where the sea practically touches your feet while you enjoy fresh seafood, with the shrimp soup a must-try. It's far from the city, and a few have found quality inconsistent, but many rate it among the best for seafood with a view.
address: 83G7+5GJ, Al Giesh, Abu Qir Ash Sharqeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527438

name: Weza Cafeteria & Restaurant
description: Wezza is a heritage seafood cafeteria and restaurant in Abu Qir with a beautiful, quiet beach view and home-style cooking. It serves seafood and soft drinks only, but the setting and traditional flavors are well-loved.
address: 83C5+4FW, Abu Qir Al Gharbeyah, Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5527415

name: Khair El Bahr Seafood - Lisan Abu Qir
description: Khair El Bahr is a seafood restaurant at Lisan Abu Qir in Alexandria, serving freshly caught fish and shellfish grilled or fried to order. Its seaside setting makes it a popular choice for a relaxed seafood meal.
address: 25 St, Tosson, Alexandria Governorate

name: Ballu Restaurant
description: Ballu is a seafront restaurant with a prime Mediterranean location, praised for amazing, fresh fish, quick service, and very reasonable prices. The breathtaking view and top-notch food make it a memorable spot.
address: 83F7+V5F, Al Giesh, Abu Qir Ash Sharqeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527438

name: Abu Yousof Fish Market
description: Abu Yousof is a fish market and restaurant where many praise top-notch ingredients, generous portions, and trustworthy, honest service. Reviews are mixed, however, with some reporting long waits and quality issues, so experiences can vary by visit.
address: 73X5+J4, Al Maamourah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5528113

name: El Sheikh Restaurant - Egyptian & Syrian Cuisine
description: This Egyptian and Syrian restaurant draws overwhelmingly negative reviews, with repeated complaints about poor food quality and bad service. Most reviewers do not recommend it.
address: Ahmed Orabi St, Abu Qir

name: Abu Hassan Grills
description: Abu Hassan is a clean grill spot in a good location, well-regarded for fresh grilled meats and especially praised grilled chicken. The surrounding street and shops aren't the most appealing, but the food itself wins fans.
address: 3 El-Moez, Abu Qir Ash Sharqeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527431

name: El Rashidy Restaurant
description: El Rashidy is a casual Alexandrian eatery known for falafel (taameya) and other Egyptian breakfast and street-food staples. It is a quick, affordable stop for a traditional local bite.
address: 2 El-Ikhlas Ln, Abu Qir Al Gharbeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527420

name: Academy Restaurant
description: Academy is a restaurant that has improved after renovations, with a cleaner space, nice lighting, and a diverse menu. Reviews are mixed, however, with some praising the service and others citing poor food and staff, so experiences vary.
address: 8366+3R8, Abu Qir Al Gharbeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5528332

name: Koshary Zaeem Alexandria - Amr & Emad, Abu Qir
description: This is a branch of the Zaeem koshari chain in the Abu Qir area. Reviews skew negative, with complaints about bland, cold koshari, small portions, and inconsistent quality between branches, so expectations should be modest.
address: Abou Kir, Abu Qir Ash Sharqeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527431

name: The Hub
description: The Hub is a cafe and restaurant whose reviews are strongly negative, with repeated complaints about food quality, order accuracy, and rude, unprofessional service. Most reviewers advise against it.
address: Lisan Gleem, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Seekh Mashwy
description: Seekh Mashwy is a well-liked grill house that also serves seafood, with a nice terrace view, freshly baked bread, and praised dishes like Iskandarani liver and grilled kofta. Most experiences are positive, though a few cite quality and value complaints, and upper-floor seating can be limited.
address: Glime Beach, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Corcovado
description: Corcovado in Gleem Bay is a restaurant and cafe with an amazing sea view, polite, friendly staff, and good value, especially with set menus. Opinions on the food are mixed, ranging from good to merely okay, so the view and atmosphere are the main draw.
address: 6XV5+4H4 Gleem Bay, Alexandria, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Friends Gleem Bay
description: Friends in Gleem Bay is a venue with beautiful decor that some find lovely for birthdays, engagements, and photoshoots. Reviews are very mixed, however, with multiple complaints about high prices, food quality, and service, so it's worth managing expectations.
address: 347 El Geish Rd, the Corniche, Gleem, in front of Lisan Gleem, San Stefano, El Raml District, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Spicy
description: Spicy is a clean, well-regarded koshari spot in Gleem, praised for consistent, fresh, high-quality koshari, including a version with liver, both in-store and via delivery. It runs a touch pricey and service can be slow at times, but the quality is reliable.
address: 18 Mostafa Fahmy, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5450333

name: Chicken Chester
description: Chicken Chester is a takeaway spot with affordable prices and quick service, where the chicken burgers and crispy chicken earn praise. Quality can be inconsistent, with some reporting cold food and excess sauce, so results vary by visit.
address: Gleem Bay, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Abo Rawia
description: Abo Rawia is a tucked-away local gem serving authentic Egyptian dishes like lamb, pigeon soup, and stuffed grape leaves, with friendly, tourist-welcoming staff and an oriental atmosphere. It's not luxurious and runs a bit pricey, with a few feeling quality has slipped, but many still rate it highly.
address: 6V3J+P89, Halawa Ln, Al Berkah, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321362

name: Restaurant B.A.D Sushi
description: B.A.D Sushi is a sushi restaurant with sharply divided reviews. While some praise the food and smiling service, many cite poor customer service, presentation issues, and substitutions like cucumber for avocado, so experiences are inconsistent.
address: 32 Mohammed Safwat St, Abu El Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433111

name: B.Laban - Hanovil
description: B.Laban in Hanovil is a dessert and ice-cream spot with delicious treats, generous extra sauces, and respectful service at its best. Reviews are mixed, however, with some citing high prices, small scoops, and inconsistent packaging between branches.
address: Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5313604

name: Abu Rawya Grills Restaurant
description: Abo Rawia is a grill restaurant in Agami where the chicken and kofta are decent. Reviews are mixed-to-negative, though, with several complaints about long waits and food that arrives cold or not fresh, so it's a backup rather than a destination.
address: Al Hanouvel, Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 21575

name: Abu Ali Restaurants
description: Abo Ali is one of Alexandria's oldest and most successful traditional eateries, beloved for its fava beans (foul) and falafel. It's a classic local spot for a hearty, authentic Egyptian breakfast.
address: 7X5M+587, El-Shaikh El-Sayed Ramadan, Sidi Beshr Qebli, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517162

name: Abu El Goud Syrian Pizza & Manakish
description: Abo El Goud is a Syrian pizza and manakeesh spot with delicious, well-priced food, a clean shop, and attentive, friendly service, making it a daily favorite for many. The labneh-with-vegetables manakeesh is a particular standout.
address: 18 Fadali St, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza 2, Miami, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Hamburgeni
description: Hamburgeni is a clean burger spot praised for consistently good quality, tasty food that arrives hot, respectful staff, and excellent service, plus standout branding. Some find the sandwich portions a little small, but most experiences are excellent.
address: 4Q36+G56, Alexandria - Marsa Matrouh Rd, Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5313465

name: Khawater Dimashqiya
description: Khawater Demashqia is a Syrian restaurant with delicious, distinctive food and reasonable, filling portions that set it apart from others. The main drawbacks are long wait times and inconsistent order accuracy and customer service, so patience helps.
address: 22 Salem, Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5312324

name: Koftagy
description: Kaftaji is a charming grill restaurant with a lovely seating area, authentic old-style grilled food, and excellent service, open from midday until late. Its great location and traditional taste make it a pleasant local choice.
address: El Hanovil, Alexandria-Marsa Matrouh Rd, Alexandria Governorate

name: Ashour
description: Ashour pairs a fish market out front with a restaurant in back, where you pick fresh seafood to be cooked, with the butterfly shrimp and creamy seafood casserole earning praise. The food is fresh and tasty with kind staff, though a few find it a bit overpriced for the simple setting.
address: 22 Khaled Ibn El Walid St, Miami, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Hawy Kebda & Kalawy (Am Moharram)
description: El Hawy (Am Moharram) is a popular Alexandrian spot specializing in Egyptian-style liver and kidneys, served in sandwiches or on plates. It is a beloved local destination for hearty, no-frills street food.
address: El Hanovil Main St corner, Radwan, Alexandria Governorate

name: Retro playstation & cafe
description: Retro is a relaxed PlayStation cafe with a chill atmosphere and very good prices, popular for gaming and hanging out. It's a solid, budget-friendly spot for a casual outing.
address: Abu Shawareb St, first St on the left next to Abu Ali Cafe, Agami El Hanovil, Alexandria Governorate

name: Lawyer's Club, Alexandria
description: The Lawyers' Club is a social club with a clean, newly furnished hall and mosque, often used for weddings and events, with good service. The main complaint is overly loud music at events, but the venue and staff are generally well-regarded.
address: Alexandria Corniche, Fleming, Second Raml District, Alexandria

name: El Loqma El Shamiya
description: El Loqma El Shamia is one of the older Syrian spots in Agami, serving sandwiches on Lebanese bread at reasonable prices. Reviews suggest the quality and service have slipped over time, with cleanliness and staff attentiveness drawing criticism, so it's an average option today.
address: 1 Al Komei, Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5313383

name: Alex King
description: Alex King is a casual spot serving well-liked pizza, with a pool area and a pleasant setting. Note that reviewers indicate it has relocated from this address, so it's best to confirm the current location before visiting.
address: 5 Al Hag Heba Saeed, Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5313340

name: El Saleheen
description: El Saliheen is a popular, no-frills eatery serving fava beans, falafel, koshari, and sandwiches at very cheap prices. The atmosphere and cleanliness are basic, but it's a long-standing, affordable local option run by people many trust.
address: 57 Ali Ibn Abi Talib, Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5313357

name: Sushi Bar
description: This is listed as a sushi spot praised by some as one of the best in Alexandria for flavor and service. However, several recent reviews report that there's no sushi bar at this location, so it's worth verifying before going.
address: Agami Bahari, Dekheila, Alexandria Governorate 5313356

name: Pono cafe-Alexandria
description: Pono is a classy cafe with a beautiful location, thoughtful decor, and a lively atmosphere, with service that exceeds expectations for many. Reviews are somewhat mixed on service consistency, but most enjoy the setting and vibe.
address: 4Q76+MQQ, Agami elhanovil, Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Abu Younes
description: Abo Younis is a fast-food spot where the mix grill, Syrian chicken, and desserts can be delicious. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about over-salting, slow, distracted service, and inconsistent portions, so experiences vary.
address: El Hanovil, in front of the Mobil station, Fathalla Market, El Hanovil, Alexandria Governorate

name: Panayoti Restaurant
description: Panayoti is a Syrian restaurant in the Agami old village area, opposite the Faculty of Commerce on the tram line, popular as a lively evening spot. It's a well-regarded local choice for a night out.
address: 24 Al Hamadi, Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5313356

name: Oshi sushi stanly
description: Oshi Sushi in Stanley is a cozy, aesthetically pleasing sushi spot with a warm atmosphere, unique seating, and friendly staff. Diners praise the tasty sushi and good service, with even some sushi skeptics won over, making it a pleasant choice for a special outing.
address: 6XJ3+XGM, Abd El-Rahman Shokry, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452004

name: Beit Fawkia
description: Beit Fawkia serves clean, delicious home-style food, sometimes with an open buffet, in a warm setting with kind staff that earns devoted fans. Experiences vary, with a few finding certain dishes salty or portions modest, but most reviews are very positive.
address: 17A Abdel Hamid El Abady St, off Syria St, Alexandria Governorate 21531

name: Fegoo sushi
description: Fegoo is a small but well-regarded sushi spot with reasonable prices, fresh ingredients, generous salmon, and well-liked shrimp noodles, plus friendly staff and a nice atmosphere. Most reviews are very positive, though the sushi itself can be a touch underwhelming for some.
address: 187 Ahmed Shawqi St, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5450101

name: Awlad Shabayek
description: Awlad Shabaik has been an Alexandria institution for over 30 years, beloved for some of the best kebabs and grilled lamb chops around, at great value. It's takeaway-only with no English menu and limited parking, and quality can occasionally dip, but it remains a nostalgic favorite.
address: 3 Tomazen, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5450112

name: Sikh Mashwy
description: Latino Hub (Seikh Mashwy) in Gleem is a stunning seafront spot with an interesting Lebanese and Egyptian menu, generous portions, and tasty food. The location and food draw praise, though service can be inconsistent, with some reporting reservation and timing issues.
address: 6XR4+HWQ, Elgesh street, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5310002

name: Al-Awaal Al-Demashky Restaurant
description: Al-Awaal Al-Demashky is a solid Syrian restaurant with consistently fresh food, incredible bread, and good chicken shawarma at moderate prices. It's not necessarily the best in town and waits can run over 15 minutes, but it's a reliable, satisfying choice.
address: 37 Khalil El Khayat St, off Mostafa Kamel, Kafr Abdou, Alexandria Governorate

name: Sultan Ayub Restaurants - Gleem Branch
description: Sultan Ayub's Gleem branch is a Turkish-style spot praised by many for very tasty food and helpful staff, with excellent sandwiches. Reviews are mixed on consistency, with some citing slow service, soggy fries, and smaller-than-expected portions, so the sandwiches are the safe bet.
address: 362 El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452032
