name: Abo Rabie BBQ
description: Abo Rabie is a long-running local chain (with Bolkly and Smouha branches) beloved for over 30 years for foul, falafel, and Egyptian breakfast staples at very cheap prices. It's mostly takeaway and a reliable, satisfying spot for authentic local food.
address: 6XJ3+GRF, Fleming, Qesm AR Ramel, Alexandria Governorate 5452004

name: La Verte Egypt
description: La Verte is a go-to for healthy snacks, meals, and balanced diet plans in Alexandria, with high-quality ingredients, a wide variety of products, and great customer service. Loyal customers praise treats like the walnut muffins and oat crackers, plus reasonable prices.
address: Al Aqesa WA Baqos, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5450227

name: Abu Kamal Restaurant
description: Abo Kamal is a long-standing, well-loved sandwich shop with good food quality, plenty of variety, and generally suitable prices. Seasoning can be inconsistent and staff aren't always the friendliest, but many are lifelong, loyal regulars.
address: 39 El-Fath, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5450112

name: CHEESE-R
description: CHEESE-R is a dining spot in Alexandria.
address: Beside misr bank, 71 Zakareya Ghoneim, camp chezar, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Qallaa Camp Shezar
description: El Qallaa in Camp Shezar is widely praised for superior-quality oriental feteer, considered by many the best in Alexandria. It runs pricey and orders take time, and it's better suited to takeaway, but most feel it's worth every penny.
address: 6W7F+H2V, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424052

name: Smash it
description: Smash It is a burger spot with a nice-looking interior, good vibes, and a pleasant location. Reviews skew negative on the food itself, however, citing small portions, excess sauce, and inconsistent quality and service, so the setting outshines the meal.
address: 58 El-Gaish Rd, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424082

name: El Shawaya Yemeni Cuisine
description: Al Shawaya is a Yemeni restaurant with sharply divided reviews, where fans rave about incredible food and friendly, English-speaking staff. Others report overly salty dishes and missing items on delivery, so experiences can vary by visit.
address: Camp shezar, Port Said St, Alexandria Governorate 21525

name: El Baraka Restaurant - Camp Chezar
description: El Baraka in Camp Shezar is a fried-chicken spot praised for crispy, hot, flavorful chicken and well-liked combos with saffron rice and sauces. The main drawback is slow service, with even small orders sometimes taking a while, so it's not a quick fast-food stop.
address: 14 Kafr Saqr St, Camp Chezar, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5424071

name: True Mama - American Restaurant
description: True Mama is an American-style restaurant with fast, friendly service and a clean venue, where dishes like the smash burger and New York fries earn praise. Quality can be inconsistent, however, with some reporting disappointing food and hygiene issues at events, so dine-in tends to be the safer bet.
address: 26 El Ismailia St, El Hekma St, Abu El Nawatir, Kafr Abdou, Alexandria Governorate

name: Eatabe Alexandria Hotel
description: Eatabe is a neat, clean hotel with a serene atmosphere, talented kitchen, a varied open buffet, and professional, helpful staff. Most stays are excellent, though a few guests have reported reservation mix-ups and paid-parking surprises, so confirm details at booking.
address: 303 El Geish Rd, Saba Basha, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452021

name: El Haram Hotel, Alexandria
description: El Haram is a hotel with amazing sea views, especially from the higher floors, clean rooms, and supportive butler service that many appreciate. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about value, breakfast, and reception handling of reservations, so it's worth confirming your booking.
address: 162 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21618

name: Blue Riviera Hotel
description: Blue Riviera is a very budget-friendly, homey hotel with friendly, welcoming staff and an excellent first-row sea view. Rooms are clean but basic, some with shared bathrooms, so it's best for travelers seeking a cheap, well-located place to stay rather than luxury.
address: 65 El-Gaish Rd, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424083

name: Club House
description: The Club House is a historic, scenic spot within the Sporting Club, good for relaxing, focusing, or socializing, with several food, gelato, and smoothie outlets on site. Service can be slow at busy times and food quality is acceptable rather than exceptional, but the setting and atmosphere stand out.
address: AR Riyadah, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433022

name: PINCH
description: PINCH is a wings-and-fried-chicken spot praised by many for tasty, fresh wings, tenders, and grilled chicken sandwiches, even late at night. Delivery quality can be inconsistent, with some reporting oily or cold food, so dine-in or careful ordering helps.
address: Inside Alexandria Sporting Club, AR Riyadah, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: Zanilis
description: Zanilis offers a calm setting with a pleasant view over the Sporting Club golf course and a varied breakfast and lunch menu of good quality. It runs a bit pricey for a club venue, with occasional notes about availability and flies, but the view and food generally please.
address: AR Riyadah, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433022

name: Sporting cafe - El assisa
description: Sporting Cafe (El Assisa) is a classic local public cafe with high ceilings, an amazing sea view, and a lively atmosphere popular for chess, backgammon, and watching football. Drinks are cheap with modest quality, and opinions on value and service are mixed, but the view and ambiance are the draw.
address: 136 El-Gaish Rd, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424084

name: WakWak
description: WakWak is a small, cozy spot specializing in chicken, fries, and mac and cheese, with generous portions, reasonable prices, and friendly staff. The chicken and fries are standouts and the value is great, though the dining area is tight, so it suits takeaway too.
address: 11 Shohdy Basha St, Stanley, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452020

name: Fatatry Dahab
description: Dahab is a well-regarded feteer spot considered by many among the best in Alexandria, with a spacious seating area, family section, easy parking, and a nice view. Prices are reasonable and the chicken feteer is a favorite, though a few have found certain savory fillings inconsistent.
address: in front of Sporting Club gate, on the tram, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria

name: Buzzing
description: Buzzing is a comfortable spot for fried chicken and beef sandwiches, with distinctive strips, good portions, suitable prices, and an owner attentive to feedback. Some find the burgers a bit oily or small, so customizing the sauce helps, but most experiences are positive.
address: 88 Officers' Buildings, beside City Square, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434041

name: Sidi Gaber
description: Sidi Gaber is a newly redesigned train station with schedule and platform screens, online ticketing, and some English-speaking staff, plus a BOB cafe and Fathallah market on site. It can get crowded with limited working ticket offices and occasional delays, but it's a key, well-located transit hub.
address: Abou Quer, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433011

name: ElWaheed, Alexandria
description: ElWaheed is a local takeaway spot for Egyptian staples like foul and falafel, with friendly staff and good value for the price. Opinions on quality vary, but the freshly fried falafel and welcoming service win regulars.
address: El Mosheer Ahmed Ismail St, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433042

name: Abu Riyad Syrian
description: Abo Riad is a Syrian restaurant where many praise tasty food, good prices, and exceptionally warm, welcoming staff who sometimes offer complimentary fries. Reviews are mostly positive, though there is at least one complaint about a cashier dispute, so most leave happy.
address: Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432069

name: Sidi Gaber Railway Station
description: Sidi Gaber Railway Station is one of the two main railway stations in Alexandria. Constructed in the 1850s, it is the oldest train station in Egypt and a key transport hub for the city.
address: 6W9V+H23, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: Smash & Splash
description: Smash & Splash is a burger spot praised for juicy, flavorful burgers with good bread and spices, great prices, and friendly service. Most reviews are very positive, with an occasional complaint about an order not arriving when items ran out.
address: 6W9W+C6J, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Shamiyat
description: Shamiyat is a restaurant in Alexandria serving Levantine (Shami) cuisine, with dishes such as grills, shawarma, and Syrian-style mezze. It offers a flavorful taste of Levantine cooking in a casual setting.
address: 6W9V+FVV, El-Shaheed Tayar Mahmoud Shakir Abd El-Moneim, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432069

name: El Rawda Seafood
description: Asmak El Rawda is a well-regarded seafood restaurant where the fish is guaranteed fresh and the frying is excellent, with helpful, skilled staff. The grilling and casseroles can be a notch below the fried dishes and prices run a bit high, but the freshness and quality win fans.
address: 50 Abd El-Aziz Fahmy, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433033

name: Pizza 88
description: Pizza 88 is a clean pizza spot with a warm welcome that delights some diners with its dough and ingredients. Reviews are sharply mixed, however, with several complaining of sparse toppings, small size, and high prices, so experiences vary by visit.
address: 6W8W+VFM, Victor Emanouil Al Thaleth, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080

name: Home Station
description: Home Station is a sophisticated cafe and PlayStation spot with fresh, healthy food, a great snack and beverage menu, and friendly, attentive service. Prices run a little high and the menu variety is limited for some, but many rate it among the better spots in the area.
address: 6X38+MQ6, Green Plaza, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Laimona cafe
description: Laimona is a cafe with great decoration and vibes and friendly waitstaff, plus a well-liked piña colada smoothie. Reviews are largely negative on the food and service, however, citing long waits, cold dishes, and inconsistent quality, so it's better for the atmosphere than a full meal.
address: 6WCW+8XP, Tout Ankh Amoun, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432069

name: El Beheira for Feteer Meshaltet
description: El Beheira is a beloved kiosk for feteer meshaltet and countryside products like cheese, milk, cream, honey, and ghee, with great taste and good prices. It's takeaway-only and cash-only, but many consider it among the best feteer in Egypt and a must-stop in Alexandria.
address: Dinshway St, beside the station, Abu El Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433012

name: Ala El Nasya Cafe
description: A El Nasia is a quiet, clean outdoor cafe in Sidi Gaber that's a comfortable spot for a relaxed sit-down, with well-prepared beverages and a polite shisha attendant. Service can be a bit slow even when it's not busy, but it's a pleasant regular hangout for many.
address: Abu Qir St towards Mustafa Kamel, beside El Beheira Restaurant, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: El Saidy Patisserie - Sidi Gaber
description: Halawany El Saidy in Sidi Gaber is a well-organized patisserie beloved for fresh basbousa, kunafa, and a wide range of Middle Eastern sweets, with friendly staff. Prices are generally affordable, though some note rising costs and that it closes briefly during prayer times.
address: El Mosheer Ahmed Ismail St branch, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433042

name: Sidi Gaber Bridge
description: Sidi Gaber Bridge is a pedestrian and traffic bridge in a busy area. Opinions are mixed-to-negative, with several feeling it complicated pedestrian access and the once-open beach view, and that traffic and the road beneath still need solutions.
address: 238 Roushdy, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber District, Alexandria Governorate 5434046

name: Soori
description: Soori is one of the older Syrian-style spots in Alexandria, still keeping a certain standard of dishes and sandwiches for longtime fans. Reviews note a decline in quality and portions relative to rising prices, and some point out it's more Egyptian than truly Syrian, so expectations vary.
address: 5 El-Shaheed Tayar Mahmoud Shakir Abd El-Moneim, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432068

name: Mostafa Gad
description: Mostafa Gad is a famous, always-busy local spot for Egyptian staples like foul, falafel, fried cheese, eggplant, and shawarma, with a genuine taste many have loved for years. Quality and service can be inconsistent and some find prices high, but the falafel, especially with hummus, has devoted fans.
address: 7 El-Shaheed Tayar Mahmoud Shakir Abd El-Moneim, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432068

name: Gad
description: Gad is a branch of the famous chain offering a huge menu of foul, falafel, eggs, and pastrami- and sausage-loaded dishes, with comfortable seating, a rarity for this type of food. It's clean with good service, though food can take some time and one reviewer flagged a food-handling concern.
address: 6W9X+F39, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080

name: Zeinyseafood
description: Zeiny is a seafood spot famous for its creative shell pasta served in seashells and Chef Zeini's flavorful seafood pasta, with fast delivery and high cleanliness. The unique presentation and rich, well-infused flavors make it well worth checking out.
address: Unnamed Road, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber District, Alexandria Governorate

name: Shokry Cafe
description: Ahwa Shokry is a classic, popular baladi coffee shop near the Sidi Gaber train station, prized for affordable prices, polite service, and a lively setting for people-watching. It's a well-located, old-style oriental cafe and a reliable local favorite.
address: 357 El-Horeya Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433011

name: The Bakery Corner
description: The Bakery Corner is a comfortable spot for a quick breakfast or brunch, with some praising the food, friendly staff, and standout drinks like the strawberry matcha. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about high prices and the quality of breads and pastries, so picks matter.
address: 19 Mostafa Kamel, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432064

name: Beef Goa Reghief
description: Beef Gowa Ragif is a burger spot that some find offers high-class service and tasteful staff. Reviews skew negative on the food, however, citing dry, tough meat, ordinary smash burgers, high prices, and order mix-ups, so experiences are inconsistent.
address: Square, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432069

name: Tico Potato
description: Tico Potato is a Fast Food spot in Alexandria.
address: Pilot Mahmoud Shoukry St, behind Carrfour, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Port for Nelson Island
description: This is the departure port for Nelson Island, a scenic historical spot popular for fishing, pleasant weather, and a fun boat outing. There's a military and navy presence at the gate, and parts have been under construction, so it's worth checking access before going.
address: 836F+C2V, Shoukri Al Khaoutli, Abu Qir Al Gharbeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Honey Moon Beach
description: Honey Moon is one of the nicer beaches on this side of Alexandria, with a calm spot to sit, decent accommodation, and cheap prices. It can get crowded and beggars sometimes interrupt visitors, but overall it's a pleasant seaside option.
address: Al Beitash Gharb, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5314738

name: Hannoville Square
description: Hannoville Square is a busy, iconic transit hub with a recognizable landmark statue, full of life and movement. It's also very crowded and noisy with heavy traffic and street vendors, so it's more a lively waypoint than a relaxing destination.
address: 3QXC+526, Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5313601

name: Hannoville Egypt Tours
description: Hannoville Egypt Tours is a travel agency praised by many for professional, friendly, and well-organized service, with good English communication and reliable drivers. Most travelers report smooth, stress-free trips, though there is at least one complaint about a missed special-assistance request, so confirm key details in advance.
address: 19 Saad Zaghloul Square, El Mesalla Sharq, Raml Station, Alexandria Governorate 21519

name: Hanovil Distinguished Beach
description: This Hannoville beach pavilion is a pretty spot with moderate waves and a cheap entry fee that includes a chair and table, with generally respectful staff. Be cautious of a deeper hole in the water and persistent requests for extra tips, and bathroom facilities are basic, so set expectations.
address: Al Hanouvel, Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5313552

name: Hanovil Public Beach
description: Hanovil Public Beach is a public beach in the Hanovil area west of central Alexandria. With open access to the Mediterranean, it is a popular spot for locals to swim and relax during the summer months.
address: 36 Mohammed Abdou Youssef, Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5313725

name: Gabi.egypt
description: Gabi is a Turkish restaurant where many rave about amazing food and excellent, attentive service, with staff like Mr. Mahmoud frequently praised. Experiences can vary, with a few reporting rude treatment, so service may be inconsistent, but most leave very happy.
address: 6WHQ+FGC, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434023

name: Otantik Kumpir - Sidi Gaber
description: Otantik Kumpir in Sidi Gaber serves authentic Turkish food, including its signature kumpir, with fresh, high-quality dishes, an amazing view, and a warm welcome. The main drawback noted is slow service, but the food and hospitality earn strong praise.
address: 6WHP+4R, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434023

name: Dom’s
description: Dom's is a burger and sandwich spot with a great location, fast service, and a nice atmosphere, where the quality is solid even if flavors can be a touch mild for some. The Philly cheesesteak and burgers have fans, though a few wish the food were a bit more special.
address: 166 Al Dir, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434017

name: The walk
description: The Walk is a vibrant seafront complex packed with a huge variety of restaurants and cafes, a perfect spot for dinner with a sea breeze or watching the sunset. Some seating and individual venues can be hit or miss, but the atmosphere and dining choices make it a popular destination.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434023

name: Carbs
description: Carbs is an Italian spot with great vibes, exceptional service, and distinctive dishes like shrimp pasta and chicken pizza, with managers who check on guests and occasional complimentary treats. The food and hospitality stand out, though smoke from the open kitchen can bother some diners.
address: 14 Ahmed Abd El-Aziz, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433113

name: Noya
description: Noya is a clean, attractive seafront restaurant with indoor and water's-edge outdoor seating, reasonable prices, and well-liked pizza, pasta, and coffee. Most experiences are very positive for family outings and celebrations, though service can be slow at busy times.
address: Tivoli Dome Mall, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: Harm El Hamam
description: Harm El Hamam is a centrally located, easy-to-reach restaurant with a spacious dining hall, though tables are packed closely with little privacy. Reviews are mixed, with complaints about undercooked or low-quality meat and service, so it's an inconsistent rather than reliable choice.
address: Inside City Square Mall, El Mosheer Ahmed Ismail St, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434041

name: Bunz
description: Bunz is a burger spot many praise for juicy, delicious, high-quality burgers, like the chili burger, plus tasty fries at reasonable prices. Experiences can vary, with at least one complaint about amenities and drink availability, but most reviews are very positive.
address: 6XG2+8HF, Ahmed Abd El-Aziz, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433113

name: IHOP
description: IHOP serves fresh, delicious American-style food with friendly, caring staff and good music, and several servers earn praise by name. Most reviews rate it among the better dining experiences in Alexandria, with only minor notes about tableware presentation.
address: 14th of May Bridge Rd, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116, Alexandria Governorate 5310002

name: Abou Fares El Sory Restaurant
description: Abou Fares El Sory is a Syrian restaurant with attractive decor, tasty shawarma and mixed plates, fast service, and good delivery, suited to families. Quality can be inconsistent and the card machine is often down, with at least one serious hygiene complaint, so experiences vary.
address: 6WGV+R56, Al Manteka Al Shamalea, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434041

name: Tots Point 6
description: Tots Point 6 is a cafe with a beautiful sea view, well-known for its signature sweet tots and a praised breakfast. Service is inconsistent, however, with complaints about long waits and loud music, so it's best enjoyed at quieter times for the view and desserts.
address: point 6, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434022

name: Kabab Ouzi
description: Kabab Ouzi is a beautiful, palace-like restaurant praised for fresh, flavorful grilled kebab and kofta, an amazing rooftop view, and kind, generous staff. Most experiences are lovely, though a few report slow service and billing issues, so it pays to check the bill.
address: Mostafa Kamel, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: Hotel Madina, Alexandria
description: Hotel Madina is a clean, budget hotel in a safe, convenient neighborhood, valued for its location, low prices, and a strong sense of security. The furniture is old and breakfast is weak, with a manually operated elevator, but it does the job for a no-frills stay.
address: El-Mosheer Ahmed Ismail, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433050

name: Jeddah Hotel Alexandria
description: Jeddah Hotel is a budget hotel with good-sized rooms, some with sea views, and generally friendly staff. Reviews note cleanliness, aging furniture, and highway noise as issues, so it's best for travelers who need an affordable, central place to stay.
address: 136 Khalf No.137, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434011

name: Golden Jewel Beach & Hotel
description: Golden Jewel is a beachfront hotel with a clean, well-maintained pool and beach, a varied breakfast, and friendly restaurant staff who earn praise by name. Rooms are comfortable if basic in amenities, and the seaside location lets you relax on the beach anytime.
address: Mostafa Kamel, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: Cleopatra Hotel Alexandria
description: Cleopatra Hotel has a convenient location, but its reviews are overwhelmingly negative, citing poor hygiene, aging furniture, weak breakfast, and unreliable service. Many guests, including foreign residents, advise looking elsewhere.
address: 160 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434015

name: Officers' Residences - Mustafa Kamel
description: This is a residential officers' apartment complex in Mustafa Kamel, not a hotel, known for flats available to rent in a safe, quiet neighborhood near City Square mall and central to Alexandria. Quality varies by unit, so it's worth inspecting before committing.
address: 6WHW+9RR, Street 14, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434043

name: ALEX HOMES - Stanley Luxury Apartments with Direct Sea View
description: ALEX Homes offers luxury apartment rentals in Stanley with a stunning direct sea view and a great location. Reviews are mixed, with some praising a beautiful, clean, fully furnished flat and helpful host and others finding it below the online photos, so confirm the specific unit before booking.
address: 277 El Geish Rd, Stanley, Alexandria Governorate 21656

name: Mecca Hotel, Alexandria
description: Mecca Hotel has a fantastic central location with sea views from many angles and notably friendly, responsive staff. Reviews are sharply divided, however, with strong praise alongside serious complaints about cleanliness, so it's worth checking recent feedback before booking.
address: 44 El Geish Rd, Camp Chezar, Al Ibrahimeya Bahari & Sidi Gaber, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21945

name: Stanley Bridge Apartment
description: This Stanley Bridge apartment offers spacious, good-value accommodation, often with three rooms, a strategic location, and lovely balcony views. Note that it's provided as a bare apartment with limited supplies like towels and toiletries, so come prepared.
address: Shohdy Basha St, Stanley, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Cleopatra Family Residence Hotel Alexandria (Egyptians Only)
description: Cleopatra Family Residents (Egyptians only) is a budget hotel with a perfect central location and sea views from every room. Rooms are narrow with old furniture and weak sound isolation, so it suits a quick, affordable stay rather than a relaxing or romantic one.
address: 160 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21618

name: Agami Beach
description: Agami Beach is a calm, pleasant spot, especially lovely in the cooler spring months, with a small entry fee for an umbrella and chair and attentive lifeguards. It gets crowded and cleanliness can suffer in peak summer, and waves can run high, so check conditions before swimming.
address: Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5314242

name: Sea beach place
description: This Agami beach within the Paradise housing community is a clean, well-organized, membership-based spot with lifeguards, security, and good facilities. The sea and sand are lovely and the crowd is calmer than many Alexandria beaches, though the access road is rough.
address: Street 5, Al Bitash Sharq, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5314438

name: Pietra Smouha
description: Pietra in Smouha is best known for outstanding, creative sushi, with each roll feeling unique, plus well-liked noodles and salads. The sushi and quality win strong praise, though the non-sushi oriental menu and service can be inconsistent, so it's a sushi destination first.
address: Tio Complex Mall, Victor Emanuele St, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21611

name: Piero Egypt Smouha Club
description: Piero at Smouha Club is a pleasant Italian-style cafe with excellent coffee, a quiet, work-friendly atmosphere, and fast, customer-focused service. Dishes are generally precise and tasty, with only occasional complaints about specific items, making it a reliable spot.
address: 6X82+VG2, Nady Somoha Al Ryadi, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080

name: Piero Egypt Matajer Mall
description: Piero at Matajer Mall is an Italian-style cafe with good staff and service and some well-liked dishes like the rocca salad and sausage. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about coffee that lacks flavor and inconsistent food, so it's less consistent than some other branches.
address: 6W6Q+HH2, Mohammed Fawzi Moaz, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432015

name: Pastaya
description: Pastaya is a small, cozy spot widely rated among the best for Italian food in Alexandria, with good quality control and well-liked dishes like lasagna, spinach ravioli, and white-sauce pasta. It can feel cramped and warm at full capacity, and a few find certain items inconsistent, but most experiences are very good.
address: El Naql wal Handasa St, Building O beside Smouha Club gate, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber District, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Makam
description: El Makam serves generous oriental feteer and pasta, with the cheesy seafood pasta and cheese-loaded feteer earning praise. Reviews are mixed, with some finding the feteer light on filling and service slow, but portions are large and several dishes are well-liked.
address: 9 Hatem Mosque, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432074

name: Maharaja Indian Restaurant - Smouha
description: Maharaja in Smouha is a clean Indian restaurant praised for tasty, well-presented dishes like butter chicken and chicken biryani, with flavorful sauces and approachable spice levels. Service and the atmosphere, including air conditioning, can be inconsistent, but the food wins fans.
address: El Mosheer Mohamed Ali Fahmy St off Admon Fremon St, Smouha, Alexandria 21646

name: Burger fire 55 🔥🍔
description: Burger Fire 55 is a fast-food burger spot praised for amazing, top-quality beef and chicken burgers with clean, fresh flavor. Reviews are consistently enthusiastic, making it a strong local pick for burgers.
address: elsayed semouha, 6 Dr Sayed Fahmy, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432065

name: 3etra
description: 3etra is a small, cozy spot with tasty, flavorful food and affordable prices, where the shawarma, burgers (especially the O mushroom smash), fries, and hawawshi earn praise. Portions can be rich and saucy, and seating is limited, but most diners happily return.
address: 41 Mohammed Bahaa Al Din Al Ghouri, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432065

name: Gorilla pizza
description: Gorilla Pizza is widely praised as serving some of the best Neapolitan pizza in Alexandria, with fluffy dough, fresh, quality ingredients, and warm, welcoming staff. It can be a little tricky to find, but reviewers consistently say it's well worth the trip.
address: El Shorta Building, Smouha-El Mahmoudeya, in front of iCare Hospital, Ezbet El Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431118

name: St. Tropez Restaurant
description: St. Tropez is an elegant, romantic restaurant with a relaxing atmosphere, gentle music, and respectful, attentive staff, popular for birthdays and special occasions. Diners praise fresh, well-prepared food and thoughtful touches like flowers and candles, making it a memorable choice for a celebration.
address: 25 Sant Giyn, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433113

name: Sushi kingdom
description: Sushi Kingdom offers a full Asian dining experience in a modern, stylish setting, with fresh, flavorful original rolls and well-liked main courses. Reviews are somewhat mixed on portions, rice texture, and service consistency, but many consider it among the best sushi in Alexandria.
address: 38 St, behind Smouha Sports Club, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432091

name: Karam El-Sham "Smouha"
description: Karam El-Sham "Smouha" is a Syrian spot in Alexandria.
address: Smouha Roundabout, start of Victor Emanuele Square, Alexandria Governorate 21111

name: PastaBucks
description: PastaBucks is a newer pasta spot serving tasty dishes like oven pasta, meatballs, and a standout shrimp pasta with fresh, quality ingredients and good portions. Seating is very limited with just a couple of outside tables, so it works best for takeaway or a quick bite.
address: in front of Mubarek Olympic Club, 84 Garden City Street, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432070

name: Abo Rawia Restaurant Smouha
description: Abo Rawia in Smouha is a warm, inviting grill restaurant praised for excellent, perfectly grilled Egyptian dishes like mixed grill platters and fried kebba, with attentive service. Experiences can vary, with occasional complaints about seafood and over-attentive service, but most find the food flavorful and made with care.
address: in front of Green Plaza, Ezbet El Nozha, Sidi Gaber

name: Focacceria smouha
description: Focacceria in Smouha is a well-regarded pizza and pasta spot, with the gamberetti pizza a standout and good overall value for the money. Pasta portions can feel small for the price and some find dishes merely average, but many rate the pizza among the best they've had.
address: Mohammed Bahaa Al Din Al Ghouri, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432065

name: Sultan Ayub Restaurants - Smouha Branch
description: Sultan Ayub's Smouha branch is a Turkish spot praised by many for excellent shawarma and doner, good portions, and smiling, attentive service. Quality can occasionally dip, with a complaint about cold, late food, but most visits are very satisfying.
address: Mohammed Fawzi Moaz, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432050

name: El Baraka Fried Chicken - Smouha Branch
description: El Baraka Fried Chicken in Smouha serves excellent, tasty, well-seasoned chicken, with the tenders and strips especially recommended, in a large, well-managed branch with friendly staff. The main drawback is occasional long waits and slow service at peak times, but the food quality wins fans.
address: Hatem Mosque St, Commercial Market, Alexandria Governorate

name: Tomato Pie
description: Tomato Pie is a pizza spot with a lovely atmosphere, friendly staff, fluffy dough, and quick service, where many rave about the taste over bigger brands. Portions of add-on toppings can be stingy for the price, but the half-and-half pizzas and crispy wedges are favorites.
address: St 38, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber District, Alexandria Governorate

name: B.A.D SUSHI, Wok of fame
description: B.A.D Sushi (Wok of Fame) is an upscale spot with stunning decor serving sushi and Chinese food that fans call fresh and flavorful. Reviews are sharply divided, however, with several complaints about rude, unprofessional staff, so service can be inconsistent.
address: Mohammed Fawzi Moaz, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432015

name: Saladero
description: Saladero is a salad-focused spot whose reviews skew strongly negative, with repeated complaints about bland, poorly prepared salads, high prices for small portions, and unprofessional service. Expectations should be modest.
address: El Farik Mohamed Fawzy St off Mostafa Kamel, Smouha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: Primo's Pizza smouha
description: Primo's Pizza in Smouha is a favorite for amazing, flavorful pizza, including seafood and whole-wheat options, with great service, fast delivery, and good packaging. The front parking area can look untidy, but most diners feel the pizza is well worth the price.
address: 6W7W+7R7, Smoha Sq., Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432072

name: shot egypt
description: Shot Egypt is a charming, fancy hidden gem with a warm, elegant atmosphere, a talented and friendly chef, generous portions, and professional, proactive staff. Diners praise delicious dishes and standouts like the Spanish latte, making it a delightful spot for special occasions.
address: Solik, Building No. 5, El Naql wel Handasa St, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Potasta - Smouha
description: Potasta in Smouha is a highly regarded pasta spot with a lovely location, generous portions, good quality, and respectful, accommodating staff. A few dishes can be inconsistent, but it keeps growing in popularity and many call it their top choice for pasta.
address: 313, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432064, Alexandria Governorate 5423040

name: Burger King - Smouha
description: Burger King's Smouha branch draws largely negative reviews, with repeated complaints about cold food, slow and disorganized service, uncleaned tables, and order mix-ups. It's an inconsistent stop, so expectations should be modest.
address: Mohammed Fawzi Moaz, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432015

name: LAMADA Smouha
description: LAMADA in Smouha is a well-loved spot for fresh, hot, flavorful chicken sandwiches like the Lamada Mix and Lamburger, with friendly service and affordable prices. The food and value win consistent praise, with curbside seating adding a fun, casual touch.
address: El Qotn Towers, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: El Shabab Hotel
description: Al Shabab Hotel is a quiet hotel with a great view and beach access, often used for conferences, training courses, and group events, with a cooperative manager. It's a restful, business-friendly venue in a calm setting.
address: 8387+HCV, Abu Qir Al Gharbeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5528341

name: Spirit
description: Spirit is a cozy, welcoming Smouha cafe that feels like a second home to regulars, with great coffee, well-liked pasta dishes, and standout fries and chicken fajita sandwiches. Service can slow when short-staffed, especially on the terrace and weekends, but the food and atmosphere keep people coming back.
address: Albert El Awal St, Borg Selim, Ezbet Saad, Smouha Square, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: Kims smouha
description: Kims in Smouha is a nicely located cafe with great coffee, especially the iced salted caramel, quality products, and friendly staff. The sandwiches and atmosphere are less impressive for some, and Smouha Club parking can be tricky, but the drinks are the highlight.
address: 6W8W+6P3, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080

name: Slaps coffee
description: SLAPS is a clean, aesthetic, cozy cafe consistently praised for excellent, well-crafted coffee from quality Arabica beans, with professional, smiling staff. It's a favorite for a morning cup, with reviewers calling it one of the better coffee spots in Alexandria.
address: front of Helnan Hotel, Albert Al Awal, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432043

name: Veranda Cafe & Restaurant
description: Veranda is a casual cafe good for family and friend gatherings, with great beverages, hookah, PlayStation, and board games. It can get noisy and cold in winter, and food quality and service are inconsistent, so it's best for drinks and hanging out.
address: El Fardous St, in front of Kheir Zaman, Smouha Square

name: 24Seven Lounge (Smouha Branch)
description: 24Seven Lounge in Smouha is a popular shisha lounge with tasty food, big portions, fresh sushi, and friendly service, with several staff praised by name. Reviews are mostly positive, though there is at least one complaint of a very late sushi order, so timing can vary.
address: 203 Tutankhamun St, in front of El Riyada School, Alexandria Governorate

name: Bahgaga Cafe
description: Bahgaga is a comfortable, clean cafe with good service and a decent setting that many consider worth a visit. The main drawbacks are limited parking on a narrow, congested street and occasionally unreliable wifi.
address: Tutankhamun Towers, Second Tower, behind Sidi Gaber train station, Smouha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: Floyd’s cafe
description: Floyd's is a uniquely themed cafe with surprisingly good pizza and good coffee, with fans enjoying the music and atmosphere. Reviews are sharply mixed, however, with several complaints about a hot, enclosed space, weak AC, no wifi, and high prices, so experiences vary.
address: Building 13, El Tayar Mahmoud Shokry St, Smouha, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: Al sheikh Coffee House
description: Al Sheikh Coffee House is a specialty coffee spot widely praised for a variety of quality beans, knowledgeable and friendly baristas who customize your cup, and very good prices, including vegan milk options. Many consider it among the best coffee in Alexandria right now.
address: 6X85+M5H Transport and engineering co. building 5, Street 38, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080

name: Mr Monkey Playstation & Café
description: Mr Monkey is a PlayStation cafe with spacious, attractive private rooms, big high-resolution TVs for gaming or Netflix, good drinks, and respectful, helpful staff. There's no food and the couches aren't the comfiest, but it's a great spot for a private gaming hangout.
address: 93 El Qasem, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434040

name: Pick N Go
description: Pick N Go is a well-located, nicely decorated cafe chain with a great ambience and affordable, decent drinks. Reviews note inconsistencies, however, including no wifi, pushy seating requests, and pricing complaints, so the setting outshines the consistency.
address: 6W7W+9GX, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432074

name: Tio Complex
description: Tio Complex is a food court whose reviews are overwhelmingly negative, with serious complaints about reservation and buffet mishandling, poor food including bad sushi, and chaotic management. Most reviewers strongly advise caution.
address: Mahmoud Shokry St, beside the train station, Tutankhamun, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber 5432069

name: Pharos Café
description: Pharos is a chill, casual cafe good for meeting friends, recently renovated with moody accent lighting and screens for watching matches. It's a modest, comfortable neighborhood spot with good service rather than an upscale destination.
address: 6X53+7W3, Elshohada Square Rd, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432078

name: Lola Cheesecake Cafè
description: Lola Cheesecake is a warm, cozy, beautiful cafe consistently praised for delicious cheesecakes, fast, excellent service, and good coffee, with board games adding to the relaxed vibe. It's a favorite spot to indulge and unwind, earning enthusiastic reviews.
address: 42 Mohammed Safwat, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: Brew & Chew (Matajer mall) smouha
description: Brew & Chew at Matajer Mall draws largely negative reviews, with complaints about small, overpriced portions, food that doesn't match the menu photos, and overcooked dishes. Quality and value are inconsistent, so expectations should be modest.
address: Fawzy Moaz, Street, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: Roadside Lounge
description: Roadside Lounge is a spot for gathering, working, or playing PlayStation, with special rooms and outlets like a burger-and-pizza shop and a coffee-and-pancake stand. Reviews are mixed, with several complaints about slow service and a strict hourly-ordering policy under newer management.
address: 12 Tout Ankh Amoun, AR Riyadah, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432021

name: Treats
description: Treats is one of the better dessert shops in Alexandria, with friendly staff and well-liked treats like fluffy puffs, molten cakes, waffles, and pancake pops, plus great sauces. It's a quiet, comfortable spot for family and friends, with PlayStation and games available too.
address: 6W5X+JMQ, Mostafa Kamel, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432070

name: DESHO Cafe
description: DESHO is a cafe with sharply divided reviews. While some praise excellent service and delicious orders under new management, others cite cleanliness, slow wifi, and poor service, so experiences are inconsistent.
address: 26 Mohamed Bahaa El Din El Ghatoury St, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: Ecuador Coffee (San Stefano Mall)
description: Ecuador Coffee in San Stefano Mall is a small cafe near the cinema with good coffee and well-liked treats like the Nutella milkshake. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about declining service and a billing issue, so the coffee is the safer bet.
address: San Stefano Mall, 2nd Floor, Shop No. #201A, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: Ciao cafe
description: Ciao in Loran is a relaxing, practical cafe with good-tasting drinks at modest prices, clean facilities, and high service quality. It's an enclosed, cash-only space where shisha and cigarette smoke can be bothersome, but the value and atmosphere win fans.
address: Ibrahim Naseer St, Louran, San Stefano, El Raml 1

name: Cupista Coffee
description: Cupista Coffee is a Cafe spot in Alexandria.
address: 668 Abu Qir St (El Horreya Rd), Gianaclis, Alexandria Governorate 21914

name: Squadlounge10
description: Squadlounge10 is a PlayStation and movie lounge with well-furnished private rooms, decent internet, and AC, good for a group hangout. Reviews note inconsistencies, however, including limited privacy through glass doors, weak food, and neglected shisha, so it's best for gaming with friends.
address: 169 Abd El-Salam Aref, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451014

name: Rayaheen Nuts
description: Rayaheen is a Turkish sweets and coffee spot where most praise delicious treats, good coffee, and friendly, knowledgeable staff who happily explain the options. Reviews are mostly positive, with at least one complaint about staff conduct, so most visits are pleasant.
address: 401 Mohammed Ahmed Afify St, San Stefano, Second District, Alexandria Governorate 5452054

name: Cafe 26 Of July
description: Cafe 26 of July is a seaside spot with a fabulous view, charging a small entry fee whether you bring your own food or order from the menu. It serves drinks rather than full meals, with basic facilities, so it's best for a group outing to enjoy the sea view.
address: Alexandria Corniche, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452054

name: De La Vega Cafe & Restaurant
description: De La Vega is a cafe with a great atmosphere, lovely music, and a beautiful sea view, with some staff earning praise for excellent service. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about cleanliness, communication, and seating handling, so the view is the strongest draw.
address: Gleem Bay, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: PappaRoti
description: PappaRoti is a clean cafe with a great view, known for its fluffy signature Turkish croissant/bun and accommodating service for large groups. Experiences with staff can be inconsistent, and tables sit close together, but the buns and setting are the highlights.
address: 6XV5+2M4, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Dolchy cafe
description: Dolchy is a small, cozy cafe praised for delicious coffee, especially the Nutella French coffee, attentive baristas, good wifi, and reasonable prices. Smoking is allowed inside the tight space, but the drinks, atmosphere, and service make it a recommended spot.
address: 6XW9+R69, ahmed shokry st, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate

name: Veto Cafe
description: Veto is a multi-level cafe with a wonderful sea view, fresh air, and a lovely atmosphere, popular for sunsets and celebrations. Service can be slow with billing to double-check, and one sushi order ran very late, but the view and ambiance are big draws.
address: San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Ecuador Coffee (Gleem)
description: Ecuador Coffee in Gleem is a pleasant, quiet cafe with wonderful coffee, a varied menu, attentive staff, and reasonable prices, with small touches like a complimentary cookie. Most experiences are very positive, though there's at least one complaint about a per-person ordering policy.
address: 112 Abd El-Salam Aref, St, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21619

name: HAWK ELITE CAFE
description: Hawk Elite is a cafe with a nice view and PlayStation, where some enjoy the location and a fun movie-night atmosphere. Reviews are sharply mixed, however, with several complaints about unfriendly, unprofessional staff and the owner, so experiences vary.
address: Al Safera Hoda Al Marasi, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: cavallo cafe
description: Cavallo is a calm, elegant cafe with good, no-surprise-fees service and polite, helpful staff. The menu is limited with no food or desserts and smoking is allowed, but it's a pleasant, quiet spot for coffee.
address: 6XW8+WXF, 10 Ahmed Shokry, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452054

name: Ecuador Coffee (Louran)
description: Ecuador Coffee in Louran is a cozy, inviting cafe with great coffee like the ice mocha and generally five-star service. It's an enclosed space where smoke can bother non-smokers and prices run a bit high, but the coffee and atmosphere win fans.
address: 52 Al Mesak, As Soyouf Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21613

name: El Makan Cafe
description: Cafe El Makan draws largely negative reviews, with complaints about a Wi-Fi or extra-order charge, a smoky enclosed space, and poor conduct, even as a few note good service. Overall it comes across as average and inconsistent.
address: 21 Al Akbal, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451116

name: Azooza Cafe
description: Azooza is a cozy, exquisite little cafe with friendly, helpful staff, a welcoming owner, and tasty food and beverages, including some funky signature drinks. The main drawback is loud music and indoor smoking for some, but the service and charm win fans.
address: 6XXC+GJR, Mohammed Al Eqbal, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451108

name: Bruxie’s sanstefano
description: Bruxie's in San Stefano sits in the newer, less crowded upstairs seaside food court with a nice view and proper AC. Food is hit or miss, with complaints about small burger portions and the occasional burnt order, so the setting can outshine the meal.
address: 6XW8+574, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Cilantro
description: Cilantro is a reliable coffee spot with consistently good drinks like espresso, lattes, and shakes, plus tasty bites, in a calm setting with friendly staff. This branch earns particular praise, though there's an occasional complaint about drink texture, so it's a solid, dependable choice.
address: 6 Arbaa St, Al Dhahereya & Ezbet El Safih, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451008

name: Aroma
description: Aroma is a seaside cafe with beautiful sea views and a great spot to watch the sunset, with tasty food and friendly staff. Service can be slow at busy times and it gets crowded and noisy on holidays, with occasional drink-quality complaints, but the view is a highlight.
address: 6XV5+4H3, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: El Arabeya Moghat & Drinks
description: El Arabia Lel Maghat specializes in traditional drinks like sobia and sahlab, with clean, air-conditioned branches, friendly staff, and free product testers. Prices run a touch high and quality is excellent, so it's worth trying before you buy.
address: 181 Abd El-Salam Aref, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451105

name: Starbucks Coffee
description: This Starbucks offers the familiar menu with a nice setting and, at some branches, an amazing view, with several staff praised for great customer service. Reviews note crowding, inconsistent food like the pretzel, and wifi that needs a local number, so service and experience can vary.
address: 397 Al Kazeno, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452052

name: Angelina kyria
description: Angelina Kyria is a patisserie celebrated for some of the best desserts in Alexandria, with high-quality ingredients and skilled pastry chefs, especially the petit gateau, mango cake, and mini eclairs. It's takeaway-focused and runs expensive, but fans consider the quality worth it.
address: 161 Abd El-Salam Aref, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: Harris Cafe
description: Harris Cafe draws largely negative reviews centered on a policy requiring food or dessert orders rather than drinks alone, even when seats are empty, which many found disrespectful. The setup and service handling overshadow the experience for most reviewers.
address: El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Green Gourmet
description: Green Gourmet is a restaurant that earns consistently glowing reviews for exceptional, fresh food, a great atmosphere and vibes, and professional, upbeat staff. Diners describe experiences that exceed expectations and happily plan to return.
address: 37 Shaarawy, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451111

name: Sincero Pizzeria
description: Sincero Pizzeria is a cozy spot with an authentic Italian vibe, dimmed lights, and great music, serving light, crusty pizzas like the Verde, Gambas, and Azul that many call the best they've had. Pasta can occasionally disappoint, but the pizza and atmosphere win strong praise.
address: 31 Abd El-Hameed El-Deeb, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452054

name: Octa Cafe and Restaurant
description: Octa is a cafe and restaurant with a wonderful view, comfy seats, and friendly, helpful staff, good for dinner and gatherings. Reviews are mixed on the food, with notes about bread-like pizza crust and inconsistent timing and temperature, and some unsure whether it's a cafe or restaurant, but the setting is pleasant.
address: El Geish Rd, in front of 26 July Hotel, San Stefano, Alexandria Governorate 5452056

name: Beit Farouk Restaurant
description: Beit Farouk is a posh Egyptian grill restaurant with an amazing view, a clean space, and warm, professional staff praised by name. The grill can be inconsistent, with some finding it lacks authentic flavor or arrives overcooked, but the hospitality and setting earn strong praise.
address: El Geish Rd, in front of 26th of July Hotel, San Stefano, Alexandria Governorate 5451105

name: ROASTER
description: Roaster is a fried-chicken spot whose reviews skew negative, with complaints about bland, underseasoned chicken and fries, high prices, slow delivery, and a lack of dine-in basics like AC and trays. Quality and value are inconsistent, so expectations should be modest.
address: 27 Mostafa Fahmy, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Mutsu Sushi
description: Mutsu Sushi delivers a delightful fine-dining experience with professional service and fresh, delicious sushi and noodles at good value, where even non-sushi fans find dishes they enjoy. Many call it the best sushi in town and a place they keep coming back to.
address: Ibrahim nasser, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451105

name: San Loran
description: San Loran is a casual restaurant described by reviewers as a fun spot, though it's wise to set your budget before ordering. There's limited detailed feedback, but the vibe comes across as enjoyable.
address: 436 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452058

name: Abo Awad
description: Abo Awad is a casual local spot near a mall serving Egyptian staples like koshari, shawarma, and crepes at modest prices, with generally welcoming staff. Quality and service are inconsistent, with complaints about wrong orders and long waits, so it's a hit-or-miss option.
address: 6XV8+VFG, Al Kazeno, San Stefano, Qesm AR Ramel, Alexandria Governorate 5452052

name: Sultan Ayub Turkish Restaurant
description: Sultan Ayub's Turkish restaurant is praised for delicious food, polite staff, and some of the best shawarma around, with this branch noted for improved timing and quality. One drawback is staff pushing for five-star Google reviews, but most diners are happy with the food and service.
address: 8 Al Kazeno, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452052

name: 5 roosters fried chicken
description: 5 Roosters is a fried-chicken spot where the food is tasty and service is fast, in a quiet setting. Quality control is inconsistent, however, with complaints about warm cola, missing covers, and unsalted fries, so experiences vary by order.
address: mall's food court, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: San stefano sea court
description: San Stefano Sea Court is the newer upstairs food court with a great sea view, a clean, cool indoor dining area, and a better atmosphere than the older ground-floor court. Individual restaurants can be hit or miss, with some pricey, slow, or underwhelming dishes, but the space itself is a clear improvement.
address: 6XW8+778, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Cuba Havana
description: Cuba Havana is a casual spot with a pleasant beach setting and well-liked drinks, where many find the people kind and the atmosphere comfortable. Reviews are mixed on food quality and crowd, but the location and drinks are the main draw.
address: 5 Mohammed Al Eqbal, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451111

name: Tarboush Restaurant
description: Tarboush is a Lebanese spot in a mall food court serving shawarma and grills, with well-liked dishes like the chicken shawarma sandwiches and Dawood Basha fatta. Reviews are mixed on portions and value, with some finding it pricey for the amount, but the taste generally pleases.
address: El Guish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Nos Regheef - Gleem Bay
description: Nos Regheef is a fast-food spot at Gleem Bay in Alexandria, serving sandwiches and quick Egyptian-style bites. It is a casual, budget-friendly stop for a fast meal near the seafront.
address: Gleem Bay, Alexandria, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Manchow Wok
description: Manchow Wok is an Asian spot whose reviews skew strongly negative, with repeated complaints that the food isn't authentically Chinese, plus poor rice, noodles, and service. A few enjoy the chicken, but overall quality and value are inconsistent.
address: 399 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Abo Shakra
description: Abo Shakra is a grill restaurant with a panoramic sea view, courteous staff, and quick service, offering a great selection of kebabs, sheesh, and grills, with the chicken cream soup and tahini recommended. The food is generally good if not extraordinary and it runs pricey, but the ambiance and service make it a solid family choice.
address: 425 El Geish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml District, Alexandria Governorate 21613

name: Pancih Sushi
description: Pancih Sushi is a small business serving sushi and noodles that many call among the best in Alexandria, with friendly staff and good prices. Large orders can run late and the online prices don't always match in-store, but the taste and value win fans.
address: 407 Ahmed Shokry, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452054

name: Abdel Rahim Koueider
description: Abdel Rahim Koueider is a Buffet spot in Alexandria.
address: 6XW9+83R, Mohammed Ahmed Afify, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452054

name: Kami sushi
description: Kami Sushi is one of the best-regarded sushi spots in Alexandria, with amazing rolls, a lovely, peaceful atmosphere, and courteous staff, with Chef Mahmoud and the team praised by name. Even takeaway holds up well, and diners consistently leave delighted.
address: 1 Al Mesak, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517070

name: Sho3la Restaurant
description: Sho3la is a fast-food spot with a wide menu and reasonable prices, where fans praise clean, homemade-tasting food with generous fillings and good delivery packaging. Reviews are sharply mixed, however, with some citing hygiene issues and over-vinegared sandwiches, so experiences vary.
address: 52 Shaarawy, Street, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 21613

name: Boucheh
description: Bouchee is a banquet-style spot serving delicious, fresh traditional Egyptian meals with top-quality ingredients, and you can even bring your own meat or turkey for them to cook. With good timekeeping, well-prepared rice and lamb, and kind staff, it earns consistent praise.
address: 436 El-Gaish Rd, street, louran, Alexandria Governorate 5452058

name: Aussie burgers and more
description: Aussie Burgers is a seafront spot with friendly, accommodating staff and decent prices, where the mushroom burger and ribs sandwich can be flavorful and satisfying. Quality is inconsistent, however, with complaints about cold or undercooked food, so experiences vary by visit.
address: 6XV5+773 Gleem bay, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: San Stefano Cafe
description: San Stefano Cafe is a local spot with good decoration and a nice view of the sea and San Stefano hotel, suited to casual family and friend outings at convenient prices. Food and drinks are decent rather than special, and service consistency has slipped for some, but the setting is pleasant.
address: 395 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452052

name: Fresh Food Market San Stefano Mall
description: Fresh Food Market in San Stefano Mall, beneath the Four Seasons, is a stylish grocery and fresh-food spot with a wide variety of mostly imported goods and a cook-to-order meat station. It's pricey and the made-to-order steak gets mixed reviews, but many love the selection and atmosphere.
address: 8-10 Al Kazeno, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: HaraHetta Ramen
description: HaraHetta is a Japanese-style spot with an authentic local-shop feel, where the ramen, dumplings, and dishes like Naruto chicken ramen win fans at reasonable prices. Reviews are sharply divided, however, with several complaints about hygiene and specific dishes, so experiences are inconsistent.
address: 8 Mohammed Al Eqbal St, Louran, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21519

name: Oshi Sushi San Stefano
description: Oshi Sushi in San Stefano is an attractive spot with a great team and amazing-tasting sushi, popular for sharing platters. Service can be slow and understaffed and a few find the flavors over-sauced, but most diners enjoy the food and setting.
address: 7 Abd El-Hameed El-Deeb, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451102

name: Caballos Cafe and Restaurant
description: Caballos is a nice cafe and restaurant with good service, decent food, and an impressive drinks show, popular for coffee and hookah. It runs pricey and excessive indoor smoking bothers some, with at least one billing complaint, so set expectations.
address: 1 Ahmed Zou Al Fekar, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452058

name: Galaxy Hostel
description: Galaxy Hostel is a clean, very budget-friendly hostel with a famously friendly, helpful host (Charlie), good wifi, and included breakfast, making it great for solo travelers. Guests describe a warm, family-like atmosphere and a comfortable base for exploring Alexandria.
address: Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21539

name: Elites1 Hotel
description: Elites1 is a charming, welcoming hotel with impeccably clean, comfortable rooms and warm, family-like hospitality, with host Mostafa frequently praised by name. Guests consistently describe feeling at home, making it a standout for service.
address: 5 Ibrahim Rady, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433137

name: Lutchi Cafe & Restaurant
description: Lutchi is a comfortable cafe and restaurant for a late lunch or dinner, with friendly staff, fast service, and well-liked dishes like the mix grill and mixed appetizers. Reviewers consistently praise the taste, portions, and professional service, especially night-shift waiter Ali.
address: 72PJ+Q2P, El-Nasr, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Majesty Ma’amoura
description: Majesty in Ma'amoura is known for delicious feteer and pizza with generous toppings and good portions, plus local-brand products, with the pistachio sweet feteer and chicken ranch as standouts. Quality can be inconsistent, with a complaint about empty crepes and billing, but most enjoy the feteer.
address: El Kawthar Tower, El Nasr St, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2

name: Cappuccino D'Amour Cafe & Restaurant
description: Cappuccino Damour is a seashore cafe and restaurant with a beautiful beachfront view and an English menu, also handling event catering. Reviews note a decline in food and service quality over time and some discomfort with staff attention, so the view is the main draw.
address: El Maamoura Corniche, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Mykonos Café & Restaurant
description: Mykonos is a cozy cafe whose coffee earns strong praise from some as the best they've had. Reviews skew negative overall, however, with repeated complaints about very slow service, small portions, and food quality not matching the prices, so experiences vary widely.
address: Sea Gate Complex, El Maamoura Beach, El Shahid Youssef El Sebai St, Alexandria Governorate

name: Anwar Masoud Grills & Seafood
description: Anwar Masoud is a seafront grill and seafood spot with a stunning sunset view and fresh fish, where the best experiences feel like being welcomed by family. Beware that unrequested appetizers may be added to the bill and some report fatty, overpriced cuts, so confirm orders and prices.
address: El Geish Rd, beside the Montaza Sheraton, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21923

name: Barista Cafe & Restaurant
description: Barista is a family-friendly cafe and restaurant with tasty food, good kids' options, and a nice garden area in the evening. It can get smoky from shisha, so non-smokers may prefer outside seating, and service is occasionally inconsistent, but overall it's a comfortable spot.
address: 72PM+7CP, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Meto Square
description: Meto Square is a clean, spacious complex near El Montaza with a sea view and a variety of restaurants, good for families, friends, and couples from breakfast onward. Reviewers praise the value, with affordable breakfasts and well-liked bites like the chili burger, in a quiet, friendly setting.
address: 222 El-Mandara Mosque, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526074

name: El Suwesy Restaurant & Grills
description: El Sweisy is one of the better-regarded grill restaurants in Al Maamoura, with amazing food, very reasonable prices, and polite, courteous staff. Cleanliness and quality can be average for some, but the value and flavor make it a local favorite.
address: El Maamoura El Balad, in front of the railway crossing, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Ibn Bakri
description: Ibn Bakri in the Atlas area serves tasty sandwiches at very affordable prices, with fresh beef burgers earning praise. Portions run small, so you may want two, and quality can be inconsistent, but it's a handy, cheap spot for a quick bite.
address: 25 Atlas, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526056

name: HM JAVA HOUSE
description: HM Java House is a bright, airy, all-ages cafe with friendly staff, a kids' play area, good pizza, and free breakfast when you order a drink. The welcoming vibe and value make it a favorite for families and casual hangouts.
address: 72HF+7C8, El-Malek, Al Amrawi, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5525018

name: El Chef Hawawshi
description: Hawawshi El Chef is a budget-friendly spot praised for some of the best hawawshi in the city, plus good pizza and seafood at suitable prices. It's a reliable, affordable choice for a tasty, casual meal.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526074

name: El Kababgy
description: El Kababgy is a grill spot with sharply divided reviews. Some praise the taste from experience, while others report stale food and poor service, so quality appears inconsistent.
address: El Nasr St, El Maamoura Beach, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: El Araby Restaurant - Abo Ahmed & Ghazal El Sham
description: Abo Ahmed (Ghazal El Sham) is a popular local spot with a huge menu of Egyptian staples like foul, falafel, koshari, shawarma, and grills. Quality and delivery can be inconsistent, with some finding it average, but fans rate the food highly for everyday eating.
address: El Maamoura, Montaza District, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Bab El Bahr Restaurant
description: Bab El Bahr is a mid-range seafood restaurant with moderate prices and tasty dishes that many enjoy. Service could use more experienced staff and quality is somewhat inconsistent, but the value and flavor draw fans.
address: off Mauritania St, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526040

name: Ezz Syrian Restaurant
description: Ezz is a Syrian restaurant with delicious sandwiches, excellent prices, and friendly staff at its best, praised by fans for authentic Syrian flavor. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about cleanliness and service at some branches, so experiences vary.
address: 25 Atlas, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526056

name: Onda CafeMamoura
description: Onda in Ma'amoura is a popular hangout with a great view and atmosphere, genuine staff at its best, and well-liked drinks. Food quality is inconsistent, with complaints ranging from mediocre dishes to a serious freshness issue, so it's better for the setting and drinks.
address: El Maamoura Corniche, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Burger King - Montazah
description: Burger King - Montazah is a Fast Food spot in Alexandria.
address: 7XCX+F88, El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526053

name: Alexandria Mediterranean Suites
description: Alexandria Mediterranean Suites is an all-apartment hotel close to Mandara beach, good for families, with friendly, helpful staff and host Raafat praised by name. Furniture is average and it can be near a busy school, but many guests return for the location and service.
address: 6 Nemat Allah St, El Mandara Bahari, Bahary, Alexandria Governorate 21411

name: Emaret El Mandara Hotel
description: Emaret El Mandara is an apartment-style hotel at Mandara beach with great sea views, a good choice for families and groups in a lively, restaurant-filled area. Rooms are basic and you may need to bring your own soap and towels, so it's best for travelers who prioritize location.
address: 804 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526076

name: Al Raya Apartments
description: Al Raya is a neat, very clean apartment hotel with organized, welcoming staff and well-equipped rooms, recommended for family stays. The surrounding location can feel chaotic and the wifi signal is weak, but the value and rooms win praise.
address: 3 No 13, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21915

name: Panda House
description: Panda House offers beautiful, spotless beachfront apartments with breathtaking balcony views and an exceptionally attentive, kind host (Hatem). Guests consistently rave about the cleanliness, location, and hospitality, often preferring it to traditional hotels.
address: 810 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526076

name: El Mahrousa Hotel
description: El Mahrousa is among the better hotels in Alexandria, with big, clean, well-stocked rooms, stunning views, and exceptionally friendly staff. Some rooms and bathrooms run small, and loud rooftop music and tipping pressure draw complaints, but the overall experience is positive.
address: 466 El-Gaish Rd, As Soyouf Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 21611

name: Youth Palace Hostel
description: Youth Palace Hostel is a clean, safe, very budget-friendly hostel near the sea, with a peaceful atmosphere and a welcoming, helpful owner (Adham) who speaks good English. It's a well-located, comfortable base that consistently impresses budget travelers.
address: Khalf no. 33 - Syouf tram - Building 3, Alexandria Governorate 21611

name: XU San Stefano Hotel Alexandria
description: XU San Stefano is a new hotel inside San Stefano Mall with an excellent seafront location, small pools, and clean, attractive rooms with easy access to shops, cafes, and the sea. As a recently opened property, some report construction noise and check-in hiccups, so confirm room readiness.
address: El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, Louran, Alexandria Governorate 11611

name: Mamora
description: Mamora is a hotel with a great view and beach access in a prime spot. Reviews are mixed-to-negative, however, with complaints about entry fees, crowds, cleanliness, and value, so it's worth checking recent feedback before booking.
address: 72RJ+5PM, El-Shaheed Youssef El-Sebaey, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: El Mandara Hotel
description: Hotel El Mandara is a small, simple hotel with friendly, helpful staff, a nice roof, and very reasonable prices. Cleanliness and service can be inconsistent, so it suits travelers wanting a basic, no-frills stay.
address: 101 El Malek Hefni St, El Mandara Qibli, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Lolowa hotel
description: Lolowa is a budget hotel close to the sea, near supermarkets, a pharmacy, and a big shopping street, with helpful staff and fresh, nice breakfast. Rooms are basic and phone/wifi coverage can be unreliable, but the location and value suit single travelers and families alike.
address: Sidi Beshr Bahri, Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5517283

name: zafero
description: Zafero offers clean, well-equipped apartment-style rooms with kitchens, fridges, and washing machines at reasonable prices, with friendly staff. Reviews note some inconveniences like occasional water cut-offs, missing bathroom mirrors, and a room mix-up, so experiences can vary.
address: 693 Corniche Rd, El Karm Tower, beside Dahab Cafe, El Asafra, Alexandria Governorate

name: Ramada Hotel
description: The Ramada Hotel is a hotel in Alexandria offering comfortable rooms and guest amenities for both business and leisure travelers. It provides a convenient base for exploring the city.
address: 544 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 21611

name: Alaa motel
description: Alaa Motel offers very clean, comfortable apartments with well-kept furniture, close to the sea with all necessities nearby. It's a calm, simple option for a one- or two-night stay in Alexandria.
address: El sahafa, street, Alexandria Governorate

name: Mero Apartment
description: Mero is a spacious, beautifully furnished three-room apartment with new furniture, full amenities, and lovely balconies in an excellent location. Cleanliness can be inconsistent between stays, with some reporting dust or dated cupboards, so it's worth confirming the unit's condition.
address: Gaafar Ibn Abi Talib, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526064

name: El Masreyeen Hotel
description: El Masreyeen has a good location and friendly staff, but its reviews skew strongly negative, citing poor rooms, weak network and wifi, and limited services. The price suits a quick one-night stay rather than a comfortable longer one.
address: 11 Salah Al Din, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21611

name: ZAHRET ALFARDAOS ROOMS
description: Zahret Alfardaos draws overwhelmingly negative reviews, with multiple guests reporting cleanliness problems, an unreliable phone number, difficulty finding the location, and even calling it a scam. Most reviewers strongly advise against booking.
address: 2 El Fardous Mosque St off Galal Hammad St, Alexandria Governorate 21411

name: FLOWER ROOMS
description: Flower Rooms offers a large, easy-access apartment in an excellent location surrounded by markets, parks, cafes, and restaurants, with the sea a ten-minute walk away. Guests describe a clean space and a polite, respectful owner, making for a pleasant stay.
address: Ahmed Hamdy St, Arab Academy for Science and Technology, Miami, behind the Academy, Alexandria Governorate 21611

name: Lovely apartment with side sea view
description: This is a clean, well-equipped apartment with a side sea view, near the Corniche, markets, restaurants, and cafes, with a respectful, helpful host (Mohammed). Most guests praise the cleanliness and service, though there's at least one complaint about missing heating, so confirm amenities in advance.
address: 11 Mohammed Awad Gebreel, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517265

name: Elsraya Studios and Apartments (Families Only)
description: Elsraya Studios and Apartments (families only) is a highly praised, very clean property opposite the Alexandria Corniche, with spacious, comfortable rooms, fully equipped kitchens, and kind, accommodating staff. Its central location near a market and the sea makes it a strong family choice.
address: 14 Awad Hegazy St, El Geish, Alexandria Governorate

name: Luxury Hotel Apartment - Miami
description: This Miami apartment is a spacious, air-conditioned family flat near shops, restaurants, and the sea, with reasonable off-season rates. The neighborhood is lively and crowded, which some love and others find noisy, so it suits travelers who enjoy a bustling area.
address: 244 Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 98541

name: Palma Inn Hotel
description: Palma Inn is a hotel in Alexandria providing comfortable accommodation and standard guest services. It is a practical option for visitors looking for a convenient stay in the city.
address: Montaza Palace Gardens, Bab Sharqi & Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5422015

name: El Khabir Hotel Apartments
description: El Khabir Hotel Apartments offers furnished apartment-style accommodation in Alexandria, suited to travelers who want extra space and self-catering convenience for short or extended stays.
address: Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Alexandria cafe
description: Alexandria Cafe is a relaxing, homey spot with excellent service, polite staff, quick orders, and well-liked drinks like the ice latte at good prices. Most experiences are very positive, though there's at least one complaint about a booking price dispute, so confirm event arrangements.
address: Mohammed Naguib, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517185

name: Leil Cafe
description: Cafe Leil has a beautiful sea-and-old-buildings view and professional staff at its best. Reviews are sharply divided on the food, however, with several reporting cold, undercooked dishes and very long waits for grills, so it's safer for drinks and the view.
address: 6W23+W88, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372065

name: The Witcher cafe and more
description: The Witcher is a cozy, peaceful cafe with a nice atmosphere, polite, helpful staff, good-quality products, and generous portions at fair prices, plus solid internet. Service can be slow at times, but most reviewers feel it's well worth the wait.
address: El Geish Rd, in front of the Automobile Club, Sidi Bishr, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate 5517265

name: Brookfield Coffee
description: Brookfield Coffee is a Cafe spot in Alexandria.
address: 22 Mohamed Anwar El Sadat St, Miami, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Azizia Cafe
description: El Azizia is a seafront cafe with a beautiful direct view of the Mediterranean, popular for fresh drinks and good shisha. It gets crowded with a minimum charge, food and drinks are average, and service is inconsistent, so the view is the main draw.
address: El Geish Rd, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza District, Alexandria Governorate 5517196

name: Daily Dose Coffee House
description: Daily Dose is a friendly, cozy little coffee shop with good espresso at very cheap prices, a nice view, and warm staff who sometimes offer a free treat. It's a comfortable, affordable spot for a quick coffee that consistently pleases.
address: 46 Shimy Bake, Ras at Tin, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321320

name: Ayoub Coffee
description: Ayoub Coffee is a cafe and coffee roaster in Alexandria serving freshly brewed coffee and specialty beans. It is a cozy spot for a quality cup or to pick up beans to take home.
