address: 47-49 Mahmoud El-Isawy, Sidi Beshr Qebli, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517168

name: Baffin Cafe
description: Baffin is a seafront cafe with an amazing location where the waves break near the chairs, plus affordable prices, kind staff, and quick service. Most reviews praise the smoothies, waffles, and shisha, with only the occasional complaint about staff attitude, so most visits are lovely.
address: Alexandria Corniche, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517283

name: Caffee Borbone
description: Caffee Borbone is a calm, well-spaced cafe serving authentic Borbone espresso with Italian music and a non-smoking area, plus a diverse food and drinks menu at reasonable prices. The quality and atmosphere win praise, though some note that smoking elsewhere can still drift in.
address: 191 Gamal Abd El-Nasir Rd, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517215

name: Abo Ali Café
description: Abo Ali Cafe has some fans of its food, like meat stuffed with olives, crepes, and fresh mango juice, with occasionally friendly staff. Reviews skew negative overall, however, citing tipping pressure, loud music, and poor, overpriced service, so experiences vary widely.
address: 7XCW+53P, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517283

name: Avenues Cafe
description: Avenues is a lovely cafe just steps from Alexandria's beach, with wonderful decoration and lighting, amazing drinks, nice cake choices, professional service, and excellent prices. It's a popular, well-reviewed spot for hangouts and celebrations.
address: khalid bin waleed, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Twelve 12 Playstation & More
description: Twelve 12 is a cozy, quiet cafe and PlayStation spot with friendly staff, enjoyable drinks at good prices, and a study-friendly atmosphere, plus gaming rooms. Most reviews are positive, though there's a complaint about being rushed to order, so service can vary.
address: Miami, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate 5517181

name: Nana Cafe
description: Nana Cafe is a long-running Corniche spot (since 2014) with a prime seaside location, an extensive menu, and consistently good service and value. Most reviewers enjoy the drinks and atmosphere, with only the occasional complaint about worn furnishings or staff.
address: 466 El-Gaish Rd, As Soyouf Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 21611

name: VALLETTA
description: Valletta is a cafe with great AC and a nice side view of the sea. Reviews are mixed, however, citing the lack of a non-smoking area, average coffee, slow service, and menu prices that differ from what's charged, so set expectations.
address: 7XCW+6RX, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517288

name: Estcan Cafe
description: Estcan is a cozy, relaxing cafe with nice decoration and a comfortable atmosphere for a cup of coffee, with generally good service. It's a pleasant, low-key neighborhood spot, with only minor notes like occasionally running short on tissues.
address: 14 Mostafa El Nahhas St, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Second Montaza District, Alexandria Governorate 5517283

name: Crazy mouse cafe
description: Crazy Mouse is a big, attractive entertainment cafe with PlayStation, billiards, and ping pong, offering good value for money. The main drawback is poor ventilation in parts of the venue, but the activities and prices make it an enjoyable hangout.
address: 9 Salman El Farsi St, El Asafra Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526062

name: HOLA playstation & Cafe
description: HOLA is a well-liked PlayStation cafe praised for excellent service and very polite staff, with an appealing atmosphere. Reviewers consistently describe it as one of the better gaming-and-coffee spots in Alexandria.
address: 38 Seif El Din El Yazal St, beside Cleopatra Hotel, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate 5516348

name: Alex Lounge café & vape store
description: Alex Lounge is a stylish cafe and vape store with excellent service, a wide selection of vapes and accessories, both local and imported, and helpful recommendations. Reviewers praise the respectful staff and overall experience, making it a go-to for e-cigarette needs.
address: El Malek Hefni Main St, the beach after El Kateaa Fish Restaurant, El Maamoura, Alexandria

name: weewaa lounge
description: Weewaa is a big, beautiful lounge with nice coffee, shisha, and breakfast, and a manager praised for hospitality. Service is the weak point, however, with several complaints about slowness and order handling, so the setting outshines the speed.
address: 27 Iskandar Ibrahim St, Sidi Bishr, in front of Miami Central, Alexandria Governorate

name: fun coffee
description: Fun Coffee is a beautiful, calming cafe with excellent service, cheerful staff, and very reasonable prices that has become a favorite for many. Reviewers describe it as relaxing and welcoming, a pleasant spot for a daily coffee.
address: 56 Ali Basha Ibrahim, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517183

name: Al Sabbahi Cafe
description: Cafe Alsabbahi is a clean, quiet spot praised by some as serving the best espresso in Alexandria, with fresh drinks and shisha. Prices run a touch high for a few, but it's a well-liked daily coffee stop.
address: 32 Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517073

name: Coffee Yard
description: Coffee Yard is a beautiful seaside coffee spot with a breeze from every direction, great coffee, and amazing prices compared to flashier places. Seating is limited and service is average, but the setting and value make it one of the nicer spots to drink coffee by the beach.
address: 20 St 29, El Soyof Bahari, Second Montaza District 5517074

name: Pops Cafe and Restaurant
description: Pops is a huge, spacious two-floor cafe with swing seats by each table, a friendly atmosphere, outstanding decor, and notably professional, polite staff. Drinks can be a bit pricey for the quality, but the comfortable setting and service make it a great place to relax.
address: 488 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517074

name: Dardasha
description: Dardasha is a budget-friendly neighborhood cafe with good, cheap drinks that many locals enjoy. Reviews are mixed, with at least one citing uncomfortable seating and slow service, but it's a serviceable, affordable spot in the area.
address: 7X6M+9PM, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5517183

name: Omar Afandy Cafe
description: Omar Afandi is a quiet, well-located coffee shop that has improved after a refresh, with nicer decor, good service, and reasonable new prices. It's a pleasant spot to sit and drink coffee, though a few items and match-time pricing can be inconsistent.
address: 64 El Sheikh Ahmed El Sakandari St with Mohammed Naguib, El Soyof Bahari, Second Montaza District, Alexandria Governorate

name: Brazilian coffee
description: Brazilian Coffee is a small cafe serving good Turkish coffee and desserts at reasonable prices, with a decent menu to choose from. The space is tight and indoor smoking can make the air heavy, but the value and friendly staff make it a handy stop.
address: 9 Ahmed Hamdy, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517221

name: Kasr Elmandarah
description: Kasr Elmandarah is a seafront spot with a good sea view, decent service, quality, and competitive prices. The main drawback is heavy smoking with no dedicated area for non-smokers or kids, but it's a pleasant place to take in the view.
address: 72H5+87C, Al Mandarah Bahri, Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5526070

name: Split cafe
description: Split Cafe is a clean, cozy, well-priced cafe with quality drinks, excellent service, and a dedicated space for events like birthdays. Reviewers consistently praise the respectful staff and different-from-the-rest atmosphere, making it a reliable, affordable spot.
address: 5 Al Yazedi, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517280

name: Rally Cafe
description: Rally Cafe is a Cafe spot in Alexandria.
address: 7X5J+765, Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517074

name: Cafe Elhana
description: Cafe Elhana is a long-established neighborhood coffee shop known for excellent service, a variety of delicious drinks, and low prices, with respectful staff. It's a well-loved local spot with a friendly, welcoming feel.
address: 7244+RFV, Al Asher MN Ramadan, Sidi Beshr Qebli, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5516601

name: El Baraka Fried Chicken - El Mandara Branch
description: El Baraka Fried Chicken in Mandara serves high-quality fried chicken that pleasantly surprises even non-fans, in a spot with a nice atmosphere. The main drawback is slow service with long waits at peak times, and quality can occasionally be inconsistent, but the chicken generally wins fans.
address: 742 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526064

name: al marouf for food industry
description: Al Marouf is a beloved family-run spot serving consistently excellent food with fresh, high-quality ingredients at very reasonable prices and huge portions, in a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Standouts include the broth, skewers on rice with nuts, fish platter, and banana cake, with quality that fans say never changes.
address: mauritaniya, 14, str, Alexandria Governorate 21923

name: Kadora seafood restaurant
description: Kadora is a seafood restaurant whose reviews skew strongly negative, with repeated complaints about overpricing, charged prices differing from quoted ones, slow staged service, and cleanliness. Several diners describe feeling overcharged, so confirm prices clearly before ordering.
address: 72J7+436, Gamal Abd El-Nasir Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526047

name: Hosny For B.B.Q & Seafood S. A. E.
description: Hosny is a well-regarded local spot for fresh, never-frozen seafood and BBQ, with tasty, well-served dishes and a nice atmosphere. It runs pricey and the service can be a bit pushy, but the freshness and quality, including dishes like eel, keep fans returning.
address: off Gamal Abdel Nasser St, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5506655

name: McDonald's Mandara - Alexandria
description: This Mandara McDonald's is a newer, surprisingly spacious branch with self-order kiosks, good seating, and kind, attentive staff who earn praise. It delivers the familiar, reliable experience, with only occasional waits at peak times.
address: 158 El Geish Rd, El Mandara, Alexandria Governorate

name: Aroos Damascus
description: Aroos Damascus is widely considered one of the best Syrian restaurants in Alexandria, serving genuine, delicious Syrian dishes like shawarma plates and fresh tabbouleh at reasonable prices. It's almost always crowded with long waits and slow delivery, so dine in early or order ahead.
address: off Gamal Abdel Nasser St, beside Ceramica Magestic, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526043

name: Eros
description: Eros is a warm, busy cafe that's often crowded with tightly packed tables and loud music. Reviews skew negative, with complaints about high prices, billing surprises, and poor service and drink quality, so expectations should be modest.
address: 713 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526061

name: Dipy
description: Dipy is a casual burger spot with acceptable prices and well-liked items like the cheese patty burger, though the fries are hit or miss. The biggest drawback is very slow service, with reports of long waits, so patience helps.
address: start of El Bostan St, off Gamal Abdel Nasser Rd

name: Marinara Kafr Abdou
description: Marinara in Kafr Abdou is a nice Italian restaurant specializing in pizza, with excellent dough and well-liked options like the Pollo Ranch and Quattro Formaggi, plus calzones and pasta, at reasonable prices. Some pizzas can be light on base sauce or cheese, so picks matter, but most diners enjoy it.
address: 24 Ahmed Abd El-Aziz, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433113

name: Cicilano
description: Cicilano is an atmospheric spot with amazing decoration, great coffee, attentive service, and occasional live music that fans love. The furniture is dated and food quality is inconsistent, so it's best enjoyed for the ambiance and drinks.
address: 780 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526070

name: ADAM BEEK
description: Adam Beek is a newer Syrian restaurant with tasty food at its best, but its reviews skew strongly negative, citing rude service, order mix-ups, high prices, and even reports of feeling unwell afterward. It's takeaway-focused with little seating, so set expectations.
address: 427 gamal abd el naser, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526036

name: Balbaa village for grills
description: Balbaa Village is a large, very crowded grill spot serving meat, chicken, and fish at better-than-expected prices, with generous portions and friendly staff. Seating can be hard to find and quality is occasionally inconsistent, so it's a lively, casual choice rather than a refined one.
address: 34 Al Sagh Mohamed Abd Al Salam, Sidi Beshr Qebli, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517120

name: Lamada
description: Lamada is a popular fast-food spot praised for tasty, fresh food, unique flavors, decent staff, and frequent wallet-friendly offers. Delivery can run a bit long at times, but high customer satisfaction keeps regulars coming back.
address: El Yazidy St at junction with 45 St, off Gamal Abdel Nasser Rd, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate

name: Aroos Dimashq
description: Aroos Dimashq is a centrally located Syrian restaurant by the sea, run by Kurdish immigrants, with delicious Syrian-style grilled chicken, generous breakfasts, and good value. Service can be just acceptable, but the authentic food makes it a must-visit for many.
address: 244 Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517274

name: Qasr El Nada
description: Qasr El Nada is an upscale restaurant tied to the Salamlek Palace gardens, with a beautiful setting, varied, delicious food in large portions, and staff praised by name, including a personal greeting from the chef. As a high-end, dress-code venue, expectations are high, and most diners come away impressed.
address: 72PC+RH6, Al Mandarah Bahri, Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Negro
description: Negro is a unique, romantic seafood spot with no menu, where you're simply served a fresh mix of shrimp, crab, fish, and more, earning rave reviews for quality and taste. The no-menu, no-prices format means you should confirm costs upfront, but most diners find the food and concept worth it.
address: 33 Amin Khirat Al Ghandour, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21611

name: Hum Hum Syrian
description: Ham Ham El Sory is a simple Syrian fast-food spot with reasonable prices and respectful staff. Reviews are mixed, with notes about slow service, an unremarkable atmosphere, and inconsistent dishes, so it's an average, budget-friendly option.
address: El Nabawy El Mohandes St, in front of El Farag Mosque, Montaza 2, 21923

name: Kadoura
description: Kadoura is a popular spot with a Mediterranean view where you pick fresh fish to be grilled or fried, with good, reasonably priced seafood. It's crowded and cramped and a few report tourist overcharging, so confirm your order and prices, but the food and setting draw fans.
address: 6V2P+VRQ, El-Gaish Rd, Souq at Tork, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361030

name: BALBAA Restaurant - Sidi Beshr
description: Balbaa in Sidi Beshr is an iconic, lively, spacious Alexandria grill spot with rich, smoky grilled meats, fast service, fair prices, and portions you choose. A few dishes like the oven items are less impressive, but the kofta, grills, and energetic atmosphere make a strong impression.
address: 148 Mohammed Abd Al Salam No 1, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517110

name: Italian restaurant
description: This Italian restaurant inside a hotel lobby has an open kitchen, friendly service, and reasonable prices, with some praising the taste. It's not strictly authentic Italian, however, with quirks like BBQ sauce on chicken pizza drawing criticism, so expectations should be flexible.
address: 72Q9+85R, Unnamed Road, Al Mandarah Bahri

name: Asmak El Ktaa
description: Asmak El Ktaa is a well-regarded seafood spot where you pick and choose your fish, with standouts like perfectly cooked shrimp and crispy calamari. Waits can be long and the downstairs area runs dirty (upstairs is nicer), with some pricing complaints, but the food quality wins many over.
address: Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza District, Alexandria Governorate 5517285

name: Al Falah Restaurant, Alexandria
description: Al Falah, near the Sheraton, serves plentiful Egyptian food at fair prices, with the feteer a standout worth every pound. It trades partly on an old legacy and cleanliness can slip, with reports of prices above the menu, so manage expectations.
address: 72H6+QP9, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526044

name: Sahar El-Laialy
description: Sahar El-Laialy is a pleasant restaurant with a few sea-view tables and a big, varied menu spanning Egyptian, Levantine, and Jordanian cuisine, with warm service and staff praised by name. The mixed grill platter and large portions impress, and while it runs a bit pricey, most find it good value.
address: 544 El, Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Abdo El Rashidy
description: Abdo El Rashidy is a popular, clean local spot famous for some of the best fava bean (foul) sandwiches around, with a great owner and friendly staff. The menu is limited with little change over time, but the breakfast staples keep fans loyal.
address: 72H7+5XR, Al Mandarah Qebli (Include Izbat Al Gabal), Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5524624

name: Abo Kamal
description: Abo Kamal serves tasty, delicious traditional food with friendly, helpful staff, and it's often crowded thanks to its reputation. Quality and service can be inconsistent for some, but most reviewers happily recommend it.
address: Forty Five St, Al Mandarah Qebli, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5524101

name: Riviera Cafe & Restaurant
description: Riviera is a large, two-floor cafe and restaurant on Alexandria's main street opposite the sea, with a great upstairs view, a wide drinks selection, and good food. Service is generally good if not always polished, making it a pleasant spot to relax by the water.
address: El Geish Rd, Camp Chezar, on the Corniche, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate

name: Victoria
description: Victoria, centered on Al-Galaa Street, is a lively shopping and strolling district with restaurants, shops, sweets, and easy tram and transport access near Victoria College. It's a little crowded but well-loved as a convenient, all-purpose destination.
address: 39 Malek Hanafi, As Soyouf Qebli (Include Izbat Derbanah), Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5516050

name: Khasr Almandarah Cafe& Restaurant
description: Khasr Almandarah is a cafe and restaurant with a wonderful atmosphere, excellent service at its best, and respectful staff. Reviews are mixed, with some noting rising prices and uneven attentiveness, but the setting is pleasant.
address: 2 Al Tlmesani, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526070

name: Mohsen Karim Restaurant
description: Mohsen Karim is a local spot best known for excellent kebda (liver) in the area. Reviews are mixed overall, with some finding it pricey or inconsistent on cleanliness, so the liver is the safest bet.
address: 11 Gamal Abd El-Nasir Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526074

name: Hadramout Restaurants
description: Hadramout is a well-liked spot for delicious food at good prices, with friendly service, and its tahini draws especially high praise. Delivery can be slow for early orders, but portions are generous and the food generally satisfies.
address: 432 Gamal Abdel Nasser Rd, Bahareya, in front of Hosni Grills, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451112

name: Lail Caffè & Restaurant
description: Lail Caffe is a restaurant with a nice-looking setting, but its reviews skew strongly negative, dominated by complaints about a per-person entrance fee just to sit, plus crowding and inconsistent food. Many reviewers found the fee off-putting, so the experience can disappoint.
address: 2 Dr Abd Al Rafea Belal, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372065

name: Holland
description: Holland is a comfortable spot with a nice seaside view, friendly staff, average prices, and a clean setting that some enjoy. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about slow service, freshness, and hygiene at the ice-cream counter, so experiences vary.
address: 752 El Geish Rd, beside Saudi Airlines, El Mandara Bahari, Second Montaza District, Alexandria Governorate 21923

name: Omar Afandy Seafood
description: Omar Afandy Seafood is a well-arranged, nicely decorated restaurant with friendly staff and a wide variety of fresh, tasty seafood prepared multiple ways. Food can arrive a bit warm in summer and there's the occasional order mix-up, but most diners highly recommend it.
address: behind the Drinking Water Company, El Maamoura El Balad, Third Montaza, 21912

name: Kebab Hamdy
description: Kebab Hamdy is a clean, trusted local grill in a quiet location, with fast takeaway and well-liked dishes like kebda, kofta, fleto, and homemade hawawshy. The menu is Arabic-only with limited English, and options are modest, but the meats and respectful service win fans.
address: 73 Khaled Ibn Al Walid, As Soyouf Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517063

name: El Baraka Fried Chicken - Sidi Bishr Branch
description: El Baraka Fried Chicken in Sidi Beshr is a decent, fairly quick option for fried chicken, with good sauces and well-liked sides. Reviews are mixed, with some finding it oily, the bread not fresh, and the rice underwhelming, so it's an average rather than standout choice.
address: Mahmoud El Eisawy St, in front of the Electricity Company, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate 5517184

name: Montazah Aida Beach
description: Montazah Aida Beach is a beloved, well-preserved sandy beach great for swimming and family gatherings, with a beautiful setting and lovely night views of Alexandria. Steeped in history and featured in films, it remains one of the city's classic, scenic spots.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Beach \Plage E3lmandra
description: Mandara Beach is one of Alexandria's largest beaches, with a free-entry gate (No. 13) and a clean, pleasant shoreline. It gets crowded and staff often expect tips on top of the chair-and-umbrella fee, and the area could use upkeep, but it's a popular seaside option.
address: Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526056

name: Maamoura Beach Alexandria - Apartments, Chalets & Villas
description: Maamoura Beach is a peaceful gated seaside neighborhood directly next to the sea, designed for comfort with a range of activities and apartments, chalets, and villas to rent. It can get busy and crowded in season, but the front-beach views and quiet setting make it a pleasant escape.
address: Youssef El Sebai St, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Semiramis Beach
description: Semiramis is one of Montazah's most famous beaches and cabin areas, set between the Venice and Palestine hotels near the Montazah Lighthouse. Reviewers love the scenery and seaside atmosphere, making it a classic Alexandria beach spot.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Tolip Beach
description: Tolip Beach is a private beach with very good hospitality, caring staff, fair prices, a kids' playground, and a clean, walkable shore. The water isn't the clearest, so it's less ideal for small children, and it gets crowded by late morning, so arrive early to reserve a spot.
address: El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452050

name: Private Beach
description: This private beach in front of the Hilton in Sidi Bishr draws largely negative reviews, with complaints about garbage in the water and sand and cleanliness issues with service items. Expectations should be modest based on recent feedback.
address: Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517186

name: Beach Hotel Rose Asafra
description: Rose Asafra is a beach hotel and a lovely spot for a few restful days in Alexandria, with sea-view suites and a calming setting. Guests also praise the on-site Mamma Mia restaurant for good Italian dishes, adding to the relaxed seaside appeal.
address: 72G2+5QH, El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526063

name: Miamy Beach
description: Miamy Beach is a beach in Alexandria.
address: Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517269

name: Paradise Beach
description: Paradise is an affordable family beach with a small entry fee and cheap chairs and umbrellas. Service and supervision are inconsistent, and the water gets deep not far from shore, so caution is advised, but the prices and family-friendly setting are draws.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: El-Mandara
description: El-Mandara is a tourist attraction in Alexandria.

name: Na3na3
description: Na3na3 is a rooftop cafe and restaurant atop the El Shatby Casino with majestic sea views and a beautiful aesthetic, well-liked for shisha, drinks, and events like workshops. Service and cleanliness can be inconsistent, but the atmosphere and views are the standout draw.
address: El Geish Rd, the Casino, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5424041

name: The Crepery Egypt
description: The Crepery is widely praised for the biggest, highest-quality crepes in Alexandria, with a varied menu spanning meat, chicken, and seafood, plus a kids' menu, at suitable prices. Generous portions, friendly staff, and consistent quality make it a repeat favorite.
address: Ahmed Hassanein St, University Stadium St, Alexandria Governorate 21525

name: Amtchy
description: Amtshy is a beachfront spot with an indescribable seaside setting, fresh breeze, amazing service, and well-loved breakfasts at reasonable prices. The main drawback is slow service, with long waits between courses, but the location and staff win fans.
address: 6W68+W5F, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424041

name: MOMO Shawerma
description: MOMO Shawerma is a well-located shawarma spot with eye-catching decor, friendly staff, and reasonable prices, notable for Egyptian-spiced shawarma that's increasingly rare. Standouts include the shawarma quesadillas and sweet potato fries, with only minor notes about delivery time estimates.
address: 7 kamel morsi, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424041

name: Beit Azari Restaurant
description: Beit Azari is a Saudi-style restaurant with fantastic interior design and welcoming staff. The food is the weak point, however, with several reviewers finding the dishes disappointing and overpriced despite tasty rice, so the vibe outshines the meal for many.
address: 53 El Kotaheya St, El Ibrahimeya Bahari & Sidi Gaber, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21524

name: Falafel and Beans - Uncle Zaghloul
description: Uncle Zaghloul is a beloved local spot for an authentic Egyptian breakfast of foul and falafel, with a great-value breakfast platter and warm, smiling service. It gets crowded on weekend mornings, but the genuine atmosphere and food make it a memorable, well-priced experience.
address: 22 Hasan El-Adawy, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423013

name: Hai Ting Chinese Food
description: Hai Ting is widely praised as the best, most authentic Chinese food in Alexandria, with fresh-made dishes, big portions, and imported Chinese ingredients and merchandise for sale. Friendly, professional staff and easy-to-find location round out a consistently excellent experience.
address: 51 Omar Lotfy St, Camp Chezar, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: Karki Restaurant
description: Karki is widely praised as one of the best fried-chicken spots in Alexandria, with big pieces, an amazing crust, great prices, fast hot delivery, and a well-liked molten cake. The main drawback is prep times over 20 minutes, but most diners find it well worth the wait.
address: 57 El Rasafa St, Emberouz & Moharram Bek, Moharram Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5413455

name: Sotohy
description: Sotohy is a creative fast-food spot praised for some of the best smashed burgers and fried chicken sandwiches in Alexandria, plus standout chicken wings with a wide range of unique sauces. The space can run hot, but the food and fresh, inventive menu win strong fans.
address: 7 Dr. Kamel Morsy St, Port Said St, Alexandria Governorate 21526

name: Kebda elfalah
description: Kebda El Falah is a famous local spot widely hailed as the king of liver (kebda) sandwiches in Alexandria, with spiced liver so good it even wins over those who dislike kebda. Service is fast and prices reasonable, though tables can be untidy, so it's about the food rather than the setting.
address: 5 Sharm Al Sheikh, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372051

name: KAF Speciality Coffee
description: KAF is a charming, relaxed specialty coffee bar near the Corniche, with a friendly, welcoming host, a calm atmosphere, and excellent coffee, including well-balanced espresso and rich V60 filter. Delicious food and top-notch service round out a consistently praised experience.
address: Camp ceasar, Port Said St, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5424071

name: Brave Playstation & More
description: Brave is a small PlayStation cafe at the base of a tower on El Geish Street, with indoor-only seating, respectful staff, great prices, and a well-liked waffle. It's a solid spot to gather with friends for gaming and casual hangouts.
address: 154 El-Gaish Rd, Cleopatra, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Palemera Cafe
description: Palemera is a traditional local (baladi) cafe serving hot drinks like tea, Turkish coffee, and herbal infusions plus cold drinks and juices. It's a nostalgic, popular-atmosphere spot, especially atmospheric during Ramadan, beloved as an old gathering place for friends.
address: Alexandria Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA, Sidi Gabir, Bab Shar'

name: HUB Z
description: HUBZ is a cafe with one of the best sea views in Alexandria, impressive food and desserts, well-liked drinks, and excellent, friendly service. It runs a little expensive and parking can be tricky, but most reviewers, including visitors, find it well worth it.
address: 52 El-Gaish Rd, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424074

name: Ecuador Coffee (Stanley)
description: Ecuador Coffee in Stanley is a small but well-run cafe with a wonderful atmosphere, extremely friendly service, and excellent-quality drinks. It's quite small with poor ventilation where smoking is allowed, and several reviewers find it notably expensive, so the coffee and vibe are the draw.
address: 259 El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452003

name: Takhyal coffe
description: Takhyal is a comfortable cafe widely praised for some of the best coffee in Alexandria, with tasty drinks, great sandwiches and mojitos, and exceptionally kind, attentive staff, with the manager even following up on orders. It's a warm, welcoming spot that keeps customers coming back.
address: 89 Street 20, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434041

name: Costa Coffee
description: Costa Coffee is a comfortable, study-friendly spot near a mosque with quality drinks and a free food item on purchases above a threshold, plus some standout, friendly staff. Service consistency varies and the bathrooms and smoking areas draw complaints, so experiences depend on the visit.
address: Building 109, Fouad El Khateeb St, El Horreya, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5422003

name: HOLA Lounge PlayStation & Cafe - Smouha
description: HOLA Lounge in Smouha is a top spot for renting rooms for movies or PlayStation, with notably friendly, professional staff, good food and drinks, and a comfortable, home-like atmosphere. Reviewers consistently rate it among the best gaming lounges in Alexandria.
address: 47 street Ismail sery, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432054

name: Aro coffee roaster
description: Aro is one of the best specialty coffee roasters in Alexandria, with impressive coffee, a well-balanced Spanish iced latte, and a praised tiramisu in a cozy setting. It currently offers desserts but no savory bakery items, and service for foreigners could use a bit more English, but the coffee stands out.
address: 11 Bani El-Abbas, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423001

name: El Khan Café
description: El Khan is a genuine old-style coffee shop with an amazing view, great shisha, charming decor and sounds, good service, and a warm atmosphere. Prices are generally good, though a couple of drinks can feel slightly overpriced, making it a beloved, traditional hangout.
address: Sidi Gaber District, Alexandria Governorate 5434004

name: Mikel Coffee Company
description: Mikel Coffee Company is a Greek chain known for a large coffee selection and cold sandwiches, with top-notch, well-prepared coffee, a cozy atmosphere, and impressive food quality. Service can occasionally be slow during busy times, but many rate it among the best cafes in Alexandria.
address: 88 El-Horeya Rd, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423002

name: Artino Cafe
description: Artino is a good-value seaside cafe with a wonderful sea view, generally quiet atmosphere, good service, and moderate prices, with nice holiday decorations. Staff readiness and parking can be inconsistent, but it's a pleasant spot for a relaxed outing.
address: 166 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Miika cafe
description: Miika is a cafe whose reviews skew strongly negative, with repeated complaints about poor food and drinks, overcooked waffles, watery soft drinks, and unprofessional service. Expectations should be modest based on recent feedback.
address: Tivoli Dome, Sidi Gaber Rd, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21619

name: Hookah (Tivoli Dome Alexandria)
description: Hookah at Tivoli Dome is a relaxed cafe with some of the best shisha in Alexandria, well-liked drinks and waffles, and a nice outdoor seating area. Food is generally good, with standouts like the seafood pasta, though there's no wifi, but the atmosphere and shisha are the draw.
address: Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Haksoss ( Cafe & Restaurant )
description: Haksoss is a well-located cafe and restaurant good for large groups, with decent coffee and a clean space. Reviews are mixed, however, with complaints about slow, forgetful service and bland food, so it's a hit-or-miss option.
address: 6WJR+HRV, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Mashhoor - Point 6 - Alexandria
description: Mashhoor at Point 6 is a quiet restaurant praised for fresh, hot, delicious food at affordable prices, with friendly, caring staff. Orders can occasionally run a bit late, but most diners feel it's well worth it.
address: Point 6 Mall, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: El Andalus Cafe
description: Cafe El Andalus is a local spot with a good view, friendly staff, and good drinks, with the owner praised for excellent service. There's the occasional complaint about tipping expectations, but it's a pleasant, casual hangout.
address: 161 El Geish Rd, Cleopatra seafront, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434017

name: cafe kafr abdo alexandria egypt
description: cafe kafr abdo alexandria egypt is a Cafe spot in Alexandria.
address: kafr abdo, sakena bent, 27 Al Sayeda Sakena Bent Al Hussein, Alexandria Governorate

name: Farouk Café 1928
description: Farouk Cafe, established in 1928, is one of Alexandria's most iconic heritage cafes, just off the Corniche, serving local Egyptian beverages in a charming vintage setting. The history, atmosphere, and good vibes make it well worth a visit to soak in old Alexandria.
address: At Tarmazeyah, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321230

name: Four sessions lounge
description: Four Sessions is a luxurious, well-organized lounge with a sophisticated atmosphere, amazing food, great drinks, and good value for the quality. A clever touch is the separate PlayStation sound system in each room, making it a standout for a classy group outing.
address: 23 Belloss St (El Lagitih), Al Ibrahimeya Qibli & El Hadra Bahari, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21524

name: Classique Patisserie
description: Classique Patisserie in Al Ibrahimeya is an Egyptian dessert shop and cafe with Corniche sea views, exceptional coffee, out-of-this-world desserts, and an authentic atmosphere. Service can be a little slow and the menu could be more detailed, but the pastries and setting win praise.
address: 48 El-Gaish Rd, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 00000

name: Le Club
description: Le Club is a charming villa-style Italian restaurant with delicious food, professional management, and friendly staff. The outdoor terrace sits by a busy main road, so it can be noisy with occasional street smells, and a minimum charge isn't always communicated, but the food and service generally please.
address: 171 Orfay Basha, Port Said St, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424062

name: Sanaa Yemeni Cuisine
description: Sana'a is a clean Yemeni restaurant praised for excellent rice, generous value, and respectful, well-presented service, considered by some the place for authentic Yemeni cuisine in the area. Reviewers consistently recommend it for a satisfying, flavorful meal.
address: 56 Abbas El Halwany St, Al Ibrahimeya Bahari & Sidi Gaber, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5424074

name: Khawater Demeshqya Restaurant
description: Khawater Demeshqya is regarded as one of Alexandria's finer Syrian restaurants, with fresh, tasty dishes, a great beach view, reasonable prices, and friendly staff. Standouts include the shawarma pizza and grilled chicken, with only the fried chicken and occasional reservation handling drawing minor criticism.
address: El Delta St, Bahary, Sidi Gaber

name: Shrimpk
description: Shrimpk is a budget-friendly seafood spot with a great atmosphere, freshly cooked dishes, and standouts like shrimp, mussels, clams, and seafood boils, with knowledgeable, approachable staff. Quality can be inconsistent, with some finding certain dishes dry or bland, but most diners enjoy it.
address: The walk mall, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434023

name: Jimmy Grills - Cleopatra
description: Jimmy Cleopatra is a popular grill spot serving good-quality grilled meat, kofta, and well-liked plain sandwiches with quality meat. Seating is mostly street-side or eat-in-your-car, and grills (beyond sandwiches) can take a long time and feel a bit pricey, but the taste wins fans.
address: 80 Sidi Gaber St, Cleopatra Baths, Alexandria Governorate

name: Bruxie’s Fawzi Moaz
description: Bruxie's Fawzi Moaz is praised for some of the most consistent espresso quality in Alexandria, with well-liked drinks like the pistachio latte and white mocha, nice decor, and friendly staff. It's a reliable, welcoming spot for coffee lovers.
address: 2 Mohammed Fawzi Moaz, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432020

name: Loza Restaurant
description: Loza is widely praised as one of the best pizza places in Alexandria, with a hands-on chef-owner who sources hard-to-find quality ingredients and produces light, flavorful pizzas with aesthetic packaging. Quality is occasionally inconsistent, but the staff are gracious about it, and most diners rave.
address: 28 Syria, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434048

name: Fish Palace Restaurant
description: Fish Palace is a clean, comfortable seafood spot praised for fresh, flavorful, perfectly cooked seafood, generous portions, and very affordable prices, with friendly staff. The lively music adds to the atmosphere, and most reviewers highly recommend it.
address: 6WHR+297, El-Mosheer Ahmed Ismail, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434031

name: El Menoufy El Kababgy
description: El Menoufy El Kababgy is a highly praised kebab spot with a stunning sea view and fresh, high-quality meat, with standouts like lamb chops, kofta, kabobs, and liver, plus excellent service. A few find it merely average, but most reviewers rate it among the best for grills in Alexandria.
address: The Walk, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434023

name: Koshari Street cleopatra
description: Koshari Street in Cleopatra draws largely negative reviews, with complaints about cold, pasta-heavy koshari, small portions, hygiene, and unappealing packaging. A few enjoy the value and friendly staff, but expectations should be modest.
address: 265 Al Dib, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434004

name: fayrouz restaurant
description: fayrouz restaurant is a dining spot in Alexandria.
address: El Tayar Mahmoud Shaker St, El Moltaqa Center, beside Go Bus, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, junction with Tutankhamun St, Alexandria Governorate

name: Maharaja
description: Maharaja is an Indian spot in Alexandria.
address: 138 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434011

name: Santorini Restaurant & Cafe
description: Santorini is a restaurant and cafe with a beautiful environment and loyal regulars who praise dishes like baked shrimp pasta and cheesecake, plus a responsive team. Reviews are sharply mixed, however, with several complaints about food quality, drinks, and cramped seating, so experiences vary widely.
address: 6WHQ+Q5G Golden Jewel party complex, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434023

name: On the Street
description: Old Street is a uniquely themed cafe designed like a vintage Alexandria street, with a relaxing atmosphere, friendly staff, and well-liked shisha and Turkish coffee. It runs a bit pricey for some, but the distinctive decor and good drinks make it a memorable spot.
address: 6W5G+5CF, Ahmed Kamha, Al Ibrahimeyah Qebli WA Al Hadrah Bahri, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423031

name: Iskandarona
description: Iskandarona is a cozy seafront cafe and seafood restaurant with a sea view, shisha, a varied menu, friendly staff, and reasonable prices. Diners praise some of the best, freshest fish they've had, top-notch cooking, and accommodating service, making it a strong local choice.
address: Tolip Hotel, El Sheikh Sayed St, Mohammed Darwish, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434044

name: Piccadilly
description: Piccadilly in Shatby is a seafront restaurant and cafe with a beautiful direct sea view, comfortable seating, great coffee, delicious food, and friendly, welcoming staff. It's consistently praised as a tranquil, enjoyable spot to eat or have coffee by the water.
address: 6W68+G2J, El-Gaish Rd, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424041

name: Karam El Sham Restaurant - Alexandria
description: Karam El Sham is a well-regulated chain serving fast, fresh Syrian and Egyptian food, with efficient pickup and several branches. The atmosphere is basic as a pickup kitchen, and at least one cashier drew complaints, but the food quality and convenience win fans.
address: Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5424001

name: Jettz burger
description: Jettz is a Scandinavian-style burger spot serving juicy, delicious burgers, special sauces, and birria tacos at excellent prices, with fast service and polite, welcoming staff. The double cheeseburger and unique sauces are standouts, and many reviewers return frequently.
address: 17 Port Said St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424040

name: El Bait El Shamy Pizza
description: El Bait El Shamy is a Syrian spot serving grilled chicken meals, manakeesh, pizza, pide, and Syrian-style bakeries at affordable prices, with friendly staff. Quality is generally good, though service consistency could improve, making it a handy choice for a casual Syrian meal.
address: 29 Abdel Hamid Badawi St, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharqi District, Alexandria Governorate 5424002

name: Holmes
description: Holmes is a spacious, clean, well-organized burger spot widely praised for consistently great quality at prices easier than its competitors, with well-liked items like the chicken wrap and cheese-and-mushroom burger. Long-time fans note quality that keeps improving, making it a local favorite for burgers.
address: 2 Saad Zaghloul St, Ben Bassam St, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Hammadi Salted & Smoked Fish
description: El Hammadi specializes in seafood, with top-notch, fresh, beautifully presented dishes like skillet-fried shrimp and salmon, in a clean, comfortable space with excellent service, and Captain Abdulaziz praised by name. Preparation can take a bit longer than expected, but the food and hospitality win strong praise.
address: 6W33+887, International Health Organization, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: El Abd Falafel
description: Falafel El Abd is a Palestinian-style spot with good cleanliness and well-liked falafel and musabbaha sandwiches at its best. Reviews are sharply divided, however, with some Palestinian diners feeling it doesn't capture authentic flavors, and there's no posted menu or price list, so confirm prices.
address: Alexander the Great St, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373010

name: Chocolate shot
description: Chocolate Shot is a calm, relaxing dessert and drinks spot with high-quality, special-tasting treats and friendly, helpful staff. Reviews are mostly positive, with at least one complaint about service when understaffed, but most enjoy the cozy vibe.
address: 41 Dinocrat St, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharqi District, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: immortals
description: This food court occupies the site of the former historic Garden of the Immortals, a change that some reviewers lament. It now hosts cafes and restaurants like Daddy's Burgers, with several diners enjoying the food and comfortable setting, so opinions are divided between its history and current use.
address: 6W33+76J, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: Koshari Street
description: Koshari Street is a small spot in the university area handy for a quick local meal, with friendly staff and fair prices. Reviews skew negative, however, with complaints about cleanliness, undercooked or cold food, hot upstairs seating, and loud music, so expectations should be modest.
address: 6W45+C84, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424001

name: Reghief Shawarma
description: Raghif Shawarma has a nice location and decent flavors, but its reviews skew negative, with repeated complaints about dry meat, long waits, and inattentive, unprofessional service. Quality and service are inconsistent, so expectations should be modest.
address: 6W33+952, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: Magabes Kuwaiti Restaurant
description: Magabis is a Kuwaiti-cuisine spot with cozy Arab-style seating that's nice for groups. Reviews are mixed-to-negative, however, with complaints about underwhelming, sometimes day-old food, limited availability, and high prices, so it's an inconsistent option.
address: Champollion St junction with Abdel Hamid Badawi St, Al Azarita, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: go sandwich
description: Go Sandwich is a small spot near the university praised by many for great taste-to-price value, with well-liked burgers, sandwiches, fries, and salads. Quality can be inconsistent for some, but most find it an affordable, satisfying choice.
address: abdel hamid badwy street, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 21221

name: Old steert
description: Old Street is a classy, atmospheric cafe and restaurant praised for incredible food and excellent service, great for breakfast and lunch. Reviewers describe it as a gem with a delicious menu and a comfortable setting.
address: Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373010

name: Crepy
description: Crepy is a crepe spot that some praise as among the best in Alexandria, especially for the chicken crepes. Reviews are sharply mixed, however, with several complaints about poor, disorganized service and food quality, so experiences vary widely.
address: 28 Dinkrat St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424002

name: Basilico
description: Basilico is a warm, popular pizzeria in a green, beautiful setting, praised for delicious woodfire pizza, excellent carbonara, great espresso, and friendly, smiling service. Some note the pizza quality can be inconsistent, but most diners count it among their favorites.
address: 9 Mahmoud Abou El-Ola Mosque St, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433123

name: El Gomhoreya Restaurant
description: El Gomhoreya is a local restaurant whose reviews are largely negative, with multiple diners describing a decline in food quality over time. A few find it acceptable, but expectations should be modest.
address: Abdel Hamid Badawi St, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: Aziz Restaurant
description: Aziz is a clean, pleasant spot with comfortable seating and good service, where the meat sandwiches and burgers earn particular praise. The crispy chicken burger can be less tender and a few find the food merely okay, but most enjoy the burgers and atmosphere.
address: 6W33+56G, Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373010

name: Dhad Coffee
description: Dhad is a well-branded cafe with an impressive, large dedicated study area that's usually quiet, making it great for studying, plus a clean bathroom and indoor and outdoor seating. The coffee quality and service are inconsistent and the wifi can be unreliable, so it's best as a study spot.
address: Dr Abd El-Hameed Sayed St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 21617

name: Croissant d'Alexia
description: Croissant d'Alexia is an Alexandrian boulangerie and cafe near the University Hospital, specializing in exceptionally baked, flaky, buttery croissants and French pastries, with good coffee. The cozy setting and standout pastries, like the chocolate croissant and vanilla flan, make it one of the city's best for croissants.
address: 6W25+C47, Estanbol - Salah Moustafa, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423001

name: The chain cafe & restaurant
description: The Chain, the revamp of the longtime Alexandria staple Selsela, is a large beachfront cafe and restaurant right in front of the library, with genuinely good food and drinks at fair prices and a direct sea view. It gets crowded and noisy with an enormous menu, and service can occasionally slip, but the seaside setting is the big draw.
address: 6W65+3J5, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424011

name: KATF Speciality Coffee
description: KATF is a clean, stylish specialty coffee spot where the standout is really the atmosphere, decor, and friendly staff, with decent coffee. It runs pricey for some and service can be slow, but the vibe makes it a nice weekend hangout.
address: Omar Lotfy, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423016

name: Souter Cafe
description: Souter is a coffee shop with decent prices and quality and a big TV for watching football matches. Reviews are mixed, with complaints about cleanliness and an atmosphere geared toward groups of guys rather than families or couples, so it's a casual hangout spot.
address: Ali Moustafa Moshrfah St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424002

name: Aura Lounge Café & Restaurant
description: Aura Lounge is a cafe and restaurant with sharply divided reviews. Some praise it as serving the best meals they had in Egypt, while many others cite very slow service, loud music, cigarette smell, and high prices, so experiences vary widely.
address: 41 Dinkrat St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424002

name: The Generals Cafe
description: Cafe El Generalat is a spot offering what some call luxurious coffee in a pleasant setting. There's limited detailed feedback, but reviewers describe a generally positive experience.
address: Alexandria Corniche, Bab Sharqi District, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Alexandria Governorate 5424020

name: Kanaka café&More
description: Kanaka is a beautiful, quiet cafe with amazing drinks, lovely atmosphere, and outstanding service and management, with separate seating areas for different crowds. Reviewers consistently describe it as one of the finer spots that makes you want to return.
address: 13 Dr Ibrahim Shawqi, Al Ibrahimeyah Qebli WA Al Hadrah Bahri, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423032

name: La Poire Café
description: La Poire is a calm, modern, comfortable cafe and restaurant with a beautiful Corniche sea view, affordable parking, and friendly staff, ideal for a light breakfast or coffee. With indoor AC and outdoor sea-view seating, it's a well-loved spot for a relaxed coffee break.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: HARIDY
description: Haridy is a convenient local spot near the library and university with a wide range of affordable food, where the kebda and kofta and generous shawarma earn praise. Quality and service have slipped for some, with tipping pressure and street-side seating, so it's a budget-friendly rather than polished option.
address: 50 Mostafa Mohammed Ismail St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424001

name: El Sokareya Cafeteria
description: Cafeteria El Sokareya is a friendly local cafe praised for very reasonable, local prices and a relaxed atmosphere, good for hanging out with friends over tea or coffee. Staff don't speak English but are welcoming, and the indoor space prefers quiet, with outdoor seating more relaxed.
address: 2 Dr Abd Al Rafea Belal, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372064

name: Tahwiga
description: Tahwiga is a casual cafe with suitable prices, welcoming staff, shisha, and games, especially pleasant at night. The drinks are inconsistent, with some finding the coffee weak and the space loud, but it's a recommended spot for caffeine and a relaxed hangout.
address: 15-17 Marmeruon, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424002

name: El Mazarita Cafe
description: El Mazarita is a casual cafe in Alexandria offering coffee, tea, and shisha in a relaxed setting. It is a comfortable neighborhood spot to unwind with friends.
address: 6W45+939, 12 Ibn Shogea St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424002

name: Caffeine
description: kæf;in is a specialty coffee roastery praised for excellent beans and coffee, a unique artistic ambience with books for a productive break, and respectful, helpful service, including reliable shipping. Reviewers rate the quality and selection among the best they've had.
address: Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5424001

name: Paradise Cafe
description: Paradise is a cafe with well-liked pizza, milkshakes, and pasta at good prices, indoor and outdoor space, valet, shisha, and ample parking. Service is sharply inconsistent, however, with several complaints about rude staff alongside a polite, accommodating owner, so experiences vary.
address: 6W44+897, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: Baker Hub
description: Baker Hub is a brunch and bakery spot praised for great pastries and Syrian cheeses, with knowledgeable staff happy to explain the options. Service can be inconsistent, but the food quality and cheese selection win fans.
address: 6W45+52F, Mostafa Mohammed Ismail St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424001

name: Mocca
description: Mocca is a quiet, pleasant cafe with excellent service, respectful staff praised by name, and good prices. Reviewers consistently describe a wonderful, relaxing experience, making it a reliable neighborhood spot.
address: 20 Mostafa Mohammed Ismail St, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharqi District, Alexandria Governorate 5424002

name: Saltana Cafe
description: Qahwet Saltana is a modest local coffee shop on a narrow side road, well-liked for great shisha, good tea, and friendly staff and owner who make you feel at home. Service can be inconsistent at times, but the welcoming vibe and quality shisha are the draw.
address: 6W45+8F3, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424001

name: E.R.B
description: E.R.B is a friendly, welcoming cafe and bakery that's a favorite for studying and hanging out, with standout desserts, good sandwiches, tasty coffee, and a calm atmosphere. The non-smoking and smoking sections sit close together so smoke can drift in, but the food and vibe win strong praise.
address: 14 Marmeruon, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424002

name: Mimi Farouk Cafe
description: Mimi Farouk is a small, quiet, popular cafe with reasonable prices and professional staff. It's a pleasant, low-key neighborhood spot for a relaxed drink.
address: Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424001

name: Shaaban Cafe
description: Qahwet Shaaban is a small local cafe near the university serving the area's workshops and students, with an excellent location, fast service, all kinds of drinks at student-friendly prices, and a nice owner. Drink quality is inconsistent and there's no bathroom, but it's a handy, affordable gathering spot.
address: 40 Ali E L Kahshkhani St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423016

name: Fraisier
description: Fraisier is a charming little Syrian-influenced patisserie that's deceptively spacious inside, with delicious ice cream, cakes, fudges, and juices at very affordable prices, served by gentle, smiling staff. Reviewers warmly recommend it for sweets and a pleasant little treat.
address: Dr Abdel Hamid El Sayed St, off Champollion St, in front of Cote showroom, Al Azarita, Alexandria Governorate

name: elite
description: Elite is a warm, atmospheric restaurant with soft music, lovely decor, and incredible service, returning to its classic recipes with old favorites like pasta caprice. The main drawback is cigarette smoke without a real non-smoking section, but the food and ambiance win fans.
address: 43 Safia Zaghloul St, Raml Station Square, Alexandria Governorate

name: Diab Cafe
description: Diab Cafe is a classic oriental coffee shop in a historic part of Alexandria, with good-quality drinks at cheap prices and quick, friendly service. The staff can be a bit pushy and there's at least one complaint about card-payment handling, but it's a solid, atmospheric spot.
address: 6 Al Bakht, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372020

name: Genoise Le Cafe
description: Genoise is a cozy, relaxing patisserie and coffee spot widely praised for some of the best desserts in the city, great coffee, friendly staff, and good prices. Standouts include the fruit tart and cakes, making it a beloved haven for a calm sweet-and-coffee break.
address: 48 Safia Zaghloul St, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372060

name: El Raml Station
description: El Raml Station is the historic heart of downtown Alexandria, a famous old area buzzing with shops, souvenirs, and local restaurants, with good views of the old city. It gets very crowded, but it's a classic, central spot for shopping, sightseeing, and famous takeaway food.
address: Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372045

name: HOLA LOUNGE playstation & Cafe
description: This HOLA Lounge is a top-tier PlayStation cafe with several private rooms, comfy sofas, cool neon-lit designs, and a home-like feel, plus good food, sweets, and drinks. Reviewers consistently rate it among the best gaming lounges around, with constant new offerings.
address: 38 El Aziz El Mannan Mosque St, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: Friends Cafe
description: Friends Cafe (formerly Central Perk) is a charming, Friends-themed coffee house, complete with the iconic orange couch and themed menu, fantastic coffee, board games, and helpful staff. It's a fun, cozy spot for friends and couples that fans of the show especially love.
address: Mohammed Shafek Ghrbal, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424050

name: CRAFT COFFE EGY
description: Craft Coffee is a beautiful, cozy specialty coffee spot with phenomenal espresso, a vibrant atmosphere, nice staff, and a strong study-friendly setup. It's small with limited AC, so seating turns over and a couple of drinks can be inconsistent, but the espresso and vibe stand out.
address: 86 Officers' Buildings, Mostafa Kamel, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: Café Fel Shar3
description: Cafe Fel Shar3 is a comfortable, air-conditioned cafe praised for amazing French coffee and good drinks, with a pleasant music selection. It's a nice, welcoming spot to escape the heat over a good cup.
address: 21-23 Ahmed Kamha, Al Ibrahimeyah Qebli WA Al Hadrah Bahri, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423031

name: Momenti cafe & more
description: Momenti is a quiet, affordable cafe with a distinctly Alexandrian feel, good food, nice Italian coffee, pleasant music, and friendly staff, suitable for family and friends. Most experiences are positive, though there's at least one serious complaint about food poisoning, so order carefully.
address: 145 Port Said St, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424062

name: ELBRO CAFE & C WORKING SPACE
description: ELBRO is a cafe and coworking space with calm, cozy rooms for studying, calls, or group work, good coffee, and helpful staff. Internet reliability draws mixed feedback and the coworking space may have relocated, so confirm before visiting for work, but it's a pleasant spot to relax.
address: 50 Abd Al Latef Al Soufani St, ground floor, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21531

name: Coffee Wizard
description: Coffee Wizard is a spacious Hungarian-style bakery and coffee shop (originating in Mansoura) with a nice vibe, good coffee, and well-liked items like focaccia and iced drinks. It's self-serve with occasionally slow or inconsistent service, but the seating and atmosphere are pleasant.
address: Albert El Awal St, beside Ali Ibn Abi Talib Mosque, Smouha, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: WOODy Cafe
description: Woody Cafe is a hidden-gem seafront spot praised for an exceptional location, quiet beauty, attentive service, and reasonable prices, with a polite owner. Reviewers consistently describe it as one of the most beautiful, peaceful places along the sea for a relaxed coffee.
address: 77 El Geish Rd (Zakaria Ghoneim St), Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate

name: Hambaka Cafe
description: Hambaka is a modern, clean take on the classic Egyptian cafe, with a variety of drinks, snacks, shisha, PlayStation, and football on the TVs, at decent prices. The drinks and offerings are fairly average and cleanliness could improve, but the location and all-in-one mix of activities make it a handy hangout.
address: 5WX9+H2J, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5422015

name: Retro
description: Retro is a cafe and restaurant with fresh, tasty food like pizza and chicken platters, good coffee, fast wifi, and private rooms for movies or billiards. Ventilation is poor for non-smokers and the crowd can occasionally be rowdy, but the food, service, and private spaces win fans.
address: 18 Tutankhamun St, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber District, Alexandria Governorate

name: Total Cafe
description: Total Cafe is a quiet, clean local spot whose biggest strength is its warm, welcoming staff who make you feel like one of the group, with classic Umm Kulthum playing. Reviewers rave about the coffee and excellent service, making it a beloved place to gather with friends.
address: 314 Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Wesya Cafe
description: El Wesya is a lively, classic street cafe at the heart of its neighborhood, with orange chairs, open-air seating, shisha, and good prices, popular for watching football. Indoor space and the restroom are small and the viewing setup isn't ideal for everyone, but it captures an authentic local vibe.
address: Ahmed Moharram, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372040

name: Hazel cafe
description: Hazel is a cozy cafe with indoor and outdoor seating, helpful, friendly staff, and talented baristas, popular for birthdays and dates. Service and food consistency have drawn complaints, and the cozy space can get loud, so experiences vary by visit.
address: 6W5X+CFR, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432070

name: Caribou cafe
description: Caribou is a calm, elegant cafe with a warm welcome, good coffee, and a comfortable, work-friendly atmosphere with decent internet, ideal for long stays. Service and drink consistency draw some complaints, but it's a reliable spot to work, study, or relax over coffee.
address: Sant Giyn, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433111

name: Andros
description: Andros is an affordable, strategically located cafe with fair-quality drinks, friendly staff, and a quiet morning atmosphere good for working. Tables are packed closely and busy staff activity can feel intrusive, with some service complaints, so it's a convenient rather than standout option.
address: 18 Adly Yakn, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452050

name: Cima Café
description: Cima is a comfortable cafe with well-liked breakfasts spanning Lebanese, Syrian, and American options, and standout friendly service from staff like Saqr. The room can get smoky and music a bit loud, and service is occasionally inattentive, but most enjoy the food and atmosphere.
address: 12 Sero Setries, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21611

name: Destino Cafe
description: Destino is a clean, calm espresso bar with premium coffee, other drinks, and desserts, served by professional, friendly staff, praised by some as the best coffee they found in Egypt. The main drawback is that smoking is allowed inside, but the quality and atmosphere stand out.
address: El Malek St, Royal Plaza Buildings, in front of Montaza train station, Alexandria Governorate

name: Up & Down
description: Up & Down is a large underground cafe with beautiful decor, swinging chairs, billiards, ping pong, a kids' area, and reasonable prices, popular with young people for group hangouts. There's no sea view and ventilation and service draw some complaints, but it's a spacious, fun spot to gather.
address: Container Hub Mall, inside El Asafra Corniche Rd, Alexandria Governorate

name: Dawar Goha Cafe
description: Dawar Goha is a cozy, rustic-styled cafe near the seafront with quirky artwork, warm lighting, good food and shisha, and friendly staff, with a traditional Egyptian flair. It can get noisy and a few charges (like for tissues or internet) surprise some, so check the bill, but the vibe and location are draws.
address: 792 El Geish Rd, El Mandara Corniche, El Mandara Bahari, Alexandria Governorate

name: Mon'ema Cafe
description: Mona'ema is a popular local cafe near the Sheraton buildings and Mandara train station, with good coffee, an excellent location, and reasonable prices. It's a pleasant, well-liked spot for friends to gather and spend a nice time.
address: Sheraton Towers, El Malek Hefni, behind the factory, Alexandria Governorate

name: Epic lounge
description: Epic Lounge is a calm, pleasant cafe with friendly service, good coffee, and prices suitable for everyone, rarely too crowded. The music can run a bit loud, but the relaxed atmosphere makes it a nice spot to unwind.
address: Gamal Abdel Nasser St, in front of El Mandara Bahareya Mosque, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Gazelle Cafe & Restaurant
description: Gazelle is a welcoming cafe and restaurant with excellent coffee (the flat white especially), good breakfasts, a pleasant atmosphere, and respectful, attentive staff praised by name. Some main dishes like steak can be inconsistent, but the coffee, desserts, and hospitality win repeat visits.
address: El Maamoura Plaza Mall, El Nasr St, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21511

name: Veto Cafe&Restaurant
description: Veto is a cafe and restaurant in Montazah with reasonably tasty food, but its reviews skew strongly negative, with repeated complaints about very long waits, menu items being unavailable, and weak English-language service. Expectations should be modest based on recent feedback.
address: El Falcon Building, in front of Montaza Lake, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21212

name: Harods inn restaurant and cafe
description: Harods is a cafe and restaurant in Ma'amoura with a beautiful sea view, well-liked pizza and coffee, and friendly staff at its best. Reviews are sharply divided, however, with serious complaints about food freshness, service, and cleanliness, so experiences vary widely.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Sheraton Montazah Beach Cafe
description: Sheraton Montazah Beach Cafe sits literally over the sea, with a delightful Coquillage breakfast spread of varied fresh dishes, a great location, and reasonable prices. Reservations can be hard to get, but the seaside setting and good service make it a pleasant choice.
address: Corniche Road, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526077

name: 99 Market
description: 99 Market is a quiet lakeside spot praised for rich, smooth coffee, fresh flavorful ice cream, iced drinks, and friendly staff, great for a quick bite before a walk by the lake. Drink quality can be inconsistent for some, but the vibe and location win fans.
address: 72P9+9XJ Montaza Palace, El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Gucci Cafe & Restaurant
description: Gucci Cafe & Restaurant is a casual spot with good service, decent drinks, comfortable seats, and a first-floor hall suitable for parties, at low prices. Reviews are mixed, with some finding the food low quality and the place in need of better organization, so it's an average option.
address: 778 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526070

name: Mocca Café & restaurant
description: Mocca Cafe & Restaurant is praised for delicious food, an inviting atmosphere, and an outstanding team, good for couples and families, with free parking. It gets crowded and loud during football matches and isn't ideal for laptop work, but the food keeps diners coming back for more.
address: 72PM+68Q, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Agora House for men only 仅限男性
description: Agora House is a men-only guesthouse praised for a friendly, welcoming atmosphere, helpful staff, clean rooms, and fast wifi, with a cafe on the second floor and handy amenities like a kitchen and washing machine. It sits in a lively area with a good view, and guests happily return.
address: 52 Safia Zaghloul St, Raml Station Square, Alexandria Governorate 21563

name: Hotel Fouad
description: Hotel Fouad is a budget downtown hotel whose biggest draw is charming sea-view rooms with old balcony doors and a refreshing sea breeze, run by a welcoming family. Rooms are small and cleanliness is inconsistent, and warm water can be unreliable in cooler months, so set expectations accordingly.
address: 15 El-Shohada, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Al Maghraby Hotel
description: Al Maghraby is a small hotel near the sea and shopping street with comfortable beds, a decent breakfast, and quick fixes to issues. Some guests report tipping pressure at check-in and a cash-only, paperwork-heavy process, so come prepared, but the rooms are comfortable for the price.
address: 10 El Boursa Al Adima Street, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 99999

name: Borg El Thaghr
description: Borg El Thaghr is a well-managed boutique hotel on the top floor of a downtown building, with attentive staff, a recent renovation, nice balcony views, and an on-site restaurant, within walking distance of the train station, trams, and Corniche. Guests repeatedly describe feeling at home, making it a convenient, comfortable base.
address: 5WW5+XHX, 44 El-Horeya Rd, Kom Ad Dakah Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371042

name: Semiramis Hotel
description: Semiramis is an older seafront hotel at the heart of Raml Station whose main appeal is its location and sea view. Rooms and facilities are dated and draw frequent complaints about cleanliness and upkeep, so it's best for travelers prioritizing position and price over comfort.
address: 6W22+Q65, El-Gaish Rd, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Cherry Maryski Hotel
description: Cherry Maryski is a hotel with sharply divided reviews. Some guests find it clean and comfortable for exploring the city, while many others report serious hygiene problems and unpleasant service handling, so experiences vary widely.
address: 9 Mohammed Farid, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21528

name: Brassbell Downtown Grey Studio Apartments
description: Brassbell offers spacious, clean, refurbished studio apartments in an excellent downtown location at the intersection of Fouad and Daniel Streets, with easy access to the city's attractions. The recurring drawback is unreliable hot water, especially late at night and early morning, so factor that in.
address: 8 El-Horeya Rd, Kom Ad Dakah Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372013

name: Crillon Hotel
description: Crillon is a simple, old-style hotel in the marvelous Raml Station area with a great sea view, quiet atmosphere, and apartment-style accommodation with shared spaces. Service can be inconsistent and it skews toward an older crowd, but it's a pleasant, well-located budget choice.
address: 5 Adib Bek Ashak, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373001

name: Misr Hotel
description: Misr Hotel is an older hotel with a beautiful sea view in a lively area full of shops and cafes, close to the library, with helpful staff and a sufficient breakfast. Rooms can smell musty and the wifi and some fixtures are unreliable, but free luggage storage and the view make it a solid budget pick.
address: 21 Amin Fekry, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372064

name: Clement's House Hotel
description: Clement's House is a budget hotel best suited for a short stay, with huge rooms, comfy beds, in-room sinks, a large shared bathroom with great hot water, and 24-hour English-speaking reception. The century-old building can be hard to find and upkeep is inconsistent, so manage expectations.
address: 46 Saad Zaghloul, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372044

name: Triomphe Hotel
description: Triomphe is a heritage hotel in central Raml Station, prized for its great location, historic character, and notably friendly, helpful 24-hour staff. Rooms are old-style with in-room sinks and firm beds, and quoted prices can differ at arrival, so confirm, but the hospitality wins fans.
address: 38 Mohammed Talaat Noeman, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373001

name: Downtown hostel center of Alexandria.
description: Downtown hostel center of Alexandria. is a 4-star hotel in Alexandria.
address: 6W22+4RM, Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 22134

name: Normandy Hotel
description: Normandy is a charming classical hotel by the sea with a beautiful harbor view, reasonable prices, and kind, welcoming staff and owner. Guests repeatedly describe feeling at home, making it a pleasant, well-located budget stay.
address: 8 Gamal El-Deen Yassin, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373001

name: Union Hotel
description: Union Hotel offers great value with comfortable beds, warm quilts, and a balcony with a memorable view of the sea and the fort. Cleanliness and amenities are inconsistent, with some guests reporting missing towels or weak water, so inspect the room first, but the view and price are strong draws.
address: 10 Mohammed Talaat Noeman, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373001

name: Raml Station Club & Hotel For Armed Forces
description: Raml Station Club & Hotel, run for the armed forces, is a historic property once favored by Egypt's last king and home to Alexandria's first roof garden, with spacious rooms and functional appliances. It primarily serves military guests, the food is poor value for civilians, and renovations have removed some old character, so it suits military travelers best.
address: Omar Lotfy St, Raml Station, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372065

name: El Yamama Hotel
description: El Yamama is a budget hotel set in a striking old foreign-style building that admirers of vintage architecture will appreciate. Room service and cleanliness draw complaints, so it's best for travelers on a small budget who value character and location over amenities.
address: 5WW2+JQH, El-Horeya Rd, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372020

name: Queen Transit Alexandria Hotel
description: Queen Transit is a budget hotel whose strengths are a beautiful balcony and a great sea view in a good location. Cleanliness, breakfast, and overall quality draw complaints, so it suits travelers focused mainly on price and the view.
address: 21 El Borsa El Qadima St, Mansheya, 21519

name: Egypt Hotel
description: Egypt Hotel is an affordable, clean option on the third floor of an old building overlooking the Mediterranean, with balcony sea-view rooms, good-quality classic furniture, and adequate service. The exterior looks dated, but the rooms, harbor views, and value make it a lovely piece of old Alexandria.
address: Saad Zaghloul St, the Corniche, El Geish Rd, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: Holiday Manshya Hotel
description: Holiday Manshya is a centrally located hotel near many activities, with a bright, generally clean facility, good service from friendly staff, and a handy grocery store nearby. Rooms and linens can feel outdated and cleanliness is inconsistent, so it's a standard, convenient choice.
address: 5VXV+G56, Ahmed Ourabi, Al Mansheyah Al Kubra, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361021

name: Gloria Hotel
description: Gloria is a budget hotel near the sea overlooking a square in the lively Mansheya market area, with spacious rooms, a nice receptionist, and great value steps from everywhere you'd want to go. Cleanliness and facilities are limited, so it's best for travelers prioritizing price and location.
