address: 2 Abbas Mahmoud El Akkad St (former Old Post), Tahrir Square, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361022

name: Nile Excelsior Hotel
description: Nile Excelsior is a low-budget downtown hotel near the sea with friendly staff, good AC, and a safe feel, including for solo women travelers. The building is old with used, sometimes dusty furniture and a noisy Mansheya location, so it suits travelers wanting an affordable, secure base.
address: 5VXW+P6Q, Al Mansheyah Al Kubra, Qesm Al Mansheyah, Alexandria Governorate 5361024

name: Alkadi Hotel
description: Alkadi is a centrally located hotel with sea-side rooms and notably warm, helpful staff praised by name. Cleanliness, upkeep, and check-in handling draw mixed reviews, so experiences vary, but the friendly service and location are recurring positives.
address: 7 Al Borsa Al Kadima street, in front Telecom Egypt El Manshia El, Mansheya, 11511

name: Philip house
description: Philip House is a beautiful, comfortable guesthouse with charming old-style rooms and views that make guests feel at home, with several returning visitors. Booking handling has drawn at least one serious complaint about a lost reservation, so confirm in advance, but the setting and comfort win praise.
address: 6W32+2Q6, Mahta Al Raml Sq, 1, Al Mesallah Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: El Karnak Hotel
description: El Karnak is a budget hotel in a perfect central location very close to the sea, with clean rooms, sea views, helpful staff, simple decor, and good prices. It can be noisy from balcony-facing windows and many rooms have shared bathrooms, so it suits short, affordable stays.
address: 11 Moursy Gameel Aziz, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: Petit Coin Hotel
description: Petit Coin is a hotel that, according to recent reviews, has declined sharply and appears to have been closed and sealed, with several visitors describing it as a ghost hotel. Confirm it is operating before planning a stay.
address: 5 Khalf Ahmed Orabi St, Mansheya, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372003

name: Applebee's
description: Applebee's offers a cozy, well-designed atmosphere with good music and lighting, delicious food, and friendly service from staff praised by name. Portions can run large and cleanliness could be more consistent, with the occasional note on steak freshness, but most diners enjoy it.
address: 14th of May Bridge Rd, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116, Alexandria Governorate 5310002

name: Piero Egypt Kafr Abdo
description: Piero in Kafr Abdo is a beautiful, spotless Italian spot praised by many as one of the best in Alexandria, with standouts like the salmon pizza and attention to detail. Service can be slow and quality occasionally inconsistent, especially on delivery, but the food and setting win strong fans.
address: 32 Mohamed Safwat St, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: pentola café & restaurant
description: Pentola is a cozy, authentic little Italian spot that fans describe as a hidden gem and a tiny corner of Italy, with delicious food, excellent quality, and warm, friendly service. The understated, no-frills setting and consistently praised meals make it a beloved repeat choice.
address: Mohamed basha saed gnaklis, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: Malakite Restaurant
description: Malakite is an Indian restaurant with a personable Chef Ahmed Hindi who often greets diners, and a good selection including vegan options. Dish consistency varies, with some finding items bland or salty, and there's a note about change-handling at payment, but the chef and veg dishes win praise.
address: Elgeesh road Gleem bay

name: Lulu Lounge
description: Lulu Lounge is a well-loved spot with a lovely view, warmly delicious food, fresh drinks, great desserts, and welcoming, fast service, with staff praised by name. Diners rave about dishes like the chicken quesadilla and Alfredo pasta, making it a favorite for many.
address: Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 23511

name: The Canteen
description: The Canteen is a quick-bite spot with sharply divided reviews. Some praise it warmly, while others report serious problems with cold or spoiled food, soggy bread, and odor, so quality appears inconsistent and expectations should be modest.
address: 7 Ahmed Abd El-Aziz, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433115

name: India Gate Alexandria
description: India Gate is widely praised as one of the best Indian restaurants in Alexandria, with authentic, flavorful dishes, a calm, cozy setting, and friendly, attentive service. Standouts include the onion bhaji, curries, and naans, making it a favorite for both tourists and Indian-cuisine fans.
address: 166 El Geish Rd, Cleopatra seafront, beside El Haram Hotel, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5434017

name: El Montazah Beach
description: El Montazah Beach is a large, beautiful beach within the renovated Montazah grounds, with a lake, walkways, family-only gates, and a low entry ticket, great for family and friend gatherings. Cleanliness varies by gate (cleaner from gate 7 onward) and parts close periodically for renovation, but it's a beloved spot to return to.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: The Cruise
description: The Cruise is an elegant, classy hotel restaurant with a lovely rooftop, beautiful views, attentive staff, and fresh food and juices. Food quality can be inconsistent, with some praising perfectly cooked dishes and others finding mains like the escalope disappointing, but the setting and service stand out.
address: El Geish Rd, Mansheya, El Shohada seafront, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: Patria Lounge
description: Patria Lounge is a chic, comfortable spot with stylish decor and a quiet ambiance that some enjoy for studying or relaxing. Reviews are sharply mixed, however, with complaints about management, slow or absent service, and inconsistent food, so it feels full of potential but uneven.
address: 1 Bastour, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 21515

name: Asteria
description: Asteria is a stylish Italian-Greek restaurant with a cozy, elegant ambiance, good-quality food, a nice variety of dishes, and attentive staff, with the manager praised by name. Diners consistently enjoy the atmosphere and dishes like the shrimp pasta, making it a favorite spot.
address: 40 Safiya Saad Zaghloul, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372024

name: Fresca Bistro & Lounge
description: Fresca is an elegant, recently renovated bistro and lounge in central Alexandria with a marine-themed decor, local art, shisha, and great vibes, lovely for sunset at the outdoor seating. The creative chefs and freshly made dishes win praise, making it a special, polished spot for a meal or evening out.
address: 399 EL El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Kabab Ouzi
description: Kebab Ouzi is a clean, well-kept oriental restaurant praised for excellent grills, sheesh tawook, oven rice, and stuffed mahshi, with outstanding, attentive service. Grilled items can take a while and a few dishes arrive less than hot, but the food and service leave most diners impressed.
address: After Alexandria Union Club, Virginia Tower - Smouha, Alexandria Agriculture Rd, Abis, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5440220

name: Mabrooka
description: Mabrooka is a small, simple, clean Egyptian restaurant with a warm, cozy atmosphere, very kind staff, an English menu, and tasty, healthy options, with the chef-owner adding a personal touch. Portions can run small for some, but the homey vibe and great service make it a memorable spot near the museum.
address: 12 Mahmoud Hamdy Khattab street, Bab Sharq, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 21563

name: Point 6 Sidi Gaber
description: Point 6 in Sidi Gaber is a restaurant-and-cafe complex still partly under construction, with several venues to choose from. Reviews skew negative, with complaints about minimum-order rules, entry restrictions, crowding, long waits, and service, so it's an evolving venue with uneven experiences.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: FalaFlaya
description: FalaFlaya is a seafront spot serving some of the best falafel and foul around at remarkable value, with generous portions, an English menu, and exceptionally warm, welcoming staff. Tourists especially praise how at-home they're made to feel, making it a highly recommended local breakfast stop.
address: 12 26th of July Rd, El Anfoushi, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321381

name: Blinky
description: Blinky is a cozy, clean cafe praised for excellent coffee and breakfast, generous portions, well-liked dishes like pesto pasta, and friendly, responsive staff. A few items (like the burger) are merely good rather than great, but the welcoming atmosphere and food make it a delightful find.
address: Abd El-Salam Aref, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451011

name: O2 Cafe de la Ville
description: O2 Cafe de la Ville is a standout sushi spot praised for fresh, beautifully presented, authentic-tasting sushi, fast preparation, good value sets, and great service in a nice interior. Reviewers, including tourists, consistently rate it among the more reliable sushi choices in Alexandria.
address: EL Naql wel Handasa St. "S" Building beside Smouha Club, gate No6, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080

name: China House
description: China House is a rare Asian restaurant in Alexandria offering Chinese, Thai, and Indian dishes in a simple, pleasant setting with friendly staff. The food is generally fine rather than spectacular and some dishes lack the expected spice, and the location can be hard to find, but it's a solid option for Asian cuisine.
address: 12 Mohammed Ahmed Afify, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452054

name: Nos Regheef
description: Nos Raghif is a well-located breakfast spot praised for delicious, quality food, excellent service, and a calm, cozy atmosphere, with staff like Andrew singled out for great hospitality. Reviewers consistently enjoy the taste and presentation, making it a relaxing place to spend a morning.
address: Point 6 Mall, Joelle Festival Hotel beach, St 6, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434044

name: Dopamina Café & Restaurant
description: Dopamina is a cafe and restaurant at the end of El Nakhl w El Handasa Street with friendly staff and decent food and portions, with well-liked dishes like scallops and grilled chicken. Quality and service have drawn complaints, especially on delivery and during busy times, so experiences vary.
address: Street 38, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Montazah
description: Montazah Palace Gardens is a renowned, recently renovated park with lakes, restaurants, walkways, golf carts, bike rentals, and a car-free, peaceful setting, with entry for a small per-person fee. Some feel a few renovations diluted its historic charm, and the walk can be tiring, but it remains a beautiful, beloved destination.
address: Montaza Palace, El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Kufta
description: Kufta is a cozy spot with both sea-view and closed seating, praised for great hawawshy and high-quality, tasty food in generous portions. Orders can take up to 45 minutes and one diner noted pushy review requests, but the food quality wins fans.
address: Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: Ma sera restaurant
description: Ma Sera is a cozy restaurant-meets-cafe with delicious, beautifully presented Italian food, including well-liked pizza and a standout smooth tiramisu, plus warm service, drawing many repeat visitors. Quality is occasionally inconsistent, with a few finding dishes plain, but most diners come away impressed.
address: 67 el Horeya road, Fouad, Kom Ad Dakah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372054

name: RUSH - Burger & More
description: RUSH is a cozy, classic burger spot praised for tasty food, generous portions for the price, good vibes, and great service. The music can run a bit loud, but reviewers consistently rate it a 10/10 experience and a repeat favorite.
address: 32 Soter St, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21613

name: Hot Restaurant
description: Hot Restaurant specializes in Jordanian dishes like mansaf and musakhan, with tender, flavorful chicken and fair portions praised by diners who've had the originals in Jordan. It's popular and a bit pricey, and the front-desk seating and service can be disorganized, but the authentic food makes it worth trying.
address: 21 Digla, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Potasta
description: Potasta is a popular, cozy pasta shop with large portions, generous cheese, and delicious dishes, served by fast, friendly staff. Branches get crowded and some note the use of vegetable ghee and slightly thin or overcooked sauces, but it's a well-loved, satisfying choice.
address: 18 No.22, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372020

name: Ceres Restaurant
description: Ceres is the rooftop restaurant of the Borg El Thaghr Hotel, reached by a quirky elevator, with a clean, attractive interior and an exceptional terrace view over Alexandria. The food is tasty, the staff friendly, and prices reasonable, making it a cozy, special spot, though desserts can be inconsistent.
address: 51 Safia Zaghloul St, Kom El Dikka Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371040

name: Santorini
description: Santorini is a calm, simply decorated seafront cafe with a significant sea view, quick service, friendly staff, a well-priced set breakfast, and a kids' area for families. Food quality is somewhat average for some, but the nostalgic Alexandria view and relaxed vibe are the main draws.
address: 6W43+6X3, El-Gaish Rd, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: Chocolate factory
description: Chocolate Factory is a cozy cafe and restaurant praised for some of the best hot chocolate in town, plus well-liked desserts like waffles, pancakes, and fondue, with good food and value. Service can be slow for some drinks and a few items differ from the photos, but it's a great spot for dessert.
address: 63 El-Horeya Rd, Kom Ad Dakah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371082

name: Oak Bay
description: Oak Bay is widely praised as one of the best sushi spots in Alexandria, even Egypt, with professional service, fresh, high-quality sushi, and a variety of kitchens to choose from. Service can be inconsistent with the occasional rude staffer, but loyal regulars return frequently.
address: 22 63 El-Horeya Rd, Kom Ad Dakah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371082

name: Soliman Coffee
description: Soliman Coffee on Fouad Street is a stylish cafe with special cappuccino, nice desserts like honey cake and cheese croissant, and surprisingly delicious pizza, in a setting with black plates and decor. The vibe and food quality are well worth it, and reviewers note improvement under newer management.
address: 49-55 El Horreya Rd, Wabour El Maya, Bab Sharqi, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372050

name: Awlad El Fallah Kebda
description: Welad El Falah is a famous, always-crowded traditional spot beloved for clean, delicious, flavorful beef liver (kebda) sandwiches with lemon and chili, served fast by friendly staff. A few longtime fans feel it was even better in the past, but it remains a favorite local liver destination.
address: 9 Qaisar, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372051

name: Sultan Ayub
description: Sultan Ayub is a lively, air-conditioned restaurant near the Alexandria Library serving extremely tasty Turkish and oriental dishes, with friendly staff. Most experiences are positive, though there's at least one complaint about feeling unwell afterward, so order fresh items, but the food and ambiance win fans.
address: 42 Ali Moustafa Moshrfah St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424001

name: Au privé
description: Au Prive is a comfortable lounge with a nice atmosphere, good vibes, and a DJ, well-suited to events and networking. Reviews are sharply mixed, however, with complaints about overpriced food and drinks and inconsistent service, so experiences vary widely.
address: 15 El-Horeya Rd, Kom Ad Dakah Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Basilico Pizza
description: Basilico Pizza is widely hailed as one of the best pizzerias in Alexandria, with excellent thin-crust Neapolitan pizza, great dough and ingredients, well-liked panini, and friendly staff, at reasonable prices. The authentic Italian vibe and top-notch quality make it a standout choice.
address: 8 El Farana St (Branch 1) / inside Sporting Club (Branch 2), off Fouad St, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: MERZY | Specialty Coffee & Bakery
description: MERZY is a clean, cozy specialty coffee shop and bakery with a booming sea view, good coffee, and highly recommended desserts, plus thoughtful touches and decent, helpful staff. It's a pleasant, considerate spot to work or relax with one of the best views around.
address: Bibliotheca Alexandrina services plaza, on the sea, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate

name: The Shami House Restaurant for Syrian Food
description: The Shami House is a simple, clean Syrian corner spot serving very good shawarma and roasted chicken with authentic flavor, mostly takeaway with some sidewalk seating. The space is small inside, but the freshness and consistency keep regulars returning.
address: 22 Chompolion St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424002

name: Normandy 3
description: Normandy 3 is a small seafront seafood spot considered a hidden gem, praised for some of the freshest, best seafood in Alexandria, a clean kitchen, a nice sea and sunset view, and polite, helpful staff. The space is tight and AC could be stronger, but the food quality wins strong fans.
address: 12 Naga Hammadi St, Makka Hotel & Royal Hall St, Bab Sharq

name: El Selsela Fishing Pier
description: Selsela Fishing Pier is one of Alexandria's oldest spots, a beautiful little sandy corner with clean water, good for picnicking, fishing, walking, and taking in nature. The catch is mostly small fish, so it's more for the scenery and relaxed atmosphere than serious fishing.
address: El Geish Rd, Eastern Harbour, Bab Sharq, Alexandria

name: Eastern Harbour Pier
description: The Eastern Harbor pier is a pleasant, scenic waterfront spot lively until late at night, with strong rocks along the shore and a walkable path toward the castle. It can be hot at midday and a few vendors are pushy, but it's beloved as the heart and foundation of Alexandria.
address: 26 July St, El Mesalla Gharb & Sherif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373001

name: Egyptian Fishing Club in Alexandria
description: The Egyptian Fishing Club is a spacious waterfront spot with great deck views, tasty seafood, and room for a range of activities, kept fairly clean. It gets crowded and some feel its private-club character has faded, but the setting and seafood make it enjoyable.
address: 6V7P+4G5, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321430

name: Alexandria Port
description: Alexandria Port is a working harbor with a coordinated design where wooden fishing boats bring in fresh catch early each morning. The port area itself is fine, but heavy, unorganized traffic just outside the gates can make arrival and departure a hassle.

name: Fishing Port at Maadia Village
description: The Maadia Village fishing port is a seaside spot known for fresh fish auctions where traders and locals buy daily catch at low prices. It sits near the international coastal highway with pedestrian-only access, giving it a distinctive, lively fishing-village character.
address: El Tabia - Rashid Line, El Maadeya, Edku, Alexandria Governorate 22676

name: Port of El Dekheila
description: The Port of El Dekheila is a working commercial and crew-change port. Reviews from seafarers are largely negative, citing bureaucratic procedures, long waits for shore passes, cleanliness issues, and occasional hassle, so it's strictly a functional port rather than a visitor destination.
address: 4QMX+V3P, Ad Dakhilah, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5320010

name: Eastern Port . Alexandria
description: The Eastern Port is an authentic, historic stretch of Alexandria's waterfront filled with traditional fishing boats, near Qaitbay Castle, with mesmerizing winter sunrises and sunsets. You can walk the seaside, find plenty of food nearby, and even hire a boat for a short trip.
address: 18 El-Gaish Rd, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321382

name: Gate 22 - Alexandria Port
description: Gate 22 is one of the entrances to Alexandria's marine port and the site of the weekly Friday flea market (Souq Al Gomaa) selling secondhand goods. Issuing port permissions here is slow and disorganized, so bring documents and cash, arrive early, and be patient.
address: El Borsa & Kafr Ashri, Mina El Basal District, Alexandria Governorate

name: Miami Island - Alexandria
description: Miami Island is a beautiful spot for stunning sea views, boats, fishing, and relaxing, especially at sunrise and sunset, with clean surrounding streets. There are no services on the island, so bring your own umbrella, food, and chairs and prepare for strong sun.
address: 622 El Geish Rd, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza District, Alexandria

name: Abu Qir Naval Port
description: The Abu Qir marine port is a seaside spot with available services and pleasant weather to enjoy. Feedback is mixed, with some hoping for development and others critical of the area, so expectations should be modest while it evolves.
address: 83JF+JJ, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Dock Alexandria
description: Dock Alexandria is a marina in Alexandria.
address: Customs Zone, Alexandria Port Police Administration, Unnamed Road

name: Abu Qir Port
description: Abu Qir Port sits in Abu Qir Bay east of Alexandria, overseen by the Egyptian Navy, with a 500-meter quay handling grain ships and solid infrastructure and depth. It's a functional commercial port rather than a tourist spot, and the surrounding waters can have jellyfish.
address: 83Q8+JM8, Montaza 2

name: Fish Island Seafood Restaurant
description: Fish Island is a highly praised seafood spot where you pick your fresh fish and a friendly chef cooks it to your liking, with a great outdoor atmosphere. Standouts include the butterfly shrimp and white seafood soup, and reviewers repeatedly rate it among the best seafood and grill experiences around.
address: Borg El Arab Airport - North Coast Rd, end of the Axis Rd, beside El Orouba Mall, Bahig, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate

name: Shāţi' al Anfūshī
description: Anfoushi Beach is a lovely historic stretch of Alexandria with cool sea views, an old fishing port, traditional restaurants, and boats you can tour. It gets very crowded, which limits relaxing, but it remains a calming favorite for taking in the sea and city character.
address: As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321381

name: Rashid Port
description: Rashid (Rosetta) Port is a well-equipped fishing port with facilities supporting the full fishing operation, including ice, canning, and fish-sales outlets, in a city known for its beauty and history. Parts are still under construction but nearing completion, with reviewers praising its scope and setting.
address: CCCG+5Q3, Rasheed, Rosetta, Beheira Governorate 5968930

name: Gate 10 - Alexandria Port
description: Gate 10 is one of the entry gates to the Port of Alexandria, Egypt's largest seaport on the Mediterranean. It serves as an access point to the harbour's maritime and shipping operations.
address: 56 El Bahareya St, Customs Zone, Alexandria Port Police Administration, Alexandria

name: Emad Bahareya Fishing Gear Shop
description: Emad Bahareya is a well-stocked fishing-tackle shop with a wide selection of rods, tools, and equipment at good prices, run by notably generous, polite, hospitable staff. It can be crowded and a little hard to reach, but the quality and service earn strong praise.
address: 119-121, Thabet Ibn Qora, Al Wardiyan Qebli, Port al-Basal, Alexandria Governorate 5332110

name: Abu Qir Fishermen's Harbour
description: The Abu Qir fishermen's harbor is a beautiful, beloved working port that provides a livelihood for local fishermen and a pleasant spot for fishing enthusiasts to launch from boats. Reviewers warmly hope it stays in its current location.
address: Second Montaza District, Alexandria Governorate 5528370

name: Edku Port
description: The Edku port is a developing waterfront spot, not yet finished, with a beautiful sea and refreshing air, nice for fishing. It's still a work in progress, but the scenery already makes it pleasant to visit.
address: 88Q2+4FC, Edku, Beheira Governorate 5958004

name: Samakmak Seafood
description: Samakmak is widely regarded as one of the best seafood restaurants in Alexandria, with fresh fish, standout shrimp, and fresh, well-made salads in a comfortable setting. Service can be slow, with notable waits for menus and food, and some find it pricey with tax added, so confirm prices, but the quality is top-tier.
address: Ras El Tin Palace, El Anfoushi St, El Seyala Gharb, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321020

name: Fishing Fish
description: Fishing Fish was a well-liked seafood spot remembered for amazing food, clean dining, welcoming staff, and reasonable prices. Recent reviews suggest it has closed and feedback on delivery turned negative, so confirm it is operating before visiting.
address: 68 El-Gaish Rd, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 21617

name: Sea side cafe
description: Sea Side is a seafront cafe with a great view, friendly crew, affordable prices, and a service-only option for bringing your own food, making it good for groups and family gatherings. It's cash-only and the music can get very loud, with a limited everyday menu, but the atmosphere and view are draws.
address: Corniche, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Blue view
description: Blue View in The Walk is a calm, romantic Greek-style cafe with beautiful blue decor, an open sea view great for photos, and good espresso. Food and drink quality are inconsistent, with some finding items cold or low quality and certain prices steep, so it's best for a coffee date with a view.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434023

name: Santos cafe
description: Santos is a seafront cafe that pleasantly surprises with better-than-expected food and drinks like a creamy lotus milkshake, plus well-liked brownies and cheesecake, friendly staff, and a great atmosphere. Service and cleanliness have drawn complaints since reopening and prices run a touch high, but the vibe and view are nice.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526064

name: delmar cafe & restaurant
description: Delmar is a simple Corniche cafe and restaurant with a wonderful open sea view, decent-to-good food, lovely music, and professional, helpful staff praised by name. Coffee quality and prices draw some complaints, with occasional slow service, but the setting makes it a pleasant Alexandria spot.
address: 135 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434011

name: Beano's Café
description: Beano's is a modern, mostly Western-style cafe with a quiet, peaceful atmosphere good for working or studying, friendly staff, vegetarian milk options, and great coffee. The internet can be slow and breakfast items aren't always fresh, but it's a comfortable spot to focus over a good cup.
address: 275 Adly Yakn, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Classic Rock
description: Classic Rock is a themed cafe and restaurant with an amazing Mediterranean view, an electric, nostalgic atmosphere, and occasional live bands that fans love. The food and service draw frequent complaints about saltiness and quality, so it's best enjoyed for the vibe and music rather than the meal.
address: seafront, beside Darwish Hotel, Al Ibrahimeya Bahari & Sidi Gaber, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21524

name: GRAND CAFE
description: Grand Cafe is a cozy, elegant cafe with a great atmosphere, friendly staff, affordable prices, on-site paid parking, and surprisingly good food and desserts. There's no sea view and the kitchen can be inconsistent on portion size for some, but it's a comfortable, uncrowded spot for coffee with friends.
address: Corniche Rd, Al Mazar, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321384

name: Sea House Roof cafe
description: Sea House is a rooftop cafe whose main appeal is a beautiful sea view, with good drinks. Reviews skew strongly negative, however, with repeated complaints about rude, money-focused service, seating dictated by staff, and tiered prices by location, so expectations should be modest.
address: 23 Mina Sharky st, Saad Zaghloul Square

name: Maspiro Cafe, Alexandria
description: Maspiro is a cafe with good tea and coffee, shisha, and a beautiful view, set just off the Corniche so you get the scenery in a calmer spot, especially pleasant in the afternoon. Prices run a bit high, the outdoor pavement is narrow, and service is inconsistent, so it's a relaxed view-focused choice.
address: 6WGQ+QH9, El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434023

name: Scala Kitchen + Cafe
description: Scala is an elegant, cozy kitchen and cafe in Gleem Bay with comfortable couches, generous portions, well-liked pizza and seafood pasta, smooth hookah service, and warm, kind staff. Some dishes can arrive a touch cold, but the atmosphere, food, and hospitality make it a favorite in the area.
address: Gleem Bay, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Leil Cafe
description: Lail Cafe is a spot that draws largely negative reviews, with complaints about overpriced, underwhelming food, rigid handling of breakfast offers, and a lack of fans or AC. Staff were accommodating about switching football matches for some, but expectations should be modest.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526076

name: Silver Town
description: Silver Town is a jewelry store praised for high-quality silver pieces, including handmade designs, with excellent management and standout, attentive customer service from staff named by reviewers. Shoppers consistently report a satisfying, well-cared-for experience.
address: 6XW8+7J3 mall, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Fouad Ahmed Jewellery
description: Fouad Ahmed Jewellery offers a fine collection that some shoppers appreciate. Reviews are sharply divided, however, with multiple complaints about slow, rude customer service and after-sales handling, so experiences vary widely.
address: Shop 40, City Center, 14 Salah Salem St, El Naql wal Handasa St, El Shahid Mostafa Hafez (formerly France St), San Stefano Mall, Al Attarin Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Elmonib Jewellery
description: Elmonib Jewellery is a well-regarded jewelry store whose owners are repeatedly praised as honest, respectable, and helpful, with friendly staff and good taste in pieces. Most reviewers warmly recommend dealing with them, though there's an occasional complaint about pricing.
address: 74 Albert Al Awal, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432008

name: Gold Era
description: Gold Era is a gold dealer with sharply divided reviews. Some praise premium quality and attentive, consistent service across repeat visits, while others find it unprofessional with sales pressure and unreliable timelines, so experiences vary widely.
address: 352 El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21531

name: TRUST
description: TRUST is an Alexandrian jewelry store that lives up to its name, repeatedly praised for honesty, professionalism, fair prices, a wide variety, and a charming welcome with expert advice from staff named by reviewers. Shoppers confidently recommend it.
address: 20 Syria, St, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21529

name: Lamsa Jewellery - Alexandria Branch
description: Lamsa is a jewelry store with a good selection that's nice for affordable gold gifts, with at least one staff member singled out for warm, helpful service. Some shoppers find the labor cost high and report slow responses to online inquiries, so experiences are mixed.
address: Abu Qir St, Saba Basha (former tattoo shop), El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 21529

name: The Sultan Silver & Accessories
description: The Sultan is a jewelry shop in Alexandria specializing in silver pieces and accessories, from rings and necklaces to decorative items. It is a handy spot for gifts and everyday adornments.
address: 225 El-Fath, Al Aqesa WA Baqos, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5450370

name: Tag Elmalek
description: Tag Elmalek is a jeweler whose reviews skew strongly negative, with complaints about inaccurate invoices, questionable weighing practices, high manufacturing costs, and poor attitude. A few cite good prices, but most feedback advises caution.
address: 31 El Shahid Mostafa Hafez St (formerly France St), El Mansheya, Alexandria

name: Gold House
description: Gold House is a jewelry store with sharply divided reviews. Some describe it as trustworthy with respectful service and discounts, while many others complain of high labor charges and unprofessional, unconcerned customer service, so experiences vary widely.
address: 31 Al Attarin Mosque St, El Soury, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5370013

name: Silver House
description: Silver House offers an elegant, up-to-date selection of silver, tungsten, watches, and similar pieces at affordable prices. Reviewers praise the collection and value, making it a solid choice for silver shopping.
address: 30 El Shahid Mostafa Hafez St, El Mansheya, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361013

name: Galaxy Egypt Silver & Accessories
description: Galaxy Egypt is a silver store praised for incredibly competitive prices, respectful service, and fast shipping, with staff named warmly by reviewers. Shoppers consistently describe an excellent, trustworthy experience.
address: Misr Station, Mahatet Misr Pharmacy St, El Bab El Gedid & Mansha, Moharram Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5413106

name: Elmasa Silver 925
description: Elmasa Silver 925 is a silver shop praised for respectable quality, good prices, and notably classy service. Reviewers warmly recommend it, with only minor suggestions to expand the simpler items.
address: 8 Abdel Salam Aref St, El Hadaya tram stop, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452010

name: IRAM Jewelry
description: IRAM is a diamond and gold showroom set in a beautifully maintained converted old palace, with an extensive collection, an easy-to-reach location, and a generally pleasant vibe. Service draws mixed feedback, from very friendly (even greeted by the owner) to merely average, so experiences vary.
address: 156 Ahmed Shawqi, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434047

name: Bullion Trading Center
description: Bullion Trading Center is a gold dealer with mixed reviews. Some find it trustworthy and cooperative with helpful reception staff, while others cite poor treatment, crowding, cash-only sales, and pricing concerns, so experiences vary.
address: 10 Syria, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434047

name: gold market
description: The Fouad Street gold market is a bustling district where you can find all kinds of gold and silver jewelry, with some shops praised for honest, helpful, welcoming service and good quality. It's always crowded and quality varies by vendor, so it's a lively place to browse and bargain.
address: 5VXQ+PJW, Souq at Tork, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361005

name: farfasha silver shop
description: Farfasha is a small silver shop with nice merchandise at inexpensive prices. Reviewers describe a pleasant, good-value shopping experience, though the shop's name has reportedly changed.
address: Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517172

name: Mohamed Abdelsalam Jewellery - MAS
description: Mohamed Abdelsalam Jewellery (MAS) is a well-known jeweler with multiple Alexandria branches and good prices. Reviews are sharply divided, however, with serious complaints about honesty and pricing alongside positive notes on selection, so shop carefully.
address: Abdel Salam Aref St, Bolkly, Alexandria Governorate

name: Mostafa Farouk Silver
description: Mostafa Farouk Silver is a jeweler in Alexandria specializing in silver jewelry and craftsmanship, offering a range of rings, bracelets, and custom pieces.
address: 10 Abd El-Salam Aref, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452010

name: Haidaq Gold & Silver
description: Haidaq is a gold and silver shop praised for a varied selection of styles, reasonable prices, and good service. Reviewers describe it as a pleasant, well-priced place to buy.
address: Sadiqat El Ketab El Moqadas St, El Mandara Bahari, El Asafra Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Mohamed Abdelsalam Jewellery - France Street
description: Mohamed Abdelsalam Jewellery on France Street is praised as one of the finer gold shops, with excellent merchandise, professional service, special offers, and honest pricing. Reviewers warmly recommend it.
address: Gold Market, 28 El-Shaheed Mostafa Hafez, Souq at Tork, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361012

name: Horus Jewelry
description: Horus Jewelry is a jewelry store with sharply divided reviews. Some praise polite staff and transparent cashback on receipts, while others report poor staff behavior and unresolved complaints, so experiences vary and it's worth shopping carefully.
address: 267 Gamal Abdel Nasser Rd, Miami, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21411

name: Fouad Shousha
description: Fouad Shousha is a jeweler with a wide variety of gold and diamonds that some shoppers rate among the best in Alexandria. Others report poor workmanship, weak after-sales service, and higher prices at certain branches, so experiences vary widely.
address: 20 El Hedaya Mosque St, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451001

name: Farid Kerollos Jewellers
description: Farid Kerollos is a jeweler with a distinctive, extensive, elegant collection that many praise for service and reliability. Reviews are divided, however, with some reporting very rude, unprofessional treatment, so experiences vary.
address: 28 El-Shaheed Mostafa Hafez, Souq at Tork, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361012

name: Al-Qady Bros Jewellers
description: Al-Qady Bros is a jeweler that offers quick gold resale with immediate cash and professional service at several branches. Reviews are largely negative on customer service and pricing, however, so know the day's market price beforehand and shop carefully.
address: 19 El-Shaheed Mostafa Hafez, Souq at Tork, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361013

name: Fathy Fatouh Jewellery
description: Fathy Fattouh is a jewelry store with sharply divided reviews. Some praise excellent, hassle-free customer service and easy exchanges, while others report exploitative pricing on gold bars and poor credibility, so shop carefully.
address: Shops C10 & C11, Green Plaza Mall, Alexandria Governorate

name: Ashraf Mounir Jewelry
description: Ashraf Mounir Jewelry has admirers who praise its taste, quality gold, and friendly, easy dealing. Many reviews are critical, however, citing high labor and stamping fees, expensive bullion, and card-payment surcharges, so confirm all costs before buying.
address: 8 Mohamed Bahaa El Din El Ghatoury St, off Mohamed Fawzy Moaz St

name: Alexandria Gold & Bullion Trading Center
description: This Alexandria gold and bullion trading center has sharply divided reviews. Some longtime customers praise polite, respectable dealing and competitive buy/sell prices, while others report rude service and selective buying, so experiences vary widely.
address: 19 Sidi Al Boussari, Souq at Tork, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5321210

name: Sea Gull Restaurant
description: Sea Gull is a fantastic seafood restaurant on the shore where you choose your fresh fish and have it cooked to order, served with a variety of salads and dips. With polite, helpful staff, an attentive manager, antiques-filled character, and amazing sea views, it's a memorable Alexandrian dining experience.
address: 4RVM+9XV, Al Meks, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5312780

name: Zephyrion restaurant , Abu Qir, Alexandria
description: Zephyrion in Abu Qir is a classy, elegant seaside fish restaurant with stunning decor, a beautiful beachfront setting perfect for sunsets, fresh, delicious food, and a small safe parking area. It's far from downtown, pricey with prices not always quoted upfront, and gets crowded, so reserve and confirm costs, but the setting and food impress many.
address: Al Giesh, Abu Qir Ash Sharqeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527438

name: San View Cafe and Restaurant
description: San View is a seaside gem praised for top-quality food, desserts, and drinks, a wonderful sea view, and incredibly friendly, attentive staff. Reviewers consistently describe an excellent, memorable experience, with only the occasional off note, making it a well-loved Alexandria spot.
address: 6XW8+88F, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Zephere Sea food elmax
description: Zephere in El-Max is a well-known seafood spot with an old-school charm, a splendid seaside view, refreshing breeze, and a clean prayer area, where the food is generally wonderful. It runs overpriced, the interior lacks windows despite being built over the sea, and orders can get mixed up, so set expectations.
address: 29 Al Kornish, Al Meks, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5312783

name: MER RESTAURANT & LOUNGE
description: MER Restaurant & Lounge is a calm, cozy spot with an amazing view, attentive, welcoming staff praised by name, nice desserts, good breakfast offers, free parking, and a kids' area. It's peaceful and family-friendly, making it a highly recommended choice for relaxed mornings or catching up with friends.
address: El Geish Rd, the Corniche, Alexandria Governorate

name: Santorini Greek Restaurant
description: Santorini is a beautifully decorated Greek restaurant with a stunning sea view, a welcome lemon-mint drink and bread with dips, delicious food, and outstanding, attentive service from staff praised by name. A live singer and sunset views make it especially lovely for couples and a memorable evening out.
address: 544 El Geish Rd, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Second Montaza District, 21611

name: Sea Walk Restaurant (Engineers Club Sea Bay)
description: Sea Walk at the Engineers Club has a calm, attractive open-water sea view that's its main appeal. Service draws heavy criticism, however, with repeated complaints about rude, inexperienced waiters, long waits, and food and drinks arriving cold or poor, so it's best for the view rather than the meal.
address: 315 El Geish Rd, Stanley, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452042

name: PUKA RESTAURANT & CAFE
description: PUKA is a cozy, hospitable cafe and restaurant with stunning sea views, light, premium-quality pizza, well-liked brownies, and caring, accommodating staff who happily adjust dishes on request. Reviewers consistently praise the atmosphere, food, and decent prices, making it a place they'd return to.
address: San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: The Bridge Café and Restaurant
description: The Bridge is a popular cafe and restaurant with a marvelous sea view, good prices, and notably friendly, attentive service, with well-liked Turkish coffee, desserts like cheesecake and profiterole, and a tasty chicken plate. View-side tables fill up fast with a waiting list and shisha runs a bit pricey, but the service and view stand out.
address: El-Gaish Rd, As Soyouf Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517070

name: Arous Elbahr
description: Arous Elbahr, next to the Mursi Abu al-Abbas mosque, is one of Alexandria's best-known seafood restaurants, where you pick fresh fish, prawns, calamari, and crab to be cooked on the spot. Quality is mostly excellent and full of flavor, with the occasional inconsistent dish, but most diners rate it a top choice.
address: El-Sayed Mohammed Karim, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 21556

name: Al Marsa seafood
description: Al Marsa is a cozy, well-kept seafood gem where you choose fresh seafood by the kilo and pick how it's cooked, fried, grilled, or butterflied with cream or tomato sauce. Diners rave about the freshness, value, and standout butterfly shrimp and crab, making it a fantastic Alexandria seafood experience.
address: Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517192

name: Portofino
description: Portofino is a reliable spot with high-quality food, well-liked dishes like creamy chicken soup, cheese pasta, and Bolognese, plus good coffee and dessert, at reasonable prices for its seafront location. Quality is occasionally inconsistent, with a serious hygiene complaint at one location, but regulars enjoy it for casual meals with friends.
address: 441 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452058

name: Santiago Restaurant & Cafe
description: Santiago in the Louran area is a clean, well-organized two-floor cafe and restaurant with a Mediterranean view, nice decor, amenities like wifi, TV, and parking, and friendly, helpful staff. Food quality is fairly average for some and the vibe leans toward a shisha lounge, but the atmosphere is comfortable for groups.
address: 418 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21325

name: Seven Seas
description: Seven Seas is rated by many as one of the best seafood restaurants in Alexandria, even Egypt, with consistently good, fresh fish, tasty grilled options, a clean setting, a garden and beach, and a friendly, welcoming crew. It's about an hour from downtown and a bit pricey, but the food and setting make it worth the trip.
address: 30 El Kaad Gohar St, Abu Qir El Sharqeya, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527436

name: Loqmet Bahr Seafood
description: Lokmet Bahr is a fine-dining seafood spot praised for delicious, fresh food, impressive cleanliness and organization, a fantastic ambiance, and outstanding, friendly service with staff named warmly by reviewers. Diners consistently describe an excellent, well-presented experience worth returning for.
address: Tivoli Dome Mall, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Shrimpk - Gleem Bay
description: Shrimpk in Gleem Bay is highly praised for exceptional, fresh seafood that some rate the best in Alexandria, with standouts like the sea bass, fried shrimp pots, and Cajun shrimp pasta, in a nice sea-view setting with friendly, respectful service. Quality is consistently high, making it a favorite for seafood lovers.
address: 6XV5+84R Gleem Bay, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Jamboojo Seafood
description: Jamboojo is a clean, pleasant seafood spot where you handpick fresh seafood, praised for high-quality food and good service that made it a trip highlight for several diners. A few find it expensive and merely mediocre and it closes early at 9pm, but most reviewers come away impressed.
address: 51 Sidi Yakout, As Sayalah Gharb, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321341

name: Zephyr Seafood
description: Zephir is a seafood restaurant with sharply divided reviews. Some praise it as among the best in Alexandria with tasty food and good variety, while others report serious problems with messed-up orders, value, and pricing, and there's no fixed menu, so confirm prices upfront and set expectations.
address: 6V6M+VFJ, Kayetbai, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321430

name: Fish Town Cloud kitchen, Alexandria
description: Fish Town is a cloud-kitchen seafood spot praised for high-quality, delicious food, excellent service, and a cozy experience that several call underrated and a must-try. As a cloud kitchen it can be hard to find at the location, so it's best for delivery or confirming the address first.
address: 3 Heliopolis St, Camp Chezar, Alexandria Governorate 21525

name: Al-Lol fish restaurant
description: Al-Lol is a beloved seafood spot in the older part of Alexandria, near old fishing boats, fishermen's houses, and the historic lighthouse, with fresh, flavorful, perfectly cooked fish and well-liked butterfly shrimp. The atmospheric setting and quality make it a must-try for seafood lovers.
address: Max Al Shalehat Next to Al Fanar, Al Meks, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5312787

name: Lamma View
description: Lamma View has a genuinely nice sea view and decent portions at reasonable prices, which is its main appeal. Food quality and service draw frequent complaints, including hygiene issues and limited AC, so it's best enjoyed for the setting rather than the meal.
address: Tivoli Dome, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Near Cafe
description: Near Cafe is a quiet, uncrowded spot with courteous, English-speaking staff, good drinks like the Nutella waffle and smoothies, and a pleasant ambiance for privacy. Prices run a bit high, there's no AC, and the music and seating rules draw some complaints, but the service is welcoming.
address: VHJQ+H2, New, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 5221540

name: El Corba Coffee
description: Ben El Korba is a warm, cozy coffee house in a historic part of Alexandria, praised for some of the highest-quality coffee in the city (especially single-origin), friendly staff, nice music, and great decoration. French coffee and service can be inconsistent, but the atmosphere and quality beans make it a favorite.
address: 8 Dr Ibrahim Abd El-Sayed, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371084

name: Flamingo Cafe
description: Flamingo in Mustafa Kamel is a seafront cafe with a stunning sea view, tasty, well-presented food like mixed grill and salads, friendly staff, and acceptable prices for the location. Several reviewers raise concerns about the welfare of the captive flamingos kept on site, so be aware, but the food and view please.
address: 6WJW+R27, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Cilantro Alex Library
description: Cilantro by the Alexandria Library is a consistently reliable cafe with excellent coffee, good desserts like tiramisu and shakes, lovely views, and genuinely friendly, welcoming staff. Longtime regulars praise its steady quality over the years, making it a pleasant spot for a sweet break.
address: Corniche, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424020

name: Two Bites
description: Two Bites is a chill, two-floor spot with a good vibe, popular for fresh, delicious croissants (the turkey croissant especially), well-liked drinks like the Spanish latte and tiramisu hot chocolate, and friendly staff. It gets crowded, a sign of its quality, making it a recommended stop for pastries and coffee.
address: Al Moaaskar Al Romani, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434046

name: Dough
description: Dough is a pizzeria with a beautiful sea view and good food, well-liked pizza, fresh juices, and dessert waffles, with kind staff toward families. Reviews are sharply mixed, however, with serious complaints about cleanliness, lack of AC, and rude service on some visits, so experiences vary widely.
address: L Bay, Kayetbai st, Bahary Citadel of Qaitbay area, 1st floor Alexandria, 21599

name: Zanilli's Coffee & More
description: Zanilli's is a seaside spot in the Montazah Palace grounds with a nice view, good-quality food and drinks, and fair prices for the location, notable as one of the few places open there. Reviews are mixed-to-negative, with complaints about very long waits, minimum-order rules, and inconsistent dishes, so set expectations.
address: 72Q9+27V, El-Shaheed Youssef El-Sebaey, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: EL Sheikh Wafik,alexandria
description: El Sheikh Wafik is a revered Alexandrian dessert parlor famous for couscous (coscos), rice pudding, om ali, and ice cream, generous with nuts and well worth the wait. It gets very crowded with waits up to half an hour and some items can arrive cold, but the traditional desserts are special.
address: 24 Kasr Al Tin, Ras at Tin, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321303

name: Yakout seafood
description: Yakout is an authentic seafood restaurant praised for well-made, tasty food at affordable prices, quick service, and a professional, notably friendly team, with staff like Omar going above and beyond. It's a great, English-friendly spot for a relaxed seafood meal while exploring the city.
address: El Kafour Rd, in front of the Hilton, Amreya, Alexandria Governorate 21556

name: El Borsa Cafe
description: Qahwet El Borsa is a large, famous cafe in Mansheya Square with indoor and outdoor seating and welcoming staff. The Turkish coffee is just okay and it's more of a casual spot for a relaxing break than a coffee destination, but the service and atmosphere win some fans.
address: 4 El Maronite Church St, El Mansheya El Kubra, Mansheya District, Alexandria

name: Greek Nautical Club
description: The Greek Yacht Club is a waterfront spot with a breathtaking upper-level view, fresh seafood, and friendly staff. The restaurant feels somewhat outdated and prices are high, and seasoning can be inconsistent, but the setting and view are the main draws.
address: Qaitbay St, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321430

name: Starbucks
description: This Starbucks branch is praised for consistent beverage quality, cleanliness, and notably warm, helpful staff who make regulars feel like family. It can get very crowded and occasionally runs out of items like filtered coffee, but the quiet atmosphere and good energy make it a pleasant stop.
address: Designia Mall, Qetaa at Tarik as Sahrawi, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5258710

name: Egyptian American Book Center ( Kafr - Abdo Store )
description: The Egyptian American Book Center in Kafr Abdo is a trusted bookstore known for 100% authentic books, a wide variety of genres, a strong English selection, fair prices, and knowledgeable, helpful staff. Some find the Arabic and classics selections limited, but it's a longtime go-to for English titles in Alexandria.
address: 35 Abd El-Qader Ragab Basha, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433112

name: Microphone Bookstore
description: Microphone is one of Alexandria's best bookstores, with a wide selection of recent publications, an interesting English children's section, a reading area, and a coffee corner, plus a relaxing, quiet atmosphere. Discounted book fairs and a gallery of notebooks and gifts add to its appeal for book lovers.
address: 574 Abou Quer, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451010

name: Rahaala Bookstore
description: Rahaala is a cozy, dreamy used and new bookstore where you feel at home, with English and Arabic titles, comics, borrowing and buy-back options, and friendly staff, at very good prices. It could use better organization, but book lovers consistently praise its selection and warm vibe.
address: Pixi shoe store, Louran, Mahmoud Sedky street, from Al Iqbal, Alexandria Governorate 21619

name: Bayt Alkotob
description: Bayt Alkotob is a welcoming bookstore with a wide range of books, helpful, kind staff, a good location, and a notably professional, fast online ordering process. It's especially praised for high-quality, interactive Arabic children's books at great prices.
address: Zahran Roushdy, off El Horreya Rd, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate

name: Aseer El Kotob Bookstore
description: Aseer El Kotob (Smouha branch) is a neat, well-lit bookstore with a wide range of titles and friendly, helpful staff, with a comforting aesthetic. Parking is scarce (especially around 3pm) and a few items run slightly overpriced, but you can call ahead or check their website for availability.
address: Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432056

name: Beit El Kotob - El Eqbal Branch
description: Bayt Alkotob (Iqbal branch) is a clean, neat bookstore with a good Arabic selection, decent children's choice, and helpful staff both in person and online, plus a smooth website for checking availability and prices. It's not the biggest branch, but the service and offering win praise.
address: 30 Al Akbal St, Louran, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 21613

name: Knowledge Book Center
description: Knowledge Book Center is a well-stocked bookstore praised for authentic, high-quality books at reasonable prices and a good variety you won't always find elsewhere. It's tucked on a side street and could use better signage, but it's a great spot for readers.
address: 4 Ibrahim Fathi Ghoneim, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5450203

name: El Sayad Stationery Center
description: El Sayad is a stationery center carrying nearly all school and office supplies at cheaper-than-average prices. The space is dusty and disorganized, so finding what you need takes longer, but the low prices and broad selection make it useful.
address: As Souri, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5370043

name: OK Group
description: OK Group is a stationery and book store offering a wide range of supplies plus services like printing, scanning, and copying, with late hours and some helpful, fast staff. Pricing and service quality draw mixed feedback, with photocopying occasionally slow, so it's a convenient if uneven option.
address: 6W5C+XVV, Al Ibrahimeyah Qebli WA Al Hadrah Bahri, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423052

name: Gerier
description: Gerier is a well-regarded bookstore praised for a wide availability of titles, reasonable, non-exploitative prices, respectful staff, and good copying facilities. Note there are similarly named shops, so confirm the location, but reviewers rate it highly.
address: 62X4+237, As Soyouf Qebli (Include Izbat Derbanah), Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5515417

name: New University House (Dar El Gamaa El Gedida)
description: Dar El Gamaa El Gedida is a well-stocked, two-story bookstore with a good variety and helpful staff, especially strong for college, law, and academic books and for those publishing doctoral theses. It's a reliable spot for university and specialized texts.
address: 38 Soter St, Al Azarita, opposite the Faculty of Law, Alexandria Governorate

name: Sout El Qahera Audio & Video
description: Sout El Qahera is one of Egypt's oldest audio and video production companies and the official distributor of classic Egyptian music recordings by legends like Umm Kulthum, Abdel Wahab, and Abdel Halim. It's a nostalgic destination for fans of golden-era Egyptian music.
address: El Azaa St, El Aqesa & Bakous, Alexandria Governorate 5450211

name: Beit El Kotob Bookstore - Camp Chezar Branch
description: Bayt El Kotob (Camp Shizar branch) is a beautiful, well-organized library and bookstore with one of the more diverse book collections left in Alexandria, respectful staff, and good service. Some shoppers report notably high prices on certain titles, so it's worth comparing, but the selection and setting are strong.
address: 10 Kafr Saqr St, Al Ibrahimeya Bahari & Sidi Gaber, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21525

name: O.H Stationery
description: O.H Stationery is a stationery shop in Alexandria stocking pens, notebooks, art supplies, and office essentials. It is a useful stop for students and professionals alike.
address: Near Pet store, 3 Masanae Aza, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432015

name: Al Felah
description: Al Felah is a book store in Alexandria.
address: 18 Al Akhla, Al Ibrahimeyah Qebli WA Al Hadrah Bahri, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5422031

name: Apple Stationery
description: Apple is an office-supply store with good service and respectable, helpful staff, including Mohamed Hussein praised by name. It's more of a supply shop than a full bookstore, so you may not find everything, but reviewers note premium products and pleasant dealing.
address: Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423015

name: Badr Stationery
description: Badr is widely considered one of the best stationery stores in Alexandria, with a deep selection of high-quality pens, pencils, notebooks, and paper, including German and Japanese brands and art and engineering supplies. Friendly staff and good service across a low-to-mid price range make it a favorite for students and professionals.
address: 21 Ahmed Kamha St, beside the Faculty of Engineering, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21534

name: Acml Egypt - Alex Center For Multimedia & Libraries
description: ACML is a sophisticated, clean, quiet bookstore notable for one of the largest selections of English titles in Alexandria, a fantastic kids' section, and cool prices. Reviewers describe it as a great destination for intellectuals and readers, with a calm, welcoming atmosphere.
address: Ahmed Shawqi St, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5450101

name: Dar Al Salam For Printing, Publishing, Distribution & Translation
description: Dar Al Salam For Printing, Publishing, Distribution & Translation is a book publisher in Alexandria.
address: 127 Alexander the Great St, El Shatby, beside the Young Muslims Association, Alexandria

name: Gomla Market - San Stefano
description: Gomla Market in San Stefano is a large, handy supermarket with reasonable prices and a wide range of food, household goods, fresh bread, and more, well-liked for its own-brand products. Some international brands are missing and staff service is inconsistent, but it's a convenient one-stop shop, quieter late at night.
address: San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452054

name: Alexandria International Exhibition
description: The Alexandria International Fair is a large venue suitable for exhibitions, conferences, and weddings at affordable prices, with two football fields rented by sports academies. It's a versatile, all-purpose event and sports space.
address: 6XWX+VC5, Toril sq, As Soyouf Qebli (Include Izbat Derbanah), Third Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5515364

name: El Sherif Markets - Alexandria
description: Aswaq El Sherif is a clean, well-lit, well-stocked local supermarket with polite, helpful staff, good prices, and a range beyond groceries including shoes, toys, and accessories. Ventilation can be weak in summer affecting some fresh goods, but it's one of the better neighborhood shops.
address: Gamal Abd El-Nasir Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526015

name: Amin Stationery
description: Amin is a well-known, well-located stationery store beside San Stefano mall, praised as a haven for stationery lovers with a beautiful, comprehensive collection of school and art supplies. Customer service can be inconsistent, but the selection keeps shoppers coming back, with the Smouha branch recommended.
address: 160 Abd El-Salam Aref, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452052

name: Kamal Saad - El Sahafa Branch
description: Kamal Saad (Sahafa branch) is part of the renowned chain offering a wide variety of stationery, fine arts and engineering supplies, pens, and many types of paper and cardboard at competitive wholesale and retail prices. Service can be inconsistent and prices have risen, but the selection and value are strong.
address: 8 Al Nagda, Al Mansheyah Al Kubra, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361021

name: Kamal Saad (KMS)
description: Kamal Saad (KMS) is a favorite Alexandria stationery store, with this branch the most organized of the three, offering a huge variety of products and brands at reasonable, near-wholesale prices, plus extras like toys and accessories. It gets very crowded and service can be uneven, but the selection and value are excellent.
address: aya tower el gesh roud, Mohammed Naguib, Alexandria Governorate

name: Maria Café & Restaurant
description: Maria is a cozy, simple Italian restaurant praised for delicious, authentic food made with genuine Italian ingredients by a foreign chef who often greets diners and accommodates preferences. With clean, charming decor, welcoming staff, and consistently excellent quality, it's a top pick for a date or special meal.
address: 11 sero stetries Raml station, Alexandria Governorate

name: Holybelly official Raml Station
description: Holybelly in Raml Station is a modern spot with a fantastic rooftop sea view, friendly English-speaking staff, and a generally good food and atmosphere that's become a favorite for some since 2023. Quality is inconsistent, with complaints about missing menu items and a couple of reports of feeling unwell afterward, so order fresh items.
address: Immortals Mall, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21563

name: Bahig (King of the Amazing Phosphorus)
description: Bahig is a popular grab-and-go seafood spot selling fresh seafood with rice or fries, with long queues signaling its reputation. There's no seating, waits can be long, and several reviewers warn about inconsistent quality and tourist overcharging, so confirm prices clearly before ordering.
address: 9 Saad Zaghloul Square, Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372045

name: Pidza Egypt
description: Pidza Egypt serves authentic Detroit-style pizza that fans rate very highly. Experiences are inconsistent, however, with complaints about uncomfortable seating, undercooked or burnt dough, order mix-ups, and service, so quality varies by visit.
address: Raml Station, 17 Saad Zaghloul Square, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Trianon
description: Trianon is a historic downtown Alexandria institution with stunning baroque decor, beautiful art, warm lighting, and a piano playing in the background that transports you to the city's golden era. Friendly, welcoming staff and a timeless, elegant atmosphere make it a memorable spot for coffee, dessert, or a meal.
address: 52 Saad Zagloul Square, Omar Lotfy, Bab Shar'

name: Kansas Fried Chicken
description: Kansas Fried Chicken is an enjoyable, family-friendly spot with an absolutely beautiful sea view, a cozy atmosphere, and excellent, fresh food. Reviewers consistently describe a pleasant dining experience worth returning for.
address: Immortals Mall, Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: El Wahsh Kababgy
description: Kababgy El Wahsh is a traditional local grill spot serving some of the best grilled and barbecue meat, with well-liked dishes like chicken and rice, friendly staff, and upstairs seating. It's no-frills with no AC and quality and service can be inconsistent, but the grills win fans when done right.
address: raml station, streat, Alexandria Governorate

name: Taverna
description: Taverna is a cozy, rustic downtown spot beloved for some of the best feteer in Alexandria, plus pizza, pies, and mixed grill, with good service from a friendly manager. Service can be inconsistent and parking is tricky, but the feteer and atmosphere draw repeat visits.
address: 1 Saad Zaghloul, Al Mesallah Sharq, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5372045

name: Athineos
description: Athineos is a historic seaside restaurant on the Corniche serving set seafood lunches, kofta, grape leaves, and hard-to-find beer in a classic setting. Food quality is inconsistent, with some finding dishes dried out or microwaved, and it caters heavily to tourist groups, so experiences vary.
address: 21 Saad Zaghloul Square, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5413323

name: Murano Restaurant & Cafe
description: Murano is a cafe and restaurant set partly over the sea like a bridge, with a spectacular view best enjoyed before sunset, delicious food, and polite reception staff. Table-reservation handling and waiter service draw complaints, so experiences vary, but the seaside setting and photo opportunities are a big draw.
address: 259 El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452003

name: Archangel Raphael Church and the martyr Mina Bgheit grapes Coptic Orthodox Patriarchate in Alexandria
description: This Coptic Orthodox church dedicated to Archangel Raphael and the martyr Mina is a peaceful, sacred place of worship. Visitors describe a deeply spiritual, awe-filled atmosphere ideal for prayer and reflection.
address: 5WG3+W68, Al Ashgar, Ghait Al Enab Sharq, Karmouz, Alexandria Governorate 5340172

name: St George & St Anthony Coptic Orthodox Church
description: St George & St Anthony, also known as the Church of the Refuge, is one of the oldest Coptic Orthodox churches in Muharram Bey, with a wonderful religious library, excellent services, and experienced, dedicated priests. It's a large, well-located, spiritually calming place for prayer, often crowded.
address: 5WR7+GM6, Al Manzalawi, Emberouz WA Moharram Beik, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5413359

name: Church of the Great Martyr Saint Mina
description: The Church of the Great Martyr Saint Mina is a peaceful, spiritual Orthodox church with many activities and a shrine holding the relics of some saints. Visitors describe it as a calm, uplifting place for prayer.
address: 6XP5+7W9, Dr Al Sabongi, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451006

name: Church of the Archangel Michael Coptic Orthodox Patriarchate sieve in Alexandria
description: This Coptic Orthodox Church of the Archangel Michael in western Alexandria's Gharbal area is an ancient church, built decades ago, with recently added icons that make attending Mass feel special. Visitors describe a beautiful, spiritual, and quiet atmosphere for worship.
address: 5WM5+GHC, Al Nefous, Al Bab Al Gadid Sharqi, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5413020

name: St Mina El Mandarah Coptic Orthodox Church
description: St Mina El Mandarah is a remarkable Coptic Orthodox church offering a serene, spiritually uplifting atmosphere amid the busy city, with beautiful architecture and efficiently run Sunday liturgies. Visitors describe a peaceful, deeply moving worship experience.
address: 1 Mohammed Zaytoon, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526058

name: Saint George and St. Bakhomios Coptic Orthodox Church, Asafra, Alexandria,
description: St George and St Bakhomios in Asafra is a beautiful, spiritual Coptic Orthodox church, still partly under construction, with wonderful priests who care attentively for everyone, including newcomers. Visitors describe it as one of the most beautiful, welcoming churches in the area.
address: El Tahrir St, El Asafra Qibli, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5524135

name: Blessed Virgin Mary Church and St. Simeon Kharraz Babuyousef Coptic Orthodox Patriarchate in Alexandria
description: This Coptic Orthodox church dedicated to the Blessed Virgin Mary and St. Simeon the Tanner sits downtown near a beach, with excellent service and dedicated priesthood. Visitors describe it as a beautiful, spiritual place of worship, though some nearby residents note the long hours of hymns.
address: Alexandria-Cairo Rd, Al Dheraa Al Bahari, Amreya, Alexandria Governorate 5252861

name: Church of the Great Martyr George Bbacos Coptic Orthodox Patriarchate in Alexandria
description: The Coptic Orthodox Church of St George in Bakos sits in a lively, crowded market district full of shops and fresh produce, with loving, peaceful priests and on-site services including a clinic. Visitors describe an authentic, welcoming spiritual atmosphere amid the bustle of one of Alexandria's famous markets.
address: 6XPC+2JX, Al Moukli, Al Mahrousah, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5450311

name: St Mary Coptic Orthodox Church, Moharam Bek
description: St Mary in Moharam Bek is one of Alexandria's oldest Coptic Orthodox churches, a charming historic place where the beloved Abouna Bishoy Kamel began his service. Visitors describe a comfortable, relaxing, deeply spiritual atmosphere that many hold dear from childhood.
address: 5WR4+GXW, Al Bab Al Gadid WA Mansha, Qesm Moharram Beik, Alexandria Governorate 5413113

name: DemianaCh - Saint Demiana Coptic Orthodox Church, El-Wardeyan, Alexandria, Egypt
description: St Demiana in El-Wardeyan, with construction dating to 1949, is considered the largest church in Wardian, standing beside the large Saad El Din Mosque. Visitors describe a great, spiritual place with kind, welcoming people.
address: Aref Bek, Al Wardiyan Qebli, Port al-Basal, Alexandria Governorate 5333031

name: Saints Church Anba Samuel recognized and Anba Abram Bgheit grapes Coptic Orthodox Patriarchate in Alexandria
description: This Coptic Orthodox church dedicated to Saints Samuel and Abram is a small but beloved place of Christian worship in Alexandria. Visitors feel a strong attachment and describe it as a beautiful spot for prayer.
address: 5WJ4+3WC, Al Haroni, Ghait Al Enab Sharq, Karmouz, Alexandria Governorate 5340163

name: The Church of the Virgin Mary for Coptic Catholics
description: The Church of the Virgin Mary for Coptic Catholics is a catholic church in Alexandria.
address: 53 Al Haroni, Ghait Al Enab Sharq, Karmouz, Alexandria Governorate 5340158

name: Virgin Mary and Saint Wanas Coptic Orthodox Church - Dekheila
description: This Coptic Orthodox church of the Virgin Mary and Saint Wans in Dekheila is a peaceful, beautiful place of worship, recently renovated from the old church. Visitors praise the serene atmosphere and the dedicated Father Apollo.
address: 4RJ9+2VV, Al Giesh, Ad Dakhilah, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5312614

name: Monastery of Saint Mina
description: The Monastery of Saint Mina is a holy, peaceful site about an hour from Alexandria, with a beautiful cathedral full of biblical paintings and ties to Pope Kyrillos VI. There are no restaurants nearby (just simple shops), so bring food and drinks, but the history, generous monks, and serene setting make it a meaningful visit for Christians.
address: 9 Mar-Mina Rd, Qetaa Maryout, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 21934

name: St. Takla Church
description: St Takla is one of Alexandria's older churches, built in 1971 and since expanded, set centrally between two hospitals with care for children and an organized, calm atmosphere. It's a pleasant, welcoming place for worship and celebrations like engagements.
address: 35 Mohammed Fouad Galal, Al Ibrahimeyah Qebli WA Al Hadrah Bahri, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423060

name: St. Marcurios Coptic Orthodox monastery for Nuns
description: St Marcurios is a Coptic Orthodox convent that's a holy, beautifully kept place of worship maintained by its nuns, where you can buy monastery products like juices, figs, mangoes, and herbs. It isn't always open, so check before making the drive, but visitors describe it as heaven on earth.
address: XHMP+4QJ, Alexandria - Marsa Matrouh Rd, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 5217521

name: Saints Maximus, Dometius and Anba Musa Church
description: This Coptic Orthodox church dedicated to Saints Maximus, Dometius, and Anba Musa has two churches and holds Mass twice weekly, on Fridays and Sundays, with kind, friendly congregants. It's a beautiful, cozy place for prayer and ceremonies like weddings, with strict but reassuring security.
address: 45 Omaraa St, Al Mandarah Qebli, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5516473

name: Church of the Great Martyr George and St. Shenouda Coptic Orthodox Patriarchate of cobblestone in Alexandria
description: Church of the Great Martyr George and St. Shenouda Coptic Orthodox Patriarchate of cobblestone in Alexandria is an orthodox church in Alexandria.
address: El Tabia - Rashid Line, At Tarh, Kafr El Dawwar, Beheira Governorate 5922372

name: Virgin Mary and Saint George Church - Ghobrial
description: This Coptic Orthodox church of the Virgin Mary and St George is a place of worship for Orthodox Christians on Al-Tur'ah Street in Abu Suleiman. It serves as a neighborhood place of prayer with a convenient location.
address: 6XPH+Q52, Dana Al Gadidah WA Izbat Al Westaneyah, Qesm AR Ramel, Alexandria Governorate 5448341

name: L Bay
description: L Bay is a seaside food court near the castle that's a popular tourist destination, with plenty of cafes and restaurants where you can relax over tea, coffee, shisha, and food with a sea view. Prices run a bit high and it can be understaffed, making service slow, but the historic setting and variety of choices are draws.
address: Kayetbai, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321430

name: Abo Qear Old
description: Abo Qear Old is a mosque in Alexandria.
address: 83C8+J48, Abu Qir Ash Sharqeyah, Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5528381

name: El-Moez Mosque
description: El-Moez Mosque is a mosque in Alexandria.
address: 62HG+M8M, El-Moez Mosque, Al Qerdahi, Third Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5512230

name: Sidi Jaber Mosque
description: Sidi Jaber Mosque is a mosque in Alexandria.
address: 6WFR+H4J, Abd Allah El-Ansary, Sidi Gabir, Qesm Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434031

name: Mosque Alexandria Petroleum
description: The Alexandria Petroleum mosque is a place of worship with good facilities and a parking area. It offers reasonable cleanliness and a calm spot for prayer.
address: 4RWQ+FF9, Al Meks, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5312782

name: Mosque of Prophet Daniel and Sidi Luqman el-Hakim
description: The Mosque of Prophet Daniel is a beautiful, historic mosque in central Alexandria with Sufi associations, said to hold the tombs of figures like Sidi Luqman el-Hakim. It's a revered landmark and a calm place for prayer and reflection.
address: 25 Khalf No.25, Kom Ad Dakah Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371040

name: Imam El Busiri Mosque
description: The Imam al-Busiri Mosque sits on the Anfoushi seafront in Mosque Square, opposite the Sidi al-Mursi Abu al-Abbas mosque, and contains the shrine of al-Busiri, the celebrated Sufi poet of the Burda. It's a historically significant seafront mosque and a focal point for visitors to the Anfoushi mosque complex.
address: Abu El Abbas El Morsi Mosque area, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate

name: Sahib El Burda - Imam El Busiri Shrine
description: The Sahib al-Burda Mosque is a historically significant Alexandria mosque and shrine honoring Imam al-Busiri, author of the famous Qasida Burda, set within the complex alongside the Abu al-Abbas and Yaqut al-Arsh mosques. It's one of the city's most important Islamic and Sufi heritage sites.
address: 6V4M+764, El-Sayed Mohammed Karim, Al Mazar, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321370

name: El Shohadaa Mosque
description: El Shohadaa is a spacious, clean, beautiful, and well-maintained mosque with a women's prayer area, where prayers are performed with devotion. Visitors especially praise the Ramadan Taraweeh prayers led by an imam who recites from memory.
address: 38 Al Akbal St, Louran, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517007

name: Sidi Mohamed Elshatby
description: This mosque in the historic heart of Alexandria holds the resting place of Sidi Muhammad al-Shatibi, a towering figure of Islamic scholarship and spirituality. Visitors appreciate praying in its open-air setting and the sense of connection to a great scholar.
address: 6W67+9MH, Dr Kamel Moursy, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424041

name: Presidency Mosque
