description: The Presidency Mosque is a serene, clean, and nicely decorated mosque with an air-conditioned men's prayer area and external extensions that accommodate large Friday crowds. It's currently under construction and some note the women's area lacks AC and Fajr prayer handling has been inconsistent, but it remains a pleasant place to pray with family.
address: 72P9+W5F, Malak Hefni, Al Mandarah Bahri, Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Ibn Khaldoon
description: The Ibn Khaldun Mosque, built during the Sadat era, is a large, beautiful landmark of Islamic heritage at the end of Al-Nasr Street, in front of Gate 10 of the Alexandria port. It's a notable neighborhood landmark and a striking sight.
address: 5VWM+7W9, Al Balqatreyah, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321111

name: Mosaaeb Ibn Omayr Mosque
description: Mosaaeb Ibn Omayr is a comfortable neighborhood mosque with a women's prayer room, serving the people of the area. It's a clean, welcoming place for daily prayer.
address: 6XJ4+6H3, Fleming, Qesm AR Ramel, Alexandria Governorate 5450110

name: Shaarawy Mosque
description: Shaarawy is a famous, beloved mosque in Loran (which lends its name to the street), busy with daily and Friday prayers. Visitors especially praise the Eid prayer experience, with festive touches like balloons and candy for children.
address: Shaarawy St, Louran, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451110

name: Abi El Dardaa
description: The Shrine of Abi al-Dardaa is one of Alexandria's best-known local shrines, a small landmark in the Karmouz neighborhood said to honor a companion of the Prophet, with the yellow tram tracks famously curving around it. The building is small, admitting small groups at a time, but it's a notable historic and spiritual stop.
address: 21 Abi El Darda St, Haret El Farahda, El Labban, Alexandria Governorate 5351041

name: El Mandara El Bahareya Mosque

name: Patriarch Catholicos Roman Church
description:
The highest-ranking bishops in Eastern Orthodoxy, Oriental Orthodoxy, the Roman Catholic Church (above major archbishop and primate), the Hussite Church, Church of the East and some Independent Catholic Churches are termed patriarchs (and in certain cases also popes – such as the pope of Rome or pope of Alexandria).
The word is derived from Greek πατριάρχης (patriarchēs), meaning "chief or father of a family", a compound of πατριά (patria), meaning "family", and ἄρχειν (archein), meaning "to rule".
Originally, a patriarch was a man who exercised authority as a pater familias over an extended family. The system of such rule of families by senior males is termed "patriarchy". Historically, a patriarch has often been the logical choice to act as ethnarch of the community identified with his religious confession within a state or empire of a different creed (such as Christians within the Ottoman Empire). The term developed an ecclesiastical meaning within Christianity. The office and the ecclesiastical circumscription of a Christian patriarch is termed a patriarchate.
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob are referred to as the three patriarchs of the people of Israel, and the period during which they lived is termed the Patriarchal Age. The word patriarch originally acquired its religious meaning in the Septuagint version of the Bible.

description: Alexandria Theater is a lovely classic theater from the city's golden age, evoking legends like Umm Kulthum, Sayed Darwish, and Abdel Halim Hafez. It's one of Alexandria's interesting historic venues, though it can get very hot when the AC isn't running and current programming is limited.
address: 9 Salah Mostafa St (Istanbul St extension, off El Sultan Hussein St), Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Horreya Center For Creation In Alexandria
description: The Freedom Center for Creativity (El Horreya) is a Ministry of Culture cultural center housed in a powerful, beautiful piece of classic architecture, hosting theater and arts events. The building and performances impress, though some find the exhibition halls poorly ventilated and in need of upkeep.
address: 1 El-Horeya Rd, Al Attarin Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371032

name: Bairam El Tounsey Theater
description: Bairam El Tounsey Theater is a classic, spacious performing-arts venue in El Shatby, about a five-minute walk from the Bibliotheca Alexandrina on the Corniche, calm and pleasant for watching shows. It needs renovation and has no dedicated parking, but it remains a nice spot for an evening of theater.
address: El Geish Rd, the Corniche, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate

name: Lighthouse
description:
The Lighthouse of Alexandria, sometimes called the Pharos of Alexandria, was a lighthouse built by the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Ancient Egypt, during the reign of Ptolemy II Philadelphus (280–247 BC). It has been estimated to have been at least 100 metres (330 ft) in overall height. One of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, for many centuries it was one of the world's tallest man-made structures.
The lighthouse was severely damaged by three earthquakes between AD 956 and 1303 and became an abandoned ruin. It was the third longest-surviving ancient wonder, after the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus and the extant Great Pyramid of Giza, surviving in part until 1480, when the last of its stones were used to build the Citadel of Qaitbay on the site.
In 1994, a team of French archaeologists dived in the water of Alexandria's Eastern Harbour and discovered some remains of the lighthouse on the sea floor. In 2016, the Ministry of State of Antiquities in Egypt had plans to turn submerged ruins of ancient Alexandria, including those of the Pharos, into an underwater museum.
address: 5R4W+RXG, Max Al Shalehat Next to Al Fanar, Al Meks, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate

name: Deeb mall cinema
description: Deeb Mall Cinema is a quiet, cozy, affordable movie theater that's rarely crowded, with friendly staff, hot popcorn, and a peaceful experience that's especially good for families. There's little to do beyond the film and some find it dated, but the calm atmosphere and low prices win fans.
address: 1 Syria St, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21311

name: Egypt Station Garden
description: Egypt Station Garden is a surprisingly peaceful, clean green space in the heart of the city by the main railway station, with trees and colorful flowers and a fine elevated view of the square. It's a refreshing escape for a short break or family stroll, though access can be restricted at times.
address: 5WV3+4F3, Al Marghani, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5370050

name: Jewel sculpture
description: The Jewel sculpture is a creative public art piece and popular photo zone tied to Egypt's revolution era. It's a fun, photogenic spot for pictures and memories along the street.
address: 6W23+WFM, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372066

name: White Sails Statue
description: The White Sails (Sails in Motion) statue stands in Silsila Square in front of the Library of Alexandria, created by sculptor Fathy Mahmoud and gifted to the city in 1968. The graceful white form expresses the sea and fishing culture deeply rooted in Alexandria.
address: El Shatby, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq

name: Qaitbay Square
description: Qaitbay Square surrounds the impressive 15th-century citadel, offering breathtaking Mediterranean views, sea breezes, ice cream, and a sound-and-light show. The well-kept fortress and lovely waterfront make it one of the highlights of any Alexandria visit.
address: 6V6J+GXC, Kayetbai, Ras at Tin, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321421

name: Planetarium Science Center (PSC)
description: The Planetarium Science Center, beside the Bibliotheca Alexandrina, offers immersive dome shows that several visitors find genuinely engaging, like an IMAX for science and history. Long ticket waits, crowding, and shows mainly in Arabic frustrate some, so confirm showtimes and language in advance.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424011

name: Sidi Bishr Pier
description: Lesan Sidi Bishr is a beautiful, popular spot jutting into the sea, beloved for simply sitting by the water and taking in the view. It's a wonderful, relaxing place named after the sheikh Bishr al-Jawhari.
address: Louran Food Court, El Mahrousa, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Anfoushy Bahary
description: Anfoushi Bahary is a classic Alexandria seaside district with sandy beaches and Mediterranean views, a wonderful place to spend a holiday. The sea is its biggest draw, pleasant at any time of year.
address: Bahary, El Seyala Sharq, 5321380

name: El Mahrousa Beach
description: Mahrousa Beach is a pleasant seaside spot with lovely air and water, and chalets that make for one of the better places to stay in the area, with excellent, fast service and a wonderful breakfast. It's a distinguished, relaxing destination by the sea.
address: 7X3C+JV, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate

name: Alexandria Corniche
description: The Corniche is a waterfront promenade running along Alexandria's Eastern Harbour and one of the city's main traffic corridors. Designed by the Italian-Egyptian architect Pietro Avoscani in 1870, its construction began in 1925 and it officially opened in 1935. The road stretches for over ten miles, from the Bahri area near the Citadel of Qaitbay in the west to the Mandara area in the Montaza district in the east, and remains a beloved spot for seaside strolls.
address: Al Kornish, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424090

name: Kom El-Nadura
description: Kom El-Nadura is an archaeological site with an old ship-signal lighthouse and Roman tombs, on a hill with views over the area. It's largely neglected and usually closed, viewable mainly from outside, with locals hoping it will one day open properly to visitors.
address: 5VVQ+947, Bahary Pik, Meshmesh Al Basal, Al Labban, Alexandria Governorate 5350021

name: Floral Clock (Saet El Zohour)
description: Saet El Zohour (the Flower Clock) is a historic square at the entrance to Fouad Street, beside the Shallalat Park and near Sultan Hussein Street, serving as a picnic spot and junction to many central Alexandria districts. It was once a distinctive landmark and, despite periods of neglect, has been part of recent square-beautification efforts.
address: 6W27+FR3, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5422004

name: Prophet Daniel Mosque
description: The Nabi Daniel Mosque is a historic mosque said to hold the tombs of Prophet Daniel and Luqman al-Hakim, with the shrine in a small room reached by a spiral wooden staircase, and facilities for ablution. Named after the scholar Muhammad Daniyal al-Mawsili, it's a revered historic site open around prayer times.
address: 21 Al Naby Danyal, Kom Ad Dakah Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371040

name: Stanley Beach
description: Stanley Beach sits beneath Alexandria's oldest sea bridge, a small but pleasant beach with a modest entry fee, chairs, and a great photo opportunity, where friendly locals add to the charm. Cleanliness and bathrooms can be hit or miss and it gets very crowded in Ramadan, but the iconic setting makes it a memorable stop.
address: 262 Moustafa Lotfy Al Manfalooti, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452003

name: Eliahu Hanavi Synagogue
description: The Eliahu Hanavi Synagogue is a beautifully restored historic synagogue and a moving testament to Alexandria's once-thriving Jewish community. Entry is free but visitors are typically asked for a donation and a tip for the guards, and hours can be unreliable, so it's wise to confirm before going.
address: Al Naby Danyal, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372030

name: Statue of Alexander the Great
description: This statue of Alexander the Great is a simple monument with great historical significance, honoring the Macedonian king who founded the city. It's close to the National Museum of Alexandria and the nearby excavation site, making it an easy stop on a history-focused visit.
address: 6W28+P9Q, El Noueiri Rd, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423020

name: Park
description: The Shallalat Gardens are among Alexandria's most beautiful green spaces, considered the city's green lung, with rare trees and plants and a section of the ancient city walls. It's a calm, safe, isolated garden with lovely shade, ideal for a quiet walk.
address: 28 Cairo - Alexandria Desert Rd, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5422004

name: Zananiri market
description: Zananiri Market is a traditional Egyptian street market with a wide variety of sellers offering some of the best prices for fresh fruit, vegetables, meat, and fish, including live animals. It's authentic and lively but lacks upkeep and can be dirty and smelly, so it's best for an immersive local shopping experience.
address: 7 El-Gammal, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433033

name: Fish Market - Halaket Al Asmaak
description: The Fish Market (Halaket Al Asmaak) offers fresh fish at competitive prices thanks to many sellers, with the handy option to have your selection cooked on site. It can be dirty and smelly, and not all sellers are honest, so you'll need to bargain hard and know your fish, ideally going with an expert.
address: 10 Kayet Bai, Ras at Tin, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321420

name: Zanaet El Setat Bedding
description: Zanaet El Setat is a historic, hugely popular bazaar packed with sewing supplies, beads, fine fabrics for party and wedding dresses, accessories, and handicrafts at reasonable, budget-friendly prices. It's a maze that's easy to get lost in and gets very crowded, but it's a treasure trove for crafters and bargain hunters.
address: Souq El Tork, Mansheya District, Alexandria Governorate 5360020

name: fish Market
description: This fish market is the right place for fresh fish at a nice seaside village location about 20 minutes from the center, with a restaurant nearby. You'll need to bargain and know your fish types and prices to avoid being overcharged, and some find better quality elsewhere.
address: 5R2R+CPP, Al Meks, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5312784

name: Alexandriai és Afrikai Görög Ortodox Patriarchátus
description: The Greek Orthodox Patriarchate of Alexandria and All Africa is the residence of the Patriarch and the historic cradle of Orthodoxy for the entire continent, beautifully restored through donations. Visitors describe a wonderfully peaceful, spiritually significant sanctuary open to all.
address: 106 Al Yonan Church, Al Attarin Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372001

name: Saint George Coptic Orthodox Church, Sporting
description: St George in Sporting is one of Alexandria's most spiritually alive Coptic Orthodox churches, beautiful and peaceful, with kind, supportive people who share the history of the church and of Father Bishoy Kamel. Visitors from around the world describe it as a deeply blessed, welcoming spiritual home.
address: 126 Omar Lotfy St, Al Ibrahimeya Bahari & Sidi Gaber, Bab Sharq, 21524

name: St. Mark's Cathedral in Alexandria
description: St Mark's Cathedral, with roots said to date to 61 AD, is regarded as one of the oldest churches in Africa and the seat of the Coptic Orthodox tradition founded by St Mark. The architecture is relatively simple in the Coptic style, but its profound history makes it a worthwhile and meaningful visit.
address: 19 Al Akbat Church St, Raml Station, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372014

name: Church of the Great Martyr George Shatby
description: The Church of St George in Shatby is a beautiful five-story Coptic Orthodox cathedral at the entrance of Alexandria on Suez Canal Street, near the tram station and the Bibliotheca. It's a peaceful, blessed place that visitors feel fortunate to experience.
address: 6W47+HQC, Cairo - Alexandria Desert Rd, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423020

name: St.Mary & St.Joseph Coptic church - Semoha
description: St Mary & St Joseph in Smouha is a beautiful, blessed Coptic Orthodox church complex with many priests plus a hospital, nursery, elderly home, rooftop garden cafe, and theater, friendly and helpful to congregants. Note that strict security can make access difficult for non-Arabic-speaking visitors, so it's primarily oriented to the local community.
address: 6W7Q+HGR, Mostafa Kamel, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432022

name: The Great Saint Abram Church - The Patriarchate of the Coptic Orthodox in Alexandria
description: The Great Saint Abram Church is a beloved Coptic Orthodox church that feels like a second home to many lifelong congregants. Visitors describe a calm, peaceful atmosphere ideal for prayer and reflection.
address: 3 Zain El-Abedeen, Emberouz WA Moharram Beik, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5413420

name: Escape room Alexandria
description: Escape Room Alexandria offers exciting, spacious horror and adventure games with creative jump scares and generally good service and facilities. Reaching them to book can be difficult and there have been recent complaints about declining standards, so it's worth confirming your reservation, but many still find it a thrilling outing.
address: 696 Abu Qir St, Louran, in front of American Furniture, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate

name: Action Zone Paintball &Outdoor Fun Activities
description: Action Zone Paintball is a standout outdoor activity spot, possibly the only one of its kind in Alexandria, with friendly, helpful staff who run great experiences for families, groups, and kids' birthdays. It runs a bit expensive, but the fun and the attentive crew make it one visitors happily repeat.
address: St 107, behind Bruxie's between Carrefour and Wahet Khatab, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Mamurah Beach
description: El Mamurah Beach is a beloved gated-compound beach with clean sand, a calm sea, and a relaxing atmosphere that's more private and sheltered than the city's other beaches. It's pricier and service staff can pester you for extra money, and the public section is more crowded, but the private area remains a favorite for many.
address: 72RJ+87F, Street 17, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Elefun
description: Elefun is a very clean, secure indoor playground with CCTV throughout, friendly, organized staff, a kids' menu, and a cozy downstairs cafe where parents can watch their children on big screens. It's a well-equipped, fun spot for kids, though a few longtime visitors feel standards have slipped recently.
address: Vodafone store, 7th Albert El Awwal, street, Beside, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Happy Land
description: Happy Land is a clean, reasonably priced theme park with a beautiful, varied range of rides suitable for both children and adults, run by a professional team. With midweek ticket offers, it's a genuinely enjoyable, well-managed place for a family outing.
address: 36 Abu El Dahab St, El Mansheya El Kubra, Mansheya District, El Sobheya & Ezbet Sherkas & Ezbet Raafat, Moharram Bek, Alexandria Governorate

name: Cornish Sporting
description: Cornish Sporting is a tourist attraction in Alexandria.
address: 36 Malwa, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424083

name: Kids Station
description: Kids Station in Smouha is a clean, spacious, well-organized indoor play area for children roughly ages 2 to 12, with a great variety of safe, learning-focused activities and friendly, attentive staff. Reasonably priced and open even during Ramadan, it's an excellent spot for family fun.
address: Matajer Mall, Mohammed Fawzi Moaz, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432015

name: Maamoura Water Sports
description: Maamourah Water Sports offers jet skis, banana boats, and other water activities on a clean, beautiful beach. Service is highly inconsistent, with multiple complaints about long waits and jet skis handed over with near-empty tanks, so confirm everything (and the fuel) before paying.
address: El Maamoura Corniche, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Lane 9
description: Lane 9 in Borg El Arab is a fantastic, reasonably priced entertainment venue with bowling, an amazing arcade, mini golf, and more, making it one of the best fun spots in the area, especially with a group of friends. The on-site cantine draws complaints for pricey drinks and a no-refund policy, but the games deliver great value.
address: Orouba Mall, Road, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 21934

name: Leafunia - kids area - art and craft -kids workshops
description: Leafunia is a lovely kids' area offering art and craft, cooking, and language classes plus seasonal events, run by friendly, professional staff that children adore. It's not very big, but the variety of creative activities and the warm, cooperative team make it a favorite for families.
address: 6 El-Nahda, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21529

name: Kido Town
description: Kido Town is a clean, nicely decorated children's amusement center with a wide variety of games and rooms (including a PlayStation room for older kids), welcoming staff, and food available. It's entertaining for a broad age range, though some parents note the unhealthy snacks placed near the play areas.
address: 336 El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 21914

name: Yacht Club of Egypt
description: The Yacht Club of Egypt is a homey, family-oriented members' club with a gym, restaurant, multiple cafes, a fishing spot, and a small swimming area, with a lovely sea breeze and good service. Entry requires being a member or a member's guest, and the beach is quite narrow, but the warm atmosphere makes it a pleasant place to relax.
address: Qaitbay St, El Anfoushi, Al Gomrok

name: Jungle zoo Alexandria
description: Jungle Zoo is a small park with simple, enjoyable activities and pleasant grounds. Reviews are mixed, however, with concerns about the condition and care of the animals, so manage expectations.
address: 3 Albert Al Awal, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432034

name: Dinoo kids area
description: Dinoo is a beautiful, clean kids' area with friendly, attentive staff who are great with children and good appetizers on offer. Families consistently describe a wonderful time, making it a highly recommended spot for a day out with the kids.
address: 11 Al Akbal St, in front of Victoria College gate, Louran, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: Alexandria Stadium
description: Alexandria Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in the Moharram Bek district of Alexandria. Opened in 1929 by King Fuad I, it is the oldest stadium in Egypt and Africa. Following renovations in 2016 and 2017, it holds around 13,660 spectators and is home to the Al-Ittihad football club. It has hosted major international tournaments, including matches of the African Cup of Nations.
address: 5WW7+WPV, Grinfel, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5422001

name: GP Sports Complex
description: GP Sports Complex is a large facility with football, tennis, swimming, and one of Alexandria's better kids' sports academies, where children can train and compete while parents relax with food and drink. Reviews are sharply divided, however, with serious recent complaints about cleanliness, staff conduct, and the lack of an online booking system, so experiences vary.
address: Green Plaza, Ezbet El Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21511

name: Viva Padel Egypt
description: Viva Padel is a beautiful, comfortable padel facility, notable as the first solo court in Alexandria, with very good quality courts. Being new and well-built, it's a nice spot for a game.
address: below Abis Bridge, Alexandria Agriculture Rd, Alexandria Governorate

name: Alexandria Sporting Club
description: Alexandria Sporting Club, commonly known as Sporting, is one of Egypt's oldest sports and social clubs, founded in Alexandria in 1890. Spread across roughly 100 acres in the heart of the city, it fields competitive teams in a wide range of sports and has even produced world champions in squash. Its basketball teams are among the most decorated in the country, and in 2022 its women's team became the first Egyptian club to win the FIBA Africa Women's Clubs Champions Cup.
address: Abu Qir St, El Reyada, Sidi Gaber District, Alexandria Governorate

name: Taverna Magic town
description: Taverna Magic Town is a small indoor playground near Gleem Bay using a top-up card system, with a 30% discount for the Engineers Syndicate. Reviews skew negative, with frequent complaints about very high prices, short game times, cleanliness, and limited staff engagement, so set expectations.
address: 6XV4+9XX, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Void Gaming Lounge
description: Void Gaming Lounge is a top-rated, cozy gaming spot with high-end, fast, clean PCs, consumer-friendly pricing, and super-friendly, knowledgeable staff, notably welcoming to female gamers. Regulars describe it as a second home that keeps improving, and the pizza is worth a try too.
address: 27 Dr Abd El-Hameed Sayed St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424002

name: Jesuit Cultural Center
description: The Jesuit Cultural Center is a warm, welcoming venue that brings together many art forms, hosting concerts, performances, and community events like iftars for special-needs groups. It's a special place for young and experienced artists alike, with organized, dedicated staff.
address: 298 Port Said St, Cleopatra, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434020

name: Russian Cultural Center
description: The Russian Cultural Center occupies a beautifully renovated old palace on Al-Batalsa Street, with wood-paneled interiors, a colored-glass wall, a garden, and an open-air theater. It offers a wide range of activities and classes, from languages to music, gymnastics, and dance, with friendly, professional teachers.
address: Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423002

name: El Salam Entertainment Center
description: El Salam Entertainment Center is a budget-friendly activity spot with bowling, PlayStation, table tennis, a gym, and a cafe, with friendly staff. Much of the equipment is old and the place lacks upgrades, air conditioning, and supervision, so manage expectations and keep an eye on kids.
address: Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434042

name: Padel Spot
description: Padel Spot is a good padel venue with an easy reservation process, a well-liked pitch, and consistently chill, friendly vibes. There can be a little sand on the court floor, so take care underfoot, but the courts and atmosphere make for an enjoyable game.
address: Alexandria, Alexandria Governorate

name: Salt Cave
description: Salt Cave is a spa that draws overwhelmingly negative reviews, with repeated complaints about broken equipment, poor-quality products, unclean rooms, long waits past appointment times, and underwhelming massages. Several reviewers strongly advise looking elsewhere.
address: 8 Maher Bek St off El Geish Rd, Louran, Abu Shakra, Alexandria Governorate 21352

name: Padel Park
description: Padel Park is a well-maintained padel venue with three clean courts, good-quality balls and rackets, easy reservations, friendly staff, and drinks on hand. It runs a little on the pricey side, but it offers a well-rounded, enjoyable experience for the sport.
address: 5XJ4+QWC, Abis, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5411510

name: The Arc Hub
description: The Arc Hub is a welcoming padel destination with three top courts, food and drink options, and a well-equipped kids' area, at great prices with well-maintained courts and racquets. A few note imperfect court flooring and tip-seeking caretakers, but most call it their reliable go-to for a fun game.
address: Ring Rd, in front of New Smouha, Ezbet Abu Malek, Khorshid El Qibleya, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5442040

name: WePadel Complex
description: WePadel is a nice padel complex with five courts, easy app-based reservations, parking, and a small cafe, making it a recommended spot for groups. Some reviewers dislike the extra charges for good rackets and balls and note only one (not very clean) shower, so come prepared.
address: Mahmoudia Axis, Zaarbana WA Al Hamam, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5446326

name: Reptile House (Beit El Zawahef)
description: The Reptile House (Beit El Zawahef) is a reptile exhibit in Alexandria where visitors can see snakes, lizards, and other reptiles up close. It is an educational attraction popular with families and curious visitors.
address: 6W4V+5C6, Canat Al Mahmoudeya, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432034

name: Four Seasons Hotel Alexandria at San Stefano, Egypt
description: The Four Seasons at San Stefano delivers a refined, luxurious experience, with attentive, professional staff, a standout beachfront buffet breakfast, and beautiful indoor and outdoor pools. A few guests feel the service occasionally falls short of the brand's five-star standard, but most describe an exceptional stay.
address: 399 El El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21599

name: Miramar Boutique hotel
description: Miramar is an elegant yet cozy boutique hotel with a charming city theme for each room, spotless housekeeping, and staff praised for going above and beyond, in a central location. Rooms run small with only side sea views and the entrance could use an upgrade, but the service and value win it many fans.
address: Al Boha, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424071

name: Tolip Hotel Alexandria
description: Tolip is a well-loved family destination hotel with a relaxing atmosphere, welcoming staff, beach access, and great views from higher floors. Sound insulation is a recurring weakness, with noise from the street and event halls disturbing some guests, so request a quieter, higher room.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434044

name: Amoun Hotel
description: Amoun is a budget hotel with beach access and a pool that's a reliable first choice for some repeat guests, with friendly, helpful staff. Reviews are sharply divided, however, with serious complaints about small, dated rooms, cleanliness, hot water, and noise insulation, so experiences vary widely.
address: 32 El-Nasr, Al Mansheyah Al Kubra, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361003

name: Qaoud Hotel
description: Kaoud Hotel sits right on the Corniche with a fantastic sea-front location and charming old-style ambiance, offering memorable panoramic water views. Several guests report rude staff, weak management, and rooms that have declined over the years, so set expectations around service.
address: 133 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434011

name: Plaza Hotel Alexandria
description: Plaza Hotel draws largely negative reviews despite its four-star billing, with frequent complaints about cleanliness, musty odors, uncomfortable beds, dated decor, and a cramped one-way-street location. Prices feel high for the quality, so manage expectations.
address: 394 El Gaish Ave, Zizinia - Alexandria - Egypt Ave

name: Hilton Alexandria Corniche
description: The Hilton Alexandria Corniche offers a great location, lovely views, a clean private beach with hourly shuttle service, and friendly, helpful reception staff. Experiences vary, with some guests reporting service lapses below five-star expectations, but many describe a clean, comfortable, well-run stay.
address: 544 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 21611

name: Romance Hotel Alexandria
description: Romance Hotel is a seafront hotel where all rooms enjoy lovely sea views, with an incredible, varied breakfast buffet, outstanding cleanliness, and a great location with a water park. Rooms aren't very spacious and could use updating, but comfortable beds and excellent staff make it a well-liked choice.
address: 303 El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452021

amenities: Casual Seafront Resort With A Water Park

name: Hyat Waterfalls Hotel
description: Hyat Waterfalls Hotel offers a perfect, central location, clean rooms, friendly staff, and reasonable prices. The big drawback is poor sound insulation, with street and traffic noise keeping some guests awake even on higher floors, and wifi could be better.
address: 65 El-Gaish Rd, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 99999

name: Hilton Alexandria Green Plaza
description: The Hilton Green Plaza is a convenient hotel with exceptional, helpful, polite staff and an enjoyable overall experience, well placed for the mall and Corniche. Some areas show the hotel's age and housekeeping can be slow at busy times, but most guests describe a very nice stay.
address: 14th of May Bridge Rd, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Jewel San Stefano Hotel
description: Jewel San Stefano has an excellent location with a direct sea view, close to Stanley Bridge, at reasonable prices for the area. Reviews are sharply mixed, with serious complaints about cleanliness, staff attitude, and inconsistent room pricing, so confirm your rate and room condition carefully.
address: El Geish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452054

name: Ithaka Mansheya Hostel Alexandria
description: Ithaka Mansheya Hostel has a wonderful central location overlooking the sea, with the kindest, most welcoming staff, cozy rooms, and good value. It's an old building that gets cold in winter and could use better heating, but comfortable beds and warm service make it a great budget choice.
address: 148 Al Ahram, Al Mansheyah Al Kubra, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361033

name: SUNRISE Alex Avenue Hotel
description: SUNRISE Alex Avenue earns rave reviews for its standout food experience across multiple restaurants, beautifully presented and full of flavor, plus a peaceful atmosphere and friendly, professional staff. It's a clean, comfortable property that exceeds expectations for both work and leisure stays.
address: Elkornesh road, Roushdy, Alexandria Governorate

name: Royal Jewel Al-Raml Hotel
description: Royal Jewel Al-Raml is praised for outstanding, friendly, professional reception staff and good service, with a rooftop pool and central location. Some guests report issues like limited hot water from small water heaters, so it's worth confirming amenities, but the warm service stands out.
address: Station, Alexandar Akbar St. - Al Kaed, Ibrahim Mosque, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 21563

amenities: Relaxed Lodging With A Rooftop Pool

name: Smouha Zahran Haus
description: Smouha Zahran Haus is a homestay with a calm, clean, comfortable room and a kind, accommodating host who lets guests store bags. Some travelers report booking and communication problems, including a double-booking, so confirm arrangements clearly, but many have a pleasant, friendly stay.
address: 35 El-Moustashar Mahmoud El-Attar, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432055

name: Cote Hotel
description: Hotel Cote is a very basic, budget property with a good location and respectable, friendly staff who make guests feel welcome. Rooms are simple, with limited amenities (some lacking AC or a fridge and no food service), so it's best for travelers who just need a place to sleep.
address: 12 Saad Zaghloul St, El Mesalla Gharb & Sherif Basha, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5372011

name: Palestine Montaza Hotel
description: Palestine Montaza Hotel boasts spectacular sea views from every room, a warm, welcoming atmosphere, attentive staff, and spacious, well-maintained rooms in the beautiful Montazah grounds. Sound insulation, smoking in hallways, and an aging fitness center draw some complaints, but the setting and views make it a memorable stay.
address: Montazah Park, El Saa Square, Al Mandarah Bahri, Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

amenities: Posh Business Hotel With A Scenic Pool
Upscale Hotel With A Private Beach

name: Serine Hostel
description: Serine Hostel is a very basic budget option with a captivating view, generally clean rooms, stable internet, and welcoming staff for some guests. Many warn it's essentially an old colonial-era house with shared bathrooms and a misleading description, so set expectations low and confirm room details.
address: 179 El-Salam, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434023

name: Hyde Park House Hotel
description: Hyde Park House occupies the top two floors of an older downtown building, with excellent, polite staff, clean rooms, a beautiful balcony view of Alexandria, and a great location near major attractions. The building and elevator show their age, but the friendly service and central location make it a recommended budget pick.
address: 21 Dr Abd Al Rafea Belal, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21517

name: Rixos Montaza Alexandria
description: Rixos Montaza is an upscale hotel in the beautiful Montaza area with a stunning location, outstanding cleanliness, excellent facilities, and exceptional, attentive service that guests praise warmly. It's consistently described as a relaxing, memorable beach stay.
address: El Montaza Palace Gardens, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Green Plaza INN Hotel
description: Green Plaza Inn is a cozy hotel with friendly, helpful staff and clean rooms with reliable AC, well suited for business stays near Green Plaza. Some guests report serious booking-platform mishaps that left them stranded at arrival, so it's wise to confirm your reservation directly with the hotel.
address: 5 Al Molhaq, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Abeer Hotel Alexandria
description: Abeer Hotel occupies a single floor of a building, with a central location and a few returning guests who praise the staff. However, the bulk of reviews report serious cleanliness problems, including insects, broken fixtures, and missing basics, so it's best approached with very low expectations.
address: 21 Hasan El Sheikh St (El Borsa El Qadima), above Nassar Cafe, El Mansheya, Alexandria Corniche, Alexandria Governorate

name: Ramsis Hotel
description: Ramsis Hotel occupies an old building with a wonderful Mediterranean sea view and warm, helpful staff, plus a good rooftop breakfast. The rooms and bathrooms are dilapidated and in need of intensive maintenance, and staff often angle for tips, so it's a stay best chosen for the view and price.
address: 236 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: New Hotel
description: New Hotel is a charming, vintage first-floor property a few steps from the Corniche, run as individual rented rooms, with a friendly, welcoming atmosphere and standout staff like Mahmoud. Stairs may challenge older guests and rooms vary, but the warm hospitality (and welcome hibiscus tea) makes it a cozy, sociable stay.
address: 5 Al Abiari, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373001

name: Ithaka Raml Hostel
description: Ithaka Raml Hostel earns consistently glowing reviews for its great location, clean rooms with fresh sheets, good breakfast, 24-hour reception, and incredibly kind, welcoming staff. Repeat guests note it keeps getting better, making it a confident recommendation.
address: 15, El Shohadaa Street, Al Masala West And Sherif Basha, Alexandria, 21521, Alexandria Governorate 92103

name: Helnan Antoniades Palace Hotel
description: The Helnan is a lovely hotel with a superb setting, beautifully designed newer rooms, stunning lighting and courtyard scenery, a huge pool, and polite, friendly staff, near a nice park. It sits a bit away from the busy tourist core, which many find part of its charm, making it a pleasant, clean stay.
address: Albert, Al Awl, Alexandria Governorate

name: Arab Boutique Hotel | Alexandria | Downtown | Welcoming All Solo and Groups BUT, Unmarried Couples NOT ALLOWED
description: Arab Boutique Hotel is a downtown budget property with an excellent central location that some solo travelers find clean, cozy, and staffed by kind people. However, many reviews raise serious concerns about organization, cleanliness (including insects), and safety, especially for solo female travelers, so research carefully before booking.
address: 47 Alexander the Great St (Soter), Al Azarita, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21525

name: Zamzam Panoramic Sea View Hotel Apartment - Miami (Families Only)
description: This ZamZam family apartment in Miami sits directly on the beach with a breathtaking panoramic sea view from every balcony, very clean and well-organized. Its high, exposed position means it can get extremely windy and cold, and some report slow or unpleasant check-in, so confirm details, but the views are a standout.
address: Corniche St, beside 1001 Nights Cafeteria, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate 5517288

name: The Grand Plaza Hotel Smouha
description: The Grand Plaza Smouha is a clean, well-located hotel near Green Plaza with friendly staff (bellboys, front desk, room service) and an extensive room-service menu that make many guests feel at home. Some report disappointing maintenance issues at higher room categories, so it's worth confirming your room, but the hospitality stands out.
address: 14th May Avenue Behind Pharos University, Sidi Gaber

name: RITZ HOTEL
description: The Ritz Hotel has a perfect central location and friendly, helpful staff that several guests praise warmly. Experiences vary widely, however, with complaints about missing five-star amenities, dated or off-putting entrances, and bathroom issues, so set expectations.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424041

name: San Giovanni Hotel
description: San Giovanni is a small, old-Alexandria hotel with warm, welcoming staff, good rooms, a seafront seating area, and a famous restaurant known for specialty dishes, carrying real nostalgia for longtime visitors. It has no private beach and is on the small side, but the hospitality and history make it a pleasant stay.
address: 205 El-Gaish Road, Stanley Bridge, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Acropole Hotel
description: Acropole occupies a classic Mediterranean apartment building with a cool Greek-acropolis vibe, partial sea views, and a great location, with staff who handle things in a friendly way. Multiple guests report serious booking and refund problems, with reservations seemingly vanishing after payment, so confirm directly and keep records.
address: 27 El Ghorfa El Togareya St, Raml Station Square, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Steigenberger Cecil Alexandria
description: The Steigenberger Cecil is a beautifully preserved historical landmark in the city center, like a time machine with its old gate, elevator, and stairs, yet spacious, comfortable rooms and excellent, professional service. With a great location, fine breakfast, and authentic atmosphere, it's long been a favorite choice in Alexandria.
address: 16 Saad Zaghloul Square, Raml Station, El Mesalla Gharb & Sherif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Asafra Armed Forces Officers' Residences Hotel
description: This Asafra armed-forces officers' apartment hotel offers clean apartments with amazing views, friendly, helpful staff, strict security, and a cafe and restaurant with good prices. It's more apartment than hotel, with noisy, non-soundproof windows and a beach that can get littered, so set expectations accordingly.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526063

name: Sea Star Hotel
description: Sea Star is a basic budget hotel with a great location three minutes from the water, friendly staff, and clean rooms that please many guests at a good price. Wifi can be slow on upper floors and a few report inconsistent pricing and extra charges, so confirm the rate upfront.
address: 24 Amin Fekry, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372064

name: Paradise Inn - Windsor Palace Hotel
description: The Windsor Palace (Paradise Inn) is a magnificent historic seafront hotel that retains its vintage charm, with a renovated bathroom, clean rooms, decent staff, and a lovely rooftop restaurant with beautiful sea views. The major drawback is noise, as single-glazed windows let in heavy street sound, so request a quieter room.
address: El Geish Rd, Mansheya, El Shohada seafront, Al Attarin

name: Sheraton Montazah Hotel
description: The Sheraton Montazah is a well-located beachfront hotel near the city center with a clean private beach, friendly staff, an excellent breakfast buffet, and a spa. Some guests report cleanliness and loyalty-points issues, so it's worth checking your room and bookings, but many describe great hospitality and a lovely stay.
address: Corniche Road, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21923

amenities: Upscale Beachfront Hotel With A Spa
Upscale Hotel With A Private Beach

name: Eastern Al Montazah Hotel
description: Eastern Al Montazah is a hotel with big, clean rooms and bathrooms, a good breakfast, and a generally pleasant, surprisingly good experience, set a short drive from the sea and Corniche. The off-the-water location and some inconsistencies in food service and room readiness are drawbacks, but many guests come away satisfied.
address: 72HF+96R, Al Amrawi, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5525018

name: Alexander the Great Hotel-Alexotel Apartments
description: Alexander the Great (Alexotel) Apartments sit right in the heart of downtown, making it easy to get around, with small, clean apartments, city-panorama views, and warm staff like Mr. Mina who offer upgrades. In-room maintenance is inconsistent, with reports of faulty sockets, fridges, and locks, so confirm your room works on arrival.
address: 5 oskofia street, small, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5372001

name: Regency Hotel
description: The Regency offers great value with an excellent seafront location, a big, tasty, inexpensive breakfast, an unreal view, and a private beach, plus friendly staff and diligent housekeeping. The major drawback is poor window insulation, which lets in heavy traffic and motorbike noise overnight, so light sleepers should request a quieter room.
address: 696 Al Moulazem Baseoni, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526056

name: Transit Alexandria Hostel
description: Transit Alexandria Hostel has an excellent central location within walking distance of the Library, Qaitbay Castle, and the aquarium, with clean sheets and helpful staff for some guests. Others report inflated charges, cleanliness issues, and undisclosed conditions like water shut-offs, so confirm all terms before paying.
address: 1 Gamal El Deen Yassine, Street Raml Station, Alexandria Governorate 21519

name: Helnan Mamoura Hotel & Conference center
description: The Helnan Mamoura is a clean, comfortable beachfront hotel in the Mamoura area with a beautiful atmosphere, professional, cheerful staff, good food, and a nice pool. Occasional bathroom-odor issues on arrival are quickly handled by room service, making for a pleasant overall stay.
address: Khaled Ibn Al Walid, Al Maamourah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21919

amenities: Posh Business Hotel With A Scenic Pool
Upscale Beachfront Hotel With A Spa

name: Louran Residence
description: Louran Residence is a hotel-apartment option with a good location and rooms that suit families and groups, earning some excellent reviews for cleanliness, staff, and value. Others report units not matching photos, weak mobile and wifi coverage, cockroaches, and missing standard amenities, so confirm the specific apartment before booking.
address: 3 Galal Zahran St, Louran, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452057

name: Paradise Inn - Le Metropole Hotel
description: Le Metropole (Paradise Inn) is a lovingly restored Belle Epoque hotel with old-world charm and elegance, a central location, an amazing rooftop breakfast, and standout, friendly service (Christina is frequently praised). Some street traffic noise comes with the central setting, but the atmosphere and hospitality make it a gem.
address: 52 Saad Zaghloul St, Raml Station, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

amenities: Sky View Restaurant Le Metropole Hotel

name: Alexandria Youth Hostel
description: Alexandria Youth Hostel is a clean, very cheap option with good rooms and big, clean bathrooms, offering dorm-style beds suitable for travelers needing an affordable place to sleep. Service is inconsistent and the strict 11 p.m. curfew frustrates some, so it's best for budget-focused, early-night stays.
address: 28 Selim Hasan, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424041

name: Golden Hoster Hotel
description: Golden Hoster is a well-regarded budget hotel praised as the best in its area, with clean, modern-classic rooms, good wifi, a great location, and friendly, attentive staff like Mr. Nabil, Mr. Emad, and Ms. Seham. Guests consistently highlight the warm reception and good value across its range of room levels.
address: El Borsa El Adeema street, Al Mansheyah Al Kubra, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361024

name: Helnan Palace Hotel
description: The Helnan Palace is a grand, royally styled beachfront hotel that some call the best they've ever stayed at, with a beautiful view, friendly staff, and good service for couples and special occasions. The restaurant draws complaints for slow, disorganized service, and beach access costs extra, but the setting and rooms impress.
address: Montaza Palace, El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21539

amenities: Posh Business Hotel With A Scenic Pool
Upscale Beachfront Hotel With A Spa

name: Ahlan Hostel - El Mazareta (Men Only Private Room)
description: Ahllan Hostel in Al-Mazareta (men only) is an excellent-value, very clean budget stay in a central location surrounded by amenities, with extremely respectful, helpful staff. Some note bed sheets weren't perfectly clean, but it's a reliable, repeat-worthy choice for budget travelers.
address: 5 Mostafa Mohammed Ismail St, Al Azaritah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424001

name: Maamura Palace Hotel
description: Maamura Palace has a wonderful balcony view of the sea and trees, a perfect location near the beach, good room space, and tasty food, making it a yearly return for some families. The lobby and common areas feel neglected and rooms lack basics like kettles and towels, and there's no private beach, so set expectations.
address: 1 El-Shaheed Youssef El-Sebaey, Al Maamourah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Evy House
description: Evy House has an excellent, easy-to-reach location and modest but comfortable, clean rooms with stunning sea views, making it a fine budget option for a short stay. However, recent reviews raise serious safety and management concerns, including reports of conflicts and guest mistreatment, so research current conditions carefully.
address: Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Maamoura Armed Forces Officers' Residences
description: This Mamoura armed-forces officers' apartment complex has a clean, organized, safe setting with a long seaside walkway that lifts the spirits. Reviews skew negative, however, with complaints about poor service, a noisy all-day pool DJ, maintenance closures, and staff angling for bribes, so it's not ideal for a quiet family vacation.
address: 72RM+8MX, Youssef Danli, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: JEWEL EL MANDRA
description: Jewel El Mandara is a hotel-apartment with a nice sea view, a good location, and helpful staff like receptionist Marwa who earn praise. Many guests report cleanliness and maintenance problems, including unclean linens, faulty AC, and missing soap, so confirm the apartment's condition on arrival.
address: 818 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21615

name: Paradise Inn Beach Resort Maamoura
description: Paradise Inn Beach Resort Maamoura is a relaxing beachfront resort in a gated community with friendly, helpful staff (Shaimaa and Shaimaa-like service stand out), tasty, reasonably priced food, and a peaceful atmosphere. Rooms can feel dated with upkeep issues like mold and thin sheets, and the entrance guard left a poor first impression for some, so expectations should be measured.
address: El-Shaheed Youssef El-Sebaey, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21915

name: N.Y.X lounge
description: N.Y.X is a cozy lounge and bar that's a popular spot for birthdays and celebrations, with a good DJ, danceable music, and generally great service for regulars. Several serious complaints about discrimination at the door and service mishaps appear in reviews, so experiences can vary sharply.
address: 43 Safia Zaghloul St, the station, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21563

name: NEO Lounge Alexandria
description: NEO Lounge in the Sidi Bishr Hilton is a lounge bar with a weekly program, great music, polite, attentive staff, good food, and well-made cocktails that many enjoy, especially during happy-hour deals. Drinks are marked up and some guests (including on New Year's Eve) feel it's not worth the price, so expectations vary.
address: 544 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517186

name: The Pint Bar
description: The Pint Bar is a lively bar and lounge with a DJ, a dance area by the tables, shisha in the lounge section, and a minimum charge. The advertised steakhouse side and stated hours are unreliable, with reports of unanswered calls and a crowded, disorganized scene when busy, so go mainly for the bar-and-DJ vibe.
address: Alex Engineering Club, 303Tareek El Gueish Saba Pasha In Front Of, Alexandria Governorate

name: Skyroof - Windsor Palace Hotel
description: The Skyroof at the Windsor Palace is a lovely rooftop spot with beautiful views over Alexandria's beach and skyline, ideal for relaxing with a partner before sunset and taking photos, with some standout, professional staff. Food quality and value draw frequent complaints, so it's best enjoyed primarily for the view and atmosphere.
address: El Geish Rd, El Gondy El Maghoul Square, 21562

name: Hooliganseg
description: Hooliganseg is a lounge bar that some enjoy for a night out, but reviews skew negative, with repeated complaints about a manager with a poor, controlling attitude, confusing reservation policies, and unwelcoming service. A weak New Year's DJ also disappointed some, so experiences vary.
address: Sunrise hotel Alexandria, Alexandria Governorate 00000

name: Calithea
description: Calithea is an old, cute, authentic restaurant full of nostalgia for longtime Alexandrians, with tasty homemade (not frozen) food, friendly service, cold beer, and charming old decor. Portions aren't large, it's cash-only, and the loud music and dim setting aren't for everyone, but many find it a warm, memorable spot.
address: Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Jackx Club
description: Jackx Club is a nice spot for dinner, dancing, and celebrating occasions with friends at a reasonable cost. The entrance is hard to find with unhelpful hotel guards, and several reviewers accuse the venue of using copyrighted photos without permission, so experiences and impressions vary.
address: Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452021

name: Hoodz Lounge
description: Hoodz is a chill lounge bar with tasty food, quick and friendly service, and a great variety of activities like board games, plus rooms you can book for PlayStation or movies, making it fun for groups and families. Drinks are hit or miss and service can be slow or inattentive at first, but the relaxed atmosphere and activities are the draw.
address: Building Z, 38 El Naql wal Handasa St, St 38, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Tesla Lounge
description: Tesla Lounge is a lounge bar with well-liked mojitos, decent, nicely presented food, and game rooms like billiards and PlayStation that make for a fun outing. Service is inconsistent, with complaints about rude treatment, minimum-charge demands, and equipment delays, so experiences vary and parking can be tricky.
address: Mohammed Abu El Fotouh St, Hadayek El Saraya Compound, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21684

name: Le Bar
description: Le Bar at the Four Seasons is an elegant, quiet, clean bar with a warm, welcoming atmosphere, excellent service, and what many call the best drinks in Alexandria, plus a good selection of food. It runs pricey, but the polished atmosphere and standout staff make it a top choice.
address: 399 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21599

name: Triple O lounge
description: Triple O is a cozy lounge with good vibes, fantastic food, friendly, respectful staff, and excellent service that many call the best lounge in Alexandria. It's a comfortable, well-liked spot worth visiting.
address: 24 abdelaziz fahmy, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452011

name: Spitfire Bar
description: Spitfire is a beloved old-school local bar tucked near the Athineos hotel, with a great atmosphere, good snacks, the best international music, and cold beer that feels well-earned once you find it. There's a charge to sit for some, but it's a genuine, characterful bar that delights regulars and travelers alike.
address: 16 El-Gaish Rd, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Bleu
description: Bleu is an open-air bar and restaurant at San Stefano with a gorgeous Mediterranean view that's especially magical at sunset, serving drinks, coffee, pizza, sandwiches, and shisha with great service. Noise from the busy Corniche road can intrude, but the view and atmosphere make it a favorite.
address: 399 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21599

name: Il Punto
description: Il Punto is one of the few spots in Alexandria that feels like a real bar rather than an upscale cafe, with good music and a lively vibe. Reviews are sharply divided, however, with serious recent complaints about reservation handling, crowding, and treatment of tourists, so experiences vary widely.
address: 5WW2+FMP, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372020

name: Cigar Bar
description: Cigar Bar is a quiet, classy bar tucked in the back lobby of the Hilton next to Santorini, with a beautiful ambiance, sea-view setting, and good music at the right times. Several guests report serious overcharging and service issues, so confirm prices carefully, but the setting can make for a nice chill-out.
address: 544 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 1, Alexandria Governorate 5517186

name: Crazy House
description: Crazy House is a newer nightclub with alcohol that stays open until morning, offering decent service at reasonable prices in a convenient location. Reviews are mixed, with some enjoying it and others strongly disappointed, so expectations should be measured.
address: 538 Khaled Ibn El Walid St, Sidi Bishr Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate

name: Beet el tarsh
description: Beet el Tarsh is an adult entertainment club that regulars describe, in playful local slang, as a uniquely relaxing, lively escape. Reviews are tongue-in-cheek but enthusiastic about the experience.
address: 3-7 Dr Borgi, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433127

name: Serenity Lounge
description: Serenity is a cozy, aptly named lounge cafe with private relaxing rooms, light shisha, Arabian music, and helpful staff, great for friends' gatherings, studying, movie nights, or just chilling. The privacy and comfortable vibe make it a highly recommended spot.
address: camp ceasar, 37 Port Said St, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 21525

name: BLOCK 99 CITY Lounge
description: Block 99 is a lounge serving hot and cold drinks, food across all dayparts, and what one regular calls the cleanest shisha they found in Egypt. Ventilation, sound, crowding, and a few reports of hidden pricing are recurring complaints, so confirm prices, but the shisha and food win fans.
address: 9 Albert Al Awal, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432014

name: Bar and nightclub Mirage
description: Mirage is a bar and nightclub with a nice setting and decent service for some guests. Reviews skew negative, however, with complaints about poor value, no English or drinks menu, and tourists being charged more, so set expectations and confirm prices.
address: 6XX8+2VP, El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452054

name: B2 Club Alexandria
description: B2 is a nightclub billed as a VIP nightlife experience with energetic music, lights, and a lively atmosphere that some guests genuinely enjoy. Reviews are sharply divided, with serious complaints about door treatment of foreigners and inconsistent minimum-charge pricing, so confirm terms in advance.
address: Sunrise Hotel, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21529

name: Club 21
description: Club 21 is a calm, cozy cafe that's been delivering good service since the early 2000s, with hospitable staff, generous, amazing food, an outdoor garden, and shisha, in a great location. It's a comfortable spot to meet a partner or friend, though some find the music not to their taste.
address: 5 El Moaaskar El Romani St, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434046

name: tiki taka
description: Tiki Taka is a cozy lounge that's one of the best spots in the area for PlayStation and gaming, with friendly, helpful staff, up-to-date games, good screens, comfortable seating, and shisha. Drinks are just okay, but the relaxed vibe and gaming setup make it highly recommended.
address: 7X4J+W8G, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517074

name: Mazazik International Night Club
description: Mazazik International is a nightclub praised by many for a warm welcome (host Abu Hamza is named repeatedly), great entertainment, and outstanding service, with some calling it the best in Alexandria. Be aware that a few reviews raise concerns about the late-night scene, so impressions vary.
address: 808 El Geish Rd, El Mandara Bahareya, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 21923

name: Hamzah Lounge
description: Hamzah is a lively cafe and lounge popular with young people, with friendly staff, games, fair prices, good drinks, and decent food, opening early for a night out. It can be crowded and small with average drinks, and service is inconsistent, so it's best for a casual, social outing.
address: 94 Street 1, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: Plus Ninety Lounge Saraya Branch
description: Plus Ninety (Saraya branch) is a lounge with good food and drinks and respectful staff for some guests. Reviews are mixed, with complaints about service speed, cleanliness, faulty AC, dated TVs, and pricing, so experiences vary.
address: 276 Abdel Salam Aref St, El Soyof Bahari, Montaza, Alexandria Governorate 21123

name: Home Station Lounge
description: Home Station is a warm, welcoming lounge cafe with genuinely friendly staff and food and drinks that some praise highly. However, multiple reviewers report serious problems with room reservations not being honored and poor handling when issues arise, so confirm bookings carefully.
address: 181 Abd El-Salam Aref, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21532

name: Lorantos
description: Lorantos is a cafe and nightclub with friendly staff and a minimum-spend policy. Reviews are mixed and modest, with some enjoying it and others finding it an underwhelming night-coffee spot rather than a true club, so set expectations.
address: 44 Safia Zaghloul St, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372024

name: Eros Restaurant and Bar
description: Eros is an aristocratic downtown bar and restaurant with an elegant atmosphere, nice decor, and background music that's good for drinks, dancing, and meeting people, especially on Thursday nights. Food quality and service draw serious complaints, so it's best enjoyed for the ambiance and drinks rather than the meal.
address: Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372024

name: Jax club
description: Jax is a nightclub with sharply divided, largely negative reviews, with several complaints about the atmosphere, cleanliness, and overall experience. A few enjoy it, but most reviewers come away disappointed, so manage expectations.
address: 303 saba basha elgish road, Alexandria Governorate

name: Privado Lounge
description: Privado is a luxurious lounge and restaurant in the heart of Alexandria, praised for excellent, professional service, amazing atmosphere, top music, and tasty food. Reservations are typically required, but reviewers consistently describe a memorable, upscale experience.
address: 6W8W+5VQ, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080

name: Lobby Lounge
description: Lobby Lounge is a bar in Alexandria.
address: 399 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21599

name: Alexandr Restaurant &Bar
description: Alexandr (now run as Spitfire by Jimmy) is a downtown bar and restaurant serving cocktails plus the Athineos menu, with great music and staff, ideal for small groups, and notably quick, accurate service. Be aware that large tour groups can be prioritized at busy times, so timing matters, but regulars enjoy it.
address: 21 Saad Zaghloul Square, Raml Station, inside Athenios, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Crowne Plaza Alexandria Mirage by IHG
description: The Crowne Plaza Smouha is a clean, modern, centrally located hotel with spotless, comfortable rooms and excellent, friendly service from standout front-desk staff. Guests consistently describe a wonderful, convenient stay that meets the brand's high standards.
address: Victor Emanuel Square, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080

name: Nefertiti
description: Nefertiti is a traditional, local-vibe Egyptian bar with friendly staff, good service, beautiful local songs, a chill atmosphere, and competitive, reasonable prices, where you can even play your own music. The food quality is its weak point, but it's a favorite for an authentic, affordable night out.
address: 13 Abbas Mahmoud El-Akad, Al Mansheyah Al Kubra, Mansheya, Alexandria Governorate 5361024

name: Romance
description: Romance is a small, nicely run nightclub and venue in a prime Corniche-front hotel, with friendly, helpful staff, good service, and a great entertainment program. Guests consistently describe special evenings and skilled management, making it a recommended spot.
address: 11 Moursy Gameel Aziz, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: Flamingo Beach, Yacht Club
description: Flamingo Beach at the Yacht Club is a cozy seaside spot with good vibes, friendly staff, welcome drinks, sunbeds, and a fresh sea breeze, great for relaxing away from the crowds (and tourist-friendly). Food and dessert quality are weak and it lacks proper restrooms and updated facilities, so go mainly for the drinks and view.
address: El Maamoura Corniche, El Mandara Bahari, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Arabesque Lounge
description: Arabesque, inside the Four Seasons, offers a wonderful experience with delicious food, special decor, a lovely view, friendly staff, and great shisha. Prices are high and there are some restrictions (like no photos), so set expectations, but most diners describe a top-notch atmosphere and service.
address: 399 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21599

name: Alexandria Opera House
description: The Alexandria Opera House (Sayed Darwish Theatre) is a beautiful, ornate, well-maintained theater full of culture, hosting concerts and performances like Vivaldi's Four Seasons, with friendly staff. It's worth booking tickets in advance and noting a dress code (jacket and tie) may apply.
address: 22 El Horreya Rd (Fouad St), El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria

name: O - Lounge
description: O-Lounge is a lively spot with high-standard service, a great atmosphere, and well-liked items like the Lamar mango juice, good for hosting birthday parties, with prices many find reasonable. It gets crowded with loud music later in the night and a few dishes (like sushi) are inconsistent, but the staff and vibe stand out.
address: 303 El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452021

name: Pool Bar & Grill
description: Pool Bar & Grill is a poolside spot with a nice setting. Reviews are limited and lean lukewarm, with complaints that the food quality and service don't match the high prices, so set expectations.
address: 399 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 21599

name: Nassyet Omar
description: Nassyet Omar is a popular cafe one block from the sea, blending local-coffee prices with the comfort of a higher-end cafe, with high-quality drinks and very friendly staff. It can get smoky and a bit noisy, but it's a great-value, well-liked spot for hanging out with friends.
address: 9 Mohammed Dori, St, Louran, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Blue Harbor Rooftop Restaurant Windsor Palace Hotel Alexandria
description: Blue Harbor, the rooftop at the Windsor Palace, offers an overwhelming sea view of Alexandria's eastern bay, a lovely atmosphere, good pizza, and friendly staff, at affordable prices. Coffee quality is moderate and there's an undisclosed per-person minimum, so ask first, but the rooftop view makes it special.
address: 17 Al Shohadaa, street raml station, Alexandria Governorate

name: Jeeda's
description: Jeeda's is a vibrant, rustic-chic beach-bar-style restaurant with a warm Chiringuito atmosphere, friendly service, and excellent food like risotto with veal and truffles and fresh seafood. It's left a lasting impression on many diners, making it one of Alexandria's standout spots.
address: 39 Horreya Avenue, Kom Ad Dakah Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: BRANZINO
description: Branzino is one of Alexandria's best seafood restaurants, right on the water with a beautiful Mediterranean view, fresh fish, standout pasta, and good value by international standards. Service can be a little inconsistent, but the freshness, food, and setting make it highly recommended.
address: Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424012

name: Alban Swesra
description: Alban Swesra is a hugely popular spot famous for cheese-laden dishes like sausage and pastrami with cheese, great for brunch or a morning meal with nice portions. It's cramped and you may wait 15+ minutes for a table at peak times, but cheese lovers consistently rate it a must-visit.
address: Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424072

name: Crave
description: Crave is a beloved seaside spot with a lovely, cozy ambiance, amazing sea views (a favorite for sunsets), delicious, well-presented food, and warm, attentive staff. Reviews are mostly very positive, with the occasional complaint about value or consistency, but it remains a top pick for many.
address: Alexandria Corniche, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5424020

name: SeaSide
description: SeaSide is regarded by many as one of the best seafood restaurants in Alexandria, with an unbelievable sea view, incredibly fresh seafood, and a great location. A few find the experience inconsistent compared to neighbors, but most diners rate it a favorite.
address: L Bay, Fort Qaitbey area, Bahary Qayetbai st, Alexandria Governorate 21599

name: La Alexandria Asian Restaurant & Cafe
description: La Alexandria is a cozy, family-run Asian restaurant with super-friendly staff and flavorful, authentic dishes that feel like a good homemade meal, from chicken katsu to satay, dumplings, and mapo tofu. The warm welcome and consistently great food make it a wonderful, recommended spot.
address: Adfo, Al Ibrahimeyah Qebli WA Al Hadrah Bahri, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 21525

name: Sky view restaurant Le Metropole hotel
description: Sky View at Le Metropole is a classy rooftop restaurant with an incredible atmosphere for a quiet night away from the city bustle, delicious, well-made food, and welcoming, professional staff. Service can be inconsistent on off-nights, but most diners describe excellent hospitality and a special experience.
address: Raml station, 52 Saad Zaghloul, street, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372032

name: Sidra By The Citadel
description: Sidra by the Citadel is a beautifully designed Lebanese restaurant with a lovely view, warm atmosphere, and well-liked dishes like the mixed grill and chicken meshab, served hot and quickly. Some find certain dishes (like the risotto) average for the price, and the online-only menu requires internet, but the setting and service win praise.
address: As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321430

name: Fish Market Marina
description: Fish Market Marina is an iconic Alexandria seafood spot with a beautiful Mediterranean sea view and a worthwhile experience despite often-long queues. Some dishes can be under-seasoned, but the fresh seafood, setting, and views make it a great choice for lunch.
address: 6V4P+542, El-Gaish Rd, Al Mazar, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321384

name: Divaz restaurant & cafe
description: Divaz is a cozy cafe and restaurant tucked in a building with a narrow, easy-to-miss entrance that opens into a nice, welcoming space with helpful staff. Smoking near non-smokers and a dated sound system draw complaints, and food is just okay, but the lovely setting and skilled staff make for a pleasant outing.
address: 91 Ahmed Shawqi, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433140

name: Santa Lucia
description: Santa Lucia, founded in 1933, is a classic, elegant fine-dining institution with solid-wood decor that transports you to another era, plus excellent, friendly service and good privacy. The food is well-regarded (the melanzane parmigiana is a highlight) though not the main draw for everyone, but the timeless atmosphere makes it special.
address: 40 Safia Zaghloul St, El Mesalla Sharq, Raml Station, Alexandria Governorate 5372024

name: Ritsa restaurant
description: Ritsa is a standout seafood restaurant where you choose your fresh fish to be cooked the traditional Egyptian way, with amazing, fresh flavors, great hospitality, and a welcoming atmosphere. Diners consistently praise the quality, cleanliness, and friendly service, making it a top seafood pick.
address: Salah El Din St off Fouad St, El Mazloum Ceramics, Khalf Ahmed Orabi, Alexandria Governorate

name: White & Blue - Greek Nautical Club
description: White & Blue, the Greek Nautical Club, is a seaside seafood restaurant with beautiful Greek-inspired decor, a relaxing atmosphere, and stunning views of the fishing boats and bay, especially at sunset. Known for an exceptional Greek salad and the chance to pick from the day's fresh catch, it's a highly recommended taste of the city's Greek heritage.
address: Kayetbai, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321430

name: Cap D’or Bar and Restaurant
description: Cap D'Or is a charming, hidden art-nouveau bar and restaurant in downtown Alexandria with great vibes every night, friendly staff, affordable local Stella beer, and delicious seafood tapas like fried fish and clams. It gets very crowded Thursdays and Fridays, so plan ahead, but it's a beloved, atmospheric gem.
address: 4 Adib Bek Ashak St, Mansheya, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372010

name: Rooftop
description: Rooftop is a tranquil, budget-friendly restaurant with a tricky-to-find entrance off the Corniche, amazing views, fresh, delicious food, and good portions. Service can be slow with drinks, and one diner reported a poor experience with management, but most praise the food, view, and value.
address: 236 Corniche, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424020

name: Ebn El Balad Restaurant
description: Ebn El Balad is an Egyptian restaurant serving home-style dishes like mahshi, kobeba, and grills, with some tasty items like the coriander potatoes. Reviews are mixed-to-negative, however, with complaints about soups, seafood quality, and consistency, so stick to the well-reviewed dishes.
address: Gleem, Alexandria Governorate 21613

name: Nasaya Restaurant & Bar
description: Nasaya is a restaurant and bar with excellent food, friendly, efficient service, alcohol, and shisha. Portions are small for the price, the music gets very loud after 8pm making conversation hard, and a minimum-charge reservation policy frustrates some, so set expectations.
address: Elkornesh road, Roushdy, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Izoya Restaurant
description: Izoya is an airy, comfortable restaurant with wide-open space and lovely sea views, a peaceful daytime atmosphere, good food, and friendly staff that several visitors call a gem. Others find the prices high, the service inconsistent, and the breakfast limited, so experiences vary, but the setting and view are draws.
address: Elkornesh road, Roushdy, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Sento Bene
description: Sento Bene is a neat, cozy restaurant offering a variety of dishes at notably affordable prices, with friendly, professional service that wins many regulars. Food quality is a bit inconsistent for some, but most reviewers find it excellent value and return often.
address: Fawzi Fahmy, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372050

name: Chez Gaby Au Ritrovo
description: Chez Gaby au Ritrovo is a long-standing Italian restaurant with charming decor and an authentic, homey Italian feel, well-known for its pizza and Negresco over decades. Service can be slow or inattentive at times, but the atmosphere and tasty food make it a pleasant, nostalgic choice.
address: 22 El-Horeya Rd, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372020

name: Abo Noura
description: Abo Noura is a clean, friendly seafood restaurant with fresh fish and welcoming owners and staff, considered by some better than bigger-name spots. Prices run a bit high and a hand-washing tap near the dining area would help, but the quality and hospitality make it a good choice.
address: Ras at Tin, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321402

name: Tarama Seafood Restaurant
description: Tarama is a charming seafood restaurant with cute decor, a lovely setting, super-fresh fish, and amazing flavors that several longtime residents call the best seafood in Alexandria. The white-sauce seafood pasta is a standout, and warm service rounds out a highly recommended experience.
address: Antoniades Gardens, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Mohamed Ahmed Restaurant
description: Mohamed Ahmed is a legendary Alexandria institution famous for foul, ta'meya (falafel), and simple Egyptian classics done exactly right, leaving a lasting impression on visitors over many years. It can get crowded and the occasional dish arrives cold, but it remains a beloved, must-try spot.
address: Shakour St, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372032

name: Malek El Semman
