description: Malek El Semman is a local gem specializing in grilled quail and pigeon served with a variety of salads and dips, with friendly, active staff, reasonable prices, and usually available tables. Portions of the birds are small (order extra) and a few find some dishes just average, but the grilled quail is a tasty highlight.
address: 45 El Attarin Mosque St, behind Misr Station Square, in front of Ahmed Hassanein Harissa, Alexandria Governorate 21517

name: Maestro Burger
description: Maestro Burger is a fast-food burger spot with good service, fast delivery, and nice packaging. Reviews skew negative on the food itself, with repeated complaints that the patties taste cheap and mediocre, so expectations should be low despite the polished service.
address: 148 El-Gaish Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5424083

name: Byblos Restaurant
description: Byblos is an elegant, beautifully designed restaurant serving a wide menu of authentic Syrian and Lebanese dishes like ouzi, grilled halloumi, and mixed grills, with professional, attentive staff. It runs overpriced and some dishes are inconsistent, but it's a great choice for a special-occasion meal in a luxurious setting.
address: 399 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Rubino’s
description: Rubino's is widely praised for some of the best authentic wood-fired Italian pizza in Alexandria, with perfect dough, rich, balanced sauce, and great value, in a calm, classy atmosphere. A few find the food underwhelming for the price, but most diners rate the pizza highly and return.
address: infront 34 Sant Giyn, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433111

name: Lebanero Resturant &cafe
description: Lebanero is a great spot for Lebanese food in Alexandria, with delicious fatta, amazing tabbouleh, falafel, and hummus, plus a wonderful sea view, especially by the windows. Service can be inconsistent and the newer space is smaller, but the food and view keep it well-loved.
address: 6XR4+JFR, El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452042

name: EL-MUMTAZA RESTURANT
description: El-Mumtaza is a beloved hole-in-the-wall serving really delicious, authentic Asian food at great value, where regulars happily overlook the unfancy, garage-like setting. Some longtime fans miss the charm of the old location and note cleanliness could be better, but the food keeps people coming back.
address: 51 Zakaria Ghanim St, Camp Chezar, Al Ibrahimeya Bahari & Sidi Gaber, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5424072

name: Mori Sushi kafr abdo
description: Mori Sushi in Kafr Abdo is a consistently excellent, elegant sushi spot with fresh, beautifully presented fish, big sashimi pieces, and outstanding, friendly service (Fares and Darwish are praised by name). Reliable for both dine-in and delivery, it's a favorite for sushi lovers in Alexandria.
address: 9 Kafr Abdou, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433123

name: San Giovanni
description: San Giovanni is a famous old fine-dining restaurant in a clean, classic-vibe hotel with a lovely outdoor breakfast area overlooking the sea and Stanley Bridge. Long a tourist-guide favorite, it has drawn recent complaints about declining food and allergy handling, so longtime fans are divided, but the setting remains a draw.
address: 272 El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452040

name: L'apéro Bistrot
description: L'apero Bistrot is an atmospheric, well-shaded bistro (formerly Le Boudoir) with an awesome multi-cuisine menu, good appetizers like chimichurri, and great service. Reservations are handled awkwardly via DM, prices feel high for the portions, and cocktails can disappoint, but the unique atmosphere keeps fans loyal.
address: 30 Al Naby Danyal, Al Attarin Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371032

name: Sumi Sushi
description: Sumi Sushi is a top contender for the best sushi in Alexandria, with high-quality ingredients, delicious sushi and noodles, fair prices, great offers, and friendly staff. Service is occasionally inconsistent, but it consistently delivers on food and value, keeping regulars coming back.
address: 160 Ahmed Shawqi, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5434047

name: Casino El Shatby
description: Casino El Shatby is a seaside food court with a great view and several restaurants (like Murano), offering good food, generous portions, and fast service by the sea. The evening music can get too loud for conversation and service can be inattentive, but the setting and variety make it a pleasant spot.
address: No. 10, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5424041

name: Focacciaria
description: Focacciaria is a modest but beloved Italian spot near Raml Station behind the Sayed Darwish Theater, famous for consistently amazing Italian-style pizza enjoyed on the sidewalk amid the city's charm. The friendly, welcoming staff and great pizza make it a yearly tradition for many returning visitors.
address: Opera House Passage, Nazmi Botros, Alexandria Governorate

name: Country Hills
description: Country Hills is a clean, cozy Southern American-style diner with wooden decor, well-liked mac 'n' cheese, casseroles, and burgers, served hot with good service. Food quality can be inconsistent (the pizza and chicken get mixed reviews), but fans return often for the comfort-food favorites.
address: 242 El-Gaish Rd, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434048

name: Farag Fish Restaurant
description: Farag is a hidden seafood gem with fresh, excellent food, friendly service, and reasonable prices that impress most diners, including the fried shrimp and squid and grilled fresh fish. It's a little out of the way and slightly pricier than some, but the quality and service make it well worth seeking out.
address: Souq El Tork, Hussain Tofik St, El Mansheya El Kubra, Mansheya District, Alexandria

name: Seagull Restaurant Gleem
description: Seagull in Gleem is a seafood restaurant with a great sea view and decent staff, where you pick your fresh seafood and tell them how to prepare it, with most diners praising the freshness and clean flavors. It runs notably expensive even by global standards, and a few dishes like the butterfly shrimp disappoint, but the quality and setting win many over.
address: 6XR4+HWQ, Elgesh street, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5310002

name: Roberto's Italian Restaurant
description: Roberto's is an Italian restaurant with a lovely atmosphere, a welcoming team, and standout dishes like steak, ravioli, and wood-oven pizza that some call phenomenal. Service speed and steak doneness can be inconsistent, with occasional long waits, but most diners come away impressed.
address: Green Plaza, Ezbet El Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Beach Restaurant and Lounge
description: Beach Restaurant and Lounge has a unique seaside location with beautiful views, a relaxing atmosphere, music, and a wide, good-quality breakfast spread. The menu is expensive and a few reviewers report booking and seasonal-closure mix-ups, so confirm before visiting, but the setting is a real draw.
address: 399 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 21599

name: Ibn Hamido
description: Ibn Hamido is a spacious, often-overlooked seafood restaurant with a beautiful view, quick, friendly service, fantastic portions, and authentic, aromatic Alexandrian seafood that many call the best in town. Quality is occasionally inconsistent, but most diners rate it a great-value option for a real seafood experience.
address: Corniche Rd, Mostafa Kamel, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate

name: Kala Restaurant
description: Kala at the Four Seasons is a perfect-in-every-way restaurant with an amazing sea view, delicious food, a quiet, relaxing atmosphere, and super-nice staff, great for a special night or event. The sushi with creative rolls and the sweets are highlights, making it highly recommended.
address: 399 El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: Princess - Tivoli
description: Princess at Tivoli has a great seafront location with indoor and outdoor spaces, perfect food, good prices, and an amazing view, especially from a front-row table before sunset. The big, varied menu is hit or miss (chicken dishes shine, pasta less so) and rooftop access can be restricted, but the view and value please.
address: 52 Street 5, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434043

name: Pablo Cafe & Restaurant
description: Pablo is a beautiful cafe and restaurant with one of the best views and notably warm, patient, polite staff who make it great for celebrations and birthdays, in a hygienic setting. Service speed and food temperature can be inconsistent at busy times, but the hospitality and view make it a recommended spot.
address: 2 Zaki Badawi Mohamed St, 267 El Geish Rd, Stanley, El Raml 1

name: old street cafe and restaurant
description: Old Street is a cozy cafe and restaurant with a fresh outdoor section shielded by decorative trees, good food, lovely desserts, coffee, and soups, plus professional, knowledgeable staff. The welcoming atmosphere and great service leave a strong impression on many visitors.
address: 18 El Ghorfa El Togareya St, Raml Station, Alexandria Governorate 21563

name: Brazilian Coffee Stores
description: Brazilian Coffee Stores is a long-standing cafe with a wide menu and varieties like espresso, Turkish, and iced coffees at reasonable prices. The space gets noisy and crowded, staff aren't the friendliest, and several longtime fans feel quality has declined, so experiences are mixed.
address: Saad Zaghloul St & El Nabi Daniel St, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372044

name: Kato
description: Kato is a lovely, intimate cafe with a cozy atmosphere, varied seating, and a spacious layout that's great for studying or working, with high-quality food (the salmon bagel is fresh and excellent), good coffee, and a tempting bakery. It runs a bit overpriced for the area, but the vibes, friendly staff, and quality keep it well-loved.
address: Syria, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433141

name: Mugs Estate
description: Mugs Estate is a small, cozy, beloved cafe with great-value prices, friendly staff, and quality coffee (the espresso is a highlight), plus well-liked croissants, San Sebastian cheesecake, and milkshakes. Recently renovated while keeping its same warm atmosphere, it's a special spot for a catch-up over good coffee.
address: 9 Sisostris St, Al Attarin Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372004

name: Taiki Coffee Culture
description: Taiki Coffee Culture is a cozy, serene specialty-coffee cafe with properly trained baristas, excellent coffee and matcha, and extremely friendly staff (Noha is praised by name). For coffee lovers seeking real specialty coffee and a relaxing atmosphere, it's a standout in Alexandria.
address: 4 Tag El Roasaa St, Saba Basha, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452022

name: Cafe de la Paix
description: Cafe de la Paix is a nice old-school seafront cafe with an incredible location right on the sea, a cool breeze, fantastic coffee, quick service, and good prices, great for shisha and sunset views. Smoking inside, a limited menu, and average billing practices are drawbacks, but the view and value make it highly recommended.
address: 6W32+5W9, El-Gaish Rd, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373002

name: Gleem Bay, Alexandria
description: Gleem Bay is a clean, well-organized seafront food court with a stunning beach, friendly staff, and delicious, quickly prepared food and drinks across its restaurants. Some items run a bit pricey, but the lovely setting and good service make it a fantastic spot to relax by the sea.
address: Glime Beach, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033

name: Wave Cafe
description: Wave Cafe has a stunning direct beach view, cozy, comfortable seating, clean toilets, and good desserts. Food quality is just okay and overpriced, service can be unprofessional, and the parking situation draws complaints, so it's best enjoyed mainly for the view.
address: Corniche, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21221

name: Ecuador Coffee (Fouad St.)
description: Ecuador Coffee on Fouad Street is an Egyptian coffee chain with a modern aesthetic, set among beautiful old buildings on one of Alexandria's most historic streets, serving solid coffee like americano and cappuccino. Smoking in the AC area and some inconsistency in the French coffee draw complaints, but it's a pleasant spot in a lovely setting.
address: 88 El-Horeya Rd, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423002

name: Central Perk Cafe, Alexandria
description: Central Perk is a wonderfully decorated Friends-themed cafe (arguably the best in Egypt) with awesome, nostalgic decor, delicious food like cheese pizza and Alfredo pasta, and good, fast service. It's a fun, photo-worthy destination for fans and casual visitors alike, with welcoming hospitality.
address: Mohammed Shafek Ghrbal, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424050

name: Loretto
description: Loretto is a small, cool cafe with a friendly atmosphere, nice coffee (the Spanish latte is well-liked), and good waffles. Indoor smoking, somewhat informal service, and tricky parking are drawbacks, but it's a pleasant, relaxing spot to unwind.
address: 18 Al Fereid Layan, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434047

name: By the way bakery & Cafe
description: By the Way is a cozy bakery and cafe praised for consistently great coffee, fresh products like whole-wheat buns and bread, good prices, and friendly, polite staff. It's a reliable, well-liked spot for breakfast or coffee, with excellent quality and service.
address: Al Qawmya Al Arabya, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5422020

name: El Selsela Cafe
description: El Selsela is a calm seaside cafe right on the Corniche with a cozy vibe, stunning views, the sound of the waves, and honest, friendly staff, great for coffee and shisha on a nice evening. You pay a bit extra for a beachside ticket, but it's a beautiful spot to enjoy Alexandria's weather.
address: Alexandria Corniche, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 5424041

name: Panorama Restaurant & Cafe
description: Panorama is a popular cafe and restaurant where the perfect sea view alone makes the visit worthwhile, with generally helpful, great service. Reviews are mixed on food quality and customer service, with some serious complaints, so experiences vary, but the setting remains a strong draw.
address: Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424090

name: Skyboo
description: Skyboo is a family-friendly restaurant with an amazing view, tasty, affordable breakfast (some meals including a hot drink), and good beverages that pleasantly surprise some diners. Noisy fans, slow service, and overly sweet drinks draw complaints, so experiences are mixed, but the view and value win fans.
address: 6V6M+WQ4, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321430

name: Tivoli Dome, Alexandria
description: Tivoli Dome is a seafront food court in a lovely location with amazing Mediterranean views, side fountains, and a variety of cafes and restaurants (like Bukharist and Murano). Some longtime visitors feel the food quality and atmosphere have declined, but it remains a pleasant place to spend a weekend by the sea.
address: Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Tim’s Coffee
description: Tim's Coffee is a beautiful, cozy newer cafe with quality products, a nice atmosphere, and genuinely friendly, respectful staff, quickly becoming one of the best in the area. The focaccia and croissant sandwiches, desserts, and generously sized bakery items are highlights for a great brunch.
address: 5 Badawy St, Raml Station Square, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373010

name: Red Rose Cafe
description: Red Rose is an elegant, quiet, British-styled cafe in Green Plaza with wooden decor, smoking and non-smoking areas, and a calming atmosphere amid the busy mall, great for relaxing, reading, or working. Service can be a little slow, but the food is delicious with good portions, evoking the old vibes of Alexandria's classic cafes.
address: Green Plaza, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Luna Park Café
description: Luna Park is a seafront cafe with a nice direct sea view, friendly staff, a kids' area, mosque, clean toilet, and moderate prices, pleasant for a drink. Food quality and billing draw serious complaints from several reviewers, so it's best enjoyed for drinks and the view rather than a meal.
address: 6W9G+FJW, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424180

name: Breadfast Coffee
description: Breadfast Coffee is a cafe outlet from Breadfast, an Egyptian company known for fresh bakery goods and on-demand grocery delivery. This branch serves freshly brewed coffee alongside freshly baked breads and pastries, making a quick stop for a coffee and a bite.
address: Mall, near Kazari, Green Plaza, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Ohana Café
description: Ohana is a clean cafe with good coffee, a calm atmosphere, and staff that many find great, making for a pleasant, relaxing experience. Service and availability can be inconsistent, with some reporting unavailable items and uneven attitude, so experiences vary.
address: 14th of May St, in front of Green Plaza, Ezbet El Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431153

name: OWL Coffee Club ( Smouha Branch )
description: OWL Coffee Club's Smouha branch has a unique dark, cozy aesthetic with wood panels, young, friendly staff, nice background music, and well-liked drinks like cold brew and bubble tea. Limited menu availability and disorganized seating draw some complaints, but the atmosphere and coffee win fans.
address: Near, Hasan Allam, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Holybelly Egypt
description: Holybelly is one of Alexandria's well-liked spots for food, coffee, and appetizers, with indoor and outdoor seating after a renovation and tasty dishes like shrimp pasta, fried chicken mozzarella, and dynamite fries. Some drinks and pizzas are inconsistent and prices run a bit high, but it remains a favorite for many.
address: 24 Abd El-Moneim Riad, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433111

name: See You Cafe & Restaurant
description: See You is a cafe and restaurant with a very good view, delicious food, and generous portions for the price, especially well-liked for breakfast and lunch (the Al Kafr breakfast is a highlight). A required minimum order (drink plus dessert) frustrates some, and prices run a bit high, but the food and sunset views please.
address: Golden Jewel Hotel, the Corniche, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: 3alrakia Café & Lounge
description: 3alrakia is a cafe and lounge with an amazing view, friendly staff who provide blankets on cold nights, and well-liked waffles, with helpful service that relocates guests to better spots. The coffee is unremarkable and the minimum-charge pricing (excluding desserts) feels steep to some, so set expectations, but the view is a draw.
address: Alex, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 23511

name: Latino Cafe & Resturant
description: Latino is a beloved seafront cafe and restaurant with a beautiful view, quick, friendly service, and very tasty food at affordable prices, with huge breakfast portions and a must-try mixed-chocolate zalabia. It gets crowded and noisy when busy, so timing matters, but the food, value, and service make it a favorite.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452042

name: Brew And Chew (kafr abdou)
description: Brew and Chew in Kafr Abdo is a favorite dessert spot with a creative array of superb chocolate desserts, plus savory items like omelettes with great portions, in a nice setting with polite staff. The dessert variety beyond chocolate is limited and presentation can be inconsistent, but the chocolate desserts keep fans returning.
address: 28 Kafr Abdou, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433115

name: Johna's Cafe
description: Johna's is a warm, inviting cafe with excellent internet, generous portions, reasonable prices, and well-liked items like club sandwiches and onion soup, great for working or relaxing. Orders can take a while even when it's not busy, but the food, value, and atmosphere make it a solid choice.
address: 1 Tout Ankh Amoun, AR Riyadah, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432022

name: Shakespeare Cafe
description: Shakespeare is a cozy, long-running coffeeshop that's a beloved safe space for friends to hang out, play games, and enjoy affordable, good drinks. Heavy indoor smoking is a real drawback for many, and some feel its quality has slipped over the years, but the friendly atmosphere keeps regulars coming.
address: 26 El Moaaskar El Romani St, Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: Délices Patisserie Alexandria
description: Delices is an elegant, legendary patisserie and restaurant with excellent breakfast, incredibly delicious desserts, and warm, helpful service in a clean setting. As one of the oldest spots in the area, some feel it could use better upkeep and consistency, but its desserts remain a beloved standout.
address: Raml Station, 46 Saad Zaghloul, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372044

name: OWL Coffee Club (Mustafa Kamel Branch)
description: OWL Coffee Club's Mustafa Kamel branch is a small, simple, cozy cafe with good coffee, a nice cheese croissant, and friendly baristas (Basma and Ahmed are praised). The older space draws complaints about cleanliness, flies, lack of AC, and limited item availability, so experiences vary, but the coffee is reliably good.
address: 364 El-Semman, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21615

name: Ecuador Coffee (Azaritah)
description: Ecuador Coffee in Azarita has a unique seafront location right on the Corniche with sailboat views, good service, and high-quality coffee, tea, and molten cake. Some report inconsistencies like a disappointing Spanish latte, but most find it a great spot for a decent cup with a beautiful view.
address: El-Gaish Rd, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373011

name: View Cafe
description: View Cafe is a seaside open-air spot with a beautiful location, the soothing sound of the sea at night, tasty sandwiches, drinks, and desserts, a cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, and a big screen for matches. View-side seating is limited, but it's a relaxing, recommended place by the sea.
address: Mustafa Kamel & Bolkly, Sidi Gaber District, Alexandria Governorate

name: Daily Dose Playstation & Cafe
description: Daily Dose is one of the city's best cafe-and-PlayStation lounges, with incredibly friendly, welcoming staff, simple yet elegant decor, clean private gaming rooms, good drinks, and fair prices. Service can be inconsistent at busy times, but most reviewers describe a comfortable, fun, highly recommended spot.
address: 17 Al Safera Hoda Al Marasi, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451110

name: Coffee Roastery
description: Coffee Roastery (now Roast Inn) is a long-loved spot that keeps its nostalgic vibes, with a wide selection and tasty breakfast, lunch, and desserts, plus great service for many regulars. Some find it pricey, slow to serve, and inconsistent of late, but loyal fans still rate it a go-to.
address: 38 Abdel Qader Ragab St, Kafr Abdou, Roushdy, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: Hush cafe
description: Hush is a quiet, clean, green-accented cafe and bakery specializing in croffles, with a lovely ambiance, friendly staff, and well-liked coffee and pastries. It runs a bit overpriced and the music can be too loud with some worn furnishings, but the atmosphere and pastries impress many.
address: El-Horeya Rd, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372054

name: Joy Corner Coffe
description: Joy Corner is a small, comfy cafe with on-point decor, polite staff, a friendly vibe, and standout hazelnut coffee, plus a wide range of milkshakes and non-alcoholic cocktails. Drinks served only in paper cups, slow upstairs service, and loud speakers draw some complaints, but it's a good spot to hang out with friends.
address: Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434022

name: Sofianopoulo Coffee beans
description: Sofianopoulo is a historic coffee store built in 1908 by the Greek Sofiano la Paolo, retaining its old authentic design, vintage machines, and impressive coffee aroma that transports you back in time. Coffee lovers praise the quality and authenticity at reasonable prices, making it a genuine Alexandria institution.
address: 21 Saad Zaghloul St, Raml Station, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372010

name: Doppio Cafe and Restaurant
description: Doppio is an impressive cafe and restaurant with exceptional food, good coffee, internet for work and study, a welcoming ambiance, and attentive, friendly staff. A few items like the Four Seasons waffles disappoint, but most reviewers describe a memorable, highly recommended experience.
address: Stanley First Towers, Abdelrahman shoukry Street, Fleming, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452004

name: LAX COFFEE
description: LAX Coffee is a spacious cafe with catchy decor, good-value drinks of excellent quality, fun games, good ventilation, and famously friendly staff (the owner often serves personally). New group-size limits and weak indoor signal frustrate some, and food can be hit or miss, but the atmosphere and coffee win fans.
address: 154 Port Said St, Main St, El Ibrahimeya, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Woods Cafe & Restaurant
description: Woods is a Mediterranean-coast cafe and restaurant where the stunning sea view is the highlight, with tasty, affordable breakfast and a lunch menu, suiting groups and families. Cleanliness and service draw sharply mixed reviews, with some serious complaints, so experiences vary, but the scenery is a strong draw.
address: Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: House of Cocoa
description: House of Cocoa is a clean, polite chocolate cafe with excellent service, a big space with nice outdoor seating, and well-liked drinks like the chocolate macchiato and mocha frappe, plus custom chocolate gift baskets. Some signature items are occasionally unavailable and prices run a bit high, but the service and chocolate stand out.
address: Mall, Green Plaza, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Ruby's cafe and Restaurant
description: Ruby's is a high-end-feeling American cafe and restaurant with great energy, fast service, and well-liked food like the crispy chicken burger, good for spending hours working, reading, or dining. It's hard to find without asking and coffee quality has been a bit inconsistent lately, but the food, speed, and atmosphere please.
address: 3 Kafr Abdou, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21523

name: UNO Cafe
description: UNO is a friendly, well-liked cafe in Smouha with a helpful team (James is praised for explaining the games) and a welcoming atmosphere, making for a great experience. Reviewers consistently describe it as one of the best cafes in the area.
address: Panorama Smouha Building, 1 St 326 with El Mahmoudeya Canal St, Smouha Square

name: Let’s Cafe & PlayStation
description: Let's is a cafe and PlayStation lounge with great food, amazing hot chocolate, and private rooms for watching matches, making it a fun place to spend the day. Service can be a bit slow and a new customer policy frustrated some, with reservations recommended, but the food and gaming setup win fans.
address: El-Fardous, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 2347634

name: Capella cafe
description: Capella is a tidy, quiet, comfortable cafe with air conditioning, delicious coffee, and well-liked items like the Spanish latte and brownie. The music can be distracting for studying and prices feel high to some without checking the menu first, but it's a comfortable, recommended spot.
address: 13 Mostafa Mohammed Ismail St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424001

name: La Princess Cafe
description: La Princess is a good-value cafe with tasty food, decent portions, no minimum charge, and a rarely crowded, relaxed setting that's nice for a hangout. Service can be slow and staff could be friendlier, and a few warn to double-check the bill, so keep your receipt, but the value is solid.
address: 28 Selim Hasan, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424041

name: Boba Spot Cafe
description: Boba Spot is a fun cafe specializing in top-notch boba drinks with varied flavors and toppings plus mochi treats, with lovely staff who often offer a complimentary welcome drink. It runs expensive for the portions and gets crowded, but the friendly service and quality boba make it a pleasant new experience.
address: 8 Sidi Gabir Rd, Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434001

name: FAM Cafe Egypt
description: FAM is a quiet, relaxing cafe with fantastic outdoor seating (with outdoor electricity, great in cold weather), good-quality coffee, and polite, hospitable staff. A few find the tea, coffee, and hot chocolate underwhelming, but most reviewers enjoy the calm atmosphere and friendly service.
address: Building 92, Officers' Residences, beside El Fath Club, Mostafa Kamel

name: Smile Cafe
description: Smile Cafe is a renovated old villa turned open-air restaurant and cafe with a big kids' area (trampolines, swings, ping pong, PlayStation), watchful staff, fresh juice, and a tasty menu, great for families and birthdays. Food quality is just average and it can get noisy, but the kids' space and atmosphere make it a fun family outing.
address: 41 Essam El Masry St off Mohammed Fawzi Moaz St, Sidi Gaber

name: Beethoven Cafe
description: Beethoven is a trendy, cozy cafe in a lovely green-hedged setting with good, well-liked food like Alfredo pasta, casadia, and burgers, plus excellent, accommodating service and a thoughtful complimentary drink. Reviewers consistently describe good quality and a pleasant atmosphere worth returning for.
address: Roushdy, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434041

name: Demel
description: Demel is a quiet, warm two-floor cafe with comfortable seating, good for working or studying, and standout pastries like cinnamon rolls and sugar cruffins with out-of-this-world dough. Weak mobile signal, inconsistent AC, and a finicky card-payment system are drawbacks, but the coffee and pastries are excellent.
address: 7 Galal El Din El Ghatoury St off Fawzi Moaz St, in front of Zahran Furniture

name: The Island Lounge
description: The Island Lounge is a seafront food court with a wonderful, meditative setting, the sound of the waves, a beautiful beach view, and affordable food like pizza and coffee, with blankets provided in winter. Service draws sharply divided reviews, with serious complaints about rude staff and seating restrictions at some venues, so experiences vary widely.
address: Near, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434050

name: Alexandria Naval Unknown Soldier Memorial
description:
Alexandria Naval Unknown Soldier Memorial at the Manshaya district is dedicated to the unknown soldiers who lost their lives in the sea battles, it is present on the Corniche of Alexandria. It was built under the rule of Muhammed Ali of Egypt as Alexandria was the main naval base for his son Ibrahim Pasha's expedition to Greece during the Greek War of Independence, that culminated in the Battle of Navarino.
Originally a memorial to Khedive Ismail built by Italian residents of Alexandria, its status was changed following the Egyptian Revolution of 1952 to commemorate fallen naval personnel.
address: Al Gonday Al Maghool Sq., Al Mansheyah Al Kubra, Qesm Al Mansheyah, Alexandria Governorate 5361033

name: Mohamed Ali Pasha Statue
description: Mohamed Ali Pasha Statue is a historical landmark in Alexandria.
address: Ahmed Orabi St, Mansheya District, Alexandria Governorate 5361007

name: Lighthouse of Alexandria
description:
The Lighthouse of Alexandria, sometimes called the Pharos of Alexandria, was a lighthouse built by the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Ancient Egypt, during the reign of Ptolemy II Philadelphus (280–247 BC). It has been estimated to have been at least 100 metres (330 ft) in overall height. One of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, for many centuries it was one of the world's tallest man-made structures.
The lighthouse was severely damaged by three earthquakes between AD 956 and 1303 and became an abandoned ruin. It was the third longest-surviving ancient wonder, after the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus and the extant Great Pyramid of Giza, surviving in part until 1480, when the last of its stones were used to build the Citadel of Qaitbay on the site.
In 1994, a team of French archaeologists dived in the water of Alexandria's Eastern Harbour and discovered some remains of the lighthouse on the sea floor. In 2016, the Ministry of State of Antiquities in Egypt had plans to turn submerged ruins of ancient Alexandria, including those of the Pharos, into an underwater museum.
address: 6V7R+PG7, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321431

name: Qaitbay Citadel
description: The Citadel of Qaitbay is a 15th-century fortress on the Mediterranean coast of Alexandria, built between 1477 and 1479 by Sultan Al-Ashraf Qaitbay. It stands on Pharos Island at the mouth of the Eastern Harbour, on the site of the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria, and is one of the city's most iconic landmarks.
address: El Seyala Sharq, Al Gomrok District, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Rassafa Square
description: El Rassafa Square sits at the busy intersection of three major streets in Moharam Bek, full of memories and authentic Egyptian street life, including popular street-food trucks. It's crowded with chaotic traffic and its appearance has deteriorated since a government market was built there, so it's more for local color than sightseeing.
address: Shayakhet Green, Emberouz & Moharram Bek, Moharram Bek, Alexandria Governorate

name: Al-Marghany Palace
description: Al-Marghany Palace is a historical landmark in Alexandria.
address: Saba Basha, First Raml District, Alexandria Governorate

name: Raml Station
description: Raml Station is the lively heart of Alexandria, a historic downtown district known for colonial architecture, bustling city life, and authentic local character, near coffee houses and dessert spots. Riding its charming old tram (for a few pounds, paid to the conductor) is a fun way to experience the city and soak up the atmosphere.
address: Mahmoud Al Falaki, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372045

name: Tea island
description: Tea Island in the Montazah grounds is reached by crossing King Farouk's beautiful monumental bridge, a scenic, historic spot where the king once enjoyed his tea, especially lovely at sunset. Note that entering Montazah and parking cost extra, and service can be inconsistent, but the setting and views are special.
address: 72RC+MFG, Al Mandarah Bahri, Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Ahmed Oraby Square
description: Ahmed Oraby Square is an epic historical square built by Italians in 1946, with impressive architecture in the heart of Alexandria. Time and neglect have taken a toll on its upkeep, but it remains a notable landmark with an interesting history.
address: Al Mansheyah Al Kubra, Qesm Al Mansheyah, Alexandria Governorate 5361022

name: The Flying Sails and a Mermaid Statue
description: The Flying Sails and Mermaid statue is a modernized piece of public art near the Library of Alexandria, evoking the sea legends tied to the city. It's a good landmark for a Corniche walk toward the Citadel or a northeast stroll to watch the sunset.
address: 6W55+WFW, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424020

name: Beer Masoud
description: Beer Masoud (Masoud's Well) is a spot known for fresh air, a beautiful sea view, and the nostalgic sight of fishermen at work, centered on the legendary well. It's currently undergoing major renovation, with reports of entry charges even during construction, so confirm before paying.
address: 7X9P+GJ5, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517268

name: Beau Rivage Promenade
description: The Beau Rivage promenade is a clean, peaceful, beautiful seaside walkway with a lovely view, one of the nicer places to stroll in Alexandria. The large number of photographers and animal rides can be a nuisance, but the calm setting and sea view make it worthwhile.
address: 7XCW+C2J, Street 2, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517283

name: Tabia Cosa Pasha
description: Tabia Kousa Pasha is one of Alexandria's important Islamic archaeological sites, a fort commissioned in 1807 by Muhammad Ali Pasha, with cannons and structures still in good shape. It suffers from neglect and limited access (one of the few of its kind even partly open), so there's not a lot to see, but history buffs will appreciate it.
address: 83F7+QHX, Toson, Abu Qir Ash Sharqeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527441

name: Saad Zaghloul Statue
description: The Saad Zaghloul Statue, sculpted by the famous Mahmoud Mokhtar, honors the Egyptian national hero who led the independence movement against British rule, set in a strategic square in the heart of the city. Once a great place to relax, the surrounding area has declined with upkeep, but the grand statue remains a significant landmark.
address: El, Mahta Al Raml Sq.

name: Qaitbay Promenade
description: The Qaitbay promenade, just outside the citadel, is a peaceful, scenic walkway along Alexandria's coastline, much improved after recent renovations that cleared away street vendors. With waves crashing against the stone blocks and great sea views, it's a highly recommended spot to sit and enjoy the coast.
address: Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate

name: Al Qaaed Ibrahim Basha Mosque
description: The Al-Qaed Ibrahim Mosque, built in 1948 in the heart of Raml Station, is one of Alexandria's most iconic and historically significant mosques, famous for its graceful, towering minaret. It's a beautiful, beloved landmark and place of worship, though car parking nearby can be difficult.
address: 6W33+7G4, Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373010

name: El Safa Palace
description: El Safa Palace is a presidential palace in the Zizinia neighborhood of Alexandria, set on a hill overlooking the Mediterranean Sea.
address: 6XV7+7VP, San Stefano, Qesm AR Ramel, Alexandria Governorate 5452051

name: Alexandria Bibliotheca
description: The Bibliotheca Alexandrina is a major library and cultural center on the Mediterranean shore in Alexandria, built to commemorate the ancient Library of Alexandria. Officially inaugurated in 2002, its vast reading room was the largest in the world at the time of construction. The complex has shelf space for millions of books and also houses a conference center, specialized libraries, museums, art galleries, a planetarium, and a manuscript restoration laboratory.
address: Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21526

name: Sidi Morsi Abu al-Abbas Mosque, alexandria
description: The Sidi Morsi Abu al-Abbas Mosque is a beautiful, free-to-enter mosque with stunning Andalusian-inspired interior decorations and engravings that fill visitors with a deep sense of peace. Relatively small but rich in atmosphere, it's a beloved Alexandria landmark and a notable spot even for locals.
address: 9 Omar Ibn El Khattab Group, El Sayed Mohamed Karim St, Commercial Market, Mosques Square, Abu El Abbas El Morsi, Bahary, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Alexandria Ancient Roman Theater
description: The Roman Theater at Kom el-Dikka is a remarkably preserved ancient amphitheater, the only one of its kind in Egypt, set in a site that also includes baths, a town square, and a Roman villa, with helpful explanatory signage. It lets you wander the ruins at your own pace and truly feel your way back in time, making it well worth a visit.
address: Ismail Mahanna Rd, in front of Misr Railway Station, Kom El Dikka Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21517

name: Roman Villa of the Birds
description: The Villa of the Birds, within the Roman Theater grounds, is a jewel of the archaeological site, famous for its beautifully restored Roman mosaics, columns, and remnants that vividly evoke ancient Roman life. Rarely crowded and genuinely striking, the mosaics make it an unforgettable, worthwhile stop.
address: 54 Safia Zaghloul St, El Mesalla Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: Serapeum of Alexandria
description: The Serapeum, set in a scenic, very local part of town a short walk from the train station, is an ancient sacred site with a quiet, moving energy and Pompey's Pillar at its heart. Some find the limited on-site information and neglected upkeep don't justify the ticket, but history lovers appreciate its deep significance.
address: Pompey's Pillar, Al Karah WA at Toubageyah WA Kafr Al Ghates, Karmouz, Alexandria Governorate 5341142

name: Ptolomaeic Roman and Greek Tombs
description: The Catacombs of Kom el-Shoqafa are rock-cut tombs beneath the surface, richly painted and carved, blending Egyptian, Greek, and Roman styles, with above-ground tombs as well. Preservation is uneven, with some chambers flooded or closed, but the architecture and underground experience make it a fascinating visit.
address: 6V2F+RMH, Ibrahim Al Awal Sq., Ras at Tin, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321020

name: Kom el Dikka
description: Kom el-Dikka is one of Alexandria's most rewarding archaeological sites, well laid out for a self-guided tour with bilingual signage, wonderful mosaics, and a section on underwater harbor archaeology. It also hosts night music events with a remarkable atmosphere, making it well worth the price of entry.
address: 5WV3+QVR, Ismail Mahana, Kom Ad Dakah Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371040

name: Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa
description: The Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa are an ancient archaeological site in Alexandria, often counted among the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages. The necropolis blends Egyptian, Greek, and Roman styles, with tombs tunneled into the bedrock during the 2nd century CE. A circular staircase descends to burial chambers used from the 2nd to the 4th century, before the site was rediscovered in 1900. It also includes the Hall of Caracalla, and remains one of the city's most remarkable historical attractions.
address: 12 off Ras El Tin St, Alexandria Governorate

name: Antoniades Palace
description: Antoniades Palace sits within spacious, calm green gardens dotted with magnificent statues, long a beloved family spot for gatherings and picnics. The palace itself is closed and the grounds suffer from neglect and litter, but the historic setting and greenery still draw fond visitors.
address: Izbat Saed Qesm, Sidi Gaber

name: Mustafa Kamel Hellenistic Necropolis
description: The Mustafa Kamel Necropolis is a little-known set of Hellenistic-era rock tombs, discovered by accident and dating back over 22 centuries, tucked among residential buildings. It's hard to find and only partly accessible (three of four tombs), but history enthusiasts find it a genuinely special hidden gem.
address: 6WJX+72X, Al Moaaskar Al Romani, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434044

name: Anfushi Tombs
description: The Anfushi Tombs are among Alexandria's oldest burial sites, Ptolemaic tombs from the 3rd century BC near Qaitbay Citadel, with well-preserved geometric decoration and Egyptian-style frescoes in some chambers. They're modest and poorly lit with limited maintenance, so some feel the entry isn't worth it, but the ancient artwork rewards those who appreciate history.
address: 6V2F+RMW, Ibrahim Al Awal Sq., Ras at Tin, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321020

name: Greek Orthodox Cemetery
description: The Greek Orthodox Cemetery is a beautiful, historically rich monument to Alexandria's 19th and 20th-century Greek community, with intricately sculpted tombs of famous families, including the Cavafy family. It's a peaceful, atmospheric site full of history and well worth a visit for its remarkable sculptures.
address: 6W38+X2C, Suez Canal Rd, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423020

name: El Montaza Gardens
description: El Montaza Gardens are extensive royal gardens in the Montaza district of Alexandria, set around historic palaces overlooking the Mediterranean. With lush greenery, scenic walkways, and sea views, the grounds are a favorite destination for relaxing strolls and family outings.
address: 77 Gamal Abd El-Nasir Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526048

name: Sir. Allenby Garden
description: Sir Allenby Garden is a decent open green space in the narrow Kafr Abdo district, a pleasant escape from busy streets where people walk dogs and play music. It needs better maintenance and cleanliness, but caretakers have improved it in recent years, making it a nice spot for a rest.
address: 6XG4+35P, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433124

name: Al Shalalat Park
description: Al Shalalat Park is one of Alexandria's few remaining historic public parks, a beautiful, peaceful place for a walk with old and rare trees and a calming atmosphere. It could use more cleaning and upkeep, and some visitors feel uneasy about safety and stray dogs, but tree lovers especially enjoy it.
address: 6W37+3RF, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423005

name: Antoniades Gardens
description: Antoniades Gardens is one of Alexandria's most renowned historical landmarks in Smouha, with elegant European-style landscaping, wide green spaces, and classical statues. Recent renovations have revived the grounds, making it a lovely, atmospheric park for families, especially around sunset.
address: Albert El Awal St, Smouha Square, Sidi Gaber

name: kouta park
description: Kouta Park is a small, compact amusement park in Al Maamoura with a variety of affordable rides, mostly geared toward older kids and teens plus a small section for little ones, with helpful staff. It feels a bit worn and in need of refreshing, but it offers a modest, enjoyable outing at budget-friendly prices.
address: El Maamoura Beach, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: El Montazah Park
description: El Montazah Park is a large public park in the Montaza district on the eastern edge of Alexandria. Surrounding the former royal palace grounds, it offers gardens, beaches, and waterfront paths along the Mediterranean, making it one of the city's most popular green retreats.
address: 72PG+293, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Africa Safari Park & Motel
description: Africa Safari Park is a family-friendly drive-through-style zoo where you can explore in your own car and see a wide variety of animals, some roaming freely with keepers handing out food. The animals are generally well cared for and staff are friendly, though some enclosures and cleanliness could be improved, making for a fun day out.
address: 65 Cairo-Alexandria Desert Rd, Alexandria Governorate 5713040

name: Alexandria Zoo
description: Alexandria Zoo is a large, old, inexpensive park where you can feed some animals, but it's unkempt with limited variety. Reviews skew heavily negative on animal welfare, with many describing cramped cages and neglected, distressed animals, so set expectations accordingly.
address: Passage in Antonyades Palace, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432034

name: El Maamoura Amusement Park
description: The Maamoura amusement park is divided into an adult area with many high-adrenaline rides and a smaller kids' section, staying open until late in summer. Many find it overpriced for the experience, with some rides closed and disappointing food, so manage expectations, though thrill-seekers may enjoy the rides.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Kids Park - Smouha Club
description: The Kids Park at Smouha Club is a clean, family-friendly play area (the Octopus Garden) with spotless, plentiful restrooms and a nearby cafe, best suited for children up to about age eight. Some equipment needs mending, but it's a pleasant spot to spend time with family.
address: 6X75+FFG, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080

name: Montaza Palace
description: Montaza Palace is a truly beautiful historic site with stunning architecture, expansive, well-maintained gardens, and gorgeous sea views, explorable on foot or by tour cart. The palace interior is often closed for maintenance, but the grounds and scenery alone make it one of the best gardens to visit in Alexandria.
address: Montaza Palace, El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Al Nozha Park in Alexandria
description: Al Nozha Park is Alexandria's main old zoo-park, very inexpensive with old trees, plenty of space for kids to run, and a modest variety of animals you can sometimes feed up close. It's aging and could use more care, but it remains one of the city's few budget-friendly green escapes.
address: Izbat Saed, Qesm Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432034

name: Saad Zaghloul Park
description: Saad Zaghloul Park is a small historic garden in front of the Steigenberger Cecil Hotel with a beautiful seafront location, a playground, and a picnic area popular with families. It has been neglected and needs maintenance, with sometimes-unclean surroundings and occasional closures, so check before going.
address: 6V2X+9QX, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373001

name: Magic Planet City Centre Alexandria
description: City Centre Alexandria   is a shopping mall located in Alexandria, Egypt, where it opened on 23 January 2003. It was developed and is managed by Majid Al Futtaim Properties. Home to over 160 retail stores, Alexandria City Centre has a gross trading area of 60,370 square meters including anchor stores such as Debenhams, Zara, Max and H&M and 14,771 square meter Carrefour Hypermarket.
address: Kilo 6 Cairo - Alexandria Desert Rd, Qetaa at Tarik as Sahrawi, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5411401

name: Rouka Land Amusement Park
description: Rouka Land is an amusement park with respectful, welcoming staff and very affordable rides (some as little as 10 pounds). Reviews are mixed, with some finding it beautiful and others feeling it needs significant improvement, but the friendly service and low prices stand out.
address: 623C+P2V, Elshohada Square Rd, Khorshid Al Qebleyah, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5445031

name: Al-Silsila Park
description: Al-Silsila Park is a beautiful small seaside garden where the Mediterranean meets the shore, with scenic views and play areas for kids. Some stone seats are partially broken and there are no restrooms, but it's a lovely spot for a relaxing visit by the sea.
address: Alexandria Corniche, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate

name: Frenzy Station
description: Frenzy Station is an indoor-outdoor amusement park that's a paradise for kids, with lots of games, VR, video games, and a soft-play area, requiring a prepaid card to play. It runs a bit expensive and some staff and rides draw complaints, but most families find it keeps children of all ages happily entertained.
address: 6X38+W87, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: Alexandria Stadium Garden
description: The Alexandria Stadium Garden is a beautiful, open public park in a good location next to the historic stadium (the oldest in Egypt and Africa, built in 1929), featuring a statue of Russian writer Mikhail. Free and accessible to all, it's a lovely green spot to enjoy the scenery.
address: 12 Omar Toson, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5370055

name: Happy land park
description: Happy Land is a small, low-priced entertainment park best suited for young children, with a good variety of rides packed into a compact area and a high quality-to-price ratio. Adults may find it underwhelming, but it's a nice, affordable outing for kids up to about age ten.
address: Al Agamy Al Bahri, Dekhela, Alexandria Governorate 5312142

name: Alex Water Park
description: Alex Water Park is described by visitors as a beautiful, quiet, and enjoyable place for children and adults, with excellent service and respectful, welcoming staff. Reviewers consistently praise the friendly treatment and pleasant atmosphere.
address: 2MVJ+F3, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 23511

name: International park Alexandria
description: International Park was built as a large garden for Alexandria and holds fond memories for many, with space for kids to play. It has fallen into neglect and lacks services, so come prepared with food and drinks and visit early or late to avoid the heat; its future has also been clouded by redevelopment concerns.
address: 6 Cairo - Alexandria Desert Rd, Abis, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5411401

name: City Centre Alexandria
description: City Centre Alexandria   is a shopping mall located in Alexandria, Egypt, where it opened on 23 January 2003. It was developed and is managed by Majid Al Futtaim Properties. Home to over 160 retail stores, Alexandria City Centre has a gross trading area of 60,370 square meters including anchor stores such as Debenhams, Zara, Max and H&M and 14,771 square meter Carrefour Hypermarket.
address: Cairo Alex Desert Rd, Qetaa at Tarik as Sahrawi, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5258730

name: Green Plaza Mall
description: Green Plaza is a large outdoor mall with a wide variety of local and international shops, plenty of restaurants and cafes, EV charging stations, and a cinema. Some shops require stepping outside to reach, and the cinema draws complaints about poor picture and sound, but it remains a popular spot for shopping and dining.
address: 14th of May Bridge Rd, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: San Stefano Grand Plaza
description: San Stefano Grand Plaza is a large, upscale mall in one of Alexandria's most premium seafront areas, with a wide range of shops from clothing to electronics and a varied food court. Indoor smoking despite no-smoking signs is a recurring complaint, but the prime location and variety make it a major destination.
address: El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: City Light Mall
description: City Light Mall is a fancy, well-designed shopping center within the City Light complex, with a good range of shops, services, and a loyalty app, though it's not yet fully established. Cleanliness, air conditioning, crowding, and parking directions draw some complaints, but it offers plenty to keep you busy shopping and dining.
address: El Qasem St, El Soyof Shamaa, Third Montaza, Alexandria Governorate 5515140

name: Orouba Mall
description: Orouba Mall, in the King Mariout area, is a large mall with ample parking, varied shops, a Carrefour hypermarket, food options, and a comfortable restaurant, convenient for travelers on the North Coast road. Staff service draws mixed-to-negative reviews and transport access can be tricky, but the parking and variety are pluses.
address: Borg El-Arab Airport - North Coast Rd, ADH Dheraa Al Bahri, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 5217464

name: Matajer Mall
description: Matajer Mall in Smouha stands out for being well-organized, clean, and comfortable, with a good parking garage, a nice kids' play area, and a relaxed, uncrowded feel that's great for family outings. It's still filling up with shops, with several spaces not yet open, but the layout and atmosphere make it pleasant.
address: 51 Mohammed Fawzi Moaz St, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Carrefour
description: Carrefour is a popular hypermarket-anchored mall with nearly everything you need at moderate, fair prices, plus a great food court, cinema, arcade, coffee and dessert shops, and clothing stores. Good air conditioning, clean restrooms, and a safe feel make it a well-liked spot, though it can get crowded and some fresh-food quality is just okay.
address: Alex City Center, Qetaa at Tarik as Sahrawi, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5258730

name: Designia Mall
description: Designia is a clean, elegant mini-mall with amazing decor, plenty of parking, high-end international brands, and good local restaurants and a gourmet food store, nice for breakfast, lunch, or a get-together. It has relatively few stores and can feel a bit bland, but the cozy, discreet atmosphere and dining options please many.
address: 5WFJ+67R, Unnamed Road, Qetaa at Tarik as Sahrawi, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate

name: Deeb Mall, Alexandria
description: Deeb Mall is a long-standing favorite for many regulars, with a variety of accessory shops, a quick food corner, a cinema, a small kids' playground, and a strong section for computers and laptops. It's a reliable, pleasant spot, especially if you're shopping for computer-related items.
address: 1 Syria St, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21311

name: Falaky Center
description: Falaky Center is a downtown shopping mall with many shops, particularly good for women's clothing and accessories. It's narrow and somewhat dim with a more basic feel than fancier malls, so it may leave sophisticated shoppers wanting more, but it's an okay option for casual shopping.
address: 13 Mahmoud Basha St, Mahmoud El Falaki, El Mesalla Gharb & Sherif Basha, Al Attarin

name: The Anime House, Alexandria
description: The Anime House is a well-organized, clean, and aesthetically pleasing shop and a top destination for anime fans, with high-quality, affordable merchandise like manga, action figures, pins, and accessories in unique designs. Most reviewers highly recommend it, though service can be inconsistent, so it's well worth a visit for enthusiasts.
address: 33-35 Zakareya Ghoneim, Al Ibrahimeyah Bahri WA Sidi Gaber, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424071

name: Elmoltaka Mall
description: Elmoltaka Mall is a shopping mall in Alexandria.
address: 6W9V+MMW, Izbat Saed, Qesm Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432069

name: National Mall Salah al-Din
description: National Mall on Salah al-Din is essentially a large, professional market street for car spare parts covering most models, known as one of the cheapest places to find them in Alexandria. Despite the name it isn't a true shopping mall, and parking is very difficult, but it's the go-to spot for auto parts.
address: Salah El Din St, El Attarin, Haret El Wataneya Mall, Alexandria Governorate

name: El Horreya Mall
description: Al-Horreya Mall on Fawzy Moaz Street in Smouha has a great location and covers a range of needs, from food and salons to clothing shops, with specialty stores for bridal furniture and a PlayStation store. It can feel underwhelming and a bit empty at times, but the convenient location and variety are useful.
address: 23 Mohammed Fawzi Moaz, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432050

name: Kiroseiz Mall
description: Kiroseiz Mall is a quiet, clean, welcoming, and compact mall that's mainly home to a small cinema and a large furniture store (High Quality), making it a good spot for browsing furniture ideas. There isn't much else to do there, so it's best for specific visits rather than general shopping.
address: 9 Ibrahim El Sherif St, El Qasem St

name: Games 2 Egypt City Centre Alexandria
description: Games 2 Egypt in City Centre is widely praised as one of the best places to buy PlayStation games, with a huge selection of new and used titles at great prices and kind, helpful staff (Hesham is mentioned by name). Gamers consistently recommend it for both games and accessories.
address: City Centre Alexandria Mall, Gate 4, Cairo Alex Desert Rd, Qetaa at Tarik as Sahrawi, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate 5411401

name: Carpet City Mall
description: Carpet City Mall is a big, clean home-goods destination with a wide range of everything you need for the home, from kitchen gadgets to furnishings, at affordable prices, with very helpful staff across sections. Air conditioning can be lacking on hot days, but the products and Black Friday deals win praise.
address: 24 Belloss El Lagitih, El Ibrahimeya, Bab Sharqi District, Alexandria Governorate

name: Mustafa Kamel - Smouha
description: Mustafa Kamel in Smouha is a quiet, safe area in the Officers' Residences district, full of schools, culture, and diverse shops, especially for clothing, shoes, and toys. The street can get very crowded with limited parking, but it offers a pleasant, well-serviced neighborhood atmosphere.
address: 6W8V+74J, 25-33 Mostafa Kamel, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432066

name: Alexandria National Museum
description: The Alexandria National Museum (ANM) is a museum in Alexandria, Egypt. It was inaugurated the 31 December 2003 by Hosni Mubarak and it is located in a renovated Italian style palace in Tariq Al-Horreya Street (former Rue Fouad). The building used to be home to the United States consulate.
address: 131 El-Shaheed Galal El-Desouky, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423004

name: Greco-Roman Museum
description: The Greco-Roman Museum is a must-visit, beautifully organized museum showcasing Alexandria's rich Greek and Roman past, with a huge collection of rare statues, carvings, and fragments and detailed bilingual plaques. Helpful guides and security round out an amazing experience for anyone who loves history and culture.
address: Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372053

name: Royal Jewelry Museum Alexandria
description: The Royal Jewelry Museum is an art and history museum in Alexandria, housed in the former palace of Princess Fatma Al-Zahra' in the Zizinia neighborhood. Its halls display an exceptional collection of jewels and jewelry from the Muhammad Ali Dynasty, alongside 19th-century paintings, statues, and decorative arts. First inaugurated in 1986, it reopened in 2010 after extensive renovation.
address: 27 Ahmed Yehia, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451010

name: Cavafy Museum
description: Cavafy Museum is an apartment museum in the center of Alexandria, Egypt, which formerly was the residence of the Greek poet Constantine P. Cavafy, where he lived most of his life.
address: 6 off Istanbul St, off Salah Mostafa St, at the end of Cavafy St, 2nd floor, Raml Station, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: Mahmoud Said Museum
description: The Mahmoud Said Museum is a little-visited gem set in the artist's former family residence, actually three museums in one, with a spectacular collection that includes a standout Wanly gallery and a basement worth seeking out. Helpful staff and remarkable art displays make it a highly recommended stop for art lovers.
address: San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451102

name: Museum of Fine Arts, Alexandria
description:
The Alexandria Museum of Fine Arts is a museum for Egyptian and Middle-Eastern fine art in Alexandria, Egypt. Located in the Moharam Bek neighborhood, it houses a collection of works by Egyptian artist and a selection of works from Baroque, Romanticism, Rococo and Orientalism.
In addition, noteworthy examples of carving, printing and sculpture from Egyptian and European artists. The museum aims to promote art to the local community and to a greater extent Egyptian society, through a selection of activities: art workshops, exhibitions and museum education for children; exhibitions for noted Egyptian artists and international cultural exchange activities.
address: 5WW7+38V, El-Mohandes Ahmed Ismail, Emberouz WA Moharram Beik, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5413416

name: Water Biology Exhibition
description: The Marine Life (Water Biology) Exhibition sits within Qaitbay Citadel and displays preserved sea and river species, birds, and a whale skeleton, combined with fascinating citadel chambers and fantastic sea views. Some feel the displays are more specimens than living exhibits and the ticket feels steep for foreigners, but the historical setting and views are a highlight.
address: 6V7P+728, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321431

name: The Archaeological Museum in the Bibliotheca Alexandria
description: The Antiquities Museum inside the Bibliotheca Alexandrina is a well-preserved, nicely displayed museum with collections spanning Roman, Islamic, and ancient Egyptian artifacts, conveniently part of the main library complex. Often bundled with library admission, it's a worthwhile stop while visiting the Bibliotheca.
address: 13 El Zarkashi St, Al Azarita & El Shatby, Bab Sharqi District, Alexandria

name: Ras el Soda Temple
description: Ras el Soda Temple is a small Greco-Roman temple originally built by a Roman charioteer as thanks to Isis for healing his broken foot, later relocated to its current spot. It isn't fully open to the public, but you can view it from outside the fence and take nice photos from the pedestrian bridge above.
address: 6W39+7GR, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423020
